Wahlanganisa titende letisihlanu ngasinye, wahlanganisa titende lesixhenxe ngasinye.
Wakwenza tingulube tamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ekugcineni kwetindlovu yesibili, kanye naletinye tindlovu tamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ekupheleni kwetindlovu yesibili.
Wakwenza tintambo tesiliva letimashumi lamabili nesihlanu, kutsi afake itenti linye nelinye, ibe yisinye.
Wakwenza netindzaba tesikhumba sema-orenji letibomvu, wazenza netindzaba tesikhumba sema-orenji lamahhashi, wazenza netindzaba tesikhumba sema-orenji lamhlophe.
Wakwenza netingcezu tesihlahla se-akademu, wabeka phezulu etentini lengcwele.
Ibhokisi ngalinye lalinebude bemamitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu kanye nesentimitha lesishiyagalolunye bubanzi.
Nalemikhono lemine nemilenze lengema-20, kanye naletintambo letimbili; ngaleyo ndlela wazenza tonkhe tinyawo tetenti.
Wakwenza tibhodi letimashumi lamane ecaleni lesempumalanga letabernakele.
Wayakwenza tinyawo tesiliva letimashumi mane ngaphansi kwetibhodi letintsatfu, tinyawo letingabambili phansi kwelinye letibobho, netinyawo tingabambili ngaphansi kwelinye ibhokisi.
Nakwecala lelinye, kwecala lasenyakatho letabernakele, wakwenza tibhodi letilishumi nambili.
kanye netibondza tesiliva lama-40, tibhotsi letimbili ngaphansi kwelinye ibhokisi.
Naye wakwenza tibhodi lesishiyagalombili kuleyo ndawo yekuphumula, ecaleni lasenyakatho.
Wakwenza netingcezu letintsatfu, kutsi tibe tindzawo letiphakeme temnyango wendlu yasebukhosini.
Nalemigodzi lemibili, imilenze yato yayiphindwe kabili kusuka phansi kuya phezulu, ibe yiringi lelinye; ngaleyo ndlela wayenza imigodzi lemine.
Akukhona khona tibhodi letisikhombisa, netibondza tesiliva lama-16; tinyawo letintsatfu ngaphansi kwelinye libhokisi.
Wakwenza netimbhoshongo tesihlahla se-akademu, talishumi elinesihlanu emabhokisini esinye sentshonalanga yetenti,
lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu emacwecwe ecaleni lelinye, namakhulu lamabili nesihlanu emacwecwe ecaleni lasenyakatho.
Wayenza imilenze lephakathi, yafika kuze ifike esiphelweni sentshonalanga kuya esiphelweni sentshonalanga, yafika emilenzeni yetibombo.
Wabeka emabhokisi esiliva negolide, wakwenza tikhonjiso tesiliva negolide kutsi kufakwe kuwo lamahlombe; wabeka emabhodlela esiliva negolide.
Wakwenza ifasitela lelinemibala yegolide, neyesiliva, neyesibhakabhaka, kanye nelinen elibomvu elincibilikisiwe; wayenza ngemakerubi, abe ngumsebenzi wesandla.
Wayenza imilenze lemine yesihlahla se-akademu, wayibopha ngegolide, wazenza tikhontsi tayo tegolide, wakhipha tindzawo letiphansi tesiliva letine.
Bayawukhipha umhlobiso wendlu, bawumisa emafasitela emnyango wetenti, bewenza ngegolide, nesiliva, nesilivere, nelinen lelihlanganisiwe, bekwenza lomsebenzi lomusha.
Waye wakwenza imilenze lemine, nemingcambu yayo, ebusweni besitayela; wabeka golide emaphiko emilenze kanye netigcondza sayo, wazenza izibambo taso letisihlanu zesiliva.

Besaleleli wayalela ibhokisi legolide, wayenza ngesihlahla se-acacia; ubude bayo bube ngumasentimitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, nebubanzi bawo bube ngumasentimitha lamakhulu lasitfupha, nebuphakeme bawo bube ngumasentimitha lamakhulu lasikhombisa.
Wayibopha ngegolide lelihle, ngasenceleni nangaphandle, wayenza nemingcambu yegolide yaso.
Wayikhipha imilenze lemine yegolide, wamisa emilenzeni yayo lemine; imilenze lemibili ecaleni elinye, nemilenze lemibili ehlangothini lwelinye.
Wakwenza netibondza tesihlahla se-akati, watiwa ngegolide.
Wabeka tintambo emacwecwe emacala lasengato lebhokisi, kutsi ligqokwe.
Wakwenza nendlu yekuphumula yegolide lemhlophe; ubude bayo bube ngumasentimitha lasitfupha, nebubanzi bawo bube ngumasentimitha lasikhombisa.
Wakwenza ema-kerubi lasitfupha, egolide lelihlanganiswe ngesandla, abekwe emigwaqeni lemibili yesipho.
wabeka kerubi kwelinye icala, nekerubi lelinye ecaleni lelinye; wakwenza lamakerubi naleso sibuko sibe yinhlanganisela.
Lama-kerubi aphindze abe nemilenze yakhe ihlanganisiwe phezulu, evikela isipho ngemilenze yawo; lamehlo abo ayebhekene naleso sipho.
Wakwenza netafula lelinemikhono lengema-20, libanzi lingu-15, neliphakeme lingu-30; wayenza ngetinyawo tegolide letilishumi.
Wayibopha ngegolide lelihle, wayenza imilenze yegolide ngaso sonke sinye.
Wayenza imilenze yakhe ibe ngububanzi besandla esisodwa, wabeka icala legolide emilenjeni yayo.
Wayikhipha imilenze lemine yegolide, wabeka imilenze yalegolide emakhoneni lamane, lapho tinyawo letine takhona.
Lezingcweti zafika kuleyo nhloko, kutsi zibambe tintambo letisebentiswa ekuthwaleni itafule.
Wakwenza tintambo tesihlahla se-akademu, wazibabeka ngegolide, kutsi babambe itafule.
Wakwenza nezinto takhe letibekwe entafuleni, tidlandza zayo, netinkomishi zayo, netimbhoshongo zayo, netibopho zalo, kutsi licwebezeleke ngalo limnikelo lokushiswayo, wazenza ngegolide lengcwele.
Wayenza intambo yemlilo ibe ngugolide lomhlophe, wayenza ngesandla sakhe; isisekelo sayo kanye nenhloko yaso ayibopha ngesandla sakhe; tigodzi tayo, namakhopho ayo, namatfuba ayo, kwabe kuyinye.
Lamandla lasikhombisa aphuma emigwaqeni yayo, lamandla lasitfupha emigwaqeni yalelinye, nemandla lasitfupha emgwaqeni walelinye.
Lamacala lamane ngalinye lalaba ngutimbili letifana nesihlahla se-alfalfa, nalabo timbali kanye netimbali, kulawo macala.
Naleso sibhakabhaka sakubo sekube khona tigodzi letintsatfu letifana nesihlahla sema-almonela, netinhlamvu taso kanye netikhongo.
Nalapho kwaphuma khona isihlahla ngaphansi kwesinye sihlahla, nesihlahla ngaphansi kwesinye sitshalo, nesihlahla ngaphansi kwesinye sitshalo; sihlahla lesishiyagalolunye saphuma kuyo.
Lamahlombe ayo nemilenze yakhe yabe yinye, ibe ngumnikelo wekushiswa wegolide lohle.
Wakwenza netinhlamvu taso lesitsatfu, namatinji ayo, namatinji akhe, abe ngugolide lomhlophe.
Wasebenzisa ema-decimita lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu egolide lelihle, wayenza intambo yemlilo kanye naleyo mikhono.

Wayenza i-altari yekufakelwa umlilo ngesihlahla se-akademu, ibe lisaka; ubude bayo bube ngumasentimitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, nebubanzi bawo bube ngumasentimitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, nebude bayo bube ngumasentimitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu.
Wayibeka ngegolide elihlanzekile, nemilenze yayo yonke, namahlombe ayo, wayenza intambo yegolide yinye ngayinye.
Wakwenza tikhonjiso letimbili tegolide ngaphansi kwegobolondo, emaceleni layo lahlukene, kutsi kufakwe khona tintambo lokuyihambisa.
Wakwenza tintambo tesihlahla se-akademu, wazisa ngegolide.
Wakwenza namafutha ekuncibilikisa angcwele, netfunyo lemhlophe yephunga lelimnandi, ngesandla somcweti.

Wakha ne altare yemnikelo wekushiswa, wayenza ngesihlahla se-akademu, ibe yisikwele; ubude bayo bube ngukumashumi lamabili nesihlanu emilenze, nebubanzi bawo bube ngukumashumi lamabili nesihlanu emilenze, nebude bayo bube ngukumashumi lamabili nesihlanu emilenze.
Waye wakhipha isandla sakhe, watsi: "Ngisho naleso sibhakabhaka sendlu yaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, sitawusifaka embhedeni wakhe.
Wakwenza naletinye tindzawo letiphakeme tekudla, letifana netinkomishi, netimbhoshongo, netibondza, netigcawu, nematiko emlilo, kutsi tibe ngesiliva.
Wayenza negreta ye altare, igreta leyenziwe ngesiliva, wayibeka ngaphansi kwesokudla se-altare, yafika esiphelweni.
Wakhipha tikhonkolo tesiliva nelibomvu letine, aze azifake emagundleni lamane ebhokisi lesiliva nelibovu, njengetikhonkolo tetibobo.
Wazenza tintambo tesihlahla se-akademu, wazibabeka ngesiliva.
Wabeka tintambo emacwecweni emacala laleyo ndawo yekushiswa, kutsi ibe ngumnikelo wekushiswa. Wayenza ibe yindilinga, yakhiwa ngetibhodi.
Wakwenza nelitshani lelibomvu, nesisekelo saso selibomvu, wasebenzisa tibhaka-bhaka letibomvu tabesifazane labasebenza emgwaqeni wetenti lekuhlangana.
Wakwenza nendlu yangasemgwaqeni; inhloko yayo, ecaleni lasempumalanga, yamamitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, ibe nendawo yetingcweti telinen lelihlanganisiwe.
Kube netimbhoshongo letimashumi lamane, netibondza tesiliva letimashumi lamane; tikhonjiswe ngesilivere, netingcweti tato.
Nasekwecaleni lasenyakatho, ubude bawo bube ngumamitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, nalapho kwabekhona tikhontsi letilishumi nembili kanye netibopho tesiliva lelikhulu.
Ecaleni lelingugwaja, ububanzi bawo bube ngumasentimitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu; bekukhona khona tingwevu letilishumi, netinyawo letintsatfu, natikhonjiswe ngegolide.
Lengxenye yasempumalanga, lapho kuphuma khona lilanga, yabe inemamitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ebukhulu.
Ngelinye icala lemnyango kwakukhona tingwevu letimamitha lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ngebude, natinhloko tesikhombisa kanye netibondza tesikhombisa.
Ngelinye icala lomngcele wendlu yangasemgwaqeni kwabekhona namatindlela amamitha lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa bude, abenetimbhoshongo tesihlanu kanye netibondza tesitfupha.
Lonke lifasitela lelingumhlabatsini lwabe lenziwe ngelinen emhlophe encibilikile.

Nalemiganga lemikhulu yayiyigolide, namatigodzi ayo abeyisiliva, netikhonjiso tabo babeyisiliva, netinhlavu tawo zatiwa ngesilivere; natikhonjiso temiganga yendlu yangasemgwaqeni zonke zatiwa silivere.

Nasekungeneni kwendlu yangaphandle kwabekhona umgodzi wegolide, nesiliva, nesilivere, nelinen lelihlanganisiwe, ekwenziweni kwayo kwaba ngumsebenzi womhlobiso; wamamitha lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa ubude bawo, namamitha lasitfupha nesihlanu ubude bawo, ngaleyo ndlela kube sekwefana nemiganga yendlu yangaphandle.
Imihlobiso yayo yabe imilenze lemine, netibondza lamane esiliva; tikhontsi tayo kanye netigcawu tayo zabe zesilivere, netinhloko tayo zabeka ngesilivere.
Nabo bonkhe bantfu bendlu yasebukhosini, kanye nebantfu bendzawo yengcwelengcwele, babenetintambo tegolide.
Lolu linani lezinto letisetshenziswa embhedeni longcwele, embhedeni womhlangano, lapho babhalwa khona ngemtsetfo waMosesi, nguLevi, ngaphansi kwesandla sa-Ithamari, unyana ka-Aron, umpristi.
Beseleleli, umsa wa-Uri, usitukulwane sa-Huri, waseSubeni laYuda, wabambisene nabo kutsi abe ngumnikelo wesono.
Neye wahlala naye Oholiyabi, umsa wa-Ahisamakhi, wasemndenini waDani, umcweti wemihlobiso, umdlovukazi, lowenza ingubo yegolide, neyesiliva, neyesibhakabhaka, neyegolide lelihlanganisiwe.
Legolide lonke lelihlanganisiwe, lelihlanganiswe kumsebenti wemhlabatsi longcwele, lalikhulu elinamaphesenti lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu lamashekeli, ngesisindo semhlabatsi longcwele.
Lesiliva lelihlanganisiwe, lelihlanganiswe kubo bonkhe bantfu bebandla, lafika kumashumi lamabili nesihlanu emilenze yegolide, ngegolide lengcwele.

Lenani lalelo libe ngubeka, inhlamvu yeshekeli ngasinye, nge shekeli yesingcwele, kulowo nalowo lobalwa kubo, labaneminyaka lemashumi lamabili nesikhombisa nangaphezulu, labamakhulu mane, lamakhulu amathathu, lamakhulu mahlanu, namakhulu mahlanu.

Lesiliva lelingaba ngumashumi lamakhulu lamabili nesihlanu lama-denaries, yafakwa ekudlaleni tindzawo letiphakeme kanye netetinyawo tefasitela: tinyawo letingama-100; ngayinye yetibondza ilikhulu elinama-250 ema-denaries.
Lesiliva lelihlanganisiwe layawuyisebenzisa ekwenzeni tikhontsi tetimbhoshongo, nekufaka phezulu tikhontsi, nekwenza tintambo tato.
Lesiliva leliniketwe njengemnikelo wesono lalingaba ngumashumi lamabili nesihlanu emashekeli.
Ngaleyo golide wakhipha tinyawo temnyango wetenti lekuhlangana, ne altare yesiliva, ne-gridi yayo yesiliva, nezinto zayo zonke;
kanye netibondza tendlu yasemhlabatsini, kanye nemnyango wayo, kanye naletinye tikhonjiso tendlu yasengcwele, netenti lelinetikhonjiso lijikeleze.
Bayakwenza ngegolide, nesiliva, nesilivere, negolide lelibomvu, ingubo zokuhlobisa, kutsi basebenze kuyo lendawo yasengcwele; bayenze neingubo zakungcwele za-Aron, njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose.
UBesaleleli wayenza i-ephod yegolide, nesiliva, negolide lelibomvu, nesilivere, nelinen lelihlanganisiwe.
Babeka legolide emacwecwe, bacota imilenze yegolide, bayisa etinsini letimnyama, netinsini tesiliva, netinsini tegolide, netinsini tesiliva, netinsini tesiliva, netinsini tegolide.
Wayenza nemilenze yesandla se-ephod, wayibeka emakhoneni layo lambili, ukuze ibandlululwe.

Nalentambo yakhe yayikhipha, wayenza ibe yinye nayo, yesiliva, negolide, negolide lemnyama, negolide lemhlophe, negolide lesimthubi, nesiliva, negolide lelihlanganisiwe; akazange ayenze ngendlela yakhe, njengoba Simakadze abewisela Mose.
Babeka ematshe e-onyx emigodini yegolide, babhala kuwo amagama lamadvodzana a-Israyeli, njengobe umhlobisi wegolide abhalela uphawu.
Wazibeka emehlweni esandla se-ephod, njengetikhontsi lokukhumbula lamakhosikazi aseSirayeli, njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose.
Wakwenza isandla, sakhiwa ngesandla, njenge-ephod, segolide, nesibhakabhaka, nesingwevu, nesinambithe, nelinen lelihlanganisiwe.
Yabe yinye, ihlukaniswe kabili, ibe nebude bemamitha lamashumi lamabili namane kanye nebukhulu bemitha lamakhulu mane.
Wabeka phezu kwayo izingcezu letintsatfu tegolide, izingcezu letinhlanu tesiliva nelibomvu, izingcezu letintsatfu tesilivere, netingcezu letinegolide.
Esigabeni sesibili kwakungu-turquoise, nesapphire, nesmeralda.
Esigabeni lesithathu kwakukhona i-hyacinth, ne-agate, ne-amethyst.
Esigabeni sesine kwakungu-chrysolite, ne-onyx, ne-jasper; kwabekwa emacwecwe egolide.

Lamacwecwe lalaba ngumakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa, alingana namagama emadvodzana a-Israyeli; ngalinye licwecwe ngegama lakhe, njengobe licwecwe lesandla, kutsi libe yitfunywa lelikhulu nemashumi lamabili.
Bayawukwenza ngetintambo, basebentisa igolide lelingenamsoco, kutsi bafake embhedeni.
Wakwenza netinhlamvu letimbili tegolide, netingcweti letintsatfu tegolide, wabeka tintingcweti emakhoneni lamakhulu mahlanu esandla.
Bafaka lemikhono lemibili yegolide emacwecwe lamakhulu lasitfupha emacwecwe lalishumi elinesihlanu emacwecwe lalishumi elinesikhombisa.
Lamacala lamanye ezinhlamvu zatiwa emabhokisini lalawo mabini, wabeka kuwo emaphiko emilenze ye-ephod ngaseceleni kwayo.
Wakwenza netingcweti letimbili tegolide, wazisa emakhoneni lawo lasitfupha ebhokisini lemlilo, kuleyo ndawo ibekwe kuyo i-ephod.
Bayawukwenza netingcweti letimbili tegolide, batawuzibeka emaceleni emilenze ye-ephod, ngasempumalanga yayo, lapho ihlangana khona naleyo mikhono leyimqoka.

Bayibopha imilenze yesifuba ngemilenze ye-ephod ngentambo yesibhakabhaka, ukuze imilenze ibe phezulu kuleyo mikhono leyimqoka, nengeke ihlukaniswe ne-ephod; njengobegtigcawu taSimakadze zaphendvula Mose.
Wakwenza nemicaba ye-ephod, yaso sonke sakhiwa ngesandla segolide.
Ngaseceleni kwegobolondo kwabekhona umlomo, lofana negobolondo, nalapho khona kwabekhona umsoco wegolide, ngobe angeke ahlukaniswe.
Bayawukwenza ema-granates ensimini yemanti lamnyama, neyegolide, neyesibhakabhaka, nelineni lelihlanganisiwe.
Baphindze bakhipha tingulube tegolide lelimfishane, bababeka phakathi kwetimbali te-granate, ngaso sonke isibambo semanti.
Kube nezinhlamvu kanye nesihlahla se-granate, netinhlamvu kanye nesihlahla se-granate, ngaso sonke isibambo segobho, kutsi kube ngumnikelo wekushiswa; njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose.
Wakwenza na-Aron nemadvodzana akhe ingubo tesiliva lelitshani, eliboshwe ngegolide.
kanye netinhlavu telinen lelihlanganisiwe, netikhobote telinen lelihlanganisiwe, netibombo telinen lelihlanganiswe.
Wayenza intambo yegolide, neyesiliva, neyesibhakabhaka, neyesingwevu, eyenziwe ngesandla, ibe ngumnikelo wekushiswa, njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose.
Baphikisa ibhokisi, inhloko yengcwele, ngegolide elifihliwe, babhalela kuyo, njengencwadi lebhalwe ngenhlamvu: "Lingcwele kuSimakadze."
Bayibeka ngentambo yegolide, bayibeke phezu kwemivimbo, njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose.
Bafike bamisa yonke lemisebenzi yetenti lesingcwele, itenti lesingumhlangano; bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli babeyenza, njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose.
Bafike banikela kuMosese tabernakele, tabernakele kanye nezinto zalo zonke, nemacici alo, namabhokisi alo, nembhoshongo wakhe, nemikhono yakhe, netibondza lakhe;
kanye netinhlavu tesikhumba sengulube lesibomvu, netinhlavu tesikhumba sengulube lesinconywe kahle, nesitayela sokuvikela ibhokisi;
ibhokisi lesivumelwane, netimbhoshongo taso, naletindlundzeli taso;
inkomishi kanye naletinye tisebenti tayo, nemnikelo wekushiswa;
nesitayela segolide lesingenamsoco, nesitayela sayo semakhandlela, naletinye tive tayo, namafutha ekukhanya;
i-altari yegolide, nephethroli yekupondza, nefutsi lelinephunga lelirozi, nesitayela semnyango wetenti;
i-altari yesiliva nelisegolide, nemgodzi wayo wesiliva, nemacwecwe ayo, naletinye tindzawo letiphakeme tayo; kanye nemgodzi wekudla kanye nesisekelo sawo;

namatindlela emphini, netimkhonto tayo, netibondza tabo, naletingwevu temnyango wemphini, netentambo tayo, netimbhoshongo tayo, naletinye tintfwalo letifanele kumsebenti wema-tabernakele longcwele, itente lekuhlangana;
kanye netibondza lokuboshweko, lokusetjenziswa ethempelini, netibondza lokungcwele ku-Aron, umLevi, netibondza lamadvodzana akhe, lokubetjelwa kwabo emkhondweni wenkhosi.
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli akazange abe nenkinga, ngobe Simakadze abemphendvula watsi: "Lamadodana e-Israyeli angeke abe nenkinga.
Mose wabheka yonke lemisebenzi, watsi: "Kungenjalo kutsi Simakadze abewiselile; ngobe bayawuyenza." Ngako-ke Musa wababarisile.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosesi watsi:
Emhla wokuqala wenyanga yekucala, utawumisa tabernakele longcwele, itente lekuhlangana.
Uyawubeka khona ibhokisi lesivumelwano, utawufaka ngaphambili kwebhokisi lesivumelwano itenti lokufihlakele, kutsi ligcinwe.
Ngeza netafula, ulungiselele kutsi libekwe phezulu; bese ungena nesitayela selanga, ulungiselele tilanga zalo.
Utawubeka i-altari yegolide yekufuya phambi kwebhokisi lesivumelwano, uphindze ubeke itenti emnyango wetente lengcwele.
Le altare yemnikelo wekushiswa uyawuyibeka phambi komnyango wetenti lesingcwele, etente lekuhlangana.
Ngeke ubeke umgodzi phakathi kwetenti lekuhlangana ne-altari, utsuse amanzi kuwo.
Utawumisa lendlu yasesitezi ngaso, ubeke ifasitela emgwaqeni wendlu yasesitezi.
Take umsi wekuphetsela, uyiphetse itente lengcwele, nezinto tonkhe letikhona kulo; uyibeke njengengcwele, nayo yonke imfuyo yayo, ibe ngcwele.
"Utawumisa i-altari yemnikelo wekushiswa kanye nezinto zayo tonkhe, uyawuyingcwelesa, ibe yingcwele kakhulu.
Unciphise i-altare kanye nesitayela sayo, ube ngungcwele kubo.
Lalela uAron nemadvodzana akhe kutsi bafike emgwaqeni wetente lekuhlangana, bese ubahlamba ngamanzi.
Lala Aharonhi ingubo lengcwele, uyamfafaze, wamisa kutsi abe ngumnikelo wesono, aze asebenze kimi njengenkhosi.
Nifike nifikeni nemadvodzana akhe, nibagqoke ngetinti.
Utawubapha umnikelo wekushiswa, njengobe wampha ubaba wabo, kutsi basebenze kimi njengenkhosi; lomnikelo wabo wesono utawubafaka ebukhosini babo kuze kube sekupheleni.
Mosesi wakwenza njalo, njengobe Simakadze abemwisile.
Lendlu yaSimakadze yabekwa ngemnyaka wesitsatfu, ngelilanga lokuqala lenyanga yekucala.
UMosi wehla itabernakele, wabeka emabhukwana ayo, wafaka tikhontsi tayo, wabeka imijovo yayo, wabeka tikhontsi tayo, wabeka tinhloko tabo.
Wamisa itenti phezu kwendlu lengcwele, wabeka ingubo yetenti phezu kwayo, njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose.
Wathatha tibhodi tesivumelwano, wazisa ngaphakathi ebhokisini, wabeka emabhubesi ebhokisini, wabeka isipho sekuthula esiphezulu kwebhokisi.
Wabeka ibhokisi lesivumelwane esingcweleni, wafaka ifasitela lesifihla-buso, wavala ibhokisi lesivumelwano, njengobe Simakadze abemwise Mose.
UMosese wabeka itafula etentini lekuhlangana, ngakwesokudla kwetafuleni lengcwele, ngasenyakatho, ngaphandle kwemgoqo.
wamisa khona inhlama phambi kwaSimakadze, njengobe Simakadze abemwise Mose.
Wabeka nesitayela semlilo etentini lekuhlangana, ngasekudla kwetafula, ecaleni lesikhungweni lesingcwele, eningizimu.
wamisa netinhlamvu phambi kwaSimakadze, njengobe Simakadze abemwisele umthetho.
UMosese wabeka inhloko yegolide etentini lekuhlangana, phambi kwetibuko.
wamisa phezu kwayo umnikelo wekushiswa wesono lesimnandi, njengobe Simakadze abewuphendvula Moiseya.
Wabeka itenti emnyango wetente lengcwelengcwele, watsi:
Wabeka i-altari yemnikelo wekushiswa emgwaqeni wetenti lesingcwele, letenti lekuhlangana, wanikela phezu kwayo ngeminikelo yekushiswa neyekudla, njengobe Simakadze abemwisile.
Wabeka umgodzi phakathi kwetenti lekuhlangana ne altare, wafaka khona amanzi lokuhlamba.
Waphuma khona uMosese na-Aron nemadvodzana akhe, bahlamba isandla sabo nenyawo labo.
Bengena etentini lekuhlangana, bese befika emgodini, bahlamba, njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose.
UMosesi wehlisa nendlu yasesitezi ngaseceleni kwetenti lengcwele kanye ne altare, wabeka ifasitela emgwaqeni wendlu yasesitezi; watsi uMosesi aphele umsebenzi.
Lefu lelingu-120, likhulu elinamaphesenti lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa (57.38%) ligcwele igolide kanye nemacwecwe esiliva nalamatshe.
Musa akazange afike etentini lekuhlangana, ngobe umfudlane ubewuhlala phezu kwalo, nekuthula kweSimakadze bekugcwele itente lengcwele.
Kuphela lapho umfudlane uphuma khona entabeni, labaSirayeli bahamba, kuwo wonke lokuhamba kwabo.
Nasekube umfudlana ungeke wehla, bangahambanga kuze kube ngusuku lapho ehle khona.
Lelifu leSimakadze laliba phezu kwetenti ngelilanga, nemlilo waba ngaphansi kwalo ngebusuku; kwabonakala kubo bonkhe bantfu baka-Israyeli kuwo onke amasiko abo.
Lev: USimakadze watsi kuMosi, wakhuluma naye etentini lekuhlangana, watsi:
"Ukhulume nalabaSirayeli, utsi kubo: 'Uma umuntu ngamunye wenu enikela ngesondlo kuSimakadze, kumele afike abe nenyama yesilwane, noma ingulube yakho, noma inkomo yakho.
Uma mnikelo wakhe wesono usuka ekudlaneni, kufanele kube ngumkhwenyana longenankinga; kumele awunikese emgwaqeni wetenti lekuhlangana, kutsi uSimakadze ayawuwuthanda.
Utawubeka isandla sakho phezu kwehlavu lenyama, ibe ngumnikelo wekushiswa, umnikelo wesono, umnikelo wesono.
Uyawubulala inkunzi yengulube phambi kwaSimakadze, bese bonyana baka-Aron, bantfu labangcwele, banikela ngegazi, belisa negazi phezu kwe altare, emnyango wetenti lekuhlangana, ngaso sonke isikhathi.
Lapha, khipha isikhumba sesilwane bese uyishiya ibe ngamake.
Lamadvodza la-Aron, umLevi, atawukhipha umlilo enhliziyweni yemnikelo wekushiswa, abe nemanti emhlabatsini.
Batawumisa emacwecwe, nenhloko, naleso sifutfu, ngesandla sabo, phezu komlilo wesihlahla esibekwe emnyango.
Lemisipha kanye nemilenze kumele ihlanzwe ngamanzi, bese umnikelo wesono uyawuwukhipha onke ema-altari; iyisondlo lesisondzayo, yimnikelo wekushiswa lonomsoco kuSimakadze.
Uma imnikelo wayo wekushiswa usuka ema-odini, ngekudla kwengulube noma ngekudla kwegodzi, kumele kube ngumkhwenyana longeke abe nenkinga.
Uyawuyibulala ecaleni lelihhovisi, ngasenyakatho, phambi kwaSimakadze; nemadvodzana a-Aron, labaLevi, kumele bafafaze igazi layo phezu lehhovisi, lijikeleze.
Uya kuyisa emacwecwe ayo, kanye nenhloko yayo, nalesifuba sayo; umnikelo wesono uyawumisa kuwo emacwecwe emlilo abekwe phezu kwendlu yase-Altari.

Lemisipha kanye nemilenze kumele ihlanzwe ngamanzi, bese umnikelo wesono uyawunikela kuwo wonke lamandla akhe, uyawuwukhipha emgodini; iyimnikelo wekushiswa, yiminikelo yekushiswa, yephunga lelihle kuSimakadze.
Uma imnikelo wayo wekushiswa kuSimakadze ube yingulube, utawunikela ngaye ngegobolondo, nome ngegobolondo lelincane.
Waye umnikelo wesono, umnikelo wekushiswa, umnikelo wema-Amori; umLevi umnikelo wesono, umnikelo wesive, umnikelo wekudla, umnikelo wesono.
Uyawukhipha isikhumba sayo kanye nemilenze yayo, utawuyifaka ecaleni lelihhovisi, ngasenyakatho-mpumalanga, lapho kufakwa khona inkungu.

Waye ayawuwugoqa ngemilenze yakhe, kodvwa angeke awuhlukanise ngokuphelele; ngobe umnikelo wesono utawuwushiswa ngumnikelo wesono esitsheni lesingcwele, phezu kwesihlahla esisemlilo; yisondlo lesisondzako, imnikelo wekushiswa, lomphunga lomnandi kuSimakadze.
Uma umuntu enikela ngemnikelo wesono kuSimakadze, kufanele kube ngumnikelo wesonka sesiliva; kumele afake phezu kwawo umsi kanye netfufu.

Uyakulethela kubo-Aharonhi, lamadvodzana a-Aaroni, labaLevi; uLevi kumele athathe isandla sakhe sigcwele saleyo mifino kanye naleyo mafuta, kanye netfunyo yakhe yonke, abe yimnikelo wekushiswa ethempelini; ngumnikelo wesono lokuhle kuSimakadze.
Lokudla lokushiywe kuyawuba ngu-Aron nemadvodzana akhe; kuyinto lengcwele kakhulu, yinye yetibopho letishiswako taSimakadze.
Uma unikela ngesondlo sekudla esiphekwe efrijini, kufanele kube ngumnikelo wesono longena-layisi, wokudla lokuhlanganisiwe nephethroli, noma mnikelo wesono longena-lasisi, lowetshiwe nephethroli.
Uma mnikelo wakho wesono uphekwa embhedeni, kumele ube ngukudla lokuhlanganisiwe nemafutha, lokungabi nemfulawa.
Uyawuyiphula ibe tindzawo letiphakeme tekudla, utawuyisa ngemafutha; iyimnikelo wesono.
Uma mnikelo wakho wesono uphekiwe emgodini, kumele ube ngumnikelo wekushiswa lowenziwe ngefulawa.
Uyawunikela ngemnikelo wesono, lowenziwe ngalezinto, kuSimakadze; utawuwunikela kumLevi, aze awunike ema-altare.
Waye umnikelo wesono, umkhonzi wakhe utawuwukhipha, abe ngumnikelo wekushiswa esihlalweni sebukhosi; yiminikelo yekushiswa, ivumba lelihle kuSimakadze.
Lokudla lokushiywe kuyawuba ngu-Aron nemadvodzana akhe; kuyinto lengcwele kakhulu, yinye yetibopho letishiswako taSimakadze.
Akukho mnikelo wesono niyawunikela kuSimakadze, ungeke ube nekudla lokuphekwe ngefulawa; ngeke nidle noma yini yekudla lokuphekwe ngefulawa, noma ijusi, njengeminikelo yekushiswa kuSimakadze.
Ningeke nizinike kuSimakadze njengemnikelo wesono, njengento yokuqala yekudla kwenu; kepha akufanele ziboshwe emgodini, njengephunga lelihle.
Kuso sonke isidlo sengcubu, utawufaka umhluzi; ungawushiyanga umhluzi wesivumelwano saNkulunkulu wakho esonkeni sakho sekudla; kuso sonke isidlo sakho utawubeka umhluzi.
Uma unikela ngemnikelo wesono kuSimakadze, ngezinto takuqala tekudla kwakho, utawunikela ngemifino emhlophe, ecutshungulwe emlilweni, nenyama yengulube.
Wafaka kuwo umsi, wabeka kuyo nefutfu; ngumnikelo wesono.
Waye umnikelo wesono, kanye nesondlo saso sekudla, naleso sibhakabhaka lesingenamsindvo lesasingemagremu lamashumi lamabili nesishiyagalombili; lomnikelo wekushiswa nguSimakadze.
Uma umuntu enikela ngemnikelo wesono, emhlambini wema-Israyeli, inkunzi noma inja, ngeke ibe necala, uma inikela ngayo kuSimakadze.
Aye abeke isandla sakhe phezu kwehlavu lenyama, aze ayikhwele emgwaqeni wetenti lekuhlangana; nemadvodzana a-Aron, labaLevi, kumele bafafaze legazi phezu kwe altare jikelele.
Waye afike abe ngumnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze, lomnikelo wesono sesondlo sokuthula: lokudla lokushisayo lokugcobisa imithambo-luvo, kanye nalokudla lokushisayo lokusemithambo-luvo,
kanye nemilenze lemibili, nemafutha ayo abekwe phezu kwayo, naleyo mikhono lemincane yesifo sikashukela, layawuwakhipha kanye nemilenze.
Lamadvodza la-Aron ayawuwushiswa kuwo ema-altari, phezu kwesondlo sokudla esicutshungulwa ngemlilo; yimnikelo wekushiswa wephunga lelihle kuSimakadze.
Uma enikela ngemnikelo wakhe wesono kuSimakadze, esuka emihlambini, indvuna noma inja, ngeke ibe nenkinga.
Uma enikela ngemnikelo wesono, kumele alungiselele phambi kwaSimakadze.
Wabeka isandla sakhe phezu kwenhloko yayo, wayawuyibulala phambi kwetentela lekuhlangana; lamadvodza la-Aron atawutsisa gazi lakhe phezu kwe altare ngaso sonke sikhatsi.
Waye utawunikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze, lokudla kwalo, nelibovu lwakhe lonke, alikucishe lifike emphinjeni, kanye nelibovu lelibise emathunjini, nalowo wonke lokudla lwemathunjini,
kanye nemilenze lemibili, nemafutha ayo abekwe phezu kwayo, naleyo mikhono lemincane yesifo sikashukela, layawuwakhipha kanye nemilenze.
Waye umnikelo wesono, lomnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze, kutsi ube ngumnikelo wesono.
Uma lomnikelo wakhe ube yibhotsi, kumele awunike phambi kweSimakadze.
Atawubeka isandla sakhe phezu kwehlavu layo, ayawuyibulala phambi kwetenti lekuhlangana; bonkhe bantfu base-Aharonhi batawutsisa ligazi laleyo nyama embindini wema-altare.
Waye utawunikela ngayo ngemnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze: lokudla lokudlidliza emathambo, kanye nekudla lokudlidliza emathambo onke,
kanye nemilenze lemibili, nemafutha ayo abekwe phezu kwayo, naleyo mikhono lemincane yesifo sikashukela, layawuwakhipha kanye nemilenze.
Waye umnikelo wesono, umnikelo wekushiswa, umnikelo wesono, lokudla lokunephunga lelihle. Lokudla lokunephunga lelihle, linani lelibomvu lwakhe.
Le mithetho ihlale ikhona kubo bonkhe bantfu bakho ngemuva kwakho, kuwo wonke lamadolobha enu: Ningeke nidle noma yini lenomsoco negazi.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
Utsi kuboSirayeli: Uma umuntu ephazamisa, ngaphandle kwekuze awazi, ngekwenza noma yini kuleyo miyalo kaSimakadze, kutsi ingasetjentwanga.

"Uma umnikelo wesono ube ngumLevi, nome umLevi abe ngumbingeleli wasebukhosini, uma ephelelwe livi, afike aze amnikele Simakadze inkunzi yenkomo lencane yengulube engabi necala, ibe yisondlo sokuhlukunyezwa ngesono sakhe.
Aye afike afike nengulube emgwaqeni wetenti lekuhlangana, aze amise isandla sakhe phezu kwehlavu lengulube, ayiselele phambi kwaSimakadze.
Lomnikelo wekushiswa kumele athathe lutho lwegazi lelibomvu, aze alingenise etentini lesivumelwane.
Aye afake isandla sakhe egazini, aze afafaze ngaleyo gazi emaphiko lasikhombisa phambi kwaSimakadze, phambi kwetibuko lelihlanganisiwe lesingcwele.

Naye utawukhipha igazi lakhe, aze alifake emakhoneni ethempelini lelifutfumelayo elinamaphunga lamnandi, elibekwe phambi kwaSimakadze enhlanganweni yetente lokuhlangana; 21nalo lisangu lelisele nalengulube liyawulifafaza ngaphansi kwesihlahla semnikelo wesono esisemnyango wenhlangano netenti.
Wathatha lokudla lokungekuhle kwengulube yemnikelo wekushiswa, nalokudla lokungekuhle lokushiywa emlonyeni, kanye nekudla lokungekuhle lokushiywa emlonyeni,
kanye nemilenze lemibili, nemafutha ayo abekwe phezu kwayo, naleyo mikhono lemincane yesifo sikashukela, layawuwasusa kanye nemilenze.
njengobe tithathwa kusuka engulubeni yemnikelo wesono, khona-ke umnikelo wekushiswa utawuzibulala phezu kwe altare yeminikelo yekushiswa.
Lesikhumba sengulube, nenyama yayo yonke, nehlavu layo, nemilenze yayo, nekudla kwalo kanye nemfuyo yalo,
kewo mkhwenyana wonke ayawuwukhipha ekungeneni kwekhampasi, abe yindawo lengcwele, lapho kususwa khona inkungu; khona-ke kumele awucwebezele emlilweni wesihlahla, lapho kususwa khona inkungu.
Uma ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli lidlwengula, belingasazi, bakwenza nanoma yini kuleyo miyalo kaSimakadze ekufanele yenziwe, bangabi necala.
"Lakho kufanele kube ngumnikelo wesono, umnikelo wekushiswa, kanye nesondlo sekudla, kanye nesondlo sewayini, kanye nesondlo HDPH, kanye nesondlo segolide.
Labaholi bebandla kumele bafake isandla sabo phezu kwehlavu lengulube phambi kwaSimakadze, bese kushiswa lengulube phambi kwaSimakadze.
Lomnikelo wekushiswa kumele afike abe ngumnikelo wesono, bese umnikelo wesono ufakwa etentini lekuhlangana.
Watsi uLevi: "Lomuntfu kumele afake isandla sakhe egazini, afafaze ngelilanga lesitsatfu phambi kuSimakadze, ngasekufeni kwetibuko.

Watsi uLevi: "Lomuntfu kumele afake legazi emlonyeni wema-altari, abe ngumnikelo wesono esihlalweni sesivumelwane saSimakadze; 21naye kufanele anikeze lokudla lokushiswako kanye nempepho yesondlo somlilo emnyango wetenti lekuhlangana.
Lawo ema-orenji atawuwakhipha, ayawuwufuya phezu kwendlu yase-Altari.
Waye ayenze nengulube yakhe, njengobe abeyenza nengulube yemnikelo wesono, kutsi kube ngumnikelo wesono; ngobe umnikelo wesono utawunikela ngesondlo salowo muntu kuSimakadze, bese kuboshwa.
Waphuma wakhipha lengulube ngaphandle kwekhampasi, wayibopha, njengobe wababopha lengulube yokuqala; iyimnikelo wekushiswa wesono lowawusebantwini bonke.
Uma umholi ephelelwa ngububi, angeke afune kutsi abe necala, ngekwenza noma yini leSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakhe, watsi akufanele yenziwe, wabekwa ejele.
"Uye afike abe ngumnikelo wekushiswa, umnikelo wesono, umnikelo wekudla, umnikelo wesive, umnikelo wesono.
wabeka isandla sakhe phezu kwehlavu lebhodza, wayawuyibulala phambi kwaSimakadze, lapho kuhlatjwa khona mnikelo wesono; iyiminikelo yekushiswa.

Watsi umnikelo wesono, umkhonzi wakhe kufanele athathe ngesandla sakhe sincane segazi lelihlanganisiwe nesondlo sesono, afake kumandlala e-altari yeminikelo yekushiswa, bese ukhipha igazi lakhe lisele phansi kwe-altari.
Waye asuke ekhipha lokudla kwalo, abe ngumnikelo wesono lokushiswako; umnikelo wakhe wokudla uyawuwukhipha emkhondweni wema-Israyeli, abe ngumnikelo wesono lokushiswako.
Uma ngabe umuntu webantfu aphelelwa ngukuthula, ekwenzeni siphi nasinye isinqumo saSimakadze lokungeke kwenziwe, abe necala.
ke-ke, uma ekhuluma ngesono sakhe, kufanele afike abe nenyama yenkunzi yengulube, ingabi nemonakalo, ibe ngumnikelo wakhe wesono.
Wabeka isandla sakhe phezu kwenhloko yemnikelo wekushiswa, wabulala khona lapho kushiswa khona mnikelo wesono.
Watsi umnikelo wesono awungcwabe ngesandla sakhe, aze afake emanzini layo emikhondweni ye altare yesondlo sokudla, bese ageza lilanga lelisele lisephansi kwe-altare.

Lokudla kwalo lonke kufanele alisetshenziswe, njengoba kusetshenzisiwe ukudla kwemnikelo wesono; umLevi utawulikhipha emgodini, kube yiphunga lelingenakunakwa kuSimakadze. UmLevi utawumisa lomnikelo wakhe wesono ebusweni baSimakadze, bese kukhululwa.
Uma enikela ngemnikelo wakhe wesono lilanga, kufanele libe lifazane, lingabi necala.
Wabeka isandla sakhe phezu kwenhloko yemnikelo wekushiswa, wayawuyibulala kutsi ibe yimnikelo wesono lapho kuhlatjwa khona inhlanzi yekushiswa.

Watsi umnikelo wesono, umkhonzi wakhe athathe ngesandla sakhe sincane segazi lelihlanganisiwe nesondlo sokudla, wamisa phezu kwemakhonyane e-altari yeminikelo yekushiswa; lokunye kwegazi lakhe liyawulikhipha ngaphansi kwesitembu se-altari.

Wonke lomafutha ayo ayawuwususa, njengekususwa lomafutha engulube kumnikelo wesono, umnikelo wesono utawuwukhipha, umnikelo wesono uyawuwushiswa esibhedlela, phezu kweminikelo yekuboshwa ngemlilo yaSimakadze. Ngako-ke umnikelo wesono utawukwenza umnikelo sesono sakhe lapho wasenza khona, aze akhululwe.
Uma umuntu ebizwa emaphoyiseni kutsi akhulume ngalento ayazi njengem Witness, bese yena ebona noma awazi lutho kepha angeke akhulume, yena ubeke isandla sakhe emtweni lobi.

"'Naye noma ngabe umuntu ucosha yini into lengcolile, njengalenyama lengcolile yemhlabatsini, noma njengesilwane lesingcolile semhlabatsini, noma njengobe isilwane lesingcolile somhlabatsini sicoshwe, nakuba akazange aqaphele, yena uzoba negciwane, abe necala.
"Nase-ke, uma ecosha noma yini lengcolile yemuntu, nanoma yini leyenza umuntu abe nephunga, noma ngabe akazange ayibone, lapho akubona khona, ungeke abe necala.
Noma lowo muntfu angabe angeke abe nenkinga yekwenza lokushoyo, kube kuhle noma kubi, lohlobo lwesibopho esingesihle lokubanjwa ngumuntu, kepha angeke afike akubonako.
Uma umuntu ephikiswa ngelinye lalawo macala, kumele avume kutsi umsebenti wakhe awuzange uphele.
ke-ke afike abe nemnikelo wakhe kuSimakadze, ngenxa yesono sakhe esibekiwe, inkunzi yemfuyo, noma ingulube, ibe yisondlo sesono; kube ngumnikelo wesono, umnikelo wesono.

Uma angeke akwazi kunikela ngenkunzi yemvu, khona-ke kumele afike abe netinkomo ezimbili, noma tingulube ezimbili, aze amnike umnikelo wakhe wesono, lomunye ube ngumnikelo wesono, lomunye ube ngumnikelo wekushiswa.
Lawo atawuwanikela kubo kumnikelo wesono; umsebenti wema-Amori kumele ube mkhulu kakhulu kunalowo waseGibhithe, kutsi abe ngumnikelo wekushiswa.
Waye afafaze ngalegazi lelihlanganiswe nemnikelo wesono phezu kwesobunxele be-altari, bese esinye sesikhumba sayo sicutshungulwa ngesandla sakhe sokudla; kube yiminikelo yekushiswa.
Lomunye utawuwunikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa, njengobe kwashiwo; khona-ke umnikelo wesono utawuwunikela kuSimakadze ngenxa yesono sakhe esibekiwe, aze abuyiselwe emuva.

Waye afike abe ngumnikelo wesono kuSimakadze, watsi: "Lomuntfu utawunikela ngaso ngesandla sakhe kanye nenhloko yakhe emkhondweni wema-Amori; linani leliphelele leliboshwa lwakhe kumele libe yisikhombisa.
Nalo loku lomnikelo wesono utawukwenta kutsi kube ngumnikelo wesono, bese umkhonzi waSimakadze abe ngumkhonzi wakhe, aze alungise kubo bonke labasolwa bakhe, nalapho kuyawukhululwa.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:

"Uma umuntu ephazamisa, ephezeka ngezinto letingcwele taSimakadze ngaphandle kwekucabanga, kufanele afike abe ngumnikelo wesono kuSimakadze, umkhwenyana wesifazane, longenankinga, umnikelo wakho wesondlo segolide, ngesibhakabhaka esingcwele.
Ase abuyisele lokudla lokungcwele, abe nesihlanu saleyo mali, aze amnike umnikelo wesono; bese umLevi ekhipha inhlawulo yakhe kuSimakadze ngemvubelo yesondlo sokuhlukunyezwa, khona-ke uya kukhululwa.
Uma umuntu ephazamisa ngekwenza noma yini kuleyo miyalo kaSimakadze, kutsi angeke yenziwe, nakuba akazange ayazi, utawubi necala, HDPH.
Uyawunikela ngemnikelo wesono, umkhwenyana wesifazane, longeke abe nenkinga ngaye, kuSimakadze; umnikelo wakhe wesono kufanele ube ngumnikelo wekushiswa, umnikelo wesono.
Le yimnikelo wesono; yena ubenesibopho sakhe phambi kwaSimakadze.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:

"Uma umuntu ephelelwa ngububi, bese ephula umthetho waSimakadze, akhohlisa umshayeli wakhe, akhuluma ngento yakhe, noma ngesivumelwano sakhe, nome abulala umshayeli wakhe, noma akwenza ngendlela engafanele,
noma athole silwane lesifile, bese ekhuluma ngalo ngesigebengu, ephikisa ngebubi. Lemikhuba lemibi ikhona kubo bonkhe bantfu.
""Uma ephelelwe licala ngendlela lenjalo, abe necala, kufanele abuye abuyisele lokho lokudlwengulayo, noma lokhu lokudlwengulayo, noma lokho okushiwo ngaye, noma lokho okulahlekile lokumutholako.
naye nanoma yini leyo akhuluma ngayo ngekuthula, kufanele ayibuyisele iphelele, abe nesihlanu sayo; kumele ayinike umnikazi wayo kuleso sikhatsi lapho ehlolwa khona.
ke-ke afike abe ngumnikelo wesono kuSimakadze, umnikelo wekushiswa: umkhwenyane lomnyama, longenankinga, kusuka ekudlaleni kwakhe, kutsi ube ngumnikelo wesono.
Kuye kube khona umnikelo wekushiswa, lomnikelo wesono, lapho umkhonzi ekhipha khona iminikelo yekushiswa neyinye yetibopho letingcwele kutsi abe ngumnikelo wesono.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:

Utsi ku-Aaroni nemadvodzana akhe: "Leli yimtsetfo wemnikelo wekushiswa. Imnikelo wekushiswa kumele uhlale emliloni, enhliziyweni ye altare yonke ibusuku kuze kube ekuseni; mlilo we-altare kufanele ugcinwe uphila.

Watsi umnikelo wesono kufanele agqoke ihembe lakhe lelibomvu, abe nemikhono emincane yebomvu emlenzeni wakhe; bese ekhipha inkungu yesondlo sokudla lokushiswayo, lapho umphunga waphuma khona enhliziyweni yakhe, aze ayibeke eceleni kwenhlanhla.
Waye utawuvala lemigqomo yakhe, agqoke imigqomo leminye, asuse inkungu yaso ngaphandle kwekhampasi, aze ayifake endaweni engcwele.

Umlilo kufanele ugcinwe ecaleni lelihlanganisiwe, ungafi. UmLevi kumele afake isihlahla esihlalweni lesingcwele ngaso sonke sikhatsi, abe nemnikelo wesono loshiswayo kanye naleyo mifino yesondlo sekuthula;
Lomlilo kufanele ugcinwe ethempelini nsuku zonke, angeke aphele.
Lowo ngumthetho wemnikelo wekushiswa: lamadvodza la-Aron atawuwunikela kuSimakadze phambi kwe altare.

Naye umnikelo wesono, umkhonzi wakhe kumele athathe inkomishi yakhe legcwele yesiliva negolide, kanye nenani leliphelele lelifutfu, naleyo futfu elingene kuyo, aze ayifake phezu kwe altare, ibe ngumnikelo wekushiswa, ube ngumphunga lomnandi kuSimakadze.
Lokudla lokushiywe ngu-Aron nemadvodzana akhe; kumele kudliwa ngaphandle kwefulawa, endaweni lengcwele, emnyango wetenti lekuhlangana.
Akufanele kuphekwe ngekudla lokudliwe, kutsi kube ngumnikelo wabo wesono; ngiwunikela kubo njengengxenye yabo, njengento lengcwele kakhulu, kanye nesondlo sesono nesondlo sokubuyisana.

Wonke lowesifazane emndenini wa-Aron angayidla, ibe ngumnikelo wabo wekushiswa kuSimakadze, kutsi kube yiminikelo yabo yesono yaso sonke isikhathi, kuwo wonke lamagatsha abo. Lonke linye liwucophelela umnikelo wesono, lizoba lingcwele.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:

Lokho ngumnikelo loyawunikela wona uAron nemadvodzana akhe kuSimakadze, ngelilanga lekubhetjelwa kwakhe kutsi abe ngumLevi: i-ephod yesiliva, njengemnikelo wesono ohlala njalo, ingxenye yakhe ngasemini, nengxenye yakhe ngasebusuku.
Uyawuyilungiselela ngewoyela emgodini, utawuyinikela ngewoyela, uyihlanganise kahle, ube ngumnikelo wesono, umnikelo wekushiswa, umphunga lomnandi kuSimakadze.

Lomnikelo wekushiswa uyawunikela wona lomnyaka mncane wemadvodzana a-Aron, lomsebenti waSimakadze. Kuye kube ngumthetho wasekuhlaleni; kumele kuqhunywe linyenti laleyo minikelo yekushiswa yaSimakadze.
Yonke iminikelo yekushiswa yemnikelo wesono wenkhosi kumele icwecwe, kufanele ingadliwanga.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:

"Ukhulume na-Aron nemadvodzana akhe, usithi: Lokho wumthetho wemnikelo wesono. Kulapho kushiswa khona iminikelo yekushiswa, lapho kumele kucwengwe khona imnikelo wesono phambi kwaSimakadze; ngungcwele kakhulu.
Lomnikelo wekushiswa wesono lowudla wona umsebenti wemaLevi; kumele udliwa endaweni lengcwele, emgwaqeni wetenti lekuhlangana.
Lokudla kwalo kuyawuba ngumnikelo wesono. Lonke linye linyenti lelingcolisa inyama yalo, liyawuba lingcwele; noma ngabe lilanga lakhe liphindza embhedeni, kufanele ulilale endaweni lengcwele.
Ingilazi yemhlabatsi lapho icutshungulwa khona kumele ihlukaniswe. Uma icutshungulwa engilazini yegolide, ingilazi kufanele ikhutshwe bese ihlanjwe ngemanti.
Wonke lowesifazane emkhatsini wemaLevi angayidla; ingcwele kakhulu.
"Lamuhla-ke, noma ngabe yini imnikelo wesono lofakwa etentini lekuhlangana, kutsi kube ngumnikelo wekushiswa, kumele adliwa; kufanele abe ngumnikelo wesono, kufanele abe ngumnikelo wesono.
Lowo ngumthetho wemnikelo wekushiswa wesono; ungcwele kakhulu.
Lemnikelo wesono kumele ukhishwe lapho kukhishiwe khona mnikelo wekushiswa, negazi lakhe kufanele liqhutshekwe phezu kwe-altari ngaso sonke simo.
Lokudla kwalo lonke kumele kunikezwe: inhloko, ne konkurrwa, nekudla lokugcobisa imfuyo,
imilenze lemibili nemafutha lakhona eduze kwesobunxele, kanye nesikhumba lesimhlophe sesifo sikashukela, sicutshungulwa kanye nemilenze.
Lomnikelo wekushiswa utawufunwa nguSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, watsi: "Lomnikelo wesono uyawufunwa nguSimakadze.
Wonke lowesifazane emkhatsini wemaLevi angayidla; kumele itfolwe endaweni lengcwele, ibe ngcwele kakhulu.
Lomnikelo wesono ufana nemnikelo wesono, kanye nalomnikelo wesono; yinye imithetho yakhe, ibe nguwo lomnikelo wekushiswa, lowo lowenzako lokukhulu kuSimakadze.
Lomnikelo wekushiswa wemuntfu, lomnikelo wema-Israyeli uyawuhlala nawo, kodvwa isikhumba saleyo nyama sitawutsi sihlale sakhe.
Lomnikelo wekushiswa lodliwayo, uma uphekiwe efrijini, noma uphekwe emgodini, noma uphekwe ngetibhaka, kumele ube nguwe-Israyeli.
Nawo wonke lomnikelo wesono, ohlanganisene nephethroli, noma ucwebile, kumele ube nguwe bonkhe bantfu labasebancane baka-Aron.
Lowo ngumthetho wemnikelo wesono, lapho umuntu enikela khona kuSimakadze.

"Wena Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, uma unikela ngayo ngemnikelo wesono, kufanele alungiselele kanye neminikelo yakhe yesonka sekudla esinamafutha, naleyo yemifino lesengumhluzi, nemabhisikidi angemhlanjululwe ngamanti.
Ngemnikelo wakhe wekubonga, kumele afike nekudla lokuphekwe ngefulawa.
Atawunikela ngayinye yinye, ibe ngumnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze; iyawuba yiyo lomuntfu lomngcwelephatsi, lowo usebentisa ligazi lelihlanganisiwe.
Lenyama yemnikelo wesono kumele itfolwe kuleso sikhathi lapho ilungiselelwa khona; angeke kube nento legcinwe kuze kube ngekusasa.

""Lakho-ke, uma imnikelo wakhe wesono ube ngumnikelo wekushiswa, noma ngabe umnikelo wakhe wokudla ube ngumnikelo wesive sakhe, kumele utfolwe kuleso sikhatsi lapho anikela khona; kepha lokho lokushiwo kungadliwa ngelilanga lesibili.
Lokudla lokushiywa lilanga lesithathu kumele kucutshekwe emlilo.

"Nakuba yini nayinye yenyama yemnikelo wesono idlalwe ngelilanga lesithathu, umnikelo wayo ngeke uvunyelwe; lowo lowunikela wona angeke abe nesibopho sawo; kumele kube ngukudla lokubi, nome ngubani nalowo loyawudla wona, kufanele abambe inkohliso yakhe.
Lokudla lokudlidliza noma yini leyimfishane, akufanele kudliwa; kufanele kucutshekwe emlilweni. Lokudla lokudlidliza lokunye, wonke lowo longcwele angakudla.
Lomuntu lodla inyama yesondlo sekuthula, esibekiwe kuSimakadze, engeke abe nephunga, lowo muntu kumele aphekwe emiphakathini yakhe.

"Naye nalowo muntu lowucosha noma yini engcolileyo, noma ngabe yinto lengcolile yomuntu, noma ngabe yinyama lengcolileyo, noma ngabe yisiphi sicupho lesingcolileyo, bese edla inyama yemnikelo wesono longcwele kaSimakadze, lowo muntu kumele aphekwe emiphakathini yakhe.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
Utsi kuboSirayeli: Ningeke nidle noma yini leyimfishane yengulube, noma yenkomo, noma yenja.
Lokudla kwesilwane lesifile ngaso, noma sibulawa ngutilwane temhlabatsini, kungasetjenziswa kuletinye zinto, kepha awuvumelekanga kutsi ucile.
Nalowo nalowo lodla umsoco wesilwane, lesinikezwa nguSimakadze njengemnikelo wekushiswa, lowo muntu kumele aphekwe emiphakathini yakhe.
Nakweyiphi na indawo lapho nihlala khona, ningadla lutho lwegazi, noma lingane lenyama, noma ikati.
Lomuntfu lodla lutho lwegazi, lowo muntu kumele ahlukaniswe nebantfu bakhe.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
Utsi kubo bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli: Lowo lonikela ngemnikelo wesono kuSimakadze, kumele afike nemnikelo wakhe wokudla, abe ngumnikelo wesono kuSimakadze.
Ngesandla sakhe siyawunikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze; lokudla lokushisayo kanye nesiphambano siyawunikela ngaso, nesifonyo sitawulibambisa ebusweni benkhosi, ibe ngumnikelo wesono.
Lomnikelo wekushiswa uyawuwukhipha ku-altari, kodvwa inhloko ibe ngu-Aron nemadvodzana akhe.
Lemphiko yesobunxele semnikelo wenu wesono niyinike ku-Ahira, kutsi ibe ngumnikelo wekushiswa.
Lomnyaka mncane wa-Aron, lonikela lilanga lemnikelo wesono kanye nemafutha ayo, kumele abe nemsindvo lesasingemagremu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu.

Nalo nhloko lelihlanganisiwe, nelombe lelihlanganiswe, ngiyithathe kumnikelo wesondlo sakubo bonkhe bantfu base-Israyeli, ngawunika uAharonhi umLevi, kanye nabana bakhe; kube ngumnikelo wabo wesono kuze kube sekupheleni, kusuka kubo bonkhe bantfu be-Israyeli.
Lowo ngumnikelo wa-Aron, nemnikelo wamadvodzana akhe, weminikelo yekushiswa yaSimakadze, kusukela kuleso sikhathi lapho befike khona kutsi basebenzela Simakadze njengompristi.
USimakadze waletsa bantfu baka-Israyeli, ngelilanga lekuboshwa kwabo, kutsi babenike lolu mnikelo wesono; ube ngumnikelo wabo wesono lohlala njalo kubo, HDPH.
Lowo ngumthetho wemnikelo wekushiswa, nesondlo sekudla, nesondlo sesono, nesondlo sokuhlukunyezwa, nesondlo sokubekwa ebukhosini, nesondlo sekuthula.
USimakadze watsi kuMosesi emfuleni iSinayi, ngelilanga lapho waletsa khona bantfu baka-Israyeli ukuba banikela ngenhlanhla yabo kuSimakadze, esigabeni seSinayi.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
Thiba u-Aron nemadvodzana akhe, netibondza takubo bonkhe bantfu, namafutha ekuphuza, nengulube yemnikelo wesono, nembingeleli lababini, nebhokisi lekudla lokungefulawa.
bese uhlanganisa libandla lonke emgwaqeni wetenti lekuhlangana.
Mosesi wakwenza njengobe Simakadze abemwisele kutsi akwenze; nebandla lahlangana emgwaqeni wetente lekuhlangana.
Mozesi wabaphendvula watsi: "Leli lisho laSimakadze, kutsi sikwenze."
Mosesi wayalela uAron nemadvodzana akhe kutsi bafike, wabahlamba ngamanzi.
Wamisa uAron ngetinsindza, wabeka umlenze wakhe phezu kwakhe, wamisa nemicabo yakhe phansi, wabeka i-ephod yakhe phezu kwakhe, wabeka intambo yegolide ye-ephod yakhe ngaphansi kwakhe.
Wabeka phezu kwakhe isandla, wabeka khona e-Urim ne-Thummim esandlani sakhe.
Wabeka i-tiara phezu kwehlavu lakhe, wabeka phezulu kwe-tiara icwecwe legolide, inhloko lengcwele, njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose.
Mosesi wathatha umsi wekuphuza, wayiphuza itabernakele kanye nezinto tonkhe letikhona kulo, kutsi azingcwele.
Watsi: "Lawo ema-altare angeke ahlukaniswe, ngobe umnikelo wesono loshiswayo awuzange uhlukaniswe nalawo ema-altare.
Wakhipha naleyo mafutha ekuphuza phezu kwehlavu la-Aron, wamphuca kutsi abe ngungcwele.
UMosesi wabeka madvodzana a-Aron, wabahlobisa ngetikhoboshi, wababopha ngemikhono, wabeka tigodzi ekhanda labo; njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose.
Wafike wafaka ingulube yemnikelo wekushiswa, Aharon nemadvodzana akhe babeka tinyawo tabo phezu kwehlavu lengulube.

UMosesi wehlisa lenyama, wathatha igazi layo, wawabeka ngesandla sakhe emikhondweni yemnikelo wesono, watsi: "Lona ngumnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze." 30Watsi uMosi: "Ngisho naleso sigubhu sema-orebhini ekudla lokuphekwa ngesihluthulelo sendlu yaNkulunkulu.
Wafaka naleso sifuba, nesokudla sayo kanye nemlonyeni wayo, wamisa ema-orenji lamakhulu lamabili kuya kumashumi amathathu eminyaka.
Lengulube, nesikhumba sayo, nemfuyo yayo, nenyama yayo, wayibopha ngemlilo ngaphandle kwekhabhinethi; njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose.
Wafaka induku yemnikelo wesono, wamisa Aharon nemadvodzana akhe ngesandla sakhe phezu kwenhlavu yebhokisi yemnikelo wesono.
UMosese wehlisa lenyama, watsi: "Laligazi litawutsilwa phezu kwe-altari ngaso tonkhe tive.
Wamisa umnikelo wakhe wesono, wawususa umlo titukulwane ta-Aaroni; watsi: "Umnikelo wekushiswa nguSimakadze.
Wahlamba ngamanzi imisipha nemilenze, wakhipha lomnikelo wesono onke ku-altari; kwakuyiminikelo yekushiswa yephunga lelihle, imnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze, njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose.
Wafaka nalowo mkhwenyana lomunye, umkhwenyane wemnikelo wekushiswa; wabeka isandla sakhe sa-Aharon nemadvodzana akhe phezu kwehlavu lomkhwenyane.
UMosesi wehlisa lenyama, watsi: "Njengomlomo wakhe wesobunxele, nasengomlonyeni wakhe wesobunxele, nasengomlomo wakhe wesobunxele, nasengomlomo wakhe wesobunxele, nasengomlomo wakhe wesobunxele.

UMosese wabeka labantwana baka-Aron, wabeka legazi emlonyeni wabo wesobunxele, nasenkundleni yesandla sabo sesobunxele, nasenkundleni yenyawo labo lesobunxele; uMosese wehlisa logwaja phezu kwebhedu ngaso sonke icala.
Wathatha nemafutha ayo, nemphimbo yakhe leyimisiwe, naleyo mafuta abekwe emathunjini, nesikhumba sesifo sikashukela, nemilenze emibini kanye nemafutha ayo, nalesifuba sasekudla.

Wathatha ebhokisini lekudla lokungahlanganiswanga, lelibekwe phambi kwaSimakadze, ibhotela elinye, nebhotela lenye lelihlanjululwe ngamafutha, nebhotela elinye, wamisa phezu kwalolo msoco kanye nemphimbo yesobunxele.
Wabeka tonkhe tive esandlani sa-Aron, nesandlani samadvodzakati akhe, waphindze wawashaya ngesandla phambi kwaSimakadze njengemnikelo wesono.

Wathi uMosesi: "Namuhla ngikunikela ngenhlanhla kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ngemnikelo lokudla kanye neminikelo yekushiswa, kanye nemnikelo wesono, kanye nemnikelo wesono lokudla kanye nemnikelo wesono.
Wathatha uMosi isandla, wamisa ngaso njengemnikelo wekushiswa phambi kwaSimakadze; yabe yingxenye kaMosesi kulowo mkhwenyana, kutsi abe ngumkhonzi wakhe, njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose.

UMosese waba nenani lemafutha okubhaka, naleyo gazi elalisetshenzisiwe enhliziyweni yethempelini, walihlisa ku-Aron, nemilenze yakhe, nabanake bakhe, nemilenze yabanake bakhe, naye; wabangcwele uAron nemilenze yakhe, nabobanake bakhe nemilenze yabanake bakhe.

UMosesi watsi ku-Aron nemadvodzana akhe: "Kungemnyango wetenti lekuhlangana nidle inyama, nidle khona kanye nenkukhu ekungeneni ebhokisini lokulungiselela lomnikelo wesono, njengobe ngibembise kutsi: 'Aron nemadvodzakati akhe kumele bayeke ukuyidla.'
Kuphela lokunye lokushiwo ngekudla kanye nengulube, mlilo.
Ningeke niphume emgwaqeni wetente lekuhlangana lilanga lesitsatfu, kuze kuphele lilanga lesisikhombisa lokubekwa kwenu emsebentini wemaLevi; lilanga lesisihlanu lokufaka isandla enhliziyweni yenu.
Kuye kwaba njalo namuhla, njengobe Simakadze abewisela kutsi kube khona, kutsi uhlangane naNkulunkulu.
Nihlale emgwaqeni wetenti lekuhlangana ekuseni nakusihlwa, lilanga lesitsatfu, nigcine lomthetho waSimakadze, kutsi ningafa; ngobe lokhu kutawuba ngumtsetfo wami.
Arone nemadvodzana akhe bakwenza njalo, njengobe Simakadze abekhuluma ngaMosi.
Kuye kube usuku lwesikhombisa, Mose wabiza u-Aron nemadvodzana akhe, nabaholi ba-Israyeli.
Watsi ku-Aron: "Thiba inkunzi yengulube ibe ngumnikelo wesono, nemvu ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa; yinye nenye kumele zibe nemonakalo, bese uzisa kuSimakadze.
Wakhuluma kubo-Israyeli, watsi: Thumelani umkhwenyana wemvu njengemnikelo wekushiswa, nengulube kanye nenyama yenkomo yeminyaka lemibili igcwele, ngaphandle kwemonakalo, ibe yiminikelo yekushiswa.
bese uthatha inkunzi yengulube nemvu, ibe ngumnikelo wesono, uyawunikela kuSimakadze, kanye nesondlo sekudla esincibilikisiwe ngephethroli; ngobe namuhla Simakadze utawukuboniswa kuwe.
Bafike bafaka emnyango wetente lekuhlangana, babeka khona iminikelo yekushiswa kanye nemnikelo wekushiswa, nabo bonkhe bantfu, bese behlala phambi kuSimakadze.
Mozesi watsi: "Lena yindlela uSimakadze awisenzile ngayo, niyenze; khona-ke ubuhle beNkulunkulu buyawubonakala kuwe."

UMosesi watsi ku-Aron: "Thinakela ethempelini, ulungiselele mnikelo wakho wesono kanye neminikelo yakho yokushiswa, ube ngumnikelo wesono kuwe nakubo bonkhe bantfu; bese ulungiselela mnikelo wesive, ube ngumnikelo wesono kubo, njengobe Simakadze abewisela.
U-Aron wafika esibhedlela, wehlisa inkunzi yengulube ibe ngumnikelo wesono wakhe.
Watsi uMosi afike ethempelini laSimakadze, watsi: "Lawo ma-Aaroni kanye nemadvodzana akhe kumele abe ngumnikelo wesono lokushiswa esihlalweni senkhosiκόν-ke.
Lamafutha ayo, nemilenze yayo, naleso sifuba saleyo mnikelo wesono, ayawuwufuya phezu kwe altare, njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose.
Lenyama kanye nesikhumba sakhe, watsi: "Uyawucindza ngemlilo ngaphandle kwekhampasi."
Wabulala nemnikelo wekushiswa, kodvwa lamadvodzana a-Aron wamisa gazi lakhe kuye, watsi lifafaze ema-altari ngaso sonke sikhatsi.
Bemnikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa, ingxenye ngayinye, kanye nenhloko yakhe, wayawuzibulala phezu kwe altare.
Wahlamba lemisipha kanye nemilenze yakhe, wayibopha phezu kwesondlo sekudla lesishiswako esibekwe emnyango.
Wanikela ngemnikelo wesive, wathatha ibhokhwe yesondlo sesono lesive, wambulala, wanikela ngayo ngesondlo sesono, njengobe akazange akwenze neleyo yokuqala.
Wakhipha nemnikelo wekushiswa, wawunikela ngendlela labeshiwo ngayo uMosi.
Wafaka nemnikelo wesono, wawugcwalisa ngesandla sakhe, wawukhipha ethempelini, kanye nemnikelo wekushiswa wekusasa.
Wabulala nengulube kanye nemvu, ibe ngumnikelo wesono lokudla lokuhlanjululwa kubo bonkhe bantfu; lamadvodzana a-Aron awanikela ngegazi kuye, walisa ethempelini lonke.
Bemnikela ngemafutha engulube kanye nembewu yemvu, naleyo mphumo lengcolile yomhlabatsini, ne脂肪e elifihlisa imithambo-luvo, nemilenze nayo yonke imfucuza yesisu.
Babeka lokudla lokutshiswako phezu kwemisipha, watsi: "Lokudla lokutshiswako kufanele kucwecwe ngemlilo emgodini.
Aron waphakamisa imilenze kanye nenhloko yesobunxele njengemnikelo wekushiswa phambi kwaSimakadze, njengobe Mose abewisela.
U-Aron waphakamisa isandla sakhe ebantwini, wabambisana nabo; wehla ngemuva kokunikela ngemnikelo wesono, neminikelo yekushiswa, neminikelo yekuthula.
Musa na-Aron bafika etentini lekuhlangana, baphuma, babambisana nabo bonkhe bantfu; khona-ke kuthula kweSimakadze kwabonakala kubo bonke bantfu.
Nakho umlilo wawuphuma kuSimakadze, wehla phezu kwe altare, wehlisa iminikelo yekushiswa neleyo yemifino; nabo bonkhe bantfu bakubona, bahlaba umxhwele, bakhonta phansi ngemehlo abo.
Nadabhi naAbihu, bantfu labancane ba-Aron, bawathatha lamahhashi abo, wabeka umlilo kuwo, wafaka khona umsi; wabanikela kuSimakadze ngemlilo ongavumelekile, loNkulunkulu akazange awavumele.
Kusuka kuSimakadze kwaphuma umoya, wababulala, bafa phambi kweNkhosi Simakadze.

UMosesi watsi ku-Aron: "Lena linye lamazwi aSimakadze, lapho ekhuluma khona, ethi: 'Ngizoboniswa sengumngcwele kubo bonkhe labo labahamba ngami, futhi ngizobonakaliswa ngenhlonipho phambi kwalabo bonke abantu.'"
Mosesi watsi kuMishayeli na-Elzaphane, bantfu ba-Uziyele, umntakwabo wa-Aaroni, watsi kubo: "Nifikeni nisuse labangani benu ecaleni lengcwele, ngaphandle kwekhampasi."
Bafike bebakhipha ngaphandle kwekhampasi, babeka emahembe abo emilenzeni yabo, njengobe Mosi abesho.

Musa watsi ku-Aron, nakwa-Elazar ne-Ithamari, labantwana bakhe: "Mna-ke ningeke nivule izinwele zenu, noma nicwebeze ingubo zenu, ngobe nizofa, futhi uSimakadze agweme libandla lonke; kodwa bazalwane benu, bonke bantfu baseSirayeli, bangalingisa labo loNkulunkulu abewabulala ngemlilo.
"Ningeke niphume emgwaqeni wetenti lekuhlangana, ngobe umnikelo wekushiswa waSimakadze unesibhakabhaka phezu kwenu, kutsi ningafa.' "Bayakwenza njengobe Mose abesho.
USimakadze watsi ku-Aron:
"Ungeke uphuze iwayini, noma yini lengcolile yesive, wena nabana bakho, lapho ningena etentini lekuhlangana, kutsi nife; kumele kube ngumthetho wesikhathi sonke kubo bonkhe bantfu basuku lwakho.
Nifanele nibone kutsi yini lengcwele kanye neyiphi lengekho, nokuthi yini lengcolile kanye neyiphi lecocekile.
Nifundise bantfu beSirayeli tonkhe tive temtsetfo, Simakadze abeyawutsi kubo ngesandla saMosesi.

Musa wakhuluma ku-Aron, na-Eleazari na-Ithamari, labangane bakhe labafileyo, watsi: "Nithathe isondlo sokudla esiseleko seminikelo yekushiswa yaSimakadze, niyidle ngaphandle kwefulawa ecaleni lesitezi sengcwele; ngobe iyingcwele kakhulu.
Lokudla kufanele kudliwa endaweni lengcwele; ngobe linani lakho, kanye nenani labanakho, ngumnikelo wesono loshiswayo kuSimakadze; njengobe ngibe ngumyalelo.

Lasifuba somnikelo wekushiswa, nenhloko yesondlo lesiphakanyiswe ngaso, ungakudla kuwo wena kanye nabanakho nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli lapho kuhlanzekile khona; lemisindvo lesasingemagremu lasitfupha namakhulu ayisishiyagalombili lama-orgasms angadliwa.

Lomphimbo lokuphakanyisiwe, nesiphambano lesihlabayo, batawutifaka kanye naleyo mafutha, abe ngumnikelo wekushiswa, bese bewushaya ngesandla phambi kwaSimakadze, kube yiminikelo yekushiswa; ibe yakho wena nemadvodzana akho, ibe yilungelo yenu kuze kube sekupheleni, njengobe Simakadze abewise.
UMosese wabheka ngesandla sakhe ingulube yemnikelo wesono, watsi: "Njengokuba yashiswa, uMosi wehlule ku-Elazar ne-Ithamari, labantwana baka-Aron labashiwo, watsi:

Ngubani na lokwenta kutsi nidle lemnikelo wesono lapho kungcwele khona? Nguwo longcwele kakhulu, ngobe Simakadze lawunikela kuwe, kutsi ususe inkohliso yemindeni yabo, ukuze ube nekuthula nabo phambi kwaSimakadze.
ngobe igazi lakhe alingena ngaphakathi kwendlu lengcwele; kufanele lokudla kube endlwini lengcwele, njengobe ngibembise.

U-Aron watsi kuMosesi: "Bona, namuhla banikela ngemnikelo wabo wesono kanye neminikelo yabo yokushiswa kuSimakadze, futhi lezinto letibuhlungu letinjalo zami; uma ngidla inhlanzi yesondlo sesono namuhla, ngabe Simakadze ungithanda?"
UMosese, lapho akubona khona, wakhululeka.
Simakadze watsi kuMosi na-Aron:
"Chaza kubo bonkhe bantfu base-Israyeli, utsi: Kusuka kuwo wonke lamahhashi aphilayo emhlabatsini, lawa niyawudla.
Ungadla noma siphi silwane lesinesifuba lesihlukaniswe ngemaviki lasitfupha kanye nesinye lesibulala tingulube.
Kusekhona isilwane lesidla inyama, noma lesinakondza lokuhlukanisiwe; angeke nizidle. 20Igrembe lidla ukudla, kepha alinakondzaκόνma, ibe yinhlekelele kwenu.
I-rock badger idla lenyama, kepha ayinaso sifuba lesihlukanisiwe, ngakho-ke ayingcolile kuye.
Ingulube idla lenyama kepha ayinaso sifuba lesihlukanisiwe, ngakho-ke ayibi kuwe.
Ingulube inemilenze lemibili, ihlukaniswe emaviki lasitfupha, kepha ayidla lilanga; ingcolile kuwe.
Ningeke nidle inyama yabo, ningeke nicoce umhlambi wabo; kumele nibe nekunakeni kwabo.
Lolu hlobo lwezinto letiphilako emanti, emfuleni nelwandle, ningeke nizidle: zonke lezi zinemilenze kanye nemacici.
"Lakho konke lokuselwandle noma emfuleni, lokungaba nalotingulube naletingwevu, noma yini lephilako emhlabatsini, noma yini lephilako emahlathini, kumele kube ngububi kuwe.
Ningeke nidle inyama yabo, ngobe letinye titfunywa tato tiyitfunya. Ningeke nidla emacwecwe abo, ngobe titfunywa tabo tiyitfunya.
Nanoma yini emanzini lengeke ibe nemilenze kanye netingulube iphindze ibe yinhle.
Lolu hlobo lwetingulube ningeke nilidle, ngobe lingcolile: i-eagle, ne-vulture, ne-black vulture, ne-snake,
ikati lelibomvu, kanye nanoma yini yehlobo lelibomvu,
noma yimuphi hlobo lwetingulube
i-horned owl, i-screaming owl, i-seagull, kanye nanoma siphi sihlobo se-hawk,
i-owl lencane, i-cormorant, i-owl lekhulu,
i-owl lemhlophe, i-owl yemhlabatsini, i-osprey,
i-stork, noma yimuphi hlobo lwe-heron, i-hoop, ne-bat.
Lawo onkhe ema-insects aphilayo lahamba ngetinyawo letintsatfu angeke akwanelise.
Kodwa-ke, ungadla letinye tilwane letinamaphiko letihamba ngetinyawo letintsatfu: labo abanetibambo letihlangene ngaphesheya kwetinyawo tabo kutsi bahambe phansi.
Kuto, ungadla noma yimuphi hlobo lwesibhakabhaka, noma imuphi hlobo lwekatidi, noma imuphi hlobo lwesibhakabhaka, kanye nanoma imuphi hlobo lwesibhakabhaka.
Lonke letinye tilwane letinamaphiko letinemilebe lemine tingeke uzive ungakhululeki.
Lokho kuyawukwenta ningabi nakunaki; lowo lowucosha umtfubi wawo, ungeke ube nakunaki kuze kube sebusuku.
Wonke lowo lokhipha lenyama yabo, kumele ahlanze ingubo yakhe, abe nekunakeni kuze kube sebusuku.
Nayinye lephilako, isilwane lesinamacopho lamancane, asihlukanisiwe, kanye nesinye isilwane esingadla lilanga, siyawuba singcolile kutsi ni HDPH; nanoma ngubani lowutifafaza, utawubi nephunga.
Lawo lahamba ngetinyawo, kuwo onke lahamba ngetinyawo, angeke abe nekunakeni kwenu; lowo utawujikisa umtfubi wawo, abe nekunakeni kuye kuze kube sebusuku.
Wonke lowo lokhipha lenyama yabo, kumele ahlanze ingubo yakhe, abe nekunakeni kuze kube sebusuku; tiyawuba nakunakeni kwenu.
Lolu hlobo lwetinyama letihamba ngemhlaba lungeke lube ngubi kuwe: ingulube, nengulube lencane, nanoma yini lephilako elingenamehlo,
i-gekko, i-monitor lizard, i-wall lizard, i-skink, kanye ne-chameleon.
Lolu hlobo lwetilwane letihamba ngemhlaba lungeke lube nakunakwa kuwe; lowo utawuba nakunakwa kuze kube sekusihlwa, nome utawuba nendlala.

"Nakuba yini nayinye yato ifile, ibe yinto lephuma kuyo, noma ngabe liyisihlahla, noma libe nguboya, noma lube ngesikhumba, noma libe nentambo yesiliva, noma kube yisiphi nasinye sidakambiso sekudla lesifakwa emanzini, kufanele sifakwe emanzini; singabi nakunaki kuze kusihlwa, bese siyahlanzwa.
Uma linye lato liphuma embhedeni wemhlabatsini, yonke into lekhona embhedeni uyawubi nenyama, bese ubuye waphula umbhede.
Nanoma yini yekudla lokudlakayo, uma lilanga lifika kuyo, liyawuba lingcolile; nanoma yini yekudla lokudlidlizako, uma lilanga lifika kuyo, liyawuba lingcolile.
Nanoma yini lapho iphuma khona imfuyo yabo, iyabi nandzawo; noma ngabe yi-oveni, noma ngabe i-oveni yekudla, kufanele ibe nendzawo, ibe nandzawo, niyibeke njengengenandzawo.
Kutsi nalapho kukhona umfula, noma ifulegi lelinemanti, liyawuhlala lihlanzekile; kodvwa lowo lowucophelela khona imfuyo yakhe, utawubi nebubi.
Uma ingxenye yesilwane lesifile siphuma emhlabatsini, lemhlabatsi uhlala uhlanzekile.
Ngako-ke, uma kufakwe amanzi embewu yakhe, bese kungena kuyo yini lenyama yakhe lefile, iya kuba nandzawo.
"'Nakuba yini lephilako, ekudlaleni kwenu, ifile, lowo lowucophelela umhlambi wayo, kumele abe nekunakenu kuze kuhlwa.

Nalowo lodla lenyama yakhe emfishane, kumele ahlanze ingubo yakhe, abe nekunakeni kuze kube sebusuku; nalowo lokhipha lenyama yakhe emfishane, kufanele ahlanze ingubo yakhe, abe nenanakeni kuze kube sebusuku.
Lonke linyama lelincane lelingahamba ngemhlaba lingcolile; ningalidla.
Ningeke nidle noma yini ehamba ngemphini yayo, noma ihambe ngetinyawo letintsatfu, noma ihambe ngetinyawo letintsatfu, noma ibe netinyawo letinene.
Ningeke nigcineni nguNkulunkulu wenu, ningabi nebubi nganoma yini lephilako, ningabi nebubi ngaleyo.
ngobe ngiye Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu; nihlale ningcwele, nibe ngcwele, ngoba ngingcwele. Ningeke nigcineni ningcolile ngeso sonke isilwane lesihamba phansi emhlabatsini.
Ngiye Simakadze, loyawutfumisa emhlabatsini we-Egypt, kutsi abe nguNkulunkulu wenu; nibe bangcwele, ngobe ngingcwele.
Le mfundiso ikhuluma ngetinyama, netingcweti, nanoma yini ephilayo lehamba emanzini, nanoma yini ephilayo lehamba phansi.
Kuyawukusiza kutsi ubone inhlanganiso phakathi kwento lengcolile nento ehlanzekile, kanye naletinye tilwane letidla kanye naletingeke tidle."
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:

Utsi kubo bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli: Uma indodana ikhulelwa, izala umntwana wesifazane, kufanele ibe nelilanga lesitsatfu ingabi namanzi; kumele abe nelilanga lesisikhombisa angabi namanzi, njengaleso sikhathi lapho ephuma khona.
Ngelilanga lesikhombisa kufanele ahlatjwe.

Angeke afike endlwini yakhe, abe nelilanga lemashumi lamane nalinye lokuhlanzwa kwegazi lakhe; angeke anikeze noma yini lengcwele, angeke afike endaweni lengcwele, kuze kuphele lilanga lakhe lokuhlanza.

"Lamuhla-ke, lapho izinsuku takuboshwa kwakhe tiphelela khona, kube ngumnyaka mncane noma ube ngumnyaka mncane, kumele afike emnyango wetenti lekuhlangana, aze atsatse kumLevi inkunzi yengulube, ibe yimnikelo wekushiswa, kanye nenyama yenkomo, noma ingulube, ibe yiminikelo yekushiswa.
"Kuye kube ngumnikelo wesono, umnikelo wekushiswa, lapho umLevi enikela ngawo kuSimakadze, kutsi abe yiminikelo yakhe yesono, ibe yinhlanhla kuye, ibe livi lakhe, libe lilungile.

""Nase, uma angeke abe nemandla ekukhulisa inkunzi yengulube, khona-ke kufanele athathe tingulube ezimbili, noma tingulube letincane ezimbili, enye ibe ngumnikelo wekushiswa, kanti enye ibe ngumnikelo wesono; nome umnikelo wesono utawukhipha umonakalo wakhe kuSimakadze, aze ahlanzwe.
Simakadze watsi kuMosi na-Aron:

""Uma umuntu esikhumbani sakhe ebona umkhuhlane, noma ubuhlungu besisu, noma umbala lokhanyayo, ngobe kube yisifo sesikhumba, kumele afike ku-Aron kutsi abe ngumnikelo wesono, noma kumunye wabana bakhe, labaLevi.

Kuye umnikelo wekushiswa abheke lesifo sesikhumba, bese ebona kutsi imilenze yesifo simhlophe, nesimo saso sesiphansi kunesikhumba; kube yigciwane lesibi kakhulu lesiphilako esikhumbeni. Umnikelo wesono longcwele uyakubona, wakhuluma watsi: "Ungengcolile."

"Make-ke, uma iphunga lelibomvu likhona esikhumbani, litsi lingeke liboneke liphansi kunesikhumba, nemilenze yayo ingabi mhlophe, khona-ke umnikelo wesono kumele agcine lomuntfu embhedeni iminyaka lesikhombisa.

Umnikelo wekushiswa utawubekwa ebusweni bakhe, bese umsebenti wema-Levi uphela. Umnikelo wekushiswa utawufakwa emaviki lasikhombisa, kuze kube sekuphele iminyaka lelishumi nesihlanu; umnikelo wakhe wesono kumele ube ngumnikelo wesono.

"Kuye kube ngumhla wesitsatfu, umnikelo wekushiswa uyawuwubheka; bese kubona kutsi igciwane lifilile, lingakasakazeka esikhumbani, khona-ke umnikelo wesono utawutsi lomuntfu uhlanzekile; lubuhlungu besikhumba kuphela; kufanele ahlanze tigqoko zakhe, aze abe mhlophe.
Ngako-ke, uma umkhuhlane wehla esikhumbani, ngemuva kwekuboniswa kwakhe kumnikelo wesono kutsi ahlanzwe, kumele aphinde abonakaliswe kumnikelo wesono.
Kutsi uma umnikelo wekushiswa ekubona, bese ubona kutsi umkhuhlane usufike wasakazeka ngesikhumba, khona-ke umnikelo wesono kumele akusho ukuthi lomuntfu ungcolile; isifo sesikhumba.
Uma umuntu ephila nesifo sesikhumba, kumele afike kumuntfu longcwele.
"Kuye kutsi umnikelo wesono abheke, bese kubona ukuthi, uma kukhona kuleyo sikhumba inhlayiya lemhlophe, nemilenze yayo ibe mnyama, nalapho inhlayiya khona khona inyama lephilayo,
isifo sesikhumba lesihlala isikhathi eside; khona-ke umnikelo wesono utawutsi lomuntfu ungcolile, angeke afune kutsi ahlukaniswe naye, ngobe ungcolile.
""Nase igciwane lelibomvu lifike lisakazeka esikhumbani, libe ligcwele sikhumba sakhe kusuka enhloko kuye emlenzeni wakhe, kuwo wonke lamehlo enkhosini,

umnikelo wekushiswa utawumubheka, bese ubona kutsi igciwane lelibomvu ligcwele mehlo akhe, khona-ke umnikelo wesono utawutsi lomuntfu uhlanzekile kulelo gciwane; lilanga lelinyenti libuye lamhlophe, ulungile.
Ngako-ke, lapho kuvela khona emlonyeni wakhe inyama lephilayo, angeke abe nebubi.
Watsi: "Lomuntfu ungeke abe nephunga lelihle, futsi angeke abe nemfudlana, kodvwa kumele abe nemfudlana lomhlophe.
Ngako-ke, uma lenyama iguquka ibe mhlophe, kumele afike kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakhe.
Kute kube umnikelo wesono, umLevi uyawuwubheka, bese ubona kutsi igciwane lishintshile libe mhlophe; khona-ke umnikelo wesono utawutsi lomuntfu uhlanzekile kulelo gciwane, ulungile.
Uma umuntu ephila nebuhlungu besikhumba sakhe, bese buso bakhe buphilisa,
bese khona lapho kuvela khona inhlayiya lemhlophe, noma khona lapho kuvela khona iphunga lelibomvu-lelibomvu, kumele aphindze ambonakalise kunkhosi.

"Kute umnikelo wesono uyakubona, bese ubona kutsi kuncane kunesikhumba, nemilenze yakhe ibuye ibe mhlophe, khona-ke umnikelo wesono utawutsi lomuntfu ungcolile; kube yisifo lesibulalayo sesikhumba, saphuma esikhunjeni.

"Kube umnikelo wekushiswa ebona kutsi, bona, angeke kube khona imilenze ebomvu kulo, futsi angeke ibe liphansi kunesikhumba, kodvwa libe limnyama, khona-ke umnikelo wesono kumele agcine lomuntfu embhedeni iminyaka lesikhombisa.
"Lawo magciwane, uma akhula esikhumbani, khona-ke umnikelo wesono uyakusho kutsi lomuntu akabi nemavi; kuyisifo.
Ngako-ke, uma iphunga lihlala likhona lapho likhona, lingasakazekanga, khona-ke liyindlala yesifo; ngobe kutsi umnikelo wekushiswa uyakusho kutsi lomuntfu ungcolile.
Noma lowo muntfu angaba nebuhlungu besikhumba sakhe ngemlilo, kanye nenyama lemnyama yebuhlungu ibuye ibe yindawo ekhanyayo, ebomvu-emhlophe noma ebomvu.

Kutsi uma umnikelo wekushiswa ebheka, bese kubona kutsi imilenze kulendawo lemnyama ibuye ibe mhlophe, nemehlo akhe abona kutsi liphansi kunesikhumba, khona-ke umnikelo wesono longcolile, waphuma kulelo gciwane; ngobe umnikelo wesono longcolile.

Nase-ke, uma umnikelo wesono ebona kutsi kulapho, angeke kube nemilenze ebomvu kulo mkhuhlane, futhi akubi kakhulu kunesikhumba, kepha kube sekubhaka, khona-ke umnikelo wesono kufanele amgcine embhedeni iminyaka lesitfupha.
Umnikelo wekushiswa utawutsi: "Kunelilanga lesitsatfu, umnikelo wekushiswa utawutsi: 'Lomuntfu ungcolile.'" Ngako-ke umnikelo wekushiswa utawutsi: "Umnikelo wesono longcolile.'

Ngako-ke, uma iphunga lihlala likhona lapho likhona, lingasakazeki esikhumbani, kepha libe likhulu kakhulu, khona-ke kuyawutsi ngukuvuvukala kwelokudla lokudlwengulayo; kube umnikelo wesono lokusho kutsi lomuntu uhlanzekile, ngobe kuyimkhuhlane wokudla lokudlwengulayo.
Uma indoda noma indodana iphindze ibe nemkhuhlane emlonyeni wakhe noma emilenzeni,

"Kute umnikelo wesono uyakubona lenkinga, bese ubona kutsi iphansi kunesikhumba, nemilenze yayo ibe mnyama kakhulu nencane, khona-ke umnikelo wesono kumele akhulume ngaye ngokuthi ungcolile; kuyindlala yesikhumba, yisifo lesibulalayo esiswini noma emlenzeni.

"Kube umnikelo wekushiswa ebheka isikhumba, bese ebona kutsi kungeke kube khona lilanga lelimnyama, ngobe licwebile kunesikhumba, khona-ke umnikelo wekushiswa utawumisa lomuntfu iminyaka lesikhombisa.

Ngelilanga lesisikhombisa umnikelo wekushiswa uyakubona lesifo, bese ubona kutsi igciwane alisakazeki, futsi angeke kube nemilenze ensundu kulo, nalapho kubonakala khona sengathi lingaphansi kwesikhumba,
"Lomuntfu kumele acwebe, kepha kufanele angeke acwebe lenkinga; khona-ke umnikelo wesono utawumufaka embhedeni iminyaka lesikhombisa.

"Kuye kube ngumhla wesitsatfu lapho umnikelo wekushiswa ebheka khona isikhumba, bese ubona kutsi isikhumba asikubi kakhulu kunesikhumba, khona-ke umnikelo wesono kumele utsi: "Lomuntu uhlanzekile; kufanele ahlanze tigqoko zakhe, aze ahlanzeke.
Ngako-ke, uma umkhuhlane wehla esikhumbani, ngemuva kwekutsi lomuntfu wahlulelwa kutsi ungcwele,
umnikelo wekushiswa utawuwubheka, bese ubona kutsi umkhuhlane ususakazeke esikhumbani, umnikelo wekushiswa angeke afune mehlo lamnyama; lomuntu ungcolile.

"Kube umnikelo wekushiswa ebheka, bese ubona kutsi iphunga lelibomvu likhule khona, lilanga lelimnyama likhula kulo, lilanga lelibovu liphelile; lomuntfu uhlanzekile; umnikelo wesono kumele akusho ukuthi uhlanzekile.
Uma umfazi noma umfana anesibhakabhaka esimhlophe esikhumbani,
umnikelo wekushiswa utawuzibheka, bese kubona kutsi lemivimbo imhlophe kakhulu, kungenxa yesifo lesibulalayo lesiphuma esikhumbani; lomuntu ungcwele.
Uma umuntu eshiya imilenze yakhe emlonyeni wakhe, angeke abe nemilenze, kodvwa ulungile.
Kodwa-ke, uma kukhona umkhuhlane obomvu-omnyama ekhanda lelibomvu noma emlonyeni, kungenxa yesifo sesikhumba esibi lesiphuma khona.
umnikelo wekushiswa utawumubheka, bese ubona kutsi uma buhlungu besikhumba ebusweni bakhe, noma emlonyeni wakhe, bumhlophe-bumnyama, bufana nenkinga yesikhumba,
lowo muntfu unegciwane lelibomvu ebusweni bakhe, ungcolile; khona-ke umLevi kumele amemetele kutsi uyabiwa.
"Lomuntfu lonegciwane, kumele agqoke tiingubo takhe letibiwe, abe nemilenze yakhe etfutfukile, abe nemehlo akhe ebusweni bakhe, bese etsi: 'Ungenako, awunako!'
Ngelilanga lelinyenti lesifo sakhe sikhona, angeke ahlanzeke; kumele ahlale ngaphandle kwekhampasi, ecaleni lakhe.
Lemigqomo ingaba nayo i-mold kuyo, noma ngabe iyimigqomo yesundu noma yelinen,
noma imiklamo leyimisiwe noma eyimisiwe yelinen, i-wool, isikhumba, noma siphi na sinye sicubu lesifakwe ngesikhumba.
umnikelo wekushiswa utawubheka lenkinga, bese ushiya lento ihlale khona iminyaka lesikhombisa.

Uyawubheka ngelilanga lesitsatfu, bese ubona kutsi igciwane lisakazekile ekudlaleni, noma kulomkhono, noma kulowo msoco, noma kuleyo sikhumba, noma yini leyenziwe ngayo; khona-ke igciwane lelibulalayo likhona kuloo mgqomo, lingcolile.

"Lomuntfu kumele atfume iingubo, noma umhlobiso wesikhumba sengulube, noma umhlobiso wesiliva, noma umhlobiso wegolide, noma into leyenziwe ngesikhumba, lapho igciwane likhona khona; ngoba yisifo lesibulalayo, kufanele itfutwe emhlane.
Ngako-ke, uma umnikelo wesono ebona kutsi, bona, igciwane alisakazekile kuleyo ingubo, noma kulelo lilanga, noma kuleso sicumbu, noma kuleyo mpahla yesikhumba,
khona-ke umnikelo wekushiswa utawuletsa lento lenemkhuhlane kuyo, bese uyibeka phansi ngelilanga lesisikhombisa.

"Kuye kube khona lilanga lesibili, umnikelo wesono uyawubheka, bese ubona kutsi iphunga lingeke lishintshe umbala walo; noma ngabe lilanga lelingcolile lisakazeke, lingakabi lingcolile. Uma lilanga lelingcolile likhona ngasenceleni noma ngasecaleni, kufanele licubhukwe emlilweni.

"Kube umnikelo wekushiswa ebheka, bese ubona kutsi iphunga lifihlekile ngemuva kwekuhlalwa, kumele alisetshenze legciwane ku HDPE, noma ngesikhumba, noma ngezinto leticutshungulwayo, noma ngezinto leticutshungulwako.
""Lawo emacwecwe, nalawo emabhande, nalawo emabhuti, naleyo mpahla leyenziwe ngesikhumba, noma ngabe ibonakala kuyo, inhle kakhulu; nome yini lenayo imfucuza, uyawuyitfusa emlilweni.
"'Uma uhlamba lempahla, noma isikhumba, bese kuphuma khona umkhuhlane kuyo, kufanele uyihlanze kabili, ibe yingcwele.' "
Lowo ngumthetho wesifo semagciwane emakhazeni esikhumba, noma elineni, noma emlonyeni, noma etinsini, noma kunoma yini leyenziwe ngesikhumba, kutsi icaciswe ingabe ihlanzekile yini, noma ingcolile.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
Lowo ngumthetho wemuntfu lonamagciwane esikhumba, ngelilanga lakhe lokuhlanzwa kwakhe; kumele afike ku sacerdote,
umnikelo wekushiswa kumele aphume ngaphandle kwekhampasi, aze ambone; bese-ke, uma lomuntu ephilisiwe ngesifo sakhe,
khona-ke umnikelo wesono uya kuletsa kutsi bafike bamnike tingulube ezimbili eziphilako, nesihlahla sesidvondza, nesibhakabhaka lesimnyama, nesihopu.
Umkhonzi utawuletsa kutsi ingulube lesinye sibulalane ngemanti laphumayo embhedeni wemhlabatsi.
Ake athathe ingulube lephilayo, nesihlahla se-cedar, nesibindi, ne-ysop, aze azifake, kanye nengulube lephilayo, emphinjeni yalelo lilwane lelihlanjululwe emanzini aphumayo.
Waye utawutsisa legazi lakhe kulowo lofanele kutsi ahlanzwe, kanye naleso singulube esiphilayo, emaviki lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa; bese uyawukhipha isilwane lesiphilayo emhlabatsini.

"Lona longena ekuhlanjisweni kumele ahlanze iingubo zakhe, abe nemilenze yakhe yonke, abe nemphunga wamanzi, aze ahlanzeke; ngemuva kwalokho angafika entabeni, kepha kufanele ahlale ngaphandle kwetente lakhe iminyaka lesikhombisa.
Ngelilanga lesitsatfu kumele awele imilenze yakhe yonke, kanye nenhloko yakhe, nemlenze wakhe, namehlo akhe; kufanele ahlanze ingubo zakhe, ahlamba umzimba wakhe emanzini, aze ahlanzekile.

"Emini yesikhombisa utawunikela ngetinkomo ezimbili, netinkomo letindzala letineminyaka eyodwa ubudala, tingeke tinenkinga ngazo; naye utawunikela ngemnikelo wesono wesinkwa sekhilogremu lelishumi nesishiyagalombili sefulawa lomhlophe lokuhlanganisiwe namafutha, kanye nephethiloli yesigamu selitha.
Lomnikelo wekushiswa utawubekwa phambi kwaSimakadze, emnyango wetenti lekuboniswa khona iminikelo yesono kanye neyekudla.
Watsi umnikelo wesono, lomnikelo wekushiswa, kufanele ube ngumnikelo wesono; umkhonzi utawuwukhipha ebusweni baSimakadze, abe ngumnikelo wesono.
Ake afile lomnikelo wesono ethempelini, lapho kuhlatjwa khona iminikelo yesono neyekudla lokushiswayo; lemnikelo wesono uyawube nguwo wema-Israyeli, njengemnikelo wesono. Ungcwele kakhulu.
Watsi umnikelo wesono athathe ngalegazi lelihlanganisiwe, wamisa phezu kwendlebe yesobunxele salowo longcwele, naphezu kwesandla sakhe sekudla, nephezu kwenyawo lakhe lelibomvu.
Umnikelo wekushiswa utawufakwa esandla sakhe sekudla, bese umnikelo wesono ufakwa esandla sakhe sekudla.

umnikelo wekushiswa kufanele afake umlenze wakhe wesandla sakhe sokudla kuleyo mafuta, abe nawo emlonyeni wakhe lokwesobunxele, bese efafaza ngemilenze yakhe lemafutha lakhona emaphiko asesikhombisa phambi kweSimakadze.

Lawo mafutha asele esandlani sakhe, umnikelo wesono kufanele awufake emlonyeni wakhe wesobunxele, nasenkundleni yesandla sakhe sekudla, nasenkundleni yenyawo lakhe lelibomvu, phezu kwegazi lelihlanganisiwe nesondlo sokubuyiselwa.
Lokudla lokushiwo nguSimakadze, utsi: 24"Lomnikelo wekushiswa utawufakwa ebusweni ba-Aaroni nemadvodzana akhe kanye namadvodzakati abo; lomnikelo wesono uyabekwa phambi kwenkhosi.
Umnikelo wekushiswa utawubekwa phambi kwaSimakadze, umnikelo wesono, kutsi alungise lokubi kwakhe; ngemuva kwalo mnikelo utawubulala iminikelo yekushiswa.
Waye umnikelo wesono, nesondlo sekudla, umkhonzi uyakuzinikela kuwo emgodini; khona-ke umnikelo wesono utawukwenza lokukhululwa kuye, aze ahlanzeke.
Naye afike abe netinkomo ezimbili, noma tingulube ezimbili, kuye ngemandla akhe; eyodwa ibe ngumnikelo wesono, kanti enye ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa.
Ngelilanga lesitsatfu kumele afike abe nemnikelo wakhe wesono, kanye neminikelo yakhe yekushiswa, emnyango wetenti lekuhlangana, phambi kuSimakadze, kutsi ahlanzwe.
Watsi umnikelo wesono, lomnikelo wekushiswa, kufanele ube ngumnikelo wesono; umLevi atawuwukhipha ebusweni baSimakadze, abe ngumnikelo wesono.

Waye abulala inkunzi yemnikelo wekushiswa, watsi: "Lomuntfu longcwele utawukhipha igazi lakhe, aze alifake emlonyeni wesobunxele salowo ongcwele, nalapho kubekwe khona isandla sakhe sokudla kanye nenyawo lakhe lelibomvu.
Umnikelo wekushiswa utawufakwa esandla sakhe sekudla, bese umnikelo wesono ufakwa esandla sakhe sekudla.
Watsi uLevi afafaze ngesandla sakhe sokudla, aze afafaze ngesandla sakhe sasekhohlo ngaleyo mafuta akhona emlonyeni wakhe wesobunxele, emaphiko lasikhombisa phambi kweSimakadze.

Watsi Simakadze: "Umnikelo wesono kumele ufakwe ebusweni benkhosi, bese ufakwa emlonyeni wayo lokudla kwesobunxele, kanye nesandla sakhe sokudla, kanye nenyawo lakhe lelibomvu, lapho kubekwe khona gazi lelihlanganisiwe.
Lokudla lokushiywa ngaleyo mafutha esandla sakhe, umnikelo wekushiswa utawukutsisa phezu kwehlavu lakhe, kutsi abe ngumnikelo wesono kuSimakadze.
Atawunikela ngemiphiko, noma ngemiphiko emincane, njengoba lomuntu engeke akwazi ukuyikhokhela;
yinye ibe ngumnikelo wesono, nesinye sibe ngumnikelo wekushiswa, kanye nesondlo sekudla; khona-ke umnikelo wesono utawumisa lowo muntu phambi kwaSimakadze.
Le mfundiso inconywa kulowo lowo unesifo sesikhumba esibi, longeke akwazi kutsi akhokhele tipho letivame kunikezwa ekuhlanzeni.
Simakadze watsi kuMosi na-Aron:
"Uma nifika ezweni leKanana, lapho ngikunikela khona kutsi libe yilungelo lakho, ngitawubeka umkhuhlane etindlu letihlala kulomhlaba.
"Lowo lobenendlu kumele afike, akhulume nemnikelo wesono, watsi: 'Ngicabanga kutsi ngibona kudla lokubi endlwini yami.'

"Kuye kube khona umvikeli-nkhosi, avumele kutsi lendlu ihlukaniswe, ngaphambi kwekungefika kumvikeli-nkhosi kutsi abone inhlayiya, ukuze kungeke kube nento elingenakubi kuyo; bese kuyawufika umvikeli-nkhosi abheke lendlu.
