Uma ikhona emgwaqeni ngetinyawo letimhlophe noma tingwevu, letibonakala likhulu kunaleyo ndzawo yemgcoko, kufanele afike esiteshini sekunakekelwa kwempilo bese ebheka umgodzi.
umnikelo wekushiswa utawuphuma emnyango wendlu, wavala indlu ngelilanga lesitsatfu, bese ubuyela ekhaya.
"Kuye kube ngumhla wesitsatfu, umnikelo wekushiswa uyawubuyela, wabheka; bese kubona kutsi igciwane lisakazekile emagumbini,
umnikelo wekushiswa utawuletsa kutsi bacubhulele emacwecwe akhona, bawuthumele ngaphandle komgwaqo, endaweni lengcolile.
Watsi: "Lomuntfu kumele afake isandla sakhe emnyango wendlu yakhe, bese ekhipha umhlobiso wayo kanye netinhlamvu taleyo indlu, aze awubeke endaweni lengcolile ngaphandle komgwaqo.
Bafanele bathathe ematshe lamanye kutsi bafake ematshe lamadala, bese basebenzisa i-plaster entsha ukufaka indlu.
Uma umdlavuza ubuyela bese uphuma endlini ngemuva kwekutsi ematshe asuswa kanye nendlu icutshungulwa kanye nekutshiswa,
umnikelo wekushiswa uyawufika, wabheka, bese kubona ukuthi igciwane lisakazekile endlini; lilanga lesifo lesibulalayo likhona, indlu ingcolile.
Bayawuyibulala, netimkhonto tayo, netinkhuni tayo, naleyo mpunga wayo wonke, bayawuwukhipha emgwaqeni, babuyele endaweni lengakabi nemavi.
Wonke lowo longena endlwini leso sikhatsi lapho indlu ivulekile khona, angeke abe nekuthula kuze kuhlwa.
Wonke lowo lohlala noma edla endlini kumele ahlanze ingubo yakhe.

"Kube umnikelo wekushiswa ufike, umkhonzi waSimakadze abone, bese ebona kutsi iphunga lelibomvu alisakazekile endlini, ngemuva kokuba indlu icwecwe, khona-ke umkhonzi waNkulunkulu kumele atsi indlu iyihlanzekile, ngobe iphunga lelibovu lisusekile.
"Lomuntfu kumele athathe tingulube ezimbili, nesihlahla se-cedar, nesiliva lelibomvu, ne-isop, aze ahlanze indlu.
Uyawubulala inkemba yinye ngemanti laphumako embhedeni wemhlabatsi.
Waye athathe isihlahla sesedvo, ne-ysop, ne-scarlet, nesilwane lesiphilayo, wamisa kuwo lilanga lesilwane lesifile kanye namanzi laphumayo, wageza indlu kalishumi elinhlanu.
Aye ahlanze indlu ngegazi lengulube, nemanti laphumako, nengulube ephilayo, nesihlahla se-sedari, ne-ysop, nesiliva.
ke-ke utawukhipha ingulube lephilayo, ayilete ngaphandle komgwaqo emhlabatsini; khona-ke uyawulungisa indlu yakhe, ibe yingcwele.
Lolu lwazi lufanele kutsi lusebentiswe ngeso sonke sifo sesikhumba kanye nebuhlungu besisu,
kufaka tinhlayiya emakhazeni noma endlwini,
kanye nekuvuvukala, i-scab, noma indawo lekhanyayo.
Lifundisa kutsi yini leyingcolile kanye nekuphi lapho ihlanzekile. Lena yindlela yekufunda ngesifo sesikhumba kanye ne-mollusc.
Simakadze watsi kuMosi na-Aron:
Utsi kuboSirayeli: Uma umuntu ephuma emlonyeni wakhe, lokuphuma kwakhe kungeke kube nebubi kuye.
Angeke abe nekuthula, noma ngabe umchamo wakhe uhlala uphuma, noma ngabe uhlala uhamba, ngobe lokhu kuyawukwenza abe nemchubu.
Nayinye ibhedu lapho ahlala khona, iyaba yinhle; nayinye into lapho ehlala kuyo, iyaba inhle.
Wonke lowo utawuhlamba ingubo yakhe, wageza isikhumba sakhe ngamanzi, abe nenkinga kuze kube sebusuku.
Nalowo nalowo lohlala yinye yezinto lapho lowo longenako ehlala khona, kufanele ahlanze tigqoko zakhe, abe nemphunga wamanzi, abe nenkinga kuze kube sebusuku.
Nalowo nalowo lowudla inyama yakhe, kumele ahlanze iingubo zakhe, abe nesikhumba sakhe singcolile kuze kube sebusuku.
"Nakuba lowo onesifo sokuphuma ephuza kulowo longcwele, yena kumele ahlanze tigqoko zakhe, ahlamba emanzini, abe ne HDPH kuze kube sebusuku.
Nanoma yini leyayihamba ngayo lowesifazane, ingcolile.

Wonke lowo lotawudlidliza noma yini leye yabe ingaphansi kwakhe, angeke abe nekunakeni kuze kube sebusuku; nalowo loyawutikhipha kumele ahlanze ingubo yakhe, ahlamba emanzini, aze abe nekunakeni kuze kube sebusuku.
Nalowo nalowo lotawuwugoca, ngaphandle kwekungodla isandla sakhe emanzini, kumele ahlanze ingubo yakhe, abe nephunga lemanti, abe nekunakeni kuze kube sebusuku.
Ingilazi yemhlabatsi lapho umfana eshaya khona kumele ihlukaniswe, kanye nanoma iyiphi ibhodlela lemilenze kufanele ihlanzwe ngemanti.
"Lomuntfu, lapho ephiliswa khona ekuphuzeni kwakhe, kumele abala lilanga lesitsatfu lokuhlanzeka kwakhe; kufanele ahlamba tigqoko zakhe, ahlamba umzimba wakhe emanzini laphumayo, bese ehlanzekile.
Ngosuku lwesine, kumele athathe tingulube ezimbili, noma tingulube letincane ezimbili, afike emgwaqeni wetenti lekuhlangana phambi kwaSimakadze, aze awanike kuLevi.
Waye umnikelo wesono, lomunye umnikelo wesono, lomunye umnikelo wekushiswa; khona-ke umnikelo wesono utawukhipha umonakalo wakhe phambi kwaSimakadze.
"Lomuntfu lophindze atfole umchamo wakhe, kumele ahlamba umhlaba wakhe wonke emanzini, abe nenkinga kuze kube sebusuku.
Nayinye ingubo, nayinye isikhumba, lapho kuyawufika khona umkhuhlane, kumele ihlanzwe ngamanzi, ibe yingcolile kuze kube sebusuku.
"Nalomuntfu lohlangana nendvodza, nalapho kuphuma khona umchamo wakhe, kumele bahlanzwe ngamanzi, bangabi nakunaki kuze kube sebusuku."
"Wena-ke, uma indoda iphuma emlonyeni wayo, kumele ibe nelilanga lesitsatfu ingabi nakunaki; lowo lomutingela kufanele abe nakunaki kuze kuhlwa.
Nanoma yini lapho ahlala khona kuyo, ngelilanga lakhe lokudlidliza, ingcolile; nanoma yini lapho ehlala kuyo, ingcolile.
Wonke lowo lotawudlidliza embhedeni wakhe, kumele ahlanze ingubo yakhe, abe nemphunga wamanzi, abe nenkinga kuze kube sebusuku.
Wonke lowo lotawudlidliza noma yini leyayihlala phezu kwayo, kumele ahlanze tigqoko zakhe, ahlamba emanzini, abe nenkinga kuze kube sebusuku.
Nakuba libhedu lakhe, noma yini leye ahlala kuyo, lowo loyicophelela kumele abe nekunakeni kuze kube sebusuku.
"Nakuba umfana ehlala naye, bese kuyawufika kuye lokusuka kwakhe, angeke abe nekuthula iminyaka lesikhombisa; nanoma isiphi sibhedlela lapho ahlala khona, angeke abe nekuthula.

"Wena umfati, uma ephuma ngegazi lakhe iminyaka leminingi ngaphandle kwemnyaka wakhe wesifazane, noma uma ephuma ngegazi lakhe ngemuva kwemnyaka wakhe wesifazane, angeke abe nekuthula kuze kube sekuphele iminyaka yakhe yesifazane, njengaleso sikhatsi lapho ephuma khona.

Nakwesiphi nasinye isibhedlela lapho ihlala khona ngesikhathi sokuphuma kwayo, siyawubi nebubi, njengesibhedlela sayo sesikhathi sakhe sokuphuma; nakwesiphi nasinye isibhedlela lapho ihlala khona, siyawubi nebubi, njengesikhathi sayo sokuphuma.
Wonke lowo lowucophelela kuleso silwane, ungeke abe nekuthula; kumele ahlanze tigqoko zakhe, ahlamba emanzini, abe nendlala kuze kube sebusuku.
"Lamuhla-ke, lapho ephiliswa khona emgodini wakhe, kufanele abala lilanga lesitsatfu, bese emvaloko abe linyenti.
Ngelilanga lesishiyagalolunye, kumele athathe tingulube ezimbili, noma tingulube letincane ezimbili, aze azifikele kumnikelo wesono emnyango wetenti lekuhlangana.
Waye umnikelo wesono, lomunye umnikelo wesono, lomunye umnikelo wekushiswa; khona-ke umnikelo wesono uyawukhipha umonakalo wakhe phambi kwaSimakadze, ngenxa yentfo yakhe lengcolile.
Niyawuletsa bantfu baka-Israyeli kutsi bangabi nebubi babo, ukuze bangafa, lapho bengenalo livi lami lengcwele, lelikhona phakathi kwabo.
Lowo ngumthetho wemuntfu lophuka, nalowo muntfu longenako lokubi lokusuka emlonyeni wakhe,
kanye nendvodza leyimfishane, nalowo muntfu lophumayo noma lowo mfazi, nalowo muntfu lohlalana nenkhosi yakhe, nome nalowo muntfu lohlalana nenkosi yakhe.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosesi ngemuva kokufa kwamadvodzana amabili a-Aron, lapho befika khona kuSimakadze, bafa.

USimakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Thitha uAron, umngane wakho, ukuthi angeke afike ethempelini elikhulu kakhulu ngaso sonke isikhathi, ngemuva kwegobolondo, phambi kwesibopho esibekwe phezu kwesibopho sesivumelwano, ukuze angafa; ngobe ngizovela emlilweni ngesibopho.
Lokho kuyawufika ngako u-Aron engcweleni: inkunzi yengulube ibe ngumnikelo wekushiswa, nemvu ibe ngumnikelo wesono.

Ase agqoke ihembe lelibomvu elingcwele, abe nemikhono lelibomvu emlenzeni wakhe, abe nemgobo welibomvu emlenzeni wakhe, abe netinhlavu telibomvu emlenzeni wakhe; lezi yitibopho letingcwele; aze ahlamba umzimba wakhe ngamanzi, bese egqoka.
"Uyawuthatha emindenini yaSirayeli, afake emakhoboka lasitfupha kutsi abe ngumnikelo wesono, nalowo mkhwenyana abe ngumnikelo wokushiswa.
U-Aron utawunikela ngengulube ibe ngumnikelo wesono, kutsi abe nekuthula yena kanye nendlu yakhe.
Waye athabathe lomnikelo wesono, wawubeka phambi kwaSimakadze emnyango wetente lekuhlangana.
Watsi: "Lomuntfu kumele abeke isandla sakhe esihlalweni saSimakadze, bese ekhipha isandla sakhe esihlalweni saNkulunkulu.
U-Aron utawunikela ngemnikelo wesono lowo mkhwenyana lobekwe ngumtsetfo kuSimakadze, watsi:
"Lebhoza lelihlanganiswe ngesoti ku-Asera, kumele libekwe liphila phambi kwaSimakadze, kutsi libe ngumnikelo wesono, lokuwukhipha emhlabatsini, njengebhoza lelihlanganisiwe nesono.
U-Aron utawunikela ngengulube yemnikelo wesono, kutsi abe ngumnikelo wesono kuye kanye nendlu yakhe; uyawubulala ingulube yemnikelo wesono.
Watsi umnikelo wakhe wesono ube ngu-shekeli yesiliva, neshekeli yegolide, neshekeli yesiliva, neshekeli yegolide, neshekeli yesiliva, neshekeli yegolide, neshekeli yegolide.
wabeka umnikelo wekushiswa emlilo phambi kwaSimakadze, kutsi umfudlane wemnikelo wekushiswa ubambe isipho lesibekwe ngasebhokisini lesivumelwane, ngobe angeke afe.
Wathatha negazi lengulube, walihlisa ngesandla sakhe ebusweni besipho, ngasenyakatho-mpumalanga; naphezu kwesipho alihlisa negazi ngesandla sakhe emaphiko lasikhombisa.

Waye abulala lokhokho wesondlo sesono sabantu, wabeka igazi lakhe entanyeni yesitandza, wakwenza negazi lesoso, njengobe akwenze negazi lengulube; walisa ebusweni besipho, kanye nangaphambili kwesipho.

Uyakwenza njalo kutsi alungise lendawo engcwele kakhulu, ngenxa yetinhlekelele temadvodzana a-Isiraheli, nezinkinga labo, kanye naletinye tigebengu tabo; kanjalo-ke uyakwenza netenti lekuhlangana, leliyiphakathi kwabo, phakathi kwetinhlekelele tabo.

Angeke kube khona muntfu wesifazane etentini lekuhlangana, kusukela lapho afike khona uAron kutsi abe ngumnikelo wesono ethempelini elikhulu, kuze aphume, aze abe ngumnikelo wesono kuye, nemndeni wakhe, nebandla lonke lalabaLevi.
Uyawuphuma, afike enhliziyweni ye altare lebekwe phambi kwaSimakadze, aze abe ngumnikelo wesono; utawuthatha igazi lenkomo neliphunga lalibomvu lwakhe, wamisa emakhoneni onke e-altar.
Waye utawutsisa ngaleyo gazi ngesandla sakhe emaphiko lasikhombisa, aze ayisahlanze, aze ayisangcwele, kutsi ingabi nemibimbi yalabaLevi.
"Uye aphelele ukwakha ithempeli elikhulu kakhulu, netenti lekuhlangana, ne altare, bese anikela ngebhokhwe lephilayo.

Wabeka isandla sakhe esisodwa phezu kwehlavu lebhokhwe lephilayo, wakhuluma ngaso zonke izingcweti tamakhosikazi aseSirayeli, kanye naleyo migudu yabo, naleso sivi sabo; wababeka phezu kwenhloko yebhokhwe, wehlisa ibhokhwe emasikweni, ngesandla semuntu obekwe kuyo.
Lombudzi utawuba netintfo letibi talowo muntfu, afike emhlabatsini; lowo muntu uyawushiya lombudzi emhlabatsini.
U-Aron kufanele afike etentini lekuhlangana, agqoke ingubo yelinen, abeyigqokile lapho efika khona esingcwele singcwele, aze azibeke khona.
Waye ahlamba umzimba wakhe emanzini emhlabatsini langcwele, agqoke iingubo zakhe, aphume, abe nesondlo sakhe sokudla kanye nesondlo sokudla sema-Israyeli, abe nesono sakhe kanye nesono lama-Israyeli.
Lamafutha emnikelo wekushiswa wesono ayawuwufuya emgodini.
Lomuntfu loyawuyisa ingulube emhlabatsini, kumele ahlanze tigqoko zakhe, ahlamba umzimba wakhe emanzini, bese emva kwalokho angafika entabeni.

Lengulube yemnikelo wekushiswa kanye nebhokhwe yemnikelo wesono, legazi labo lafakwa ethempelini lokungcwele kakhulu, kutsi kube ngumnikelo wesono, kumele bakhishwe ngaphandle kwekhabhinethi; kufanele bacutshwe ngemlilo sikhumba sabo, nemfuyo yabo, nenyama yabo.
Lomuntfu loyawuzibulala kumele ahlanze ingubo yakhe, abe nesikhumba sakhe sicociwe ngamanzi, bese efika entabeni.

Lolu hlelo lungaba ngumthetho wenu kuze kube sekupheleni: kulenyanga yesishiyagalolunye, ngelilanga leshumi, kufanele niphumule, ningasebenzisi lutho, nalowo lozalwa kulomhlaba, nalowo ohlala phakathi kwenu.
ngobe ngalolusuku lolunye niyawucutshungulwa kutsi ningabi necala, niyawucutshungulwa kutsi ningabi necala; kusuka kuwo onkhe ebubi benu niyawucutshungulwa phambi kweSimakadze.
Kuyawube ngusuku lwekuphumula lokuphelele kuwe; kufanele uhlale ungadli kudla, kube ngumthetho wemihla lenu.
Lomnikelo wekushiswa, lowo umnikelo wesono, lowufakwa esivumelwaneni naSimakadze, kufanele agqoke iingubo tesiliva negolide, impahla lengcwele.
Uya kulungiselela ithempeli elikhulu kakhulu, netenti lekuhlangana, ne altare, nalabaphatsimandla kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu bebandla.
Le mithetho ibe ngumthetho wenu kuze kube sekupheleni, kutsi banike umnikelo wesono kubo bonkhe bantfu baka-Israyeli, kanye ngaleso sikhatsi semnyaka; ngobe Simakadze abewisela Mose.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
"Ukhulume na-Aron, nemadvodzana akhe, kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, utsi kubo: 'Lena yindlela Simakadze abewisele ngayo.
Nalowo nalowo waseSirayeli lobulala inkunzi, noma ingulube, noma inkomo, entabeni, noma ngaphandle kwentabeni,

kodvwa angeke ayifikelise emgwaqeni wetenti lekuhlangana, aze ayinikeze njengemnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze phambi kwendlu yakhe lengcwele, lowo muntu utawubi negazi; gazi uyawulibabisa, lomuntu lowo uyasuswa emiphakathini yakhe.

"Lakho kusho kutsi lamadvodza aseSirayeli, lapho abulala khona emhlabatsini, kufanele afike abe ngumnikelo wesono kuSimakadze; kumele afike abe ngumnikelo wesono emnyango wetenti lekuhlangana, abe ngumnikelo wesono kuMosi, umLevi.
umnikelo wekushiswa utawuwufafaza umlonyeni wakhe, bese ukhipha igazi lakhe emgodini waSimakadze emnyango wetente lekuhlangana; nesikhumba sayo siyawusibulala, ibe ngumoya lomnandi kuSimakadze.
Bangeke baphinde banikela ngenyama yabo emabhokhweni abo, abebehamba ngawo; kumele kube ngumthetho wabo kuze kube sekupheleni, kubo kanye nemindeni yabo yonke.
Utsi kubo: Nalowo nalowo waseSirayeli, nalowo nalowo lohlala phakathi kwenu, lonikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa noma ngemnikelo wesono,
nome angeke ayifikelise emgwaqeni wetenti lekuhlangana, kutsi ayinike uSimakadze, lomuntu lowo kumele aphekwe emiphakathini yakhe.
Nalowo nalowo waseSirayeli, nalowo nalowo lohlala ebantwini bakho, ladla lutho lwegazi, ngiyawubeka isandla sami esihlalweni salowo muntu, ngiwucubhulele emehlweni akhe.

Batsi: "Leligazi liyawuba ngumnikelo wesono; ngobe umphefumulo walenyama lephilayo ukhona kuleyo gazi. Nami ngikunike lona, kutsi libe ngumnikelo wesono ngale-altari; ngoba lilanga leliphilayo, igazi, liyawuba ngumnikelo wesono kuSimakadze.
Ngako-ke ngitsi kuboSirayeli: Akukho muntfu lophilako phakathi kwenu longeke asele ekudlaleni gazi, nalowo lohlala emehlweni enu angeke asele ekudlaleni gazi.
Nalowo nalowo wase-Israyeli, nalowo nalowo wesikhashana lohlala phakathi kwabo, uma ebulala isilwane noma umhlambi wetilwane letidlakalayo, kumele asuse gazi lakhe, alizise ngemhlaba.
Nakho-ke ngitsi kuboSirayeli: "Ningeke nidle igazi lalowo nalowo lophilayo, ngobe litfu lalowo nalowo lophilayo liyigazi lakhe; lowo nalowo lodla lona kumele aphekwe."

Nalowo nalowo lodla isilwane lesifile, noma lesihlanganisiwe nenyama yemhlabatsini, kube ngumuntfu wasekhaya noma ngabe ungumhlali, kumele ahlanze ingubo yakhe, ahlamba emanzini, abe nekunakenu kuze kube sebusuku; emva kwalokho abe netekuthula.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
"Ukhulume nalabaSirayeli utsi kubo: 'Ngiye Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu.
Ningeke nihambe njengobe kwenziwa ezweni laseMijiphu, lapho nihlala khona; ningabe nihamba njengobe kwenziwa ezweni leKanana, lapho ngiyawukulethela khona; ningabe nihamba ngendlela yabo.
Lamandla ami niwagcine, nemiyalo yami niyigcine niyiphumele. Ngiye Nkulunkulu wenu.
Nigcine imiyalo yami nemtsetfo wami; ngobe umuntu lowenza, uyawuphila ngawo. Ngiye Simakadze.
Angeke nifike emndenini wakhe, kutsi nihlangane naye. Ngiye Simakadze.
Ungeke uphindze ube necala lokubi kuyise wakho; ngobe yena ngubaba wakho, wena kufanele ungabi necala lokubi.
Umkakhe wababa bakho ungeke ube nebucwebe bakhe, ngoba lokhu kuyawuphazamisa umkakhe.
"Ungeke ube nebudlelwane nenkosikazi yakho, noma ngabe indvodzakati yababa bakho, noma ngabe indvodzakati yamama wakho, noma ngabe wazalwa ekhaya lakho, noma ngabe kwakunye.
Ungeke ufike kundvodzakati yakho, noma kunkhosikati yakho; ngobe kuyitfutfuko kuwe.
Ungeke uvule ibuso bendvodzakati yababa wakho, lezalwa ngubaba wakho; yena udadewabo; ungawuvula.
Ungeke uvule isikhumba senkosikazi yababa bakho; yena ngumndeni wakhe, umfana wakhe.
Ungeke ube nesive senkosikazi yakho, ngobe yena umshado wenkhosi yakho.
Umuntfu lofana nalowo utata wakho, ungawufihla umlomo wakhe; ungumyeni wenkosi yakho.
Ungeke uvule isikhumba senkosikazi yakho; yena ngumfazi wemadvodzana akho, awufuni ukuvula isikhumba saSimakadze.
Ungeke ubone buso bendvodzakati yakho, ngobe kuyawuphazamisa umyeni wakho.

Ungeke ube nemehlo embhedze wakhe kanye nendvodzakati yakhe; ungeke ube nendodana yomntwana wakhe, noma nendodana yenkhosi yakhe, ungeke ube nemehlo embhedze wayo. Baye bobandlululo lwakhe; lokhu kubi.
Ungeke ube nenkosikazi yendvodzakati yakho, kuze kube ihlala, ukuze ube ngumncintiswano wayo, bese uhlangana naye.
"Ungeke ufike kumuntfu lowesifazane ngelilanga lakhe, lapho engakabi nemphilo yakhe lengcolile.
"Ungeke ube nebudlelwane nendvodzakati yemuntfu wakho, uphindze ube nebubi kuye."
Ungeke uvumele namunye wemadvodzana akho aphume emlilo abe nguMolekhi; nome uphindze unciphise igama laNkulunkulu wakho. Ngiye Simakadze.
Mna-ke, ungeke uhlangane nemuntfu lomnyama njengobe uhlangane nendvodza; ngobe kuyinto lebi.
Ungeke uhlangane nanoma yini lephilayo, ukuze ungabi nenkinga nayo. Umkhwenyana angeke abe nesilwane, kutsi uhlangane nalo; lokhu kuyawuba buhlungu kakhulu.
Mna-ke ningabi nenkinga ngayinye yalezi zinto, ngobe naleyo ndzawo leminyenti yebantfu labengisayikhuphula phambi kwenu, bayinenkinga.
Lelizwe laliba nebubi, ngobe ngayekela kuyo inkohliso yayo; lemhlaba wakhipha bantfu bakhe, njengemuntfu lophuma emphinjeni.
Ngako-ke nigcine imiyalo yami nemtsetfo wami, ningazange nikwenze nasinye salezi zinto letibi, noma ngabe ungumhlali wasemhlaba, noma ngabe uhlala phakathi kwenu.
ngobe labantfu labahlala kulomhlaba ngaphambi kwenu bakwenzela zonke lezi zinto letibi, khona lemhlaba waba nebubi.
Uma niyiphazamisa lelizwe, liyawutfusa nani, njengobe latfusa linye ilizwe lelibe khona ngaphambi kwenu.
Lomuntfu lowenza linye laletinye titfo letibi, lowo muntu kumele ahlukaniswe nabantfu bakhe.
Nigcine ke imiyalo yami, kutsi ningeke nihambe ngelinye lalawo masiko abulalayo, abekhona ngaphambi kwenu; ningabi nenkinga ngawo. Ngiye Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
"Ukhulume nesive seSirayeli, utsi kubo: Nibe bangcwele; ngobe mina, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, ngingcwele.
Lowo uyawuhlonipha umtfubi wakhe, nalowo uyawuhlonipha ubaba wakhe, nigcine iSabhati yami. Ngiye Nkulunkulu wenu.
Mna, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, nginguSimakadze longuSomandla, Nkulunkulu wenu, ngobe nimi.
Uma ninikela ngemnikelo wesono kuSimakadze, niyawunikela ngayo ngendlela efanele, ukuze ibe yinhle kuwe.
Kuyawudliwa kulelo langa nilinikela ngalo, noma ngelilanga lesitsatfu; kepha noma yini lehlala kuze kube lilanga lesithathu, kumele icutshwe emhlane.
Uma kudla kwalo kudliwa ngelilanga lesithathu, kungeke kuvunyelwe kutsi kube khona.
Wonke lowo loyawudla wona, utawuba necala lakhe, ngobe wakhipha kulelo lingcwele lelingangcwele kaSimakadze; nalowo muntfu kumele ahlukaniswe nebantfu bakhe.
"Lamuhla-ke, lapho nivuna khona imbewu yemhlabatsini wenu, ningayivuna kuze kufike ekugcineni kwemhlabatsini lwakho, noma ungayeki ukubuyisa lokudla lokubiwe.
Ungeke uphuze iwayini lakho, nome ubeke emajikijolo akho emlonyeni wakho; 21uyawushiya kulowo mtfubi kanye nalowo wesikhashana. Ngiye Nkulunkulu wenu.
"Mna-ke, ningatsebi, nitsi: 'Asekho umuntfu lophilayo.'
Ningeke nifake igama lami enhliziyweni yenu, ngobe niyawuphazamisa igama laNkulunkulu wenu. Ngiye Simakadze.
"Mna-ke, ngitsi kuwe: Mna-ke, ngitsi kuwe: Musa kusebentisa umkhonto wakhe ngelilanga kuze kube ngubusuku.
"Ungeke ubulale umdlavuza, nome ubeke phambi komdlavuza yini nayiphi into leyawuwuphazamisa; ngobe wena utawuthandaza kuSimakadze longuSomandla wakho. Ngiye Simakadze.
"Ungeke ugweme lokubi ekucasheni kwakho, ungabonisi isandla somdlavuza, nome ubeke ecaleni lomtfubi; ungeke ugweme umkhonto wakho ngekuhle.
Ungeke uhambe ukhuluma ngebugebengu ebantwini bakho; ngobe ngiSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.
Ungamkhoni mngane wakho enhliziyweni yakho, kodwa ugweme umhlobo wakho ngamehlo akho uma ekhohlwa, ukuze ungabi nesibopho sebubi bakhe.

"Ungeke ubeke isandla sakho emlonyeni wakhe, ngobe ngiSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho. 21Ngakho-ke akufanele ube nenkinga nanoma ngubani emndenini wakho; kodvwa kufanele umthande lomunye wako njengawe ngokwakho.
Kutsi:. Ungabambisani nenyama lehlukene,. Ungeke ubeke emhlabatsini lakho timbewu letihlukile,. Ungeke ugqoke tiingubo tezinto letihlukene,. Ungeke usebentise isandla sakho kumsebenti wemhlabatsi.

""Uma umuntu ehlangana nendvodzakati yakhe, indvodzakati yemuntfu, ibe yindodana yalowo mkhonzi, angeke ibuyiselwe, noma angeke avumeleke ukuba abe ngumkhonzi wakhe; bangabi nakufa, ngobe yena akazange avumeleke ukuba abe ngumkhonzi wakhe.
Lomuntfu kumele afike abe nemnikelo wesono, umnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze, emnyango wetenti lekuhlangana.
"Umnikelo wekushiswa utawufakwa ebhokisini lemlilo, umnikelo wesono, kanye neminikelo yekushiswa, kuze kube ngumnikelo wesondlo sakusihlwa; umnikelo wesono kumele ubekwe ebhokisini lemlilo.
"Uma nifika ezweni, nafaka khona noma yimuphi umtfubi lophilayo, ningeke nidle umnikelo wayo wesono; iminyaka lemithathu kumele ube ngumnikelo wesono kuwe, ungadlanga.
Ngemnyaka wesine, yonke imfuyo yayo ibe ngcwele, ibe ngumnikelo wekubonga kuSimakadze.
Ngemnyaka wesihlanu ningeke nidle umnikelo wayo, kutsi umhlambi wakho ube mkhulu kakhulu. Ngiye Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu.
Ungadla noma yini yekudla lapho igazi likhona kulo. Ungasebenzisi umlingo, noma uphindze utfole lokuya kwenzeka.
Ungayicitsi imilenze emigwaqeni yenhloko yakho, noma ungayicitsi imilenze yembebe yakho.
Ningeke nicwebeze isikhumba senu, nivune lokufa, ningeke nibeke uphawu ebusweni benu. Ngiye Nkulunkulu.
"Ungeke uphuce indvuna yakho, uyenze ibe ngumfoti, kutsi ilizwe lihambe libe ngumfoti, liphele ngebubi."
Nigcine lilanga lesabate lami, niyihloniphe indlu yami lengcwele. Ngiye Simakadze.
Ningeke niye kulabo abakhuluma ngezinto eziphilayo, noma kubo labafuna ukukhuluma ngezinto ezifileyo; ningaba khona kubo, ngobe bakwentani nibi. Ngiye Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu.
Hamba ubhekene nalabo bakhulu, hloniphana nabo labakhulu; ngobe ngiNkulunkulu wakho. Ngiye Simakadze.
"Uma umhlali ehlala nawe ezweni lakho, ungawubiseli ngebuhlungu.
Utakwenza umkhwenyana, lohlala nawe, abe sengathi ungumhlali wakho; utawuwuthanda njengobe uyawukuthanda wena; ngobe naye ube ngumkhwenyana ezweni leMijiphu. Ngiye Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu.
Ungagcini lapho ulinganisela khona ubude, sisindo noma inani.
Ngiye Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, lowawutfusa ezweni leMijiphu. 23Nine nginguSimakadze longuSomandla wenu, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ngobe nimi.
Nigcine tonkhe timiso tami, naletinye timiso tami, niziphumele. Ngiye Simakadze."
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:

"Uyakhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, utsi: Nalowo nalowo wesifazane waseSirayeli, noma lowo mhlali waseSirayeli, lonikela ngemunye wemadvodzana akhe kuMoleki, kumele abulawa; bantfu belizwe labangeke bagweme ukumbulala.

Nami ngitawubeka sandla sami esihlalweni salowo muntu, ngiwucishe ebantwini bakhe; ngobe angeke abe nekuthula endlini yami lengcwele, nome angeke abe nekuthula kulelo igama lami elingcwele, uma enikela ngemadvodzana akhe ku-Molokhi.
Nakuba bantfu balelo lizwe bebona ngamehlo abo kutsi lowo muntu unikela ngemadvodzana akhe kuMoleki, bangawubulalanga;
ngase ngibeke isandla sami esihlalweni salowo muntu, nesihlalo semndeni wakhe; ngase ngiwucishe lomuntu kanye nalabo bonke labahamba ngemuva kwakhe, baphuma emiphakathini yabo.
Lomuntu lobuyela kulabo labakhuluma ngemimoya, nelabo labafuna ukubona kusasa, angeke ahambe ngalendlela yabo; ngobe ngitawubeka isandla sami esihlalweni salowo muntu, ngiwucime ebantwini bakhe.
Nihlale ningcwele, ningabi ngcwele; ngobe ngiye Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu.
Niyigcine imiyalo yami, niyiphumele. Ngiye Simakadze loyawukungcwelela kwenu.
Lomuntfu loyala ubaba wakhe noma umama wakhe, kumele abulawe; wabala ubaba wakhe noma umtama wakhe, kufanele abulawe.
Uma umuntu ephazamisa indodana yomfana wakhe, indvodzakati yemuntfu lomfana wakhe, lowesifazane naleyo ndoda kumele bafa.
""Wena-ke, uma umuntu ehlangana nendvodzakati yababa wakhe, utawufa; yena nayise kumele bafatiswe; bangabi necala lokubulawa kwabo.
Uma umuntu ehlala nenkosikazi yakhe, kumele batfunywe bonke; baphumele kuhlukunyezeka lokubi kakhulu; bangafa ngecala labo.
Uma umuntu eshada nendvodzakati yakhe kanye nemtakwabo, kuyinto lebi; kumele bacubhukwe ngemlilo, yena naleyo ndoda, kutsi kungeke kube khona lokubi phakathi kwenu.
Uma muntfu ehlangana nesilwane, kufanele abulawa, kanye nesilwane kumele niyibulala.
""Nase umfazi afike esilwaneni, aze ahlangane nayo, kufanele ubulala lowesifazane kanye nesilwane; kumele babulawe. Ukufa kwabo kuyawuba ngumnikelo wabo wesono.
"Lomuntfu lohlangana nendvodza ngelilanga lakhe, wafihla umfula wayo, nayo yawufihla umtfungo wayo; bangacinywa bobabili emphakathini wabo.
Ungeke ube nendodana yenkosikazi yakho, noma indodana yenkhosikati yakho; ngobe kuyinto lebi kakhulu kubo bonkhe bantfu.
Uma umuntu ehlangana nendvodzakati yenkosikazi yakhe, uyise wenkosikazi yakhe uyawuyiphazamisa; baya kuba nesono sabo; bangabi nabantwana baphela.
Uma umuntu eshada nendvodzakati yakhe, kuyinto lengcolile; umyeni wakhe wesilisa utawubi mnyama; bangaba nemntwana.
Nigcinela ngako tonkhe timiso tami, nemtsetfo wami wonke, niwuphumele; ukuze lelizwe lapho ngiyawunifaka khona kutsi nihlale kuyo, lingeke linukele.
Ningeke nihambe ngemithetho yebantfu labengingabakhipha phambi kwenu; ngobe bakwenzela zonke lezi zinto, ngobe ngibakhonta.

Nami ngitsi kuni: Niyawuyithola lelizwe labo libe yitfu, nami ngiyakulethela kutsi libe liwe, ilizwe elihlanganisiwe nemmbila nemvubelo. Ngiye Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, lowazihlukanisa nisuka emazweni labanye.

Ningeke nihlukanise phakathi kwesilwane lesihlanzekile nesinye esingaluhle, kanye netingulube letihlanjululwayo naletingalule; ningabi nemfudlana ngekudla noma yini yenyama lephilayo, nome tilwane temhlabatsini, noma lokunye lokudlidlizako, lami sengikulethela kutsi lingcolile.
Babe bangcwele kuye, ngobe ngiyabangcwele ngiye Simakadze; nami sengikwati kutsi nihlale nguNkulunkulu wami, ngatsi uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, watsi: "Labo bangcwele bami!
Lowesifazane noma lowesifazane lokhuluma nalabo abafileyo, nome lokhuluma nento lephilayo, kumele abulawe; kufanele aboshwe ngemlilo. Ukufa kwabo kuyicala labo.
USimakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Ukhulume nalabaLevi, bantfu baka-Aron, uthi kubo: 'UmLevi angeke abe nenkinga ngemuntfu lofile emphakathini wakhe;
ngaphandle kwalabo labafana naye: umtfubi wakhe, ubaba wakhe, unyana wakhe, intombi yakhe, lomkhulu wakhe,
nome lomunye wemadvodzana akhe, angeke abe ngumkakhe; ngobe angeke abe ngumkakhe, kodvwa abe nguyise wakhe, ngaye-ke angadlidli.
Angeke abe nenkinga ngebantfu labahamba naye, angeke abe nenkinga ngemsebenti wakhe longcwele.
Bekufanele bangabi nenhloko yabo yinye, bangabi nemilenze yabo yinye, bangabi nemlomo wabo.
Bangaba ngcwele kuNkulunkulu wabo, bangaphazamisi igama lakhe; banikela ngeminikelo yekushiswa yaSimakadze, inyama yeNkulunkulu wabo; kufanele babe ngcwele.
Angeke abulawe ngumkhwenyana, noma nguwesifazane longakabi ngcwele; ngobe umnikelo wesono ungcwele kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakhe.
Uyawumngcwele, ngobe yena unikela ngekudla kwaNkulunkulu wakho; kufanele abe ngungcwele kuwe, ngobe ngingcwele mina, Simakadze, lowo lokwenza ningcwele.
""Nakuba indvodzakati yemnikelo wesono iphazamisa imphilo yayo, ibe ngumfoti, iphazamisa ubaba wakhe; kumele icutshwe ngemlilo.

Lomnikelo wekushiswa, lowo mkhulu kubo bonkhe bantfu bakhe, lomsebenti wakhe wukuthi umhluzi wekuphuza utfolwe phezu kwehlavu lakhe, wabekwa esivumelwaneni sokuba agqoke iingubo taSimakadze kutsi abe ngum祭zi, kumele angavumeli tinwele zakhe tihambe ngaphandle, noma anikeleti imihlobiso yakhe.
Angeke afike kumuntfu lofile, angeke abe nebubi ngababa bakhe noma ngamama wakhe.
Angeke aphume ethempelini aze abe nebuhlungu, ngobe angeke abusise ingcwele yeNkulunkulu wakhe; ngobe umnikelo wekushiswa waSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakhe unesibhakabhaka phezu kwakhe. Ngiye Simakadze.
Lowesifazane loyawukwati kumele abe ngumfana.
Angeke akwati indodana yenkosikazi, noma indodana levunwe, noma indodana engakabi mhlophe, noma indodana lehamba ngemanti; kodvwa kumele abukwe nendodana yebantfu bakhe.
ngobe angeke abe nenkinga ngemadvodzana akhe emiphakathini yakhe; mina ngiye Simakadze, lowo lowungcwele.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
Utsi ku-Aron: Lomunye wemadvodzana akho, lanenkinga emlonyeni wakhe, angeke afike anikela ngekudla kweNkulunkulu wakhe, kuze kube kuphele iminyaka yakho.
Angeke afike namunye lowo unenkinga yesikhumba sakhe, noma lomnyama, noma lophikisayo, noma lomdlavuza webuso bakhe, noma umdlavuza womlomo wakhe,
ngobe angeke kubekho namunye lobe nesandla noma nenyawo leliboshwe,
noma yimuphi lonemilebe lencane kakhulu, noma yimuphi lonenkinga yemehlo, isifo sesikhumba lesikhulisayo, noma imvubelo, kanye nanoma yimuphi lonemisipha yakhe leyimfihlakalo ikhubazekile.

Angeke afike nanoma yimuphi lomkhuluwa wa-Aron, umnikelo wesono, lanenkinga yakhe, aze anikela ngeminikelo yekushiswa yeSimakadze; inenkinga yakhe, angeke afike aze anikela ngekudla kweNkulunkulu wakhe.
Angeke aphuze inyama yaNkulunkulu wakhe, inyama lengcwele kakhulu, nenyama lengcwele.
Angeke afike emgodini, angeke afike ema-altarini, ngobe kukhona lokubi kuye; angeke anikeze tingcwele zami, ngobe ngiye Simakadze loyawubangcwele babo."
UMosesi wakhuluma njalo ku-Aron, nemadvodzana akhe, nalabaLevi.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
Utsi ku-Aron nemadvodzana akhe, kutsi bagcine ezintoni letingcwele letimikelwe ngumndeni waSirayeli, lapho beminikela khona; ngobe bangangeni lutho emkhondweni wami longcwele: Ngiye Simakadze.

Utsi kubo: Nalowo nalowo wesifazane senu, esuku ngaleso sikhathi, lapho engcolileyo, afike kuzinto letingcwele, labaSirayeli bezinikela kuSimakadze, lowo muntu uyawucutshungulwa phambi kwami; mina nguSimakadze.

"Naye nanoma ngubani, emndenini wa-Aron, lanesifo sesikhumba, noma abe nemfucumfucu emlonyeni wakhe, angeke aphuze lezinto letingcwele kuze kube ucocekile. Nalowo lowo lowucophelela into enobucwebe ngekufa kwemuntu, nome umuntu onemfucuko yesisu,
noma nalowo lowucophelela silwane lesiphilako lesenza kutsi abe nenkinga, noma nalowo lowucophelela umuntu lowenza ukuthi abe nenkinga ngesiphi simo,
utawuba nekunakeni kuze kube sebusuku; ngeke afune lutho kuleso sipho esingcwele, ngaphandle kwekunge wahlamba umzimba wakhe ngamanzi.
Uma lilanga liphuma, angeke abe nenkinga; ngemuva kwalokho angadla lezinto letingcwele, ngobe yikudla kwakhe.
Angeke adle isilwane lesifile, noma lesihlanganiswe nenyama yemhlabatsini, ngobe ngaso angabi nebubi. Ngiye Nkulunkulu.
LabaLevi kumele bagcine imiyalo yami, bangabi necala, bese bafa ngenxa yalokuyiphazamisa. Ngiye Simakadze loyawubangcwele kwabo.
Angeke kube khona muntfu longaphandle kwendlu yaSimakadze loyawudla lezinto letingcwele; nalowo umkhwenyana lohlala naye, noma lowo umkhonzi wakhe, atawudle.
"Lamuhla-ke, uma umLevi ethenga mkhonzi ngemali yakhe, lowo mkhonzi uyawudla kuwo; nalabo labazalwa ekhaya lakhe nabo bangadla inyama yakhe.
Uma intombi yemnikelo wesono ikwati umuntu longeke abe ngumnikelo wesono, angeke ayedla lekudla lokungcwele lokunikezwako.

"Lamuhla, uma umnikelo wesono ufakwa emnyango wendlu yaSimakadze, wena nemadvodzana akho kanye nemadvodzakati akho niyawudla inyama yakhe; kepha uma umnikelo wesono ufakwa emnyango wendlu yenkhosi yakho, wena nendvodzakati yakho niyawudla inyama yayo.
""Nase umuntu edla kuleyo mnikelo wekushiswa ngengozi, kumele afike abe nekudla lokungcwele kube ngumnikelo wakhe wesono, naye abeke kuyo isihlanu saleyo minikelo.
Lamadvodza ase-Amori angeke abe ngumnikelo wesono, kodvwa kumele abe ngumnikelo wesono.
ngobe batawudla, bafike babe necala; ngobe ngiye Simakadze loyawubangcwele kwabo.'
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:

Utsi ku-Aron nemadvodzana akhe, nalabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli: Nalowo nalowo waseSirayeli, nalowo nalowo wesikhashana eSirayeli, uma enikela ngenhlanhla yakhe emkhondweni wakhe, noma ngemnikelo wakhe wokudla, noma ngemnikelo wakhe wesono, kutsi abe ngumnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze,
Kutsi kuvunyelwe kuwe, kumele kube ngumkhwenyana wesifazane, ingulube, noma inkunzi ngaphandle kwenkinga.
Mna-ke, unganikelanga ngento leyo ikhona inkinga kuyo; ngobe angeke ibe ngumnikelo wesono.

Uma umuntu enikela ngenhlanhla kuSimakadze, ngemnikelo wekushiswa, noma ngemnikelo wesono, kusuka ekudlaneni kwengulube noma kusuka emhlambini, kumele kube lilungile kutsi livumeleke; ngeke libe nenkinga.

Leyimnyama, noma leyimfishane, noma leyimdlovukazi, noma lenetsaba, noma lenetsiba, noma lenetsiba, noma lenetsifo sesikhumba, angeke niyinikela kuSimakadze; ngeke niyibeke phezu kwebhedu njengemnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze.
Unganikela ngengulube noma timbuti letinengxenye yeגוףi lephakeme kakhulu noma encane kakhulu njengemnikelo wesono, kepha angeke kuvunyelwe kutsi ugcine umyalo.
Ningeke ninike umnikelo wesono kuSimakadze, silwane lesicutshungulwe, noma sicutshunguliwe, noma sicutshungulwa, noma sicutshungulwa; ningawusebentisa lomsebenzi ezweni lenu.
Ungeke uthathe kulowo wesikhashana, kutsi kube yikudla kwaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho; kuba nenkinga kuwo, kukhona lokubi kuwo, angeke avunyelwe kuwe.'
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:

"Uma kuzalwa ingulube, noma inkomo, noma umkhwenyana, kumele ihlale nemama wayo iminyaka lesikhombisa; kuze kube ngusuku lwesibhozo nalapho liphuma khona, liyawufaneleka kutsi libe yimnikelo wesono kuSimakadze.
Musa kubulala inkomo noma ingulube lilanga lelinye nalelo lincane.
Uma ninikela ngemnikelo wesono kuSimakadze, niyawunikela ngendlela lefanele, kutsi kube lulala kuwe.
Kuyawudlalwa ngalolusuku lunye; ningeke nishiye lutho kulo kuze kuhlwa. Ngiye Simakadze.
Ngiye Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu. Nigcine imiyalo yami niyiphumeze.
Ningeke niphuce igama lami elingcwele, ngobe ngitawuvunywa emiphakathini yabantfu beSirayeli. Ngiye Simakadze loyawukungcwelela kwenu,
ngobe ngitsi: Lami Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, lowo waphuma ezweni la-Egipta kutsi abe nguNkulunkulu wenu.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
"Ukhulume nalabaSirayeli, usithi kubo: Lemicimbi yami engcwele, imikhosi yaSimakadze, loyawuyimemezela njengemihlangano lengcwele, yile:

Ngelilanga lesine ungeke usebenze, kodwa mhla wesikhombisa ngusuku lokuphumula, usuku lokuphumula lokugcwele, liholidi elingcwele; akumele nisebenze nhlobo. Ngusuku lokuphumula kuSimakadze, kuwo wonke lamadolobha enu.
Lemithendeleko yaSimakadze, imihlangano lengcwele, niyawuyimemetela kuleso sikhathi sayo, yile:
Ngelilanga lelishumi nelinesihlanu lenyanga yokuqala, lapho lilanga liphuma khona, kufanele kube yiPasha yaNkulunkulu.
Ngelilanga lelishumi nelinesihlanu kulomnyaka, kuyawufika umnikelo wekushiswa wekudla lokunge-fermented kuSimakadze; nitawudla ukudla okunge-fermented lilanga lesitsatfu.
Lemini yekucala nitawube nekuhlangana lokungcwele; ningasebenzi msebenzi lomusha.
Ngelilanga lesishiyagalolunye nitawunikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze; ngalolusuku lesixhenxe kumele kube khona kuhlangana lokungcwele: angeke nibe nemsebenzi lomusha.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
"Ukhulume nalabaSirayeli, utsi kubo: Uma nifika ezweni langabanikela ngalo, niyivuna imbewu yayo, kufanele nifike ninike kumnikelo wesono lokudla lokuhlanganiswako, kanye neminikelo yenu yesono.
Waye atawuwushaya lomnikelo wesono phambi kwaSimakadze, kutsi uvumeleke kuwe; emhla lesishiyagalolunye ngemuva kweSabhati, umnikelo wesono utawuwushaya.
Ngelilanga lenu lokudlidliza intambo, nitawunikela ngenkomo yemnyaka mncane yinye, ingabi nenkinga, ibe ngumnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze.
kanye nemnikelo wayo wesono, i-ephod yesiliva lelihlanganisiwe nephethiloli, njengeminikelo yekushiswa kuSimakadze, ibe ngumoya lomnandi; kanye nemnikelo wayo wokudla, i-ephod yewayini.

Ningeke nidle inhlanzi, noma imbewu ecutshungulwe, noma inhlama, kuze kube nguleso sikhathi lapho niyawunikela khona kuNkulunkulu wenu; kumele kube ngumthetho lohlala njalo kuwo wonke lamasiko enu, ngaso sonke isitembu sakho.
Kusuka kulilanga lesikhombisa ngemuva kweSabhati, kusukela kuleso sikhathi nitawubala emaviki lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu agcwele.
Utawubala iminyaka lengema-50, kuze kube ngusuku lokulandzela sabato yesishiyagalolunye; uyawunikela ngemnikelo wesono lomusha kuSimakadze.

Nitawukhipha emindenini yenu iminikelo yekushiswa yeminqumo lemibili, leyinye ibe yi-ephod yesiliva, ne-ephod yegolide, ne-ephod yesiliva, ne-ephod yegolide, ne-ephod yesiliva, ne-ephod yegolide, ne-ephod yegolide.

Nalenyama niyilungiselele inkunzi yenkomo yeminyaka lelishumi nesikhombisa, ingabi nemonakalo, nengulube yesifazane enye, nemvu lababini; ibe ngumnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze, kanye nesondlo saso sekudla, nesondlo saso sokumwaya; kube yiminikelo yekushiswa, iphunga elimnandi kuSimakadze.
Negodzi elinye libe yimnikelo wesono, nemadvodza lasitfupha emnyaka munye abe ngumnikelo wesondlo.
Waye umnikelo wesono, umnikelo wesonka, umnikelo wekushiswa, umnikelo wekudla, umnikelo wesive, umnikelo wesono, umnikelo wesono ebusweni baSimakadze; umnikelo wesono.
Nitawumemetela kulelo langa lingcwele, ningeke nisebenze noma yini yemisebenzi lemihle; kumele kube ngumthetho wesikhathi sonke emindenini yenu, kuwo onkhe emadolobha enu.

Nalapho nikhulisa khona imbewu yemhlabatsini wenu, ngeke nikhulise kuze kusiphelweni semhlabatsini sakho, naleso sikhukhula saso ningasicubunguli; siyawushiywa ngumtfubi nelowo mkhwenyana. Ngiye Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
Utsi kubo bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli: Kumnyaka wesitsatfu, ngemhla wokuqala wenyanga, kumele kube khona ekuseni lokuphumula, liholidi lengcwele, lokumbuso lokubhujiswa kwethumbu.
Ningeke nisebenzele nhlobo, kodvwa nitawunikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
"Lamuhla, ngelilanga leshumi leliviki lesishiyagalolunye lomnyaka wesitsatfu, ngusuku lokukhululwa; kumele kube nengqungquthela engcwele, niphumule, ninike umnikelo wesono kuSimakadze.
Ningeke nisebenze nhlobo ngalolusuku, ngoba ngusuku lwekuphucuka, kutsi nihlolwe kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu.
Lomuntfu longeke abe nekudla ngalolusuku, lowo muntu kumele aphekwe emiphakathini yakhe.
Nalowo nalowo lowenza siphi nasinye umsebenzi ngalolusuku, ngitawususa ebantwini bakhe.
Akufanele nisebenze nhlobo; le yimithetho yetfu, kutsi niyigcine kuze kube sekupheleni, kuwo wonke lamasiko enu, kuwo onkhe emadolobha anihlala kuwo.
YiSabhati yekuphumula lokuphelele kuwe; kufanele uhambe ungadli kudla; kusukela ngelilanga lesi-9 lenyanga, ngasekusihlwa kuya kusihlwa, kumele uyigcine.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:

Utsi kubo bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli: Ngomhla wesishiyagalombili walenyanga yesitsatfu, kuyawufika umnyaka wamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, kube ngusuku lwemikhosi yetingcotsholo kuSimakadze, lilanga lesithupha.
Lemini yekucala nitawube nekuhlangana lokungcwele; ningasebenzi msebenzi lomusha.

Ngelilanga lesishiyagalombili nitawunikela ngeminikelo yekushiswa kuSimakadze. Ngosuku lwesikhombisa nitawube nekuhlangana lokungcwele, niyawunikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze; kufike liholidi lelikhulu; ningasebenzisi msebenzi lomusha.

Lezi yimikhosi yaSimakadze, lemibili niyawuyimemezela njengemicimbi engcwele, kutsi ninikeze iminikelo yekushiswa yaSimakadze, nemnikelo wekushiswa, nemnikelo wesono, nemnikelo wekudla, nemnikelo wewayini, lilanga ngalinye ngelilanga lakhe.
Lamandla lawa ahlanganisa nezinsuku teSabhati taSimakadze, neminikelo yenu, kanye naleyo mnikelo wenu wesono, naleyo mnikelo wenu wokudla, niyawunikela kuSimakadze.

"Emhla wesishiyagalombili wenyanga yesishiyagalolunye, lapho nitawukhipha khona imfuyo yelizwe, kufanele nigcine usuku lokuphumula kuSimakadze lilanga lesisikhombisa; usuku lokuqala kumele lube ngusuku lokuphumula, kanye nosuku lwesihlanu kumele lube ngusuku lokuphumula.

Ngelilanga lokuqala nitawukhipha lokudla lokuhle kwesihlahla, netinhlamvu tegolide, netinhlamvu letimhlophe, netinhlamvu tasolwandle; niyawubhishisa ngekuthula phambi kwaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, ekuseni nakusihlwa.
Niyigcine njengeholide lengcwele kuSimakadze, lilanga lesitsatfu ngalesomnyaka; kube ngumthetho lohlala njalo emindenini yenu. Ngenyanga yesishiyagalolunye niyigcine.
Niyawuhlala emahhashini iminyaka lesikhombisa. Wonke lowo lazalwa titukulwane teSirayeli kumele ahlale emahhashini,
Lakho kutsi batfole bantfu bakho ngemuva kwenu, babone ukuthi ngibavumele labaSirayeli bahlale emahhashini, lapho ngibakhipha khona ema-Egypte. Ngiye Nkulunkulu wenu."
Ngako-ke Mosesi wakhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli, watsi: "Lemicimbi lengcwele yeSimakadze.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
Laletsa bantfu baka-Israyeli ukuba bakulethele uphethroli we-olive, lomhlophe, locwecwe, lokuwufaka emakhazeni, kutsi ahlale ekhanya.

Etentini lekuhlangana, ngaphandle kwetibuko elingene entanyeni yesivumelwano, u-Aron kumele agcine ilanga likhanya kusukela ekuseni kuze kube ngasebusuku phambi kuSimakadze; kube ngumthetho wesikhathi sonke kubo bonkhe bantfu labasuka emizweni yenu.
Angeke avumele kutsi lilanga lelisekwesibhakabhaka segolide elingenawo umhluzi lihlale lihamba phambi kwaSimakadze.
Nciphisa umnikelo wesono, ubeke emacwecwe lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, usebenzise emakhilogremu lasitfupha emnikelo wesono ngayinye.
Uya kuzibeka emigqeni emibili, sishiyagalombili emgwaqweni ngamunye, phezu kwetafula lelihlanganisiwe phambi kwaSimakadze.
Utawubeka umnikelo wekushiswa lomhlophe esigabeni ngasinye, kube ngumnikelo wesono, iminikelo yekushiswa kuSimakadze.
Lokudla kumele kusetjelwe lilanga leShabbati ngaso sonke isikhathi phambi kwaSimakadze; kube ngumnikelo wesono wamakhosikazi aseSirayeli.
Lokudla kuyawuba ngumnikelo wa-Aron nemadvodzana akhe; kumele bakudla khona endaweni lengcwele; kuyinto engcwele kakhulu yeminikelo yekushiswa yaSimakadze, lilungelo labo lahlala njalo.
Kwabe kukhona umuntu, lomama wakhe wayeyisiSirayeli, kodvwa ubaba wakhe waba ngumSirayeli; waphuma waya kubantfu beSirayeli, kwaba nemphiko phakathi kwakhe naye nalowo mSirayeli.

Wakhuluma lomfati wase-Israyeli umfana wakhe, waphazamisa igama lengcwele laSimakadze, wababulala. Bafike bamletha kuMosese; negama lomzali wakhe bekunguShelomithi, intombi kaDibri, wemndeni wakwaDan.
Bayawubeka emgodini, kuze uSimakadze ababuvise kutsi kumele bakwenze yini.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosesi watsi:
"Thumela ngaphandle kwekhampasi lowo lophule; bonke labo labebakhuluma nabo kumele bafake isandla sabo phezu kwenhlavu yakhe, nebandla lonke kumele ligweme.
Utsi kuboSirayeli: Nalowo nalowo lokhuluma ngesibi kuNkulunkulu wakhe, uyakuba nesono sakhe.
Wonke lowo lokhuluma ngegama laSimakadze, kumele abulawa; ibandla lonke kufanele ligweme; noma ngabe ungumkhwenyana, noma ngabe uvela kulomhlaba, uma ekhuluma ngegama laSimakadze, kufanele aphele.
Wonke lowo lobulala omunye umuntu kumele agwenywe.
Wonke lowo lobulala lenyama yemuntu kumele ayibuyisele, kuphila ngekuphila.
Uma umuntu ebulala umngane wakhe, kumele kube khona lokufana nalapho yena abewenza khona:
inhloko ngenhloko, nemehlo ngemehlo, nemilenze ngemilenze; kanye naleyo buhlungu abeyawubangelwa ngayo, kumele akwenzelwe.
Lomuntfu lobulala silwane kumele ayisethe, kepha lomuntfu lobulala umuntu kufanele atfutwe.
Lomthetho lowo utawuba lomunye kuwe, nome ngabe ungumkhwenyana, noma ngabe ungumhlali wasemhlaba; ngobe ngiye Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu.

UMosi wakhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu be-Israyeli, bakhipha lowo muntfu lobulalayo ngaphandle kwekhampasi, bamwisela emacwecwe aze aphele. Lamadodana e-Israyeli akazange akwenze njalo, njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosesi emfuleni iSinayi, watsi:
"Ukhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, usithi kubo: Uma nifika ezweni labengingabanikela ngalo kuwe, lemhlaba kumele ugcine iSabhati kuSimakadze.
Ngeminyaka lesikhombisa utawumisa imifula yakho, netinsika takho utawuzisusa, nawe uyawuvuna impahla yayo.
kepha ngonyaka wesikhombisa kumele ube yiSabhati yekuphumula kwemhlaba, ibe yiSabhati kuSimakadze; ungeke ukhulele emhlabatsini lakho, ungeke utsuse ivini lakho.
Lawo lakhula ngaye-ke, ungawakhulisanga, naleyo mbewu yesihlahla sakho sewayini esingacinywanga ungayivuna; kube ngumnyaka wekuthula kwemhlaba.
Lamandla emhlaba, aphumayo ngeSabhati yalo, kumele abe ngukudla kwenu; kuwe, nalabo labasebenza nawe, nalabo labasebenzela wena, nalabo abahlala nawe, kanye nalowo lohlala nawe.
Nasetilwaneni takho, nasetilwaneni temhlaba letihlala emhlabatsini lakho, liyawuba yikudla; nome yini lephuma kuyo, niyidle.
Utawubala iminyaka lelishumi nesikhombisa yesive, emashumi lamabili nane emaviki lasitfupha.
Ngemnyaka wesitsatfu, ngemhla lesilishumi wenyanga, kufanele uphuze lilanga lekutsi; ngalolusuku lwekubuyisana, kumele uphuze lilanga lekutsi emhlabatsini wenu wonke.

"Niyawungcwelesa lomnyaka wesihlanu, nitawumemetela livi lokukhululeka kulomhlaba wonke kubo bonkhe bantfu labahlala kuwo. Lomnyaka utawube ngumnyaka weJubilee kuwe; nizobuyela nibuye, ngamunye wenu ezweni lakhe lokuzalwa, kanye nemndeni wakhe.
Lomnyaka wesihlanu utawube ngumnyaka weJubilee kuwe; ngeke usale, futsi ngeke usidle lokudlalwa ngaso, ngobe lilanga lesihlahla sewayini lesingeke sihlolwe.
Kuyawuba ngumnyaka wemaJubilee, ibe ngcwele kuwe; lokudla lokusuka emhlabatsini ningeke nikudle.
Lomnyaka weJubilee, niyawubuyela kuwo onkhe emadolobha ensimini yenu.
Uma uthengisa mhlaba umngane wakho, noma uma uthenga mhlaba kuye, ungakhangisina.
Uma uthenga kulomfana wakho, kubeka intengo yakho ngenombolo yeminyaka kusukela eJubilee ledlule; yena abeke ixabiso lakhe lokuthengwa ngalo ngemanani lasele ekukhuleni.
Uma kushiya iminyaka leminingi, intengo iyakhuphuka. Uma kushiya iminyaka embalwa kuphela, intengo iyancipha. Lento atawukuthengisa yona ngumanani ekulima.
Ningeke nikhohlwe, ngobe ngiSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu; mina ngiNkulunkulu wenu.
Nihlale nilandzela imiyalo yami, nigcine lemigaqo yami, nihlala nikhululeke kulomhlaba.
Lemhlaba utawunikela ngekudla kwawo, niyawudla kutsi nikhululeke, nihlala khona niphephile.
Ningeke nitsi: Sitawudla yini kumnyaka wesitsatfu, uma singasibulali, siphindze sikhiphe timali zethu?
"Ngitakulethela inhlekelele yami kuwe kumnyaka wesishiyagalombili, khona lemhlaba utawunikela ngekudla kwalo iminyaka lengemashumi lamane.
Ngemnyaka wesitsatfu, lapho ufaka khona imbewu yakho, niyawudla ngekudla lokusha; kuze kufike emnyaka wesithoba, nitawudla ngekudla lokusha.
Lemhlaba ngeke uthengiswe kuze kube sekupheleni, ngobe lemhlaba nguyawumi; ningabahambi bangaphandle nalabahlala nami.
Nakweyiphi na indawo yemhlaba lapho uhlala khona, kufanele uvumele kutsi umhlaba uthengiswe kabusha.
""Uma umuntu emndenini wakho aphelelwa yindlala, bese ethengisa ingxenye yemhlaba wakhe, kufanele afike umkhonzi wakhe losedvundzayo, abuye athenge.
"Nase-ke angeke abe nemuntu loyawuyithenga, kodvwa ekupheleni kwemnyaka wakhe utawukwenza kahle, aze abe nemali le suficiente kutsi ayithenge ngokwakhe.
atawubala iminyaka eyawuyithengisile, aze abuyisele lomuntfu labewathengela wona iminyaka yeminyaka lesele, bese ubuyela emhlaba wakhe.
Uma angeke abe nemandla ekubuyiselweni kwayo, khona-ke lemhlaba uyawuhlala kulowo lowuthengisile kuze kube ngumnyaka weJubilee; emnyakeni weJubilee utawubuyiselwa, wabuyela emhlaba wakhe.
Uma umuntu ethengise indlu emgwaqeni, angeke abe nemnyaka logcwele ngemuva kokuthengiswa kwayo kutsi ayibuyele; iminyaka lemibili kumele abe nelungelo lokuyibuyela.

"Uma iphindze ibuyiselwe, kuze kube kuphelile lomnyaka, indlu lekhona emgwaqeni wenhloko-dolobha iya kuba yiye lowo uyithengelayo, nemndeni wakhe ngemuva kwakhe, ibe yiyakhe kuze kube sekupheleni; ngemnyaka wema-Jubilee ayibuyeli.
Letindlu letisemadolobheni, lapho kungabikho tigodzi ngaso sonke sikhatsi, kumele zithathwe njengetindlu temhlabatsini; zingathengwa, kufanele zibuyiselwe kumnyaka lomusha.
Lamadvodza laLevi angeke abe nelungelo lokubuyisa indlu yakhe, noma yimfuyo yakhe, noma imijikelo yayo.

"Nakuba uLevi ethengise indlu yakhe, noma ngabe yikuphi emabhishi abo, angeke ayibuyisele ngemnyaka weminyaka lemashumi lamane; ngobe izakhiwo tamadolobha laLevi ziyindawo yabo yasebukhosini phakathi kwalabaLevi.
Lemifula yemadolobha abo angeke ithengiswe, ngobe iyabe yinye yabo kuze kube sekupheleni.
Uma ngabe kukhona esinye sabanye sihlwele, singeke sikwazi ukunakekela isandla saso, sivelane naye; ahlale nawe njengemhlali kanye nalowo lohlala ekhaya.
Ungeke umnike umnikelo wesono, ngobe Simakadze Nkulunkulu wakho unesibopho salowo lophilayo.
Ungeke umnike imali ngemvubelo, ungeke umuthengise nekudla ngemali leningi.
Ngiye Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, lowo waphuma ezweni leMijiphu, kutsi aninike umhlaba weKanana, kutsi ngibe nguNkulunkulu wenu.
Nakuba munye wenu ephambene nawe, athengelwe wena, ungawusebentisa kutsi abe ngumkhonto.
Utawube ngumholi wakhe, kanye nalowo lohlala nawe; kumele asebenze kuwe kuze kube ngumnyaka weJubilei.
"Nake utawuphuma nawe, yena nemadvodzana akhe, aze abuye emndenini wakhe, nasemhlabatsini lwababa bakhe.
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli angeke athengiswe njengabakhonzi bami, njengoba ngibakhiphe emhlabatsini leMijiphu.
Ungawuphazamisi nguNkulunkulu wakho, ngobe uyawuphelelwa livi.
Amakhosikazi akho nemadvodzakati akho ayawuvela emazweni langaphandle, nitawuwathenga kuwo.
Nakwebantfu labahlala lapha nani, niyawubathenga nabo, kanye nemindeni yabo, nalabo abazalwa ezweni lenu; bangabe beyimpahla yenu.
Uyawubanikela kubo bonkhe bantfu labaphilako, utawubashiya babe yimpahla yabo; bangabe basebenti zakho kuze kube sekupheleni kwekuphila kwabo; kodvwa ungabi ngumholi wemadvodzana akho.
"Kungeke kube khona umkhwenyana, noma lohlala nawe, afike abe ngumtfubi, kodvwa kube khona omunye wemadvodzana akho, afike abe ngumtfubi, aze athengelwe lowo mkhwenyane, nome lomunye wemndeni wakhe.
"Nase, ngemuva kwekuthengwa kwakhe, angeke abe nelungelo lokubuyiselwa emuva; lomunye wabazalwane bakhe angamubuyisela emuva.
nome umyeni wakhe, noma umfana wakhe, noma lomunye webantfu bakhe labasemndenini wakhe; noma, uma ecebile, angabuye abuye.

"Uyawubala iminyaka yakhe, yena nalowo wamthengisile, kusukela kuleso sikhatsi lapho athengiswe khona kuze kube ngumnyaka weJubilee; kanye nenani leminyaka, kumele abe nentengo yekubuyiselwa kwakhe, njengemuntfu lokhokhelwa ngemali.
Uma sekusele iminyaka leminingi, kufanele abuyisele emuva ingxenye enkulu yentengo lapho athengiswe ngayo.
Uma sekusele iminyaka embalwa kuphela kuze kube ngumnyaka weJubilee, kumele abala lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu bese ekhokha imali lencane kakhulu, ngeminyaka lemincane lekhona.
Akufanele atfolwe njengemuntfu losebentiswa iminyaka ngeminyaka, kufanele uqiniseke kutsi umnikazi wakhe akawuphazamisi.
Uma angeke abuyiselwe ngendlela lenjalo, kumele aphume emnyaka weJubilee, yena nemadvodzana akhe.
ngobe bantfu bakaSirayeli bami baholi; bami baholi, labo ngabakhipha ezweni leMijiphu. Ngiye Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu.
"Mna, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, ngitsi: Ningeke nifake ezweni lenu litshe leselicwebezelayo, noma inhloko-mlilo, noma umnikelo wesono, ukuze niwukhonze; ngobe mina nguSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu.
Nigcine lilanga lesabate lami, niyihloniphe indlu yami lengcwele. Ngiye Simakadze.
Uma nihamba ngemiyalo yami, nigcina imiyalo yami,
Ngitakulethela imvula yenu ngesikhathi sayo, nemhlaba utawunikela ngekudla kwawo, nesihlahla semhlaba sitawunikela ngembewu yalo.
Lekuvuna kwakho kutawuhlala kuze kube yisikhathi sokulima, nekudla kwenu kuyawuhlala kuze kube yisikhathi sokutshala; niyawudla ukudla lokugcwele, niyawuhlala ezweni lenu liphephile.
Nami ngitawunikela ngekuthula kulomhlaba, niyawuphumula, ngobe ngeke kubekho lowo utfumisayo. Nami ngiyakususa lokudla lokubi emhlabatsini, nalomkhosi ungeke uhambe ngemhlabatsini wenu.
Niyawuphazamisa labahlukumezayo, bese babulawa ngesandla phambi kwenu.
Labo banesihlanu bayawuphazamisa lamakhulu, nalabo banekhulu bayawuphazamisa lamashumi lamakhulu lalishumi; nabo bonkhe bantfu labaphikisayo batawugwanywa ngesandla phambi kwenu.
"Nami ngitawukubheka, ngiyawukubambisana nawe, ngiyawukubambisana nawe, ngiyawukubambisana nawe, ngiyawugcina umhlangano wami nawe.
Utawuhlala udla timbuti temnyaka lodlule lapho kufanele uphindze ukhiphe letinye titfunywa kutsi ube nendzawo yekudla.
Nami ngitawubeka indlu yami phakathi kwenu, ngingakucishisela isandla sam.
Nami ngiyawuhamba phakathi kwenu, nami ngitawuba nguNkulunkulu wenu, nibe bantu bami.

Ngiye Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, lowawutfusa ezweni leMijiphu, kutsi ningeke nibe baholi babo; ngobe ngiwuphula umkhonto wesandla sami, ngawususa emlonyeni wenu, ngakwenza nihambe ninemehlo enu amile.
Lakho-ke, uma nitsi: "Akufanele sikhulume naSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, kutsi akwente la mazwi,
uma niyiphula imiyalo yami, nome niyiphazamisa imiyalo yami, ngobe ningeke niphumele kuwo wonke lamandla ami, kodvwa niphule umnqophiso wami;

ngaloko ngitakwenza kuwe, ngitawukulethela ekuphazamisekeni lokujulile, nesifo lesibulalayo kanye nemkhuhlane, loyawutfusa amehlo akho, nempilo yakho; nawe utawukhula mbewu yakho ngaphandle kwesondlo, ngobe bobubi bakho bayayidla.
Nami ngiyawubuyela kuwe, nawe utawuhlaselwa ngulabo batfutsi bakho; nalabo abakuchukumisayo baya kukubusa wena; nawe uzogwaja nakuba akukho lokwephula.
Nakuba naleso simo-ke nitsi, ningami hluli, ngitakulethela lokukhulu kunaloko lokwentako lilanga lesikhombisa ngebubi benu.
"Nami ngitawuphula umgogodla wemandla akho, nekwenza izulu lakho lihlale lifana nensimbi elingenamlilo phezu kwakho, nemhlaba ngaphansi kwakho uhambe njengesiliva.
Lamandla enu wonke angeke asebenze kahle, ngobe imhlaba wenu awutawunikela ngekudla kwakhe, nesihlahla sakho ngeke sinike inhlanzi yayo.
"Nakuba nihamba ninganilalela, ngobe ngitsi: 'Asekho lowo longeke amkhonze', ngiyakusebentisa loku kutsi ngibuse ngemaphesenti lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa ngebubi benu.
Nami ngiya kutfumisa emihlambini yenu isilwane semhlabatsini, sitawukususa labantwana bakho, nekudla kwakho, nenyama yakho, nendlu yakho.
Nakuba naleso sikhathi ningeke nibuye nami, kodvwa nihlale nihamba ningami,
Nami ngitahamba natsi, ngitawukuhlasela niphikisane nebubi benu, nangebunyenti bebubi benu.
Ngitakulethela umkhosi phezu kwenu, kutsi nigweme inhlanganiso yami; nalapho nisuka khona enhliziyweni yenu, ngitawutfusa umkhuhlane phakathi kwenu, nizobekwa emlonyeni wema-Israyeli.

Uma ngikucishe umnikelo wenu wekudla, khona-ke besifazane bantfu labalishumi bayawukusisa umnikelo wenu wekudla efrijini lelinye, nekudla kwenu kutawunikezwa ngesisindo; niyawudla, kodvwa ningabi nendlala.
Uma, naleso simo, nitsi: 'Asikulalelani,' kodvwa nihlala nihamba ningami,
Nami ngitahamba natsi ngemphiko yami, nami ngitakusitsa niphicote liphesenti lesisikhombisa ngebubi benu.
Niyawudla inyama yabantwana benu kanye nendvodzakati yenu.
Nami ngiyawuphula emathempelini enu, netingcweti tenu letiphakeme, nami ngitawubeka ticubu zenu phezu tecubu tamehlo enu, nami ngiya ekujuleni kwenu ngebuhlungu.
Nami ngiyawushiya imijikelo yenu ibe yitfu, nezindawo tenu letingcwele zibe ngumhlabatsi; ngobe ngingeke ngilibone liphunga lelihle letibopho tenu.
Ngitayisa lelizwe lakho libe ngumhlaba, kutsi batfutsi bakho, labahlala kulo, babe nebuhlungu.
Nami ngitawukusakazela phakathi kwebantfu, nami ngiyawukhipha isandla sami, ngiyokwephula emuva kwenu; nelizwe lenu liya kuba yitfu, namadolobha enu azoba ngumhlaba.
Ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho lelizwe lihlala khona, nibe ezweni lalabo batfutsi benu, liyawujabulela iminyaka yayo yeShabbati; imhlaba utawuphumula, uyawujabulela iShabbati yalo.
Kuphela lapho ihlala khona, iya kuba nekuthula lokungeke kube nalo eminyakeni yenu yeSabhati lapho nihlala khona.

Nalabo labashiyelwe phakathi kwenu emazweni lababuphikisi benu, ngitawubaphazamisa, kuze kube lilanga lesihlahla lesibhaka-bhaka elivuthayo ngemoya liyawubaphazamisa; bese baphuca njengobe bephuca emgodini, nabo bangabi nalowo lowagcwabisa.
Baya kuhlaselwa, lomunye ngelowo, njengobe bahlaselwa ngesikhephe, nakuba akukho lowo loyawubabulala; ngobe ningeke ni HDPHLE emphilweni yenu.
Utawufa emiphakathini yebantfu, nemhlaba wema-Israyeli utawukubulala.
Nalabo labashiyelwe kwenu, bayawuphazanyiswa emazweni lababuphikisi bakho, ngenxa yesono sabo, kanye nesono sababuphikisi babo.
Baye bakhuluma ngesono sabo, nesono sababa babo, ngalento yabo yekuphazamisa ngimi, nangekuphazamiseka kwabo kimi.
ngobe ngabasusa, ngabafaka ezweni lalabo lababusi babo; bese lilanga letfu lihlaza inhlonipho yenhliziyo yabo, baphindze babone umonakalo wesono sabo.
khona-ke ngiyawukhumbula umhlangano wami naYakobi, kanye nomhlangano wami naIsake, nalomhlangano wami naAbrahama; neleyo ndawo ngiyawukhumbula.

Lelizwe liyawuhlala lishonile, litawujabulela izinsuku zalo zokuphumula lapho lihlala lishonile ngaphandle kwabo; nabo batawujabulela inkohliso yabo, ngenxa yemtsetfo wami labawukhohlisayo, nemithetho yami yababi.

Naleso simo, bangabe bakhona ezweni lalabo lababulalayo, ngitawubasusa ngaso sonke isikhathi, ngingabi nabo emthethweni wami; ngobe mina nguSimakadze Nkulunkulu wabo, utsi: Ngitakusikhipha kulolu daba.
Ngitawukhumbula, ngenxa yabo, isivumelwano sami nababa babo, lapho ngibakhiphe khona ezweni la-Egipta, phambi kwamehlo ebantfu, kutsi ngibe nguNkulunkulu wabo; mina ngiyoSimakadze.
Lemiyalo, nemithetho, nemigaqo-mthetho, loSimakadze wakhuluma ngayo ngesandla saMosesi emfuleni iSinayi, phakathi kwakhe namakhosi aseSirayeli.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
"Ukhulume nalabaSirayeli utsi: 'Uma umuntu enikela ngemnikelo wesono kuSimakadze, kufanele akhokhele lowo muntu ngokwentengo yakhe.'
Kutsi uma umfana eneminyaka lemashumi lamabili kuya kumakhulu lamane, wena utawukwenta kutsi abe ngushekeli yesiliva lama-50, nge shekeli yesingcwele.
Umfana loneminyaka lemitsatfu kuya kweyisikhombisa, umlinganiselo wakhe ube liphesenti lama-30.
Kumuntu loneminyaka lemibili kuya kumashumi lamabili nesihlanu, inzuzo ebekwe ngumaphesenti lamashumi lasitfupha esiliva kumfana kanye nemaphesenti lalishumi emdvuna.

Kumuntfu loneminyaka lemibili kuya kulishumi nesihlanu ubudala, inhlawulo ibekwe ngetinhlamvu letisikhombisa tesiliva kutsi kube ngumfana kanye netinkhulungwane letintsatfu tegolide ukuba ube ngumfati.

Kumuntu loneminyaka lemashumi lamane namakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa noma ngaphezu kwayo, inhlawulo iphindze ibe ngumaphesenti lalishumi elinesihlanu wesiliva kumuntfu wesifazane kanye namaphesenti lasitfupha kwendvodza.
""Nase, uma engeke akwazi kukhokha inhlawulo yakho, kufanele afike kumnikelo wesono, umnikelo wesono utawukwenta inhlawulo yakhe; ngemandla lalowo lowawunikele, umnikelo wesono uyawukwenza.
Uma mnikelo wakhe wesono ube yisilwane lesifanele kutsi sinikezelwe kuSimakadze, khona-ke isilwane lesiniketwe uSimakadze kumele singcwele.
Angeke ayishintshe, ayenze ibe yinhle ngeyenhle, noma ibe yinhle ngeyenhle; kepha uma eshintsha inyama ngenye, khona-ke lenyama neleyo silwane labeyishintshile kumele zibe ngcwele.
Uma imnikelo wayo wesono ube yinyama lengcolile, engeke ibe ngumnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze, khona-ke kumele afike abe ngumLevi.
Kutsi kutsi umnikelo wesono, noma ngabe ulungile noma ngabe awulungile, lomnikelo wesono kumele ube ngumnikelo wesono.
Uma umnikazi efuna ukuyithenga kabusha, kufanele akhokhe inzuzo yayo kanye nesihlanu semali.

Uma umuntu enikela ngendlu yakhe kutsi ibe ngumnikelo longcwele kuSimakadze, khona-ke umnikelo wesono kufanele alinganise indlu yakhe, ngabe iyilungile yini noma iyibi; njengobe umnikelo wesono usabalalisa ngayo, njalo-ke kumele ihlukaniswe.
"Kube lowo labewunikela ngendlu afuna ukuyithenga, kufanele akhokhele imali yayo kanye nesihlanu sayo, bese ibe yakhe.

Uma umuntu enikela ngemhlabatsi wemndeni wakhe kuSimakadze, khona-ke kumele akhokhwe ngentengo yembewu yakhe, kutsi ikhule: shekeli lemashumi lamakhulu lasitfupha nesihlanu sesiliva ngayinye ikhilogramu lelishumi nembili yembewu yejusi.
Uma enikela ngemhlaba wakhe kumnyaka weJubilee, inzuzo lesetjisiwe ihlala.

Uma enikela ngemhlaba wakhe ngemuva kwemnyaka weJubilee, khona-ke umnikelo wekushiswa utawukwenta ixabiso lakhe lifana nenani leminyaka lekhona kuze kube ngumnyaka weJubilee lolandelayo, nenani lakho liyawuncipha.
"Uma lowo labewunikela ngemhlaba ufuna ukuyithenga, kufanele akhokhele imali yayo kanye nesihlanu sayo, ibe yakhe.
Ngako-ke, uma akayithengela emuva lemhlabatsi, noma uma uyithengise kumunye, angeke ayithengiswe emuva.
Lesitezi, lapho siphuma khona kumnyaka weminyaka lelishumi elinesihlanu, sitawube singcwele kuSimakadze, njengesitezi lesisondele kakhulu kuye; iyawuba yiye yabaLevi.
Uma ngabe umuntu enikela kuSimakadze ngemhlabatsi lapho athenge khona, longeke abe yindawo yemndeni wakhe,
umnikelo wekushiswa, umnikelo wesono, umnikelo wesonka, umnikelo wesive, kanye neminikelo yekushiswa, kumele ikhokhwe ngaleso sikhathi, ibe ngumnikelo longcwele kuSimakadze.
Ngemnyaka weJubilee, lemhlaba uyawubuyela kulowo lowuthengele lona, lowo loyindlu yemndeni wakhe lemhlaba.
Lonke linani lelibekwe kumele lisebenzise umsindvo lesasingemagremu lasitfupha kuya kumashumi lamabili esiliva negolide.

"Lamuhla-ke angeke kube nemuntu lonikela ngemnikelo wesono, noma ngabe isilwane, kutsi sibe ngumnikelo wesono; ngobe umnikelo wesono unguweSimakadze; noma ngabe yingulube, noma ngabe inkomo, unguNkulunkulu wakhe.

Uma kuyisilwane lesingcolile, umnikazi ungayithenga kabusha ngekukhokha inzuzo yayo lesetjentisiwe kanye nengxenye yesihlanu. Uma ayithengiselwe emuva, kumele ithengiswe ngentengo yayo lesetjentisiwe.

"Naye noma yini lomuntu enikela ngayo ngesandla sakhe kuSimakadze, kutsi ibe ngumuntu, noma kube yisilwane, noma kube yimhlabatsi semndeni wakhe, angeke athengiswe, noma abuye abuyiselwe; yonke leyo mnikelo wesono ungcwele kakhulu kuSimakadze.
Angeke kube khona umuntu lophindze abuyiselwe emuva, uma ecutshungulwa kutsi abe ngumnikelo wesono; kumele abulawa.
Lamashumi lasikhombisa ezinto zonke letiphuma emhlabatsini, noma yimifino yemhlabatsini, noma imbewu yesihlahla, liyawuSimakadze; lingcwele kuSimakadze.
Uma umuntu efuna kutsi abuye athengise yinye yesihlanu sakhe, kumele akhokhe inhlawulo yayo kanye nelinye lesihlanu.
Leshumi lengulube kanye nelibomvu, ngalinye lelikhulu lesilwane lesidlula ngezansi kwesandla semuntfu lomfuyi lapho libalwa khona, kumele libe lingcwele kuSimakadze.

Umnikazi wakhe angeke akhethe lokuhle kusuka kulolubi, naye angeke ashintshe linye lato. Uma eshintsha linye lato, khona-ke isilwane kanye naleso esishintshwe ngaso siyawuba singcwele; ngeke kubuye kuthengiswe.
Lemiyalo leyo, uSimakadze watsi nayo kuMosesi, kutsi ayinike bantfu beSirayeli emfuleni iSinai.
Num: Ngemnyaka wesitsatfu ngemuva kwekuphuma kwabo bantfu baseSirayeli emhlabatsini waseMijiphu, ngemhla wokuqala wenyanga yesibili, Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi etentini leketela kuhlangana, esigabeni seSina, watsi:
Linani labantfu labaseSirayeli bonkhe, ngemindeni yabo, nangetindlu tababa babo, nibhalela inombolo yalabo bonke lamadoda, ngalowo nalowo,
Nabo bonke labaneminyaka lemashumi lamabili namakhulu lasitfupha kuya kumashumi lamabili nesihlanu eminyaka, labo bangaphuma ekulwa ema-Israyeli; wena kanye na-Aron nivamise kubabala ngemikhosi yabo.
Kuyawuba nemuntfu lomunye emndenini ngamunye, lowo utawube nguMengameli wemindeni yabo.
Lemi magama lamadoda ayawuhlangana nawe: Ku-Rhubheni, Elisuri, umsa waShedeuri.
ku-Simeoni: Shelumiyeli, umsa waZurishadai.
ku-Juda: Nashoni, umsa wa-Aminadabi.
ku-Issakhar: Nethaneli, umsa wa-Suari.
ku-Zabuloni: Eliabu, umsa waHeloni.
Labo balishumi elinamakhulu lalaba nguElishama, umsa wa-Amihudi; nalabo bamashumi lamabili nesihlanu laba nguGamayeli, umsa waPedasuri.
ku-Benjamini: Abidan, umsa waGideoni.
ku-Dan: Ahiezeri, umsa wa-Ammishadadi.
ku-Asere: Paghiyeli, umsa wa-Okran.
ku-Gadi: Eliyasaf, umsa waDeueli.
ku-Naphtali: Ahira, umsa wa-Enani.
Laba baholi bemindeni yabo, labagcini bomndeni wabo; babe yinhloko yamaqembu lamakhosikazi ase-Israyeli.
Mosese na-Aron bathatha lamadodana lawa, abesaziwa ngemagama abo,

Baye bahlanganisa libandla lonke, kumnyaka wa Pisani, ngelilanga lesitsatfu, babalwa ngemindeni yabo, nangetindlu tababa babo, ngalabo labaneminyaka lemashumi lamane namakhulu lasitfupha nesikhombisa namakhulu lamabili nesihlanu.
Wababala uMosese emfuleni iSinayi, njengobe Simakadze abemwisele umthetho ngawo.
Nabo bonkhe bantfu lababhaliswe kubo, kanye nemindeni yabo, nangetindlu tabazali babo, babalwa ngokuthi bangaba ngu-140.
Labo ababhalwa kubo, labasuka esukungeni la-Rubeni, bekungumashumi amane namane lamakhulu mane nesihlanu.

Lamadvodza laSimeoni, abesilisa labalishumi elinesikhombisa namakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamabili nesihlanu eminyaka, labo bonkhe bantfu labahamba nabo emkhosini, bahlukaniswa ngemindeni yabo kanye namakhosikazi abo,
Labo lababhalwa kubo, labasuka esukungeni laSimeoni, bekungumashumi lamabili nesikhombisa lamakhulu matatu.
Labo babalwa kubo bonkhe bantfu baseGadi, ngemindeni yabo kanye nabangane babo, ngamanani lamagama, kusukela kumnyaka wamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa kuze kube sekupheleni, bonke labaphumako ekulwa.
Labo lababhalwa kubo, labasuka esukungeni leGadi, bekungumashumi lamane nesihlanu emawaka lamakhulu lamabili namakhulu mane.
Lamadvodza laJuda, ahlukaniswe ngemindeni yabo kanye namakhosikazi abo, ngalabo labaneminyaka lemashumi lamabili nesikhombisa kuya kwamakhulu ayisishiyagalombili (52 000) eminyaka.
Labo ababhalwa kubo, labasuka esukungeni la-Juda, bekungumashumi lamabili nesihlanu emawaka lamane namakhulu lasitfupha.
Labo babalwa ngemadvodzana a-Issakhari, bangabamashumi lamane eminyaka nangaphezulu, labaphumako ekuhambeni nasekufezeni imikhosi, bonkhe bantfu labanemnyaka mnye ubudala besuka kumndeni wababa babo.
Nabo lababhalwa kubo, labasuka esukungeni la-Issakhari, usishiyagalombili nemashumi lamabili namane lamakhulu mahlanu.
Lamadvodza aseZabuloni, abesilisa labalishumi elinambili nemashumi lamane eminyaka nangaphezulu, labo bangaphuma emphini yenkhosi yabo, babalwa ngemagama, ngamunye ngamunye.
Nabo lababhalwa kubo, kutsi bahlukaniswe ngemindeni yabo, bangaba ngumakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane nesihlanu, lamakhulu lasitfupha.
Labo babalwa ngemindeni yabo, ngamadodana abo, nangetindlu tabazali babo, labaneminyaka lemashumi lamabili nesikhombisa nangaphezulu, bonke labo bangaphuma emkhosini;
Labo lababhalwa kubo, bosukundza kwa-Ephrayimi, bekungumashumi lamane lamakhulu mahlanu.

Labo bahlukaniswa ngemindeni yabo, ngemindeni yemadvodzana abo kanye nemadvodzakati akhe, ngamagama awo, labaneminyaka lemashumi lamane nangaphezulu, bonke labo abakwazile ukuya ekwakheni umsebenti wekulwa.
Labo lababhalwa kubo, bosukundza lwaManase, bekungumashumi lasitfupha namakhulu mahlanu nelishumi elinambili.

Lamadvodza aka-Benjamini, ahlukaniswe ngemindeni yawo kanye nemadvodzana akhe, abesilisa lamakhulu lamabili kuya kulishumi elinambili; labo lababhalwa ngamagama abo bonke labebengaphuma emphini yemndeni wakwaBenjamini.
Labo lababhalwa kubo, labasuka emndenini waBhenjamini, babemakhulu lamashumi lasitfupha nesihlanu emawaka lamane.
Labo babhaliswe kubo bonkhe bantfu baseDani, ngemindeni yabo kanye nabangane babo, kutsi babe ngumakhulu lamabili nemashumi lasitfupha kuya kulishumi elinesihlanu;
Labo lababhalwa kubo, kutsi bangaba ngumndeni waDani, bekungumashumi lamane nambili lamakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa.
Labo babalwa ngemadvodzana a-Aseri, ngamadodana abo, ngemindeni yabo, ngemindeni yebantfu labalishumi elinambili nangaphezulu, labengaphuma emkhosini, onkhe emagama awo, ngamunye ngamunye.
Labo lababhalwa kubo, kutsi bangaba ngumnyaka munye namakhulu mane nemashumi lamane.
Labo babhaliswe kutsi bangaba ngumndeni waNeftali, bahlukaniswa ngemindeni yabo kanye nemindeni yalabo lababili.
Labo lababhalwa kubo, kutsi bangaba ngumnikelo wesono, bekungu-53 nemakhulu mane.
Loba babalwa nguMosese na-Aron, kanye nebaholi bakaSirayeli, labalishumi elinambili; ngayinye imindeni yabo yamakhosikazi abenenhloko yayo.
Nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, lababalwa ngemindeni yabo, kusukela kubudala beminyaka lemashumi lamane nangaphezulu, bonke labo bangaphuma ekulwa,
Linani leliphelele laba ngumakhulu lasitfupha, lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu lamakhulu kanye namashumi mahlanu.
LaLevi-ke, ngesuku lababa babo, akazange abe nenani labo.
Simakadze abekhuluma kuMosi, watsi:
"Suku laLevi ungalibala, ungeke ubale nenani labo bonkhe bantfu base-Israyeli.

"Lamuhla-ke, ngitsi kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli: Lamadvodza aseLevi atawuhlala ethempelini lengcwele, lapho kugcinwa khona umthetho wesivumelwano, kanye nempahla yayo yonke, nabo bonkhe bantfu bayo; baphindze babambe itabernakele kanye nempahla yayo yonke.
Nalapho itenti liyawuhamba khona, labaLevi batawuyisusa; nalapho liyawumiswa khona, labaLevi batawuyimisa; kodvwa lowo longena kuyo, kumele abulawa.
Lamadvodzana a-Israyeli kumele babeke tindlu tabo, ngamunye ekamelweni lakhe, kanye naletinye tinhlamvu takhe, ngemikhosi yabo.

LaLevi-ke kumele atente ecaleni letenti langcwele, lapho kugcinwa khona umthetho wema-Israyeli, ukuze kungeke kube nendlala kubo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli; ngobe labaLevi bamele bagcine tindlu taNkulunkulu.
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli ayawukwenza njalo, njengobe Simakadze abemwisele Mose.
Simakadze watsi kuMosi na-Aron:
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli angeke ahlale esiteshini esiseceleni kwetenti lekuhlangana, kepha kumele ahlale esiteshini lesingaphansi kwayo, ngaso sonke isikhathi, ngaso sonke sikhathi.
Kusenyakatho-ntshonalanga, lapho lilanga liphuma khona, litawumisa tindlu zalo ngemikhosi yawo; inhloko yetive taSirayeli ibe nguNahashoni unyana wa-Aminadabi.
Liqembu lakhe, lababhaliswe kubo bekungumashumi lasikhombisa nane lamakhulu mane.
Ngaphesheya kwabo kuyawuhlala suku la-Issakha; umholi wemadvodzana a-Issakha uNethaneli, umsa wa-Suari.
Titukulwane takhe, lababhaliswe kubo bekungumashumi lasitfupha nesihlanu emakhulu mahlanu.
Nakho kuyawufika suku laZabuloni, nesikhulu semadvodzana aZabuloni: Eliabu, umsa waHeloni.
Titukulwane takhe, lababhalwa kubo bekungumashumi lamane nesikhombisa lamakhulu mane.
Labo bonkhe lababhaliswe ekamelweni laJuda, ngemikhosi yabo, bangamakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa namane lamakhulu mane; labo batawuhamba kuqala.
Kusenyakatho-ntshonalanga, livi lemndeni wakwaRubhen litawuhlala licampe ngemikhosi yayo; umholi wemadvodzana aRubhen uElisuri, umsa waShedeure.
Titukulwane takhe, lababhaliswe kubo bekungumashumi lamane nesihlanu emakhulu mahlanu.
Nasekudla kwabo kuyawuhlala suku laSimeoni, nesikhulu semadvodzana aSimeoni kutsi kube nguShelumiyeli, umsa waZurishadai.
Titukulwane takhe, lababhaliswe kubo bekungumashumi lasitfupha nesikhombisa lamakhulu matatu.
Nakho kuyawufika suku laGadi; umholi wemadvodzana aGadi uEliyasaf, umsa waReueli.
Liqembu lakhe, lababhaliswe kubo bekungumashumi lamane nesihlanu emakhulu mane, lamabili nasitfupha.
Labo bonkhe lababhaliswe ecampheni lakwaRubeni, ngemikhosi yabo, bangamakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu nalinye lamawaka, lamakhulu lasitfupha namashumi mahlanu.

Letenti lekuboshwa liyawuphuma, kanye nepabhoni laLevi eliphakathi kwemakhampasi; batawuhamba ngendlela labahlala ngayo emaphaketheni abo, ngaso sonke sikhatsi, wonke umuntu embhedeni wakhe, ngaphansi kwebhande lakhe.
Kusenyakatho-ntshonalanga, livi lemndeni wakwaEfremu litawuhlala licampe ngemikhosi yayo; umholi wemadvodzana aEframu nguElishama unyana waAmihudi.
Liqembu lakhe, lababhaliswe kubo bekungumashumi lamane lamakhulu mahlanu.
Nasekudla kwabo kuyawuhlala suku laManase; umholi wabo bonkhe bantfu ba-Manase ube nguGamayeli, umsa waPedasuri.
Liqembu lakhe, lababhaliswe kubo bekungumashumi lasitfupha nambili lamakhulu lamabili.
Nakho kuyawufika suku la-Benjamini, nesikhulu semadvodzana aBenjamini, abe nguAbidanu, umsa waGideoni.
Titukulwane takhe, lababhaliswe kubo bekungumashumi lasitfupha nesihlanu emakhulu mane.
Labo bonkhe lababhaliswe ecampheni laEfremu, ngemikhosi yabo, bangamakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa lamakhulu kanye namakhulu lasitfupha.
Ngasenyakatho, livi lemndeni waDani liyawuhlala licampe ngemikhosi yawo; umholi wemadvodzana aDani ngu-Ahiezeri, unyana ka-Amishadayi.
Titukulwane takhe, lababhalwa kubo bekungumashumi lamane nambili lamakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa.
Ngaseceleni kwawo kuyawuhlala suku la-Aseri; umholi wemadvodzana a-Aseri uPagiyeli, umsa wa-Okran.
Titukulwane takhe, lababhaliswa kubo bekungumashumi lamane nalinye lamakhulu mane.
Nakho kuyawufika suku la-Nephthali, nesikhulu sebantfu ba-Nephthali lomunye umholi, Ahira, umsa wa-Enani.
Liqembu lakhe, lababhaliswe kubo bekungumashumi lasitfupha namakhulu lamabili nesihlanu.
Labo bonke lababhaliswe emkhosini waDani bangamakhulu lamakhulu mane, lamashumi mahlanu nesikhombisa lamawaka, lamakhulu lamabili namakhulu lasitfupha.

Loba bakhona lamadodana eSirayeli, lababhalwa ngemindeni yabo; labo bonkhe lababhalwa, emakhazeni abo onke, ngemikhosi yabo, babemakhulu lamane, lamakhulu matatu, lamakhulu mahlanu, namashumi lamabili nesihlanu.
AkwaLevi akazange ahlukaniswe neminye imindeni yeSirayeli, njengokuba Simakadze abewise Musa.
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli akwenze njalo, njengobe Simakadze abemwisele umthetho uMosesi; ngalendlela yabo bamisa tindlu tabo, nalapho besuka khona, wonke umuntu ngemndeni wakhe nemindeni yawo.
Lokho kuyawufana nendlela yemndeni waAaroni naMoses, lapho akhuluma nabo eSinani.
Lamagama lamadvodzana a-Aron:Nadab, lomkhulu kubo, ne-Abihu, na-Eleazari, na-Itamari.
Loba babenemadvodzana a-Aron, bekubo labaLevi, labaphatselwe kutsi basebenzela umnikelo wesive.

Nadabhi naAbihu bafa phambi kwaSimakadze, lapho benikela khona ngemlilo kuNkulunkulu, emfuleni iSinayi; bangabe nabantwana; kodvwa Eleazari neIthamari babe ngumnikelo wesono ekupheleni kwemnyaka wa-Aron, ubaba wabo.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
Landza suku laLevi, wabeka ngaphansi kwesandla sa-Aron, umLevi, kutsi basebenze naye.
Bafike basebenzela yena kanye nebandla lonke etentini lekuhlangana, besebenza emthendelekweni longcwele.
Bafike bagcine yonke imihlobiso yetenti lekuhlangana, kanye nemisebenzi yalabaSirayeli, kutsi basebenze endlwini yasengcweleni.
Utawubanikela ngalabaLevi ku-Aron nemadvodzakati akhe, abe ngumnikelo wesono esivumelwaneni saSimakadze, kutsi abe ngumnikelo wesono.
Utawumisa u-Aron nemadvodzana akhe kutsi babe baLevi; kodvwa lowo longena kulelo lingcwele, kumele abulawa.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
"Lamuhla, bona, ngitawukhipha labaLevi emiphakathini yalabaSirayeli, babuye babe ngumnikelo wesono esivumelwaneni saSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.

Nakho-ke, ngitsi: Lamadodana akho nalabafazi bakho bangami; ngobe lamakhosikazi akho nemadvodzakati akhe abenginyenti kakhulu. 13Ngeleso sikhatsi lapho ngabulala khona wonke lomusha emhlabatsini weSirayeli, nami sengilungiselele kutsi abenendlu yami, mina Simakadze.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosese emhlabatsini saseSinayi, watsi:
Linani laLevi, ngemindeni yabo, nangetindlu tabo; linani lonke lomfana loneminyaka yemnyaka mncane nangaphezulu.
Mosese wababala, njengobe Simakadze abemwisile.
Lokho kwakunguLevi: Ghershoni, neKehati, naMerari.
Lolu hlobo lwabana beGhershoni: Libni naShimeyi.
Labo balishumi elinamakhulu lamadvodza aseKehati: Amrami, ne-Izhari, naHebroni, naUziyeli.
Lakwa-Merariya: Mahli naMushi; lalaba ngubo mndeni waLevi, ngemindeni yabo.
Ku-Ghershoni kwafika imindeni yeLibni naye yeShimehi; laba bahlala eGhershoni.
Lamanani abo, onkhe emadoda aneminyaka yemnyaka mncane nangaphezulu, labengaba ngumakhulu lamabili nesihlanu.
Lamadodana laGershoni atawuhlala esiteji ngasenyakatho, ngemuva kwetenti lengcwele.
Nesikhulu semindeni yema-Ghershoni, uEliyasaf, umsa kaLayeli.
Kutetenti lekuhlangana, lamadodana eGershoni abe nemsebenti wetenti lesingcwele, netente layo, netintela tayo, naletingwevu temnyango wetenti lekuhlangana,

kanye netibopho temphi, netibopho temnyango wendzawo yengcwelengcwele, netibopho tetitukulwane seSirayeli, kanye netibopho tendlu yasebukhosini, netibopho tenkhosi, netibopho tamakhosi, netibopho tebantfu, netibopho taletinye tindzawo letiphakeme.
Ku-Kehati kwasuka ku-Amrami, ne-Izhari, ne-Hebroni, ne-Uziyeli; laba bakungumndeni wakwa-Kehati.
Batsi babalwa, bonke labesifazane labaneminyaka lemibili ubudala nangaphezulu, babemakhulu lasitfupha, lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu; nabo babenesibopho sokunakekela lengcwele.
Lamadodana la-Kehati atawuhlala esiteji ngasekudla kwetenti lengcwele.
Nesikhulu semindeni yema-Kehati bekunguElizafanu, umsa kaUziyele.

Labo babenesibopho sokugcina ibhokisi lesivumelwano, netafula, nesitayela selilanga, nemibhede, nezinto letisetshenziswako ethempelini, naletingwevu; nabo babe nesibopho sokwenza yonke imisebenzi yabo.
Nalenhloko yalabaLevi, u-Eleazari, umsa wa-Aron, umLevi, waba nguMengameli wabo bonkhe labagcina imisebenti yabo engcwele.
KuMerariya kwasuka kumndeni waMaheli nawaseMushi; laba bakungumndeni waMerari.
Lamanani abo, onkhe emadoda aneminyaka yemnyaka mncane nangaphezulu, labengaba ngumakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa.
Nasenhloko yemindeni yabana Merari ube nguSuriyeli, umsa waAbihayili; laba bahlala ecaleni lelinye letenti lasenyakatho.
Lamadodana aMerariya abe nemsebenti wekuphatha tikhontsi tetenti, nemikhono yayo, nembhoshongo wayo, ne Chikhwele sayo, naletinye tindzawo letiphansi taso; nabo babesebenza kuwo wonke umsebenzi.
kanye netimbhoshongo tendlu yasemgwaqweni, netibopho tayo, netimkhonto tayo, naletintambo tayo.

Nabo-Mosesi na-Aron, nemadvodzana akhe, babehlala esiteji esibhekene netenti lekuhlangana, ngasemgwaqeni lophumayo kwelanga; bona babenesibopho sendlu yasengcwele ngesandla salaboSirayeli; lowo lofika kuyo kufanele abulawa.
Nabo bonke lababalowe nguMosi na-Aron, labaneminyaka yemnyaka mnye ubudala nangaphezulu, labaLevi, ngemtsetfo waSimakadze, ngemindeni yabo, babemakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa lamawaka.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Linganisa bonke labaseSirayeli labakhulelwe besifazane, kusukela emnyakeni owodwa naphezu kwalo, bese ubhala inombolo yabo ngemagama abo.
"Thintela laLevi kutsi abe ngimi endaweni yalabo bonke labavula umlomo ema-Israyeli, kanye nesilwane salabaLevi esikhundleni senbiro yeso sonke sema-Israeli; mina nguSimakadze.
UMosi wababala bonke labaseSirayeli labazalwa kuqala, njengobe Simakadze abemwisele umthetho.
Inani leliphelele labesifazane labazalwa kuqala labaneminyaka yemnyaka lomunye noma ngaphezulu, lababhalwa ngegama, bekungumashumi lamabili nambili emawaka lamakhulu lasitfupha nesihlanu.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
Utabela labaLevi endaweni yalabo bonke labaseSirayeli abavula umlomo wabo, nenyama yabo yebantfu labaLevi endaweni yenyama yabo; nabo bangabe bami. Ngiye Simakadze.
Bakhona bantfu labalishumi elinambili nemashumi lasikhombisa namakhulu mathathu, labazalwa kuqala enkhosini yaseSirayeli, bangako bonkhe labaLevi.
Nakho-ke utawukhokha ngeshekeli lesihlanu yesiliva kulowo mkhonto wegolide, kutsi kube ngushekeli lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa.
Lemali yenhlawulo yekuboshwa kwalowo lowo utawuyinikela ku-Aharon nemadvodzana akhe.
Mozesi watsi: "Lakho kungenxa yebantfu labakhulu kunabo, labengaba nenani lelikhulu, kanye nalabo baLevi, labafike behlala nabo.
Wabakhipha ema-shekeli lamakhulu mathathu, lamashumi lamane nesihlanu esiliva, ngesilinganiso sendlu yasengcwele, kubo bonkhe labadzala baseSirayeli.
UMosesi wabeka lemali ku-Aron nemadvodzana akhe, njengobe Simakadze abemwisela.
Simakadze watsi kuMosi na-Aron:
Linani lamadvodzana a-Kehati phakathi kwaLevi, ngemindeni yabo, nemindeni yalabakwati babo.
Linganisa lamadoda onkhe, kusuka eminyaka lemashumi lamane kuya kumashumi lamabili nesihlanu, laphumako kutsi asebenze etenteni lekuhlangana.
Lowo ngumsebenzi wemadvodzana aKehati etentini lekuhlangana; lomsebenti wabo kumele ube kuzinto letingcwele.
