"Lamuhla-ke, lapho lihlanganiso lihamba khona, uAron nemadvodzana akhe kumele bafike bakhuphule ifasitela lelingenhla, bavule ngeso ibhokisi lesivumelwano.
Bafike bamisa ingubo yesikhumba lesincanyana phezu kwayo, bafaka ingubo yegolide emhlophe phezulu kwayo, babeka emabhubesi ayo lapho.

Batawufaka phezu kwetafula lekudla lokusetshenzisiwe, licwecwe lesinhlamvu lesibhakabhaka, bese babeka kuwo emabhodlela, namakhowa, nemabhodlela ekudla lokushiswayo; nekudla lokuhlalako kumele kube khona.
Baphindze bafake phezulu kweto tingwevu letimnyama, babete ngesikhumba lesincanyana, bese befaka imikhono yayo endaweni yayo.
Baphindze bathathe ingubo yegolide, bayigqoka ibhokisi lelilanga, nelanga layo, nemacwecwe ayo, namabhodlela ayo, naletinye tigodzi letifakwa emanzini.
Bafanele bayifake, kanye nezinto zayo tonkhe, ebhokisini lelinesikhumba lesihle bese bayifaka emgodini wekutsi itfolwe.
Bafike bamisa ema-altare egolide, babeka phezu kwawo ingubo yesiliva negolide, bayigcoba ngesikhumba sengulube, bafaka khona tintambo zalo.
Baphindze bathathe tonkhe tindzawo letingcwele letisetshenziswa ekusebenzeni khona, bazibeke etinhlamvu tegolide, bazigqoka ngesikhumba sengulube, bazisa emgodini.
Baphindze basuse lilanga lesiliva elibukhali, bese belibabeka phezu kwayo licwebe lesimnyama.
Batawubeka kuyo zonke izinto letisetshenziswa kulo altare, ema-pavers, nema-forks, nama-spades, nama-basins; bese bafaka phezu kwayo ingubo yesikhumba sengulube lemnyama, bafake khona tintambo zayo.

Nase-Aron nemadvodzana akhe baphele lokugcoba lempahla yengcwele, naleyo mpahla yonke yengcwele, lapho kutawuphuma khona umkhosi, khona-ke lamadodana eKehati azofika abonise; kodvwa bangawucoci lomnikelo wesono, ngobe baya kufa. Lena impahla yetenti lekuhlangana, labaLevi bazoyibonisa.

Eleazaru, umsa wa-Aron umLevi, umsebenti wakhe uyabe nguwo wemafuta ekukhanyayo, nefushane lelifutfumekayo, nemnikelo wekushiswa lohlala njalo, namafutha okubhaka; 21naye aphindze abe ngumphathi wetenti lelingcwele lonke kanye nalolunyenti lwezinto letikhona kulo: ithempeli nempahla yayo.
Simakadze watsi kuMosi na-Aron:
Lakwa-Kehathi angeke aphelelwe emndenini waLevi, ngobe bahlala khona.

Lokho ningeke nikwenze kubo, kutsi baphile bangafa, lapho befika kuleso singcwele esingcwele kakhulu: Arone nemadvodzana akhe kumele bafike banike wonke umuntu lomsebenzi wakhe, nalowo mnikelo wesono lakhe.
Labo baseKehati-ke kumele bangangeni kutsi babone lezinto letingcwele, ngisho naleso sikhashana, ngobe bangafa.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
Batsi: "Linani labangani bakaGershoni, ngemindeni yabo, nangetindlu tabo.
Linganisa lamadoda onkhe, kusuka eminyaka lemashumi lamabili nesikhombisa kuya kuneminyaka lengema-50 ubudala, labo labaphuma basebenzela etindlu tekuhlangana.
Lokho kuyawuba ngumsebenzi wemindeni ye-Ghershoni, ngemisebenzi yabo netibondza labo.
Baphindze babambe titende tetenti lesingcwele, netenti lekuhlangana, netintela zalo, netintela letingwevu, netintela temnyango wetenti lekuhlangana,

namatfuba endlu yasebukhosini kanye nendlu yenkhosi, namatinhloko lamakhosi, namatinhloko labaholi, namatinhloko lamaphoyisa, namatinhloko labantfu, namatinhloko lamadvodza, namatinhloko lamaphoyisa, namatinhloko lamaphoyisa, namatinhloko lamaphoyisa, namatinhloko lamaphoyisa,
Labo baseGhershoni kumele babe ngaphansi kwesandla sa-Aron kanye nalabo bonkhe bantfu labasebenza nabo; utawukhuluma kubo ngaleyo minikelo yabo yekushiswa neyekudla.
Lowo ngumsebenzi wemindeni yemadvodzana aGhershoni etentini lekuhlangana, ngaphansi kwesandla sa-Ithamari, umsa wa-Aron, umLevi.
Linani lamadvodzana aMerariya, ngemindeni yabo, nemindeni yebantfu babo.
Linganisa lamadoda onkhe, kusuka eminyaka lemashumi lamane kuya kumashumi lamabili nesihlanu, laphumako kutsi asebenze etenteni lekuhlangana.
Lolu hlobo lwezinto lokumele basebentise ekusebenzeleni kwabo etentini lekuhlangana: tibhodi tetenti lesingcwele, nemingcambu yayo, netimbhoshongo zayo, netibondza zalo;

namatindlela emphini, namatfuba ayo, netinsika tayo, netimbhoshongo tayo, netingconyana tayo, nezinto takhe tonkhe, netintfo letisetshenziswako kuwo; bese ukhuluma ngegama lalowo nalowo lokufanele abe nalo.
Lowo ngumsebenzi wemindeni yemadvodzana aMerari etentini lekuhlangana, ngaphansi kwesandla sa-Ithamari, umsa wa-Aron, umLevi.
Ngaleso sikhatsi Mosi, na-Aron, nebaholi bemindeni yabo, babala lamadodana eKahati, ngemindeni yabo, ngalabafami babo.
Babala bonkhe lamadoda, kusuka eminyaka lemashumi lamane kuya kumashumi mahlanu eminyaka, labaphumayo kutsi basebenze etentini lekuhlangana.
Babalwa ngemindeni yabo, laba ngumakhulu lamabili, emakhulu lasikhombisa, namashumi lasitfupha.
Lokho kwakungubo bonke lababhalwa emindenini yakwa-Kehati, labasebenza etentini lekuhlangana, labesabalaliswa nguMosese na-Aron, njengobe Simakadze abewisela umthetho ngaMosi.
BoGersoni babalwa ngemindeni yabo, ngetindlu tababa babo.
Lamadoda onkhe, kusukela eminyaka lemashumi lamane kuya kumashumi lamabili nesihlanu, labo labafika besebenza etentini lekuhlangana,
labo lababhalwa kubo, ngemindeni yabo, nangetindlu tababa babo, babe förstångwe lamakhulu lamabili, lamashumi lamane nesihlanu.
Loba bangabo bonke lababhaliswe emindenini yama-Ghershoni, labasebenza etentini lekuhlangana, lawaseMosesi naAron ababhalwa kubo, njengobe Simakadze abewisele.
Labo lababhalwa kubo, labaseMerariya, bahlukaniswe ngemindeni yabo kanye nemindeni yabo.
Lamadoda onkhe, kusukela eminyaka lemashumi lamane kuya kumashumi lamabili nesihlanu, labo labafika besebenza etentini lekuhlangana,
labo lababhalwa kubo ngemindeni yabo, babemakhulu lasitfupha, lamashumi lamane.
Laba ngubo bonke lababhalwa emindenini yabana-Merariya, labesabalalelwa nguMosi na-Aron, njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose.
Mosi na-Aron, nebaholi beSirayeli, babala bonkhe labaLevi, ngemindeni yabo, nangetindlu tababa babo.
labo bonkhe bantfu labaneminyaka lemashumi lamane kuya kumashumi mahlanu eminyaka, labaphumayo kutsi basebenze kumsebenti wetenti lesingumhlangano, kanye nalabo labafaka impahla
babalwa labalishumi elinesihlanu lamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane.
Babala, njengobe Simakadze abewisela umthetho ngesandla saMosesi, babeka kuwo wonke umuntu umsebenzi wakhe kanye nempahla yakhe; babala, njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
Utsi: "Ukhulume nalabaSirayeli kutsi bakhuphe ngaphandle kwekhampasi wonke lowo unesifo sesikhumba, nelowo onendlala yegazi lephuma emlonyeni wakhe, kanye nomuntfu longcolile lokudlidliza.
Lamadoda namakhosikazi, khiphani; khiphani ngaphandle kwekhampasi, bangabi nenkinga ekhampasini, ngobe ngihlala phakathi kwabantu bami.
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli ayawukwenza njalo, wabasusa ngaphandle kwekhampasi, njengobe Simakadze abekhuluma kuMosese.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
Utsi kubo-Israyeli: Uma indoda noma indodana yemuntfu ifuna ukubulala umngane wayo ngesiphi nasinye sinqumo, bangaphazanyiswa nguSimakadze, khona-ke lowo muntu uyabiwa.
Ase avume lokuhlukunyezwa kwakhe, abuye abuyisele kulowo lowo abewudlwengula, abeke kuyo isihlanu saleyo mali, aze amnike lowo abewudlwengula.
Nawo wonke lamalungelo emnikelo wesono, lapho bantfu beSirayeli bewunikela kumaLevi, ayawube nguwe.
"Lomuntu ngamunye utawunikela ngezinto letingcwele, kepha noma yini leniketwa ngumbusi iyawuba yiye."
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
"Chaza kubo bonkhe bantfu base-Israyeli,okusho kwabo: 'Uma indodana yemuntu iphuma emndenini wayo, ingomunye wakhe,
"Ungeke afike emndenini wakhe, bese ehlala naye, kodvwa umyeni wakhe angawazi; ngobe abesewuphazanyiswa, kepha kube sekufihlakele, kube kungakabi namuntfu lokhuluma kuye, nome abewetiwa ekuhambeni.
Nase umfazi wakhe afike abe nebuhlungu benhliziyo, abe nenkinga yakhe ngayo; nome naye afike abe nebuhlungu benhliziyo, abe nenkinga yakhe ngayo, kodvwa yena angeke abe nenkinga yakhe ngayo.

"Nakuba umfazi wakhe angeke abe ngumnikelo wesono, kodvwa ube yiminikelo yekushiswa yesive sakhe; khona-ke umkakhe kumele amnikele isondlo saso kuSimakadze. 19Ngokwesinye simo noma ngesinye, lowesifazane kufanele anikele enkhosini yakhe kutsi ibe ngumkhonto wayo, kanye nesibopho sayo sokudla nesiphuzo.
Lomnikelo wekushiswa utawufikela lowesifazane, wabeka phambi kwaSimakadze.
Wabeka amanzi angcwele emgodini wemhlabatsini, wafaka namanzi emhlabatsini lwetendlu lengcwele, wabeka kuwo amanzi.

Watsi umnikelo wesono, lapho umkhonzi emisa khona lowesifazane phambi kwaSimakadze, avule izinwele zakhe, afake emlonyeni wakhe inhlanhla yesive, leyinhlanhla yenhlekelele. Nawo umnikelo wesono, lapho wabeka khona emanzini angabi nephunga elifihlisa lokulama;

Umnikelo wekushiswa utawumisa lowesifazane, utsi kuye: "Uma umfana angeke ahlangane nawe, noma uma ungabi necala lokudlwengula lowesifazane wakho, khona-ke lawa manzi ebuhlungu abengelaphazamisa kumele angakubi kuwe.
Ngako-ke, uma uhamba nemuntfu longekho mkhwenyana wakho, uphindze wehlisele wena ngokwakho, wahlala naye ngaphandle komkhwenyana wakho.
"Umnikelo wekushiswa utawubekwa embhedeni wakhe, khona lapho umkhonzi angeke abe nenkinga nalowo mkhwenyana; ngobe Simakadze Nkulunkulu wakho uyakwenza kube ngumlilo emlonyeni wakhe.

Lamanzi laletingelapheki afike emilenzeni yakho, abe ngumlilo emphinjeni yakho, abe ngumlilo emlonyeni wakho, abe ngumlilo enhliziyweni yakho, abe ngumlilo enhliziyweni yakho, abe ngumlilo enhliziyweni yakho.'"
Lomnikelo wekushiswa utawubhalela lamazwi lawa ebhokisini, bese wageza la mazwi emanzini angcolile.
utawumisa lowesifazane aze aphuze amanzi lalimaza, abe lilanga lelamaza, bese efika kuwo amanzi lalimaza, abe lilanga lelamaza.
Umnikelo wekushiswa utawuthathwa ngumnikelo wesono esandla salowo mfazi, umkhonzi utawuwukhipha phambi kwaSimakadze, uyawunikela kuwo ema-altari.
Waye athathe isandla sakhe sigcwele lemnikelo wesono, njengengxenye yekumbuso, wawukhipha ecaleni lelihlanganisiwe, watsi: "Lawo ma-Amori atawudla lamanzi.

"Uma yena ephazamise, ephezelisa umshado wakhe, bese edla amanzi aletha lalama, ayawufika kuye abe ngumkhuhlane, nemilenze yakhe ikhule, nentamo yakhe ibe mnyama, futhi abe ngulama phakathi kwabantu bakhe.
Ngako-ke, uma lowesifazane angeke ehlelekile, kepha ehlanzekile, angeke abe nenkinga, kodvwa angeke abe nemadvodzana.
Lolu lwazi lukhuluma ngalokukhazamisa, kutsi uma indodakazi iphuma emndenini wayo, ibe nendvodzakati yakhe, iphazanyiswa,
noma lapho kuyawufika khona umphefumulo wesive kumkakhe, nome lapho afike khona umphefumulo wesive kumkakhe, kufanele ambeke phambi kwaSimakadze, kube ngumnikelo wekushiswa.
Umkakhe ungeke abe necala, kodvwa indodana yakhe iphindze ibe necala ngesono sayo.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
"Ukhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, usithi kubo: 'Uma umuntu noma indoda inikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze, ibe nguNaziri,
Angeke aphuze wayini, noma iwayini lelibomvu; angeke aphuze siphuzo sewayini, noma siphuzo lelibovu; angeke aphuze umhluzi wetingcotjo, angeke afune tincotjo, timnyama nome timhlophe.
Ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho ehlala khona kutsi abe nguNaziri, angeke adle noma yini lephuma emvinini wesihlahla sewayini, ngisho nembewu yakhe kanye nesikhumba sayo.
Ngelilanga lelinyenti lemtsetfo wakhe, isandla sokusika asikucishe kuhlavu lakhe; kuze kufike ekupheleni kwemihla yakhe yemnikelo wesono, ungcwele; kumele avumele inwele yenhloko yakhe ikhule.
Ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho ehlala khona kutsi abe ngumnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze, angeke afike emhlane wemuntfu.
Nakuba ubaba wakhe, noma umama wakhe, noma umyeni wakhe, noma indvuna yakhe, nome indodana yakhe, bafa, angeke abe nenkinga nabo; ngobe livi lakhe lelingangcwele nguNkulunkulu lisenhlavu yakhe.
Live lonke lekuba nguNaziri, ungcwele kuSimakadze.
Ngosuku lwesikhombisa afike abe netinkomo ezimbili, noma tingulube ezimbili, aze amnike umnikelo wekushiswa emnyango wetente lekuhlangana.

Waye umLevi utawunikela ngelinye njengemnikelo wesono, nelinye njengeminikelo yekushiswa, kutsi abe ngusondlo sakhe esivumelwaneni, ngobe aphelelwe livi; nome-ke lomuntfu kumele abe ngumnikelo wesono ngelilanga lelinyenti.

"Uya kunikela ngaso sonke isikhathi sakhe sakubo, abe ngumnikelo wesono; uyawunikela ngaso sonke isikhathi sakhe sabo, abe ngumnikelo wesono; uyawunikela ngaso sonke isikhathi sawo, abe ngumnikelo wesono.
Le yimithetho yeNaziriti, lapho kuphelelwa khona lilanga lakhe leNazirithi: kumele afike emgwaqeni wetenti lekuhlangana.

Afike anikela khona ngeminikelo yakhe kuSimakadze: inkunzi yengulube yomnyaka mncane, ingabi nenkinga, ibe ngumnikelo wekushiswa; inkunzi yengulube yomnyaka mncane, ingabi nenkinga, ibe ngumnikelo wesono; nomkhwenyana, angabi nenkinga, abe ngumnikelo wesono.
kanye nebhokisi lekudla lokungalengiswanga, lihovisi lelihlanjululwe ngemafutha, nemabhisikidi afakwe mafutha, kanye nemnikelo wabo wesono kanye neminikelo yabo yekushiswa.
Lomnikelo wekushiswa utawubekwa phambi kwaSimakadze, umnikelo wesono kanye neminikelo yekushiswa.
utawunikela ngenkunzi yemvu ibe ngumnikelo wesono kuSimakadze, kanye nebhokisi lekudla lokungefulawa; nawe-ke umLevi kumele alungiselele iminikelo yayo yekushiswa naleyo yemfisha.
Nakhe uNazireli, lapho efika emgwaqeni wetenti lekuhlangana, awele imilenze yakhe yenaziri, athathe imilenze yakhe, aze ayifake emlilweni ngaphansi kwemnikelo wekushiswa.
Nakho-ke umnikelo wekushiswa kumele ube ngumnikelo wesono, kanye nesondlo lesinyenti sekudla, kanye nesondlo lesincane sekudla, kanye nesondlo lesincane sekudla, kanye nesondlo esincane sekudla.

Waye umnikelo wemaNaziri utawuwukhipha, awungcolisa phambi kwaSimakadze, kube yiminikelo yekushiswa; ingcwele, ibe ngumnikelo wesono, ibe ngumnikelo wesondlo, ibe ngumnikelo wesondlo, ibe ngumnikelo wesono, ibe ngumnikelo wesono.

Lowo ngumthetho weNaziri, lowenza namathiphu, kanye nemnikelo wakhe lotawuwunikela kuSimakadze, kutsi abe ngcwele kuye, ngaphandle kwalokho angeke akwazi ukukwenza; ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho ekhuluma khona ngematiphakheji akhe, kufanele akwenze ngendlela yemtsetfo weNaziri.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
"Ukhulume na-Aron nemadvodzakati akhe, utsi: Ngalendlela lenjalo nitawubambisana naboSirayeli; sithi kubo:
Simakadze utawukubambisana nawe, uyawukuvikela.
USimakadze utawukucosha, utawukuba nekuthula nawe.
Simakadze abeke mehlo akhe kuwe, abe nekuthula nawe.'
Ngako-ke batawubeka igama lami phezu kwalabaSirayeli, nami ngiyawubabhalisela.
Watsi lapho Mosese ephelele ekubekeni itabernakele, wayithambisa, wayisangcwele, kanye nezinto zayo zonke; wayithambisa ne altare, nezinto zayo zonke, wazisangcwele.
Bafike banikela ngalolusuku labaholi bemadvodzana a-Israyeli; laba bekungubaholi bemindeni yabo, bomkhuluwa babo, kanye nemadvodzakati abo, labazange babalwa.

Bafike banikela ngemnikelo wabo kuSimakadze: imoto leyisishiyagalombili, nengulube lelishumi elinambini; yinye imoto ngabaholi lababini, kanye nengulube ngalowo nalowo; banikela ngawo phambi kwetenti lesingcwele.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
"Thintela kubo, kutsi basebenzise kumsebenti wetenti lekuhlangana; utawubanika labaLevi, ngaso sonke sigungu sabo, njengobe bekufanele basebenze.
Mosesi watsi: "Lawo ema-carriages naleyo mintfwalo, ngiyawuyinikela kuLevi."
Wabanikela ngemikhumbi lemibili nengulube lemine kumadvodzana aGershoni, ngokwemisebenzi yabo.
nalemikhumbi lemine kanye nengulube lesishiyagalolunye kwalabaLevi baseMerariya, ngokwemisebenzi yabo; basebenza ngaphansi kwesandla sa-Ithamari, umsa wa-Aron, umLevi.
LakwaKehati-ke Mosesi akazange abonise, ngobe babe nesibopho sezinto letingcwele, bekufanele bazibambe emlenzeni wabo.
Banikela ngemnikelo wesono, banikela ngemnikelo wesono phambi kwe altare, ekuseni lapho kusetjentelwe khona i-altare.
. "Inawu," ze wi Musa, "jeden z kniazów powinien przynosić ofiarę na dzień, aby udekorować altar."
Ngelilanga lokuqala wanikela ngemnikelo wakhe Nashoni, umsa ka-Aminadabi, wasebukhosini beJuda.

Umnikelo wakhe waba licwecwe lesiliva elinye, elingenamamitha lamakhulu mathathu nemashumi lamane, nengilazi yegolide eyodwa, elingenamamitha lamashumi asibhozo, ngeshekeli lengcwelengcwele; obobabili babegcwele umnikelo wekushiswa wesiliva lomile loshiywe ngamafutha, abe ngumnikelo wekudla.
Wanikela nasinye isibambo segolide, lesilinganiselwa kushekeli lelishumi, sigcwele uvumba;
umnikelo wekushiswa wengulube lencane, nemvu, nendvodzakati yemnyaka munye, njengeminikelo yekushiswa;
umhlambi wema-obhutsi lasitfupha njengemnikelo wesono,
kanye nemnikelo wesono: inkunzi lemibili, umhlambi wetinkomo letisihlanu, lomkhwenyana wema-obhotsi lasitfupha, nemfuyo yemvu lelishumi elinamahlanu; lomnikelo wawuweNahashone, umsa wa-Aminadabi.
Ngelilanga lesitsatfu wanikela uNethaneli, umsa wa-Suhari, umholi weSisahari.

Ngelilanga lesithathu waba nemnikelo wakhe Eliabu, umsa waHeloni, umholi wemadvodzana aZabuloni lomunye wemadvodzakati laZebuloni.

Ngosuku lwesine wanikela Elizur, indodana kaShedeure, inhloko yamadodana aRubeni.

kanye nemnikelo wesono: tingulube ezimbili, nama-otini mahlanu, nemabhokhwe lamakhulu mahlanu, nama-otini emnyaka munye mancane mahlanu; lokhu kwaba ngumnikelo waEliyasafhi, umsa kaDeueli.
Ngelilanga lesikhombisa wanikela Elishama, umsa wa-Amihudi, umholi wemadvodzana aEfraim, ngemnikelo wakhe.

kanye nemnikelo wesono: tingulube ezimbili, nama-otini mahlanu, nemabhokhwe lamakhulu mahlanu, nalabomvu lamakhulu mahlanu; lomnikelo wawuye Elishama unyana wa-Amihudi.
Ngosuku lwesikhombisa wanikela ngemnikelo wakhe Gamaliyeli, umsa waPedasuri, umholi wemadvodzana aManase.

Wanikela nasinye isibambo segolide, lesilinganiselwa kushekeli lelishumi, sigcwele uvumba;
umnikelo wekushiswa wengulube lencane, nemvu, nendvodzakati yemnyaka munye, njengeminikelo yekushiswa;
umhlambi wema-obhutsi lasitfupha njengemnikelo wesono,
kanye nemnikelo wesono: tingulube ezimbili, nama-otini mahlanu, nemakhoboka lamakhulu mahlanu, namabele lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu eminyaka; lokhu kwaba ngumnikelo waGamiliyeli, umsa waPedasuri.
Ngelilanga lesithoba wanikela uAbidanu, umsa kaGideoni, umholi wemadvodzana aBenjamini, ngemnikelo wakhe.

Umnikelo wakhe waba licwecwe lesiliva elinye, elingenamamitha lamakhulu mathathu nemashumi lamane, nengilazi yegolide eyodwa, elingenamamitha lamashumi asibhozo, ngeshekeli lengcwelengcwele; obobabili babegcwele umnikelo wekushiswa wesiliva lomile loshiywe ngamafutha, abe ngumnikelo wekudla.
Wanikela nasinye isibambo segolide, lesilinganiselwa kushekeli lelishumi, sigcwele uvumba;
umnikelo wekushiswa wengulube lencane, nemvu, nendvodzakati yemnyaka munye, njengeminikelo yekushiswa;
umhlambi wema-obhutsi lasitfupha njengemnikelo wesono,

kanye nemnikelo wesono: inkunzi lemibili yengulube, nama-orenji lasitfupha, nemakhoboka lalishumi elinamahlanu, nemabele lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu eminyaka; lokhu kwaba ngumnikelo waAbidanu unyana kaGideoni.
Ngelilanga leshumi wanikela ngu-Ahiezer, umsa ka-Amishadai, umholi wemadvodzana aDani.

Umnikelo wakhe waba licwecwe lesiliva elinye, elingenamamitha lamakhulu mathathu nemashumi lamane, nengilazi yegolide eyodwa, elingenamamitha lamashumi asibhozo, ngeshekeli lengcwelengcwele; obobabili babegcwele umnikelo wekushiswa wesiliva lomile loshiywe ngamafutha, abe ngumnikelo wekudla.
Wanikela nasinye isibambo segolide, lesilinganiselwa kushekeli lelishumi, sigcwele uvumba;
umnikelo wekushiswa wengulube lencane, nemvu, nendvodzakati yemnyaka munye, njengeminikelo yekushiswa;
umhlambi wema-obhutsi lasitfupha njengemnikelo wesono,
kanye nemnikelo wesono: inkunzi lemibili, nemhlambi walama-orenji lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, nemfuyo yemvu lelishumi elinambili; lomnikelo waba nguAhiezeri, umsa ka-Amishadai.
Ngomhla wesine, uPagieli, indodana kaOkran, inhloko yabantu baka-Asere, wanikela ngomnikelo wakhe.

Umnikelo wakhe waba licwecwe lesiliva elinye, elingenamamitha lamakhulu mathathu nemashumi lamane, nengilazi yegolide eyodwa, elingenamamitha lamashumi asibhozo, ngeshekeli lengcwelengcwele; obobabili babegcwele umnikelo wekushiswa wesiliva lomile loshiywe ngamafutha, abe ngumnikelo wekudla.
Wanikela nasinye isibambo segolide, lesilinganiselwa kushekeli lelishumi, sigcwele uvumba;
umnikelo wekushiswa wengulube lencane, nemvu, nendvodzakati yemnyaka munye, njengeminikelo yekushiswa;
umhlambi wema-obhutsi lasitfupha njengemnikelo wesono,
kanye nemnikelo wesono: tingulube ezimbili, nama-otini mahlanu, nemakhoboka lamadoda lamahlanu, nama-otini lamadodana emnyaka munye mahlanu; lomnikelo waba nguPagiyeli, umsa waOkran.
Ngelilanga lelishumi elinambili wanikela Ahira, umsa wa-Enani, umholi wemadvodzana aNeftali.

Umnikelo wakhe waba licwecwe lesiliva elinye, elingenamamitha lamakhulu mathathu nemashumi lamane, nengilazi yegolide eyodwa, elingenamamitha lamashumi asibhozo, ngeshekeli lengcwelengcwele; obobabili babegcwele umnikelo wekushiswa wesiliva lomile loshiywe ngamafutha, abe ngumnikelo wekudla.
Wanikela nasinye isibambo segolide, lesilinganiselwa kushekeli lelishumi, sigcwele uvumba;
umnikelo wekushiswa wengulube lencane, nemvu, nendvodzakati yemnyaka munye, njengeminikelo yekushiswa;
umhlambi wema-obhutsi lasitfupha njengemnikelo wesono,

kanye nemnikelo wesono: tingulube ezimbili, nemhlambi walama-orenji lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, namabhokhwe lamakhulu lamabili nesihlanu, nalamba lamnyaka mncane lalishumi elinhlanu; lomnikelo wawuwe-Ahira unyana ka-Enani.
Lokho kwakungumnikelo wabaholi beSirayeli, wekunikela ngesandla esibhedlela, kumnyaka wekucala lapho kufakwa khona ukhilimu: tipho tesiliva lama-12, namabhodlela egolide lamakhulu mahlanu.

Isisindo salowo mbhedha wesiliva bekungushekeli lamakhulu lamabili namashumi amathathu, nesibambi ngasinye saba ngushekeli lama-70; linani leliphelele lesikhundla segolide laba ngamaphesenti angama-2 nge shekeli yengcwele.

namatishi lagolide lalishumi nembili, agcwele uvumba, esisindo sawo ngasinye si shekeli lelishumi, nge shekeli yendawo yasengcwele; linani leliphelele lesiliva lamatitishi lalikhulu nemashumi lamabili.

Inyama yemnikelo wekushiswa yabe yinkunzi yemagilebhisi lelishumi nembili, nemfuyo yayo lelishumi nambili, nama-andele emnyaka munye alishumi nambili, kanye nesondlo saso sekudla; namabhokhwe lamakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa abe yiminikelo yekushiswa.

Lenyama lelihlanganiswe nemnikelo wesondlo sekuthula: inkunzi yengulube lengema-24, umhlambi wema-60, ibhokhwe lengama-60, nemacwecwe emnyaka munye angama-60. Lowo waba ngumnikelo wekunikela ngesandla esithendeni lesingcwele, ngemuva kwekuphekwa kwayo.

Nalapho Mose ephuma etentini lekuhlangana, kutsi akhulume naye, wangena lapho, wakhuluma naye kusuka phezu kwendlu yekuphumula ebekwe ngebhokisi lesivumelwano, kusuka phakathi kwalabo baphilayo lababini; watsi kuye:
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
Utsi ku-Aron: Uma umisa lilanga lesikhombisa, kufanele likhangele ebusweni besikhulu selilanga.
U-Aron wakwenza njalo; wababeka emakhandlela akhe, akhanya ngaphambili kwesikhulu semakhandlela, njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose.
Wayenza ibe yindlovu yegolide, eyenziwe ngesandla, kusukela emlenzeni wayo kuya emacandza akhe; ngaleso simo Simakadze abemukhombisa sona, uMosese wayenza.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
"Thintela labaLevi phakathi kwalabo bonkhe bantfu be-Israyeli, ubabuhlanze.
Ngalendlela lenjalo utawubahlanza: usike phezu kwabo amanzi ekugcoba, bacwebeze isikhumba sabo sonke, balave tigqoko tabo, bangabi mhlophe.
Bafike baphindze bathathe tinkunzi tengulube kanye nemnikelo wayo wekudla, isiliva lelihlanganisiwe nemsinyane lommbila; nawe utawuthatha tinkunzi tengulube letimbili njengeminikelo yekushiswa.
Landza labaLevi phambi kwetenti lekuhlangana, bese uhlanganisa khona lonke ibandla lalabaSirayeli.
Lalela labaLevi bafike phambi kuSimakadze, kutsi lamadvodza aseSirayeli abeke isandla sakhe phezu kwabo.
U-Aron utawunikela ngeLevi kuSimakadze njengemnikelo wesono kusuka kuboSirayeli, kutsi basebenzele umsebenzi waSimakadze.
LaLevi latawubeka isandla sakhe phezu kwehlavu lengulube, wanikela ngayinye ibe yisondlo sesono, nelinye libe yisondlo somlilo kuSimakadze, kutsi abe ngumnikelo wesono kuSimakadze.
Utawubeka labaLevi phambi kwa-Aron nemadvodzana akhe, utawubanikela ngemnikelo wesono kuSimakadze.
Ngako-ke uyawuhlukanisa labaLevi kulabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, kutsi babe bami.
Naloku utawubahlanza, utawubanikela njengemnikelo wekushiswa, bese befika labaLevi basebenzela etentini lekuhlangana.
Labo bami bami nguNkulunkulu, bami ngaseSirayeli; ngibathathe ngesandla sami endaweni yalowo wonke lavula umlomo emadvodzana aSirayeli.
Wonke lowo wesifazane eSirayeli, kusukela kumuntu kuze kube yinyama, nguyawumi; ngaleso sikhathi lapho ngibulala khona sonke lesifazane esiswini sakwa-Egipta, ngawamisa ngesandla sami.
Nami ngitabela labaLevi endaweni yalabo bonke labaseSirayeli labavula umlomo.

"Ngibanikela ngalabaLevi ku-Aron nemadvodzana akhe, njengemnikelo wesono kusuka kubo bonkhe bantfu baka-Israyeli, kutsi basebenzela bantfu baka-Israyeli etentini lekuhlangana, nalapho besenza khona umnikelo wesono; ngobe kungeke kube khona indlala phakathi kwabantfu baka-Israyeli, lapho befika khona esingcweleni."
Mosi na-Aron, kanye nemindeni yalabaSirayeli, bakwenta kubo bonkhe labaLevi, njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose kutsi akwenze kubo.
LaLevi bahlanzwa, bahlamba ingubo zabo; uAron wabanikela kubo njengemnikelo wesono phambi kwaSimakadze, wabalungisa esivumelwaneni naNkulunkulu, kutsi abe temize.
Baye baphuma besuka eBhetlehema, batsi: "Lemihlambi yesive sethu ihlala kulendlu yaSimakadze," 21bafike base entabeni yaseGibhithe, kwa-Aron nemadvodzana akhe; ngobe Simakadze abewisela Mose.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
Lolu hlelo lwabaLevi lutsi: Kusuka kumnyaka wamashumi lamabili nesihlanu nangaphezulu, kumele afike abe ngumnikelo wekushiswa etentini lekuhlangana.
Ngeminyaka lemashumi lamabili nesihlanu kumele baphume emisebenzini yabo kanye nekuyeka kusebentisa.
Baye basebenzela labazalwane babo, bangabasiza emisebenzini yabo yetenti lekuhlangana, kodvwa nabo kumele bangabi nesibopho sokusebenza; ngako-ke nitawumisa lomsebenzi waLevi.
Ngemnyaka wesitsatfu ngemuva kokuphuma kwabo bantfu beSirayeli emhlabatsini waseMijiphu, ngemnyaka wakucala wenyanga yokuqala, Simakadze wabakhuluma kuMosese emfuleni iSina, watsi:
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli kufanele agcine iPasha ngesikhathi sayo.
Niyigcine kuleso sikhathi sayo, ngelilanga lelishumi nelinesihlanu lelinyanga, lapho liphuma khona ilanga; niyenze yonke imiyalo yayo kanye naletinye timiso.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Laba-Israyeli, nigcine iPasha."

Bayigcine ngemnyaka wesitsatfu wenyanga yokuqala, ngelilanga lelishumi nelinesihlanu, lapho liphuma khona ilanga, esigabeni seSinayi; njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose, kanjalo-ke bantfu baseSirayeli bayenze.
Bakhona bantfu lababi, lababenesifutfu, labangeke bagcine iPasha ngalolusuku; bafike kuMosesi na-Aron ngalolusuku, bethi:
batsi: "Sinenkinga, ngobe sicophelela umfile; kungani ke singavunyelwa umnikelo waSimakadze kuleso sikhathi kanye nebantfu baka-Israyeli?"
Musa watsi kubo: "Thumelani lapha, kuze ngibone kutsi Simakadze ukhuluma yini ngenu."
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:

Utsi kubo bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli: "Uma ngabe kukhona lomunye wenu, noma linye lamadvodzakati enu, angeke abe nekuthula ngenxa yesilwane lesifile, noma ehamba ngendlela ende, ningeke nigcine iPasha kuSimakadze.
Lomnyaka wesitsatfu, ngelilanga lelishumi nelinesihlanu inyanga yekucala, utawuyikhipha; uyawuyidla nekudla lokunge-maza kanye nemithi lemibi.
Ningeke nishiye lutho kulo kuze kube ngubusuku, ningeke niphuze lutho kulo; nigcine yonke imiyalo yePasha.

"Lomuntu longcwele, angase angeke abe ehambeni ngendlela, kodwa angamlungiseleli uPasha, lowo muntu kumele ahlanganiswe nebantfu bakhe; ngobe akunikeze imnikelo wesono kuSimakadze ngesikhathi saso; yena uyakuba nesivi sakhe.

"Nasekungeke kube khona umkhwenyana lohlala nawe, lafuna ukwenza iPasha kuSimakadze, kufanele agcine imiyalo yayo kanye nemithetho yayo; njengendlela lenjalo kumele abe nayo umkhwenyana nalowo wasemhlaba.
Ngosuku lapho itabernakele yamiswa khona, umfudlana wawufihla itabernakele yemtsetfo; kusukela ngasebusuku kuya emini, umfudlana waba phezu kwetabernakulum, ubonakala njengemlilo.
Kube kube njalo; lilanga lelimnyama liyifihla, lilanga lemhlophe ibonakala njengemlilo.
Nalapho umfudlana uphuma etentini, bantfu baseSirayeli bahamba; nalapho umfudlana uhlala khona, bantfu baseSirayeli bahlala khona.
Ngemtsetfo waSimakadze, bantfu baka-Israyeli bahamba, nangemtsetfo waNkulunkulu bahlala; nsuku zonke lapho umfudlana uhlala khona phezu kwetenti, nabo bahlala.
Nalapho umfudlana ehlala khona ngezinsuku eziningi phezu kwetenti, bantfu baseSirayeli balalela ilizwi laSimakadze, bangahambanga.
Ngezinye izikhathi imvula yahlala ngezinsuku ezimbalwa phezu kwetabernakele; ngaleso simiso saSimakadze, bahlala basekucampeni, ngaleso simiso saSimakadze, basuka.

Nasekungeke kube khona sikhatsi lapho intaba ihlala khona kusukela ngekusasa kuze kube ekuseni, bese kuyawufika usuku lokukhulu, basuka; noma ngabe ngubusuku, noma ngabe ngelilanga, lapho intaba iphuma khona, basuka.

Kube lilanga lemibili, noma ngemnyaka munye, noma ngeminyaka lelishumi, lapho umfudlana ehlala khona phezu kwetabernakele, bantfu baseSirayeli bahlala khona, bangasukanga; kepha lapho iphuma khona, basuka.
Ngemtsetfo waSimakadze bamisa emakhazeni abo, nangemtsetfo waSimakadze bahamba; balandzela umthetho waSimakadze, njengoba abewise ngesandla saMosese.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
"Uyakwenza netibopho letimbili tesiliva, letingconywako; tingeke tisetshenziselwe kutsi kuhlangatshezwane ibandla, kanye nalapho emabhishi ehamba khona.
Nalapho kuphucuka khona tindlebe letimbili, libandla lonke kumele lihlangane kuwe emgwaqeni wetenti lekuhlangana.
Uma kuphucuka yinye kuphela, khona-ke kumele bahlangane nawe labaholi, laba chefuni bemikhosi yakaJuda.
Kuze lilanga letfu lifike, timphi letihlala ecaleni lasenyakatho kumele tihambe.
Uma i-alarm iphuma lilanga lesibili, timphi letihlala ecaleni lasenyakatho kumele zihambe. I-alarm iya kuba yisignali yekuhamba.
Ngako-ke uma ukhuluma nabo, khona-ke uphuze emphinjeni, ngaphandle kwekuphota.
Lamadodana a-Aron, labaLevi, kumele baphume ngemibhoshongo. Lo mthetho utawuhlala njalo kuwe kanye nemindeni yenu.

Uma niphuma emphini, enhliziyweni yenu, kulwa nemfowabo loyawuphazamisa; khona-ke kufanele niphuze umsindo wemabhubesi, ngobe Simakadze Nkulunkulu wenu utawukukhumbula wena, nawe uya kusindisa emlonyeni womfowabo.

Naleso sikhathi sekuphumula kwenu, naleso sikhathi semikhosi yenu, naleso sikhathi sokuqala kwenyanga, kufanele niphuze timphimbo ngeminikelo yenu yokushiswa, neminikelo yenu yekuthula; kuze kube ngukumbuso kuNkulunkulu wenu. Ngiye Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu.
Kumnyaka wesitsatfu, kumnyaka wesihlanu, ngenyanga yesibili, ngelilanga lemashumi lamabili nesikhombisa, umfudlana waphuma etentini lesivumelwane semtsetfo.
Basuka bahamba, bantfu baka-Israyeli besuka eGibhithe besuka eSinayini; ngobe lizulu lahlala eGibhithi leParani.
Loku kwaba ngukuqala kwabo kutsi bahambe, ngemtsetfo waSimakadze lowawutsi ngaMosi.
Bahamba kuqala ngemikhosi inhloko yetive ta-Yuda, neNahashoni unyana wa-Aminadabi waba nguMengameli wesive sabo.
Ngaphesheya kwemphi yaleso sihlanganiso, kwaba nguNethaneli umsa wa-Suari.
Ngaphesheya kwemphi yakwa-Zabuloni kwaba nguEliab, umsa waHeloni.
Letenti lengcwele yasuswa, basuka nabo bonkhe bantfu beGershoni naBenjamini, lababagcini bayo.
Emva kwalo kwasuka inhloko yetive ta-Rubheni, ngaso Elisuri unyana wa-Shedeuri, waba nguMengameli wesive sawo.
Ngaphesheya kweluhlaka lwemndeni wakwaSimeoni kwakunguShelumiyeli, umsa waZurishadai.
Ngaphesheya kwesolwandle kwakunguEliyashaphi, umsa waDehueli, waba nguMengameli webantfu baseGadi.
Basuka khona bantfu baka-Kehati, babe nezinto letingcwele; letenti labekwa phansi ngaphambi kokuba bafike.
Emva kwalo kwasuka inhloko yetive ta-Ephrayi, ngemikhosi yayo; ngaphesheya kwayo kwaba nguElishama unyana wa-Amihudi.
Ngaphesheya kwemphi yamakhosi, kwaba nguGamayeli, umsa waPedasuri.
Ngaphesheya kwemphi yebantfu baseBenjamini kwaba nguAbidan, umsa waGideoni.
Lakugcina lahamba livi lesiteji seDani, livela ekugcineni kwesiteji sonke; naphezu kwalo livi kwakungu-Ahiezeri, unyana ka-Amishadai.
Ngaphesheya kwesolwandle kwakunguPagiyeli, umsa wa-Ohrani, waba nguMengameli webantfu base-Aseri.
Ngaphesheya kwesokudla kwa-Ahira, umsa wa-Enani, kwaba ngumndeni wakwaNephtali.
Lokho kwakuye kutsi kuhambe emaqembu lamakhosikazi aseSirayeli, lapho besuka khona.

UMosi watsi kuHobab, umsa ka-Reuheli, umkhwenyana waMosesi, waseMidiyani: "Siyahamba sifike endaweni lapho uSimakadze abesho kutsi utawusiya kuyo; phuma nathi, siyawukwenza kahle kuwe, ngobe Simakadze ukhuluma ngezinto ezinhle ngeSirayeli.
Hobab watsi kuye: "Angeke ngihambe, kepha ngiyawubuyela ezweni lami nebantfu bami."
Watsi: "Musa, sicela, ungasishiya; wena uyazi lendawo lapho kufanele sihlale khona emhlabatsini, ube ngumholi wethu.
Uma ufika nathi, sitawukwabelana nawe ngezinto tonkhe letihle Simakadze latfumisayo.
Bahamba basuka emfuleni waSimakadze, behamba uhambo lwezinsuku ezintathu; ibhokisi lesivumelwane saNkulunkulu laliyihamba phambi kwabo ekuseni nakusihlwa, labafuna khona indawo yekuphumula.
Imanti yaSimakadze yabe ingaphansi kwabo ngelilanga, lapho besuka khona esiteji.
Nalapho ibhokisi lesivumelwane saNkulunkulu liphuma khona, uMosese wakhuluma watsi: "Susa, Simakadze, bahlukaniswe baholi bakho, bahambe nabo labakukhohlisa!"
Nalapho ihlala khona, watsi: "Buyisela, Simakadze, emaphesenti lamakhulu aseSirayeli."
Labantfu baphuma bekhala, ngobe babenenkinga; Simakadze wapaza, watsi: "Umlilo usuka kuSimakadze wehla phakathi kwabo, wawudlidliza ingxenye yesitezi sekamelweni."
Batsi: "UNkulunkulu ukhuluma kuMosi, watsi: 'Njengomhlambi lomkhulu welive, ngitawuwubulala.
Batsi: "Tabereha," ngobe mlilo waSimakadze wabatfusa phakathi kwabo."
Batsi nabo bonkhe bantfu labahamba nabo, bafike bafuna ukudla; ngobe lamadvodza aseSirayeli akazange aphinde abe nendlala, watsi: "Ngabe sitawudla yini inyama!
Sikhumbula inhlanzi lesidla ngayo mahhala e-Egypt, kanye ne-currants, melons, leeks, onion, ne garlic.
Lakho-ke kuphele sifiso sethu, singabona lutho ngaphandle kwalo manna.
Le-manna yayifana nembewu lencane ye-coriander, yabonakala njenge-resin emnyama.
Baye bahamba bewuqoqa, bewubhaka emabhodleni noma bewubhaka ngetitshe, bewubhaka emabhodleni noma bewujika ube ngukudla lokucwebezelayo; kube nephunga lelifana nalelo lomhluzi.
Nasebusuku, lapho lilanga lemvula liphuma ligwaca emkhosini, ne-manna lafika nalo.
Mosese wakhuluma kuwo wonke lamadodana, ngasemnyango wetente lakhe; Simakadze waba nendlala kakhulu, naMosese waba nebuhlungu.
UMosesi watsi kuSimakadze: "Ngubani na lowutfumisayo umkhonzi wakho? Ngikwenze yini, kutsi ubone kube buhlungu kuwe, kuze ubeke lilanga lebantfu bonke phezu kwami?

Ngibe ngibazala yini laba bantu bonke, noma ngabafaka kanjani emhlaba, kutsi ungitshele ukuthi ngiwathathe emilenzeni yami, njengobe umkhwenyana ethwala umntwana, kuze kube yileyo mhlaba lowawuwusho kubo-baba babo?
Ngaphi ngitawunikela ngekudla kubo bonkhe bantfu, ngobe batsi: Sinike inyama kutsi sidle!
Ngingeke ngibabambe laba bantu bonke linye, ngobe kunzima kakhulu kum.
Uma ucabanga kutsi ungeke ungiphathe ngendlela lenjalo, khona-ke bulala ngaleso sikhathi, uma unenkinga nami. Ungaze uvumele ngibheke kutfunywa kwami."

USimakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Thiba nami amadoda lamashumi lamakhulu lalishumi elinesihlanu emaLevi asuka kuSirayeli, lawaziyo ukuthi bangabaholi nebaholi babantu; utawuwafaka etentini lekuhlangana, babe khona nawe.
Ngitaphuma khona, ngikhuluma nawe khona; ngitawukhipha lomoya okhona kuwe, ngiwufake kubo; nabo batawuba nesibopho sebantfu kanye nawe, ukuze ungabi nalo wena kuphela.

Utsi kubo: Lingisani lingcwele, nilungiselele kusasa lokudla inyama; ngobe uSimakadze walalela kutsi nikhuluma, nitsi: Ngabe sifuna yini ukudla inyama! Kube kulungile kuwe eMijiphu. Ngako-ke Simakadze utawukulethela inyama, niyidle.
Ningeke niyidle lilanga elinye, noma lilanga lemibili, noma lilanga lesihlanu, noma lilanga lelishumi, noma lilanga lemashumi lamabili;
lilanga lonke, kuze kuphume emphinjeni yenu, niyipalele; ngobe niwuphumile Simakadze lokhona phakathi kwenu, natingcolisa kuye, nitsi: Nakhe saphuma kanjani ema-Egypti?
Mosi watsi: "Namuhla ngikhona phakathi kwamakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane emaphesenti ebantfu labahamba ngenyawo, wena utsi: 'Ngitawubanika inyama kuze badla ngenyanga legcwele.'
"Nase kubulawa tonkhe tingulube kanye netibondza, ngabe kutawufike yini kubo? Nase kutfolwe tonkhe tinhlanzi telwandle, ngabe kutawufike yini kubo?"
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Isandla sami sincane yini? Namuhla utawubona kutsi ngabe ngikhuluma yini, noma ngingeke ngikhulume."
UMoses waphuma, wakhuluma kubo, watsi kubo: "Lemiyalo kaSimakadze injalo;" wahlangana nabaholi babo labamashumi lamane nesikhombisa, wababeka ecaleni letenti.

USimakadze wehla emlilweni, wakhuluma naMosi, watsi: "Thina-ke sitawukhipha umphefumulo lobe ukhona kuMosesi, siwubeke kubo bonkhe bantfu bami lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa; lapho umphefumulo ufika khona kubo, bashumayela, kodvwa bangazange bakhulume.
Bakhona lamadoda lababili, Eldadi naMedada, abehlala emgwaqeni; laba babhalwe encwadini yabaholi, kodvwa bebengaphuma etenteni. Lomoya waba phezu kwabo nabo, bafika baprofetisa emgwaqeni.
Waphuma umfana, wakhuluma kuMosi, watsi: "Eldad neMedad baprofetisa emgwaqeni."
UJoshua, umsa wa-Nun, umkhonzi waMosesi kusukela ebutsheni bakhe, watsi: "Mosi, nkosi yami, letsa kubo."
Musa watsi kuye: "Ungifuna yini kutsi ugcine umsindo ngami? Ngabe bonke abantu bakaSimakadze bangaba boprofeta, ngobe Simakadze angabeka umoya wakhe kubo bonkhe!"
Ngako-ke Musa nebaholi beSirayeli babuyela ekampheni.

USimakadze wehlisa umfutho, wakhipha tingulube kusuka elwandle, wayifaka phansi emgwaqeni, ngaso sonke isikhathi, kuze kufike kufike emaviki lamakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, kwaze kwaba ngumlilo omkhulu.

Baphuma nabo bonke busuku nalowo mhlaka-nye, kanye nosuku lonke lokulandelayo, bahlanganisa tingulube; angeke kube khona lowo wakhipha ngaphantsi kwemakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu emalitha lamanzi. Bezimisa ngaso sonke isikhashana esiteji.
Lenyama yabe ikhona emlonyeni wabo, bengeke babeyiphule, lapho kwaphuma khona umsindo waSimakadze kulabo bantu, wababulala ngesifo esikhulu kakhulu.
Batsi: "Kule ndawo ibizwa ngokuthi yiKibrot-hataava, ngoba khona babulale labantfu labafile ngendlala."
Basuka eKibrothi-hataava, bahamba befika eHaserothi, bahlala khona.
Miriami na-Aron bakhuluma ngaMosi, ngenxa yendvodzakati yakhe leKushithi, leyo ayibolile; ngobe abeyibolile indodana yaseKushithi.
Batsi: "UNkulunkulu ukhuluma ngeMosesi kuphela, akazange akhulume nathi na?" USimakadze walalela amazwi abo.
UMosese waba ngumuntu lohlala elula kakhulu, mkhulu kunabo bonke labaphila emhlabeni.
Watsi Simakadze watsi kuMosesi, na-Aron, naMiriam: "Niphumani nitawufika etenti lekuhlangana; niphuma nabo bonkhe labanye bobabili.
USimakadze wehla etululeni lwesivunguvungu, wahlala emgwaqeni wetenti, watsi ku-Aron naMiriam; bafike bonke bobabili.
Watsi: "Makhe nikhulume; uma kukhona umprofeti phakathi kwenu, mina, uSimakadze, ngiyawuvela kuye ngekubona, ngikhuluma naye ngephupho.
Angeke kube njalo nalowo mkhonzi wami uMosi, lowo lothembekile endlu yami yonke.
Ngaye ngikhuluma ngaso buso kubuso, ngemazwi acacile, hhayi ngemiphiko; naye ubona imfihlakalo yaSimakadze; ngobe yini-ke kutsi ningalokothi nikhulume naMosi, umkhonzi wami?
USimakadze wehluleke kakhulu nabo, waphuma.
Watsi lapho umfudlana uphuma etentini, wabona isikhumba sa-Miryami simhlophe njengentshebe; Aharonu wehla waya kuye, watsi: "Ngibonani, isikhumba ngaso simnyama kakhulu.
watsi kuMosesi: "Nceda, nkosi yami, ungase usibeke esivumelwaneni lesive sethu, lapho sakhetsile khona ngendlela engaqhelekanga.
Akufanele abe njengemuntfu lozalwa mnyama, lomsoco wakhe uphelelwe ngamashumi lasitfupha.
Mozesi watsi kuSimakadze, utsi: "ONkulunkulu, ngiyakucela uyawuphilisa."

Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Kube ubaba wakhe wephuza emlonyeni wakhe, angeke abe nenkinga iminyaka lesikhombisa? Yibeke ngaphandle kwekhampasi iminyaka lesikhombisa; bese emva kwalokho ivunyelwe ukuba ifike.
Miriami wabekwa ngaphandle kwekhabhinethi iminyaka lesikhombisa, kodvwa labantfu baphindze babuyela emuva, kuze abuyiselwe.
Basuka eHaserothi, bamisa tindlu tabo emfuleni weParan.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
"Thuntela lamadoda kutsi abone ilizwe leKanana, leliyawubanikela kuboSirayeli; thuntela umholi ngamunye emndenini wababa babo."
Wabathumela ke Musa esigabeni semhlabatsini saFaran, njengobe Simakadze abewisela umthetho ngawo; bonke laba babe ngabaholi bamakhosi lamadvodza ase-Israyeli.
Lamagama abo lakungule: kusuka kumndeni wa-Rubeni, uShamua, umsa kaZakhuri.
Kusuku lweSimeoni: Shafati, umsa waHori.
ku-Juda: Kalebe, umsa waJefune.
ku-Issakhar: Igal, umsa kaJoseph.
ku-Ephrayimi: Hoshea, umsa waNun.
ku-Israyeli wa-Benjamini: Palthi, umsa waRaphu.
ku-Israyeli, nguGadiyeli, umsa waSodi.
ngomnyaka wasikhombisa, emndenini wakwaManase, emndenini ka-Josefa, Gadhi unyana waSusi.
Kwakwa-Dani: Ammiyeli, umsa waGemali.
ku-Aseri: Sethuri, umsa kaMikayeli.
ku-Israyeli, nguNabhi unyana waVofsi; ku-Israyeli, ngu-Ahira umLevi.
ku-Israyeli wa-Gadi: Geweli, umsa kaMahi.
Lemi magama lamadodana aMosesi abewathumela kutsi bahlolisise lelizwe; naHosheya, umsa waNuni, Mosesi watsi nguJoshua.
Wabathumela kutsi babone iNingizimu yeKanana, watsi kubo: "Niya ezweni laseNtshonalanga, niye emhlabatsini, bese nifika lapho.
Nibone lemhlaba, nibone kutsi unjani; nibone ukuthi bangaphi bantfu labahlala khona, bangaphi labo labavuthayo, bangaphi labo abancane, bangaphi labakhulu.
Ingabe lemhlaba lapho bahlala khona ulungile noma awubi? Ingabe lamadolobha abo avulekile noma akhuselekile ngetindlu?
Lemhlaba ugcwele yini noma awunawo? Ingabe kunetihlahla kulo mhlaba, noma asikho? Kulungile kuwe, uyenise nekudla kwemhlaba." Bekuyisikhathi sekukhulisa timbali takuqala.
Baye baphuma, bahlola lelizwe, besuka emfuleni i-Zin kuya eRehobothi, lapho kungena khona ema-Emati.
Bafike bafika eHebroni, lapho kwahlala khona Ahiman, neSheshai, naTalmai, bantfu baka-Enaki; (Hebroni yakhiwa iminyaka lesikhombisa ngaphambi kweSoan yaseMisri).
Befika efulani le-Eshkoli, bacubhulela khona isihlahla semvini kanye nesihlahla sembali yewayini, besiboshwa ngulabo bobabili emtimbeni wabo; nabo bacubhulela khona tithelo te-granate namatiko.
Lakwashiywa igama lendawo leyo ngokuthi yiValley of Eshcol, ngenxa yesitandza sabaSirayeli, lababeke khona.
Bafike babuyela ngemuva kwelilanga lemashumi lamane, lapho bekubopha khona lelizwe.
Bafike bahlangana naMosese na-Aron, kanye nemindeni yalabaSirayeli, eKadeshe, emhlabatsini waseFaran; banikela ngenhlolovo kubo kanye nemindeni yabo, babonisana nembewu yelizwe.
Bakhuluma kuMosi, batsi: "Sifike ezweni lapho utfumele khona; leli lizwe liphuma ngekudla kanye nejusi; naleso sithelo saso.
Kusekho nabantfu labahlala khona, banamandla kakhulu, nemadolobha abo anemiganga, namakhulu kakhulu; sabona khona nabo bonkhe bantfu baka-Enaki.
Amaleki ahlala eNtshonalanga, ne-Heti, ne-Jebusi, ne-Amori ahlala emhlabatsini, ne-Kananani ahlala eduze kwelwandle kanye nakweJordane."
Kalebe waletsa labantfu kutsi bangabi nenkinga naMosesi, watsi: "Thintsi sifike siyithathe lelizwe, ngobe singeke sikwazi lihlasela."
Batsi lamadoda afike naye: "Singeke sikwazi kuhlasela laba bantu, ngobe banamandla kunethu."
Baye bakhuluma ngemhlaba labawuhlolile, bethi kubo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli: "Lomhlaba siwuhlolile udla labo abahlala kuwo; nalabo bonke abantu besibabona khona bangamakhulu kakhulu."
Siyawubona khona nalabamnyama, labangani baka-Enaki, labavela kulabo bamhlophe; sitawuba nabo njengetingulube, sitawuba nabo njengabo.' "
Lobusuku bonke ibandla lonke lakhipha umsindo, laba bantu balile.
Batsi bonke bantfu ba-Israyeli bakhuluma ngaMosesi na-Aron, batsi kubo: "Singeke siphile ezweni leMijiphu, noma siphele kulomhlabatsini lo.
"Nake yini Simakadze atawutifaka kulelizwe, kutsi sifa emkhosini? Emavi ethu nezingane zethu kumele tithathwe njengetibondza. Angeke kube kuhle yini ukuba sibuye eMisri?"
Batsi: "Thintsi sikhethe umholi, sibuye e-Egypte."
Musa na-Aron bahlaba ibuso babo emhlabatsini, phambi kwalo lonke libandla lelivelekile lalabaSirayeli.
NaJoshua unyana waNun, naKalebe unyana waJefune, lababili labazange babone lelizwe, balahla ingubo yabo.
Bakhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, batsi: "Lelizwe lesihleli kulo, lelihlanganisiwe, yilizwe lelihle kakhulu.
Uma uSimakadze ethandana nathi, utawutifaka kulelizwe, utawulinikela kuthi, ilizwe lelivuthayo lobisi nemvubelo.
Kuye, ningabi nenkinga naSimakadze, nize ningeke nikhathazeke ngebantfu belizwe leli; ngobe sitawubadla njengalenyama. Ukuthula kwabo kuphelile, kodvwa Simakadze ukhona nathi; ningabi nenkinga nabo.
Lakho bonke bantfu bakhuluma kutsi bangababulala ngemlilo, kodvwa ingcwele kaSimakadze yabonakala etentini lekuhlangana kubo bonkhe bantfu base-Israyeli.
USimakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Kuyaphi isikhathi lapho lemindeni iyawungiphazamisa khona, naphezu kwekungeyikholwa kimi? Naphezu kwezinto zonke eziphawulekayo lozange ngizenza phakathi kwabo.
Ngitawubabulala ngendlala, ngiyawuwafisha; wena ngitakwenza ube yinhlanga lelikhulu kakhulu, nenamandla kunale.
Musa watsi kuSimakadze, utsi: "Bami-Egipta bayawukubona lokhu; ngobe wena utawukhipha labantfu emazweni abo ngemandla akho.

Baya kukhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu labahlala kulelizwe; bakholwa kutsi wena, Simakadze, uphakathi kwalaba bantu, bese ubabona ngamehlo akho namehlo abo, nefu lakho likhona phezu kwabo, nawe uhamba phambi kwawo emkhosini wemlilo ngelilanga kanye nemthende lemvula ngebusuku.
Uma ubulala laba bantu bonke ngasinye, khona-ke lamazwe atawutsi, lapho ekhuluma ngalo usizi lwakho, utsi:
ngobe Simakadze angeke abe nekhono lokuwufaka lomndeni kulomhlaba lowo, labewawutawuwunikela kubo, watsi: "Wababulala esigabeni setfu."
Ngako-ke, Simakadze, ngikucela, khombisa kutsi unamandla akho akhulu kakhulu, njengobe watsi:

"Simakadze ungumtfubi wendlala, ukhulule inhlonipho yakhe; unciphisa ubugebengu nekuphazamisa, kepha angeke amshiye longcolile engekho emthethweni. Uyewulahla umonakalo wabazali kubo bonkhe bantfu kuze kube ngumnyaka wesithathu nawasesihlanu.
Nceda, lisabalalise lokubi kwalaba bantu, ngobe kukhulu lekuthula kwakho, njengobe usabalalise kubo kusukela lapho baphuma khona eMijiphu kuze kube manje.
Simakadze watsi kuye: "Ngikukhulule, njengoba utsi.
Ngako-ke, sengiphila kimi, nemhlaba wonke utawugcwaliswa ngukuthula kweSimakadze, nguNkulunkulu wakho;
muntfu lomunye wabo angeke abone lelizwe, ngobe babone ukuthula kwami, nezimpawu zami labengingazenza eMisre naleso siphepho; kodvwa bamitfutsa iminyaka lengemashumi lamane, bangamlalela.
Asekho kubo lokubona lemhlaba labengingayeki kutsi ngiwubona, lapho ngakhuluma khona kubabundza babo; nabo bonke labo labangiphazamisa, bangayibona.
"Lakho-ke mkhonzi wami Kalebu, lowo unemoya owodwa, ngobe wahlala engilandela nge Chikhati sakhe, ngaye ngitawumufaka ezweni lakhe layawulivakashela, netfu lakhe liyawulithola njengelifa.
ngobe Amaleki na-Kanana bahlala emigwaqeni; buyelani kusasa, nihambe nifike esigabeni semhlabatsini, ngendlela yelwandle lwesiSundu.
Simakadze watsi kuMosi na-Aron:
"Kungakapheli yini kutsi ngibe nenkinga nalebandla lelibi, leligcotshwa ngami? Ngitsi: "Ngikulalela lokugcotshwe ngumndeni waSirayeli ngami.
"Ngitsi kubo: Ngekuphila kwami, kushoo Simakadze, ngaso sonke simo semazwi enu aphuma emilonyeni yami, ngiyawukwenza.

Lamehlo enu, namaso akho, nemilenze yenu kumele iphele kulolu mhlabatsini. Nabo bonkhe bantfu lababhaliswe phakathi kwenu abaneminyaka engama-20 ubudala kanye nabo bonke labo baphuma kuleyominyaka lelishumi elinambili kuya kweyishumi nesishiyagalolunye, labaphikisa ngami,
Ningeke nifike ezweni lapho ngitsi: 'Ngitakusishiya khona,' ngaphandle kwaKalebe unyana waJefune neJoshua unyana waNun.
Nitsi: 'Labantwana bakho bayawuboshwa;' kodvwa ngitawubakhipha, bangayidla lemhlaba lowutsi niwuphumile.
Nakwenu, titfunywa tenu tiyawugwaca kulomhlabatsini.
Labantwana benu bayawuhamba bahlala esigabeni setfu iminyaka lemashumi mane, baphindze bahlupheke ngenxa yenkohlakalo yenu, kuze kube kuphele ticubu zenu kulesigabeni setfu.
lilanga ngalinye leminyaka lemashumi lamane, lapho niyihlolisisa khona lelizwe, litawuba ngumnyaka lomunye; iminyaka lemashumi lamane niyawugqoka inkohliso yenu, ukuze nibone indlela yami enini.
Ngiye Simakadze, lokhulumayo; ngiyakwenza njalo kulolu hlanga lonke lokubi, leluboshwa ngami; kuleso siphepho bazophelela, bese bafa lapha."
Bafike babuyela, labamadoda aMosesi abewathumela kutsi ahlolisise lelizwe, wabeka libandla lonke elingcolisa kuye, bekhuluma ngalelizwe ngebubi.
Laba bantu lababisele lelizwe, bahlaselwa ngubhubhiso, bafa phambi kwaSimakadze.
Joshuwa, umsa waNun, naKalebe, umsa waJefune, bahlala bephila kubo bonkhe bantfu lababehleli ezweni labo lokuyihlolisisa.
UMosese wakhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli amazwi aSimakadze, kodvwa labaSirayeli bahlupheka.
Bavuka baphuma ekuseni, bafika enhloko yemhlabatsini, batsi: "Sifile; hlala lapha, sizohamba siye endaweni lapho Simakadze abesithi ikhona."
Musa watsi: "Ngubani na loyawuphazamisa umyalo waSimakadze? Lomsebenzi ungeke uphumelele.
Mna-ke ningahamba, ngobe Simakadze angeke abe phakathi kwenu; ngobe niyawugwanywa phambi kwa usizi wenu.
Ba-Amaleki nalaba-Kananani bakhona lapha phambi kwenu, bese nigwaca emkhosini; ngobe niyawubuyela emuva kutsi ningawulandzela Simakadze, yena angeke abe nani.
Baye bahamba nabo, bafike befika esiphelweni semhlabatsini; kodvwa Musa nebhokisi lesivumelwane saSimakadze alikhuphukeli ekamelweni.
Baphuma khona laba-Amaleki nalaba-Kananani, labahlala kulolu mhlabatsini, bahlasela, bababulala kuze kufike eHorma.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
Utsi kubo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli: Uma nifika ezweni labengingabanikela ngalo, niyawuhlala kulo;

uma ninikela ngeminikelo yekushiswa kuSimakadze, kusuka ekudlaneni kwenu kanye nemindeni yenu; kube yimnikelo wekushiswa noma ibe ngumnikelo wesono, kutsi nifeze nandza yenu, noma kube yisibopho senu, noma kube yimikhosi yenu, njengephunga lelihle kuSimakadze.

Nalowo lanikela ngemnikelo wakhe, kumele afike abe nemnikelo wesono kuSimakadze, umnikelo wema-ephah lamakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ema-ephah esiliva, lohlanganisene nema-ephah lamakhulu lasitfupha egolide.
Nalenyama leyinye yemnikelo wekushiswa, noma yemnikelo wesono, kufanele ulungiselele nelitji lelinye lewayini njengemnikelo wekudla.
Nase-orebhini, utawulungiselela imnikelo wesono lofana nekhilogremu lemibili yefulawa ehlanzekile encibilikisiwe ngelitha lelinye nesihlanu lemafutha;
kanye nemnikelo wekushiswa wewayini, likhulu elinamaphesenti lamakhulu lasitfupha elitha; kube yiphunga lelihle kuSimakadze.
Uma ulungiselela inkunzi yengulube ibe ngumnikelo wekushiswa, noma ibe ngumnikelo wesono, kutsi ugcwalise nandza yakho, noma ube ngumnikelo wesondlo sekuthula kuSimakadze,
kanye nengulube, utawunikela ngemnikelo wesono, umsindvo lesasingemagremu lamakhulu lamabili kuya kumakhulu lasitfupha esiliva, elinamakhilogremu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu emafutha.
kanye nelitha lesihlanu sewayini njengemnikelo wekushiswa; ngumnikelo wesono, umphunga lonomsoco kuSimakadze.
Lokho kufanele kwenzeke kulowo mkhwenyana, nelowo mdlovukazi, nelowo mntwana wengulube noma wembudzi.
Sebenzisa lokhu kunoma yinye lenyama, kungakhathaliseki kutsi incane yini.
Lokho kumele akwenze wonke lowo lozalwa kulomhlaba, lapho enikela khona ngemnikelo wekushiswa wephunga lelihle kuSimakadze.

"Nasekungeke kube khona umkhwenyana lohlala nawe, noma nanoma ngubani lohlala nawe emave edlulele, uma enikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa wephunga lelihle kuSimakadze; njengobe niyakwenza niyawuyenza naye.

Kuyawuba khona mthetho owodwa emindenini yenu, nani nalabo bangaphandle labahlala nabo; lomtsetfo kumele ube ngumnikelo wesono kuwo wonke lamasiko enu. Lomuntfu wangaphandle niwo kanye nawe phambi kwaSimakadze.
Lemiyalo kanye naleyo mithetho ikhona nani, nalowo mhlali lohlala phakathi kwenu.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
"Ukhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli, utsi kubo: Uma nifika ezweni lapho ngiyawunifaka khona,
bese nidla kudla kwelelizwe, nitawubeka kuso kutsi kube yimnikelo wesono kuSimakadze.
Lokuqala kwekudla kwakho, utawunikela ngaso mnikelo wesono. Uyawunikela ngalo mnikelo wesono, njengobe umnikelo wesono lowunikela ngembewu yemhlabatsini.
Ngelilanga lesikhombisa nitawunikela kuSimakadze ngemnikelo loshiswayo, kutsi ube ngumnikelo wesono, kusukela ekuqaleni kwekudla kwenu.
Natsi-ke, uma nidlwengula, ngobe ningeke nigcine noma yini kuleyo miyalo leSimakadze abekhuluma ngayo kuMosi,
ngaso sonke sinqumo Simakadze lakusho kuwe ngesandla saMosesi, kusukela kuleso sikhatsi lapho Nkulunkulu abekhuluma khona nawe, kuze kube sekupheleni.

""Nakuba ibandla lonke likwenze ngaloko, ngaphandle kwekuti lingazi, khona-ke litawunikela ngenkunzi yengulube eyodwa ibe ngumnikelo wekushiswa, ngephunga lelimnandi kuSimakadze, kanye nesondlo sayo sekudla, nesondlo sayo sokudla lokushisayo, njengobe kusho umthetho; nalowo mkhwenyana abe ngumnikelo wesono.
Waye umnikelo wakhe wesono, nesondlo sakhe sakusihlwa, nalowo umkhonzi abe ngumnikelo wekushiswa kubo bonkhe bantfu besive seSirayeli; kube yiminikelo yabo yekuboshwa kuSimakadze ngenxa yesona.
Lakho kuyawukhululwa kulo lonke ibandla lalabaLevi, nalowo mhlali lohlala phakathi kwabo; ngobe bonke bantfu baphikisane nabo.
""Uma umuntu ephelelwa ngudlavuza, kufanele atsatse ingulube yemnyaka munye kutsi ibe yimnikelo wesono.
Waye umnikelo wekushiswa utawubekwa phambi kwaSimakadze, kutsi kube ngumnikelo wesono, umnikelo wesono lokukhululwa kuwo; umnikelo wesono lokudla, umnikelo wesono lokukhululwa kuwo.
Lolu mthetho utawutsi kulowo nalowo lobe wazalwa eSirayeli, noma ngabe ungumhlali waseSiyoni, nome ngabe ungumhlali wekwa-Israyeli.
"Lakho nalowo muntu lobe ephelelwe ngumoya, abe ngumSirayeli noma kube ngumhlali wasemhlaba, uma ephazamisa uSimakadze, lowo muntu kumele ahlukaniswe nebantfu bakhe.
Wayikhohlisa imvumo yaSimakadze, wayiphula imiyalo yakhe; lowo muntu kumele ahlukaniswe; inkohliso yakhe ihlale kuye.
Bekuba bantfu beSirayeli bakhona emhlabatsinio, kwafunwa umfana lophuma ekudlaleni ngelilanga leSabhati.
Batsi labo babemuthola eqoqa imithi, bafike bamletha kuMosese na-Aron, kanye nemindeni yabo.
Wabeka ngaphansi kwengcindezi, ngobe bekungeke kucaciswe kutsi kumele kwenziwe yini kuye.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Lomuntfu kumele abulawa; ibandla lonke kufanele ligweme ngemlilo phandle kwekhampasi."
Lakho bonkhe bantfu baphuma bemukhipha ngaphandle kwekhampasi, bamwisa ematshe, wafa, njengobe Simakadze abewisela Musa.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
"Ukhulume nalabaSirayeli, ufike ubabutshele kutsi: 'Ningeke nibe nemivimbo emincane emafasiteleni emicabango yenu, ngentambo lemnyama-lemnyama emvinzini wemivimbo yenu.

Nalo kumele libe pakhwele lenu, nilibone, niyicabangele yonke imiyalo yaSimakadze, niyigcine; ngobe ningase nihambe ngentamo yenhliziyo yenu nasenhliziyweni yenu, noma ngemehlo enhliziyweni yenu, ngaleyo ndlela niyawuphazamisa.
Niyawukhumbula, nitawulandzela tonkhe timiso tami, nibe bangcwele kuNkulunkulu wenu.
Ngiye Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, lowawutfusa ezweni le-Egypt, kutsi abe nguNkulunkulu wenu; ngiye Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu.
Nakho Korha, umsa wa-Izhari, umsa wa-Kehati, umsa waLevi, naDathani naAbironi, bantfu ba-Eliab, nabo-On, umsa wa-Pelethi, labahlala eRhubeni, bafike naye.
Bafike bahlasela uMosese, kanye namadodana lamakhulu mambili nemashumi lamabili nesihlanu eSirayeli, abaholi abadume kakhulu, abeboshwa ngumphakathi.
Bahlangana naboMosesi na-Aron, batsi kubo: "Nifikeni phezulu kakhulu; ibandla lonke lingcwele, bonke bangcwele, uSimakadze ukhona nabo; kungani nihlala kubantfu bakaNkulunkulu?"
UMosese, lapho akubona khona, wehla ngebuso bakhe phansi emhlaba.

Wathi kuKhohathi nakubo bonke abahamba naye: "Ngokuhlwa nguNkulunkulu utawukhombisa lowo ofuna kuye, nome longcwele; lowo utawumuvumela ukuba afike kuye; lowo ayawukhetha utawumuvumela ukuthi afike kuye.
Lokho kufanele nikwenze, wena nalabaphikisayo bakho, Kora; landzelani tibhaka-bhaka.
Namuhla nitawubeka kuwo umlilo nefutsi phambi kuSimakadze, ngobe lowo Nkulunkulu labewukhethile, yena angeke abe ngungcwele; kodvwa nine, niLevi, ningazange nihambe kude kakhulu.
Musa wakhuluma kuKora, watsi: "Site, niLevi!

"Ngabe akuncane kuwe kutsi uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, wahlukanise nisemphakathini wakhe, watsi nifike kuye, nize nisebenzele ethempelini laNkulunkulu, nihlale phambi kwebandla, nibambisene nabo?
"Uye utfumele wena kanye nalabo bonkhe bantfu bakho, labaLevi; ngobe nifuna kutsi nibe baLevi nabo!
Kulungile, wena kanye nebantfu bakho bonke nihlangane naSimakadze; ngobe u-Aron ungubani, kutsi ningamuphikisa yena?
Mosese wathumela wayabiza uDathani naAbironi, bantfu labatvori ba-Eliabhi; kodvwa batsi: "Asikufikeni!
Lincane yini lesi, kutsi utfumele sisuka ezweni lelifuthelana nemmbila, utsi utfume nathi emfuleni lomnyama, bese uphindze ube ngunkhosi yethu?
Utsi: "Akekho nalowo utawutifaka ezweni lelivuthayo ummbila nejusi, nome utawutinika imifulasondza nemishado kutsi siyigcine. Ucabanga yini kutsi utawubakhohlisa laba bantu? Singeke sifike!"
Mosesi wehla emlonyeni wakhe, watsi kuSimakadze: "Ungavumeli mnikelo wabo ufike kuwe; sengitawutsi ngiwuthathe ngisho nedosi lalinye kubo, noma ngiwubise namunye wabo."
UMosi watsi kuKora: "Thina nebantfu bakho bonke nifikeni phambi kwaSimakadze, wena nabo, kanye no-Aron, kusasa.
Nithatheni lomunye nalowo isipho sakhe, nifake kuso sicinyo, nizifikele phambi kwaSimakadze, tisipho tamakhulu lasitfupha namashumi lamabili nesihlanu; nawe na-Aron nifikele tisipho tenu.
Batsi baphindze bakhipha isandla sabo, babeka emacwecwe abo emlilo kuwo, bafaka khona umnikelo wesono, bahlala emgwaqeni wetente lekuhlangana, naboMosese na-Aron.
Korha wahlangana nabo bonkhe labaholi bakhe emgwaqeni wetenti lekuhlangana; khona-ke kukhanya kweSimakadze kwabonakala kuwo wonke lomndeni.
Simakadze watsi kuMosi na-Aron:
Hamba usuka kulabo bantu, ngobe ngitawubabulala ngaleso sikhatsi.
Musa na-Aron bahlabela buso babo emhlabatsini, batsi: "Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wemaphuphu laso sonke lesiphilayo, ngabe umuntu lomunye uyawuphazamisa libandla lonke?
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosesi watsi:
Watsi Simakadze kuMosi: "Ukhulume nebandla, usithi: 'Thumelani ngaphandle kwendlu yaKora, naDathani naAbironi.'
Musa waphuma, waya kuDathani naAbironi; nebaholi beSirayeli bahamba ngemuva kwakhe.
Waletsa ibandla, watsi: "Thumelani emigwaqweni yalaba bantu lababi, ningeke nicubhulele noma yini leyayibo, ukuze ningabi nenkinga ngazo zonke izigebengu zabo."
Basuka baphuma endlwini yaKora, naDathani, naAbironi; Datani naAbironi babephuma behlala emgwaqeni wetente labo, nabomadodana abo, nemadvodzana abo, nemadvodzakati abo.
UMosese watsi: Ngalento nitawuzi ukuthi nguSimakadze loyawumithumela, kutsi ngikwenze lezi zinto zonke, ngobe angeke ngikwenze ngesandla sami.
Uma laba bantu bafa ngekufa kwabo, njengobe bafa bonke bantfu, Simakadze angeke amtfumele.

Uma-ke uSimakadze esenza sinqumo esisha, kutsi itfu lemhlaba livule, libe liwudla nabo kanye nezinto tonkhe letibakhona, baphume bephila emgodini wokufa; khona-ke nitawuzi ukuthi lamadoda lawa ayawuphazamisa Nkulunkulu.
Batsi bafike bakhuluma ngaleso sicondza, ngobe imhlaba wawudlwengula ngaphansi kwabo.
mhlaba wawuvuleka, wawabulala bona nemindeni yabo, nalabo bonke labengabakho eKora, nabo bonkhe lababo.
Baphuma baphila, nabo bonke labo babenabo, besuka eShebhoni; imhlaba wabawuvala phezu kwabo, basuswa emiphakathini yebantfu.
Nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, lababahlala nabo, balalela ingoma yabo, babaleka, batsi: "Lemhlaba utawutsi utfusa nathi."
Kusuka kuSimakadze kwaphuma umoya, wehlisa lamadodana lamakhulu lamabili namashumi mahlanu anikela ngefutsi.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
Utsi ku-Eleazari, unyana wa-Aron, umLevi, kutsi athathe tibhaka-bhaka kusuka emlilweni, abete emacwecwe emlilo; ngobe tibhaka-bhaka tingcwele.

Lamandla lalabo madoda abeke engozini impilo yabo, uyawuwabeka emacwecwe, utawuwabeka phezu kwe altare; ngobe babekwe phambi kwaSimakadze, bangcwele, bangaba ngubufakazi kubo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli."

U-Eleazari, umLevi, wahlanganisa tibhaka-bhaka tesiliva nelibomvu, labo labagcwale lababoshwe, wabeka emacwecwe egolide kuwo, wabeka emacwecwe esiliva kanye nemacwecwe esiliva, wabeka emacwecwe esiliva kanye nemacwecwe esiliva.

Waba ngubufakazi kubo bonkhe bantfu base-Israyeli, kutsi angeke kube khona noma ngubani, ngaphandle kwemadvodzana a-Aron, lofika ekusinikela ngenkabi phambi kwaSimakadze, ukuze angabi njengeKore nemindeni yakhe; njengobe Simakadze abekhuluma ku-Eleazari ngesandla saMosi.
Kwatsi ngelilanga lesitsatfu, libandla lonke lalabaSirayeli lakhalala kuMosi na-Aron, besithi: "Niye lowabulala abantu bakaSimakadze."
Batsi bahlangana nabo bonkhe bantfu labani naMosi na-Aron, babuyela etentini lekuhlangana; ngobe Chikhwele sitawulifihla, nebukhosi bakaSimakadze buvela.
Musa na-Aron bafike phambi kwetenti lekuhlangana, batsi:
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
Batsi: "Thumelani emiphakathini yalaba bantu, ngobe ngitawubabhubhisa ngaleso sikhathi."Baye bakhonta ngebuso babo phansi.

UMosesi watsi ku-Aron: "Thiba insipho yakho, ufake kuwo umphunga wesitezi semlilo, ubeke kuyo insipho, uye engqungqutheleni, ube ngumnikelo wekushiswa kubo; ngobe buhlungu benkhosi buphuma, nendlala iqale."
U-Aron wakwenza njengobe uMosi abekhuluma kuye, watsi: "Ngisho naleso sifo sengiqale kutsi sibe khona phakathi kwebantfu." Wabeka iphunga lelifutfume ebusweni bakhe, wabalungisa.
Wahlala phakathi kwabafileyo nalabo baphilayo, lilanga lesifo lalisa.
Labafa ngalolubhubhiso labengama-14, ngaphandle kwalabo labafile ngenxa yaKora.
U-Aron wabuyela kuMosesi emgwaqenio tetente lekuhlangana, ngobe isifo saso siphelile.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
Utsi: "Chaza lamadvodza ase-Israyeli, uthathe kubo isandla esisodwa ngasinye senkhosi, kutsi kube ngumnikelo wesono; ubhale amagama abo esandla sawo.
Nasetinhlamvuni taLevi ubhale igama la-Aron; tinhlamvu titawuba ngayinye ngenhloko yebantfu, kutsi kube khona tinhlamvu letindzala.
Utawutibeka etentini lekuhlangana, phambi kwebhokisi lesivumelwano, lapho ngizohlangana khona nawe.
Lomuntu longeke ngiwukhethe, isandla sakhe sitawukhipha tingulube; ngaleso sikhathi ngiyawumisa kutfunywa kwemadvodzana a-Israyeli kuwe.
Wakhuluma ke Mosi kubo-Israyeli, nabaholi babo bamunikela ngesandla esisodwa ngaso sonke sentshonalanga yabo; isandla se-Aron sabe siphakathi kwabo.
Mozesi wabeka tintambo phambi kwaSimakadze, etentini lemtsetfo.
UMoses wafika endlwini yesivumelwano, wabona ukuthi imbewu yeAron, leyayihlala kumndeni kaLevi, yakhula; ikhulela, yavula izimbali, yakhula imbewu ye-almonds.
Mosese wakhipha tonkhe titfunywa phambi kwaSimakadze, wabakhombisa bantfu baka-Israyeli; batsi: "Baye bakubona, bese bethatha lomkhuluwa ngamnye itfunya lakhe.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Vula sandla sa-Aron phambi kwebhokisi lesivumelwano, ligcine khona libe ngubufakazi kubo bonkhe bantfu lababusile, ukuze bagweme lokubi kwabo ngami, bangafa."
Mosese wakwenza njengobe Simakadze abemwisile.
Batsi bantfu baka-Israyeli kuMosesi: "Sitafa, siphelelwe, siphelelwe sonke.
Wonke lowo lofika etentini lengcwele kaSimakadze, uyafa; yini natsi siyawufa?'

USimakadze watsi ku-Aron: "Wena, nemadvodzana akho, nemndeni wakwa-Aron, nitawuba nesibopho sokuhlukunyezwa kwendlu yasengcwele; wena kanye namadvodzakati akho nitawuba nesibopho sokuhlukumezeka kwemisebenzi yenu yekuba baholi bebandla.
Ufike ubambe nabo labangani bakho, isizwe saLevi, isizukulwana soyise wakho, basebenze nawe; bahlangane nawe, basebenze nawe, wena nemadvodzana akho nisebenzeni phambi kwetenti lemtsetfo.
Labo bangase basebenze kuwe, bagcine umsebenti wetenti lonke; kodvwa bangase bafike emathuluzi engcweleni nasenhliziyweni, kutsi bangafa nabo nine.
Bafike bahlangane nawe, bagcine inkonzo yetenti lekuhlangana, basebenzela kuyo yonke imisebenzi yayo; ngobe angeke kube khona mnye longena kuwe.
Nawe utawugcina isikhundla sendawo lengcwele kanye nesihlalo somlilo, kutsi kungeke kube khona ukungcola kwami ebantwini beSirayeli.
Nami ngitawubakhipha bazalwane benu, labaLevi, emiphakathini yalabaSirayeli; bayawube ngumnikelo wesono lokunikezwayo kuSimakadze, kutsi basebenze etentini lekuhlangana.

"Yebo, wena kanye nemadvodzana akho ningeke ningaphazamisi iminikelo yekushiswa yendlu yaSimakadze, noma yini lephathelene naletithende letingcwele, nome into engaphansi kwetafula lokudlidliza. Nginesibopho senkonzo yenu yasekubhikishani; kodvwa lowo lofika esibhedlela kumele abulawa."

USimakadze watsi ku-Aron: "Ngikubeke wena ngasekudla kwami, ngaso sonke isive lesingcwele semadvodzana a-Israyeli, lokungingcwele kimi; ngikuleta kuwe kanye nabenina bakho njengelungelo lakho kuze kube sekupheleni, ngoba ukhonjwe.

Lolu hlelo luya kuwe, kusuka kuzinto letingcwele kakhulu, lezingafunwa ngemlilo: yonke imfuyo yabo, kanye neminikelo yaso yesono, nemnikelo wesono, nemnikelo wekushiswa, laba ngumnikelo longcwele kakhulu wena nabanabo.
Lokudla lokungcwele kakhulu lokufanele ukule; wonke lamadoda angawadla; ube ngumnikelo wesono.

Lolu mnikelo uyawuwu pakisela wena, kanye nemadvodzana akho namadvodzakati akho; ngumthetho wakho lohlala njalo. Wonke lowo ohlanzekile emndenini wako angawadla la ma-alfabhethi alowo mkhonto wenkhosi yakho.
Naleyo mafutha e-olive, newayini lelibomvu, nembewu, lokudla kwasekuqaleni lokutfunywa kwabo, labo labanikela kuSimakadze, ngiyawukunika wena.
Lamandla lakuqala emhlaba wabo, labo labanikela kuSimakadze, kumele abe akho; wonke lowo longcwele emndenini wakho angawadla.
Lonke lelive lase-Israyeli, lelihlanganisiwe kuSimakadze, liyawube lakho.

Wonke lowo utawube nguwe, lowo wesifazane wemuntu kanye nalowo wesifazane senyama, loyawunikela kuSimakadze; kodvwa lowo wesifazane wesilisa, nome lowo sesifazane senyama lesingabi nephunga, kumele ube nguwo wena.
Nase beneminyaka yemnyaka mncane, babuye bathengiswe ngemali yabo, ngeshekeli lesiliva lelishumi nesihlanu, kutsi kube ngumnikelo wesondlo sendlu yasengcwele.

Kuye kutsi lomnyaka wesifazane wengulube, noma wemvu, noma wembudzi, ungawubuyiseli; kube ngumnikelo wekushiswa. 21Lomnyaka wesifazane wengulube, noma wemfucuza, noma wembudzi, ngeke uwubuyele kuwo, ngobe lungcwele.
Lenyama yabo iyawuba yakho, kanye nemphimbo yemnikelo wesono kanye nemilenze yesobunxele ibe yako.

Nawo wonke lamandla aphakeme, ezinto letingcwele, labo bantfu bakaSirayeli labanikela kuSimakadze, ngiwunike wena, nabangane bakho, namadvodzana akho, namadvodzakati akho, njengelungelo lakho lokumilisela kuze kube sekupheleni; ngumnikelo wesono lohlala isikhathi eside phambi kwaSimakadze, umkhonto wokuhlala, kuwe kanye nemindeni yakho.
USimakadze watsi ku-Aron: "Ungeke ube nemhlaba eSirayeli, nawe ungeke ube nengxenye phakathi kwalabo bantu; ngiyabe yinxalenyeso yakho kanye nelifa lakho emiphakathini yabaLevi.
Nami ngitawubanika labaLevi ingxenye yesikhombisa yaso sonke lesiphilako eSirayeli, ibe yitfunyo yabo, njengentfwasabelo yemsebenti wabo wetenti lekuhlangana.
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli angeke afike etentini lekuhlangana, kutsi bangabi nesono, baphile.

BaLevi kuphela labafanele umsebenti wetenti lekuhlangana, nabo baphindze babe nesibopho saleyo ndlu. Kuye kube ngumthetho lohlala njalo emindenini yenu, kuze bangabi nanoma yisiphi isikweletu semaLevi phakathi kwalabaSirayeli.

Nase-Israyeli utawunikela ngaleyo minikelo yekushiswa, naleyo mnikelo wesono, kanye naleyo mnikelo wekushiswa, kutsi ibe yitfu laLevi; ngobe ngitsi: Bangeke babenelikhaya phakathi kwabantfu be-Israyeli.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
"Uyawukhuluma kuLevi, utsi kubo: 'Uma nithola ema-decimes lamadvodza aseSirayeli, lokudla lokuphekwa ngesandla, lelinye lama-decime lalowo ma-decime kumele linikezwe nguSimakadze.'
Lomnikelo wakho utawukwenta kutsi ube ngukudla lokusuka emhlabatsini, noma umhluzi losuka emgodini.

Ngendlela lenjalo nitawunikela ngemnikelo wesono kuSimakadze, kusuka kuwo wonke lamashumi lasikhombisa alowo mnikelo wesono labewuthola kubo-ke bantfu beSirayeli; niyawunikela nguAron, umpristi, lomnikelo wesono kuSimakadze.
Kusuka kuwo wonke lamahlombe akho, utawunikela ngeleyo ngxenye lengcwele kakhulu, ibe ngumahlombe akhe.
Utsi kuLevi: Uma ninikela ngento engcono kakhulu, neleyo yinye iphindze ikhokhwe kuwe njengento lephuma emgodini wekudla kanye nento lephuma emgodini wemavini.
Ningeke niyidle kuphi naphi, nine nemindeni yenu; yimali yenu yemsebenti wenu etentini lekuhlangana.
Uma unikela ngento engcono kakhulu, ngeke ube nebubi ngalo; kodvwa ungabi nesono ngezinto letingcwele tamakhosikazi aseSirayeli, ngobe utawufa.
Simakadze watsi kuMosi na-Aron:
Lowo ngumthetho lowo Simakadze abewisela wona, watsi: Ukhuluma kubo-Israyeli kutsi bafike kuwe nenyosi lemnyama, lencane, yinye, ingabi nemfudlana, ingeke ibe nenkinga kuyo, ingeke ibe nejubane.
Uyawuyinikela ku-Eleazarhi, umLevi; kumele aphume ngaphandle kwekhampasi, umnikelo wekushiswa kufanele abe ngaphansi kwakhe.
Eleazari, umLevi, kumele athathe legazi ngesandla sakhe, alisetshendze lilanga lesitsatfu ebusweni betenti lekuhlangana.
Lenyosi kumele icutshwe ebusweni bakhe; sikhumba sayo, nemfuyo yayo, negazi layo, naletiphatsimandla layo kufanele ticutshwe.
umnikelo wekushiswa kufanele athathe isihlahla sesedvo, ne-ysop, nesiliva lelibomvu, atawutifaka emlilo lapho inkunzi yengulube iphuma khona.
"Lomuntfu kumele ahlanze iingubo zakhe, abe nesikhumba sakhe singcolile kuze kube sebusuku, bese efika emgwaqeni, ngobe umnikelo wakhe wesono ungcolile kuze kube semini.
Nalowo layawuyishiswa, kumele ahlamba ingubo yakhe, abe nesikhumba sakhe singcolile kuze kube sebusuku.
Umuntfu longcwele kumele ahlanganise umhlabathi walenyoni, awubeke ngaphandle kwekhampasi endaweni lengcwele; kufanele ugcinwe emphakathini waseSirayeli, abe ngumanti lokuhlanza: imnikelo wekushiswa.
Nalowo lokhipha inkungu yakhe, kumele ahlanze iingubo zakhe, abe nenkinga kuze kube sebusuku; le mithetho ibe ngumthetho webantfu beSirayeli, kanye nalabo bangaphandle labahlala nabo.
Wonke lowo utawubi nelilanga lesitsatfu angeke abe nekuthula, ngobe umsebenti wakhe uyaphela.

"Lomuntfu kumele ahlanzwe ngamanzi ngelilanga lesithathu, nome ngelilanga lesisikhombisa, bese ehlanzekile; kepha uma angeke ahlanzwe ngelilanga lesithathu, noma ngelilanga lesisihlanu, ngeke abe nephunga.

Nalowo nalowo lowucophelela umuntu ofile, angeke ahlanze isikhumba sakhe; lowo muntfu utawucinywa ema-Israyeli, ngobe umnikelo wekushiswa awutsiswe phezu kwakhe; yena ungcolile, ukungcola kwakhe kuhlala kuye.
Lokho ngumthetho, uma umuntu efa etentini: Wonke lowo uphuma etentini, nalowo lokhona etentini, kumele abe nelilanga lesitsatfu angeke angcolile.
Nayinye inhlama levulekile, lengeke ibe nemgoqo wayo, itawubi nephunga.
Naye nalowo loyawudlidliza, emhlabatsini, lowo labulawa ngesandla, noma lowo afile ngaso, noma ithambo lemuntu, noma intaba, ungeke abe nekuthula iminyaka lesikhombisa.
"Lomuntfu longcolile utawumisa inkungu yemnikelo wekushiswa wesono emgodini, wageza ngawo amanzi laphumayo.

"Umuntfu longcwele kumele athathe isifonyo se-ysop, amise emanzini lawo, afafaze letenti, nanoma yini elingene kulo, nalabo labakhona; kanye nalomunye lowo utawufafaza noma yimfuyo yemuntu, noma umfileyo, noma umdlovukazi, noma isibhedlela.

Lomuntfu longcwele utawuwufafaza lowo muntfu longcolile ngelilanga lesithathu, nelilanga lesisikhombisa; ngelilanga lesitsatfu utawumuhlanza. Lomuntfu longcwele uyawuhlamba tigqoko zakhe, wageza isikhumba sakhe ngamanzi, bese enyangeni yekucala abe semusha.

"Naye lowo muntu lobe sewubi, angeke ahlanzeke; lowo muntu uyawususwa emphakathini wakhe, ngobe wahlambalaza indawo lengcwele kaSimakadze; lilanga lekutsi lihlanjisiwe lingeke lafafazwa phezu kwakhe; uyabi.
Lomuntfu lowufafaza amanzi ekubuyiselweni kufanele ahlanze tigqoko zakhe; nalowo lowo ucophelela emanzini ehlukaniswa, kumele abe nenkingabiro kuze kube sebusuku.
Nanoma yini lapho lowo longakabi nemavi afike khona kuyo, iyaba yinhle; nalowo lafika khona kuyo, kumele abe nemveni kuze kube ekuseni.
Bafika esigabeni setfu saCini, inyanga yokuqala, bonke bantfu ba-Israyeli, bahlala eKadeshi; khona kwashona uMiriyamu, wabanjwa khona.
Bekungaba khona amanzi emindenini yabo, bahlangana naboMosesi na-Aron.
Batsi: "Ngabe singeke safa lapho labazalwane batfunywa khona phambi kwaSimakadze!
Ngubani na lowabeka ibandla laSimakadze kulomhlabatsini, kutsi sife lapha, nathi nenyama yethu?

Nitsi: 'Ngubani na lowatfumisa eMisre, kutsi afike sifike kulendawo lebi kakhulu, lapho kungabikho khona umnikelo wesono, kungabikho khona umnqumo, kungabikho khona iwayini, kungabikho khona imifino, kungabikho khona amanzi lokudlela?'
Waphuma ke uMosi na-Aron emphakathini, wafika emgwaqeni wetenti lekuhlangana, waba nemilenze yakhe emhlabatsini, wabonakala kubo ukuthula kweSimakadze.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:

"Thintela isandla sakho, uhlanganise libandla wena na-Aron mzalwane wakho; bese nikhuluma lodonga phambi kwabo, libe nemanti ayo aphuma kuyo. Nitawukhipha amanzi kulodonga, kutsi lihlanganiso kanye nemfuyo yawo baphuze."
UMosese watsi: "Ngubani na lowo muntfu longeke abe ngumnikelo wesono kuSimakadze, njengobe Simakadze abemwisile?
Musa na-Aron bahlangana nabo bonkhe bantfu phambi kwemlilo, watsi kubo: "Thingini, nibugebengu; ngabe sitawubakhipha yini amanzi kulemlilo?"
Musa waphakamisa isandla sakhe, wehla mlilo ngesandla sakhe kabili; kwaphuma amanzi lamakhulu kakhulu, baphuza inhlanganiso kanye nemfuyo yabo.
USimakadze watsi kuMosesi na-Aron: "Ngobe ningakholwa kimi, kutsi nimihle phambi kwalabaSirayeli, ngakho-ke ningeke ningenise lelibandla kulomhlaba lapho ngiyawubanikela khona."
Lamanzi lawa lakunguMeriba, lapho bantfu base-Israyeli bekhuluma khona kuSimakadze, watsi kubo: "UNkulunkulu ungcwele."
Mosesi wathumela labaholi eKadeshi kunkhosi yase-Edomu, watsi: "Uyise wakho uSirayeli uthi: 'Wena niyazi zonke izinkinga letitfunyelwe nathi.
batsi: "Bababa bethu bakhuphuka bafika eMisri, sahlala khona iminyaka leminingi; kodvwa labaMishithi batfumisa kakhulu nathi nababa babo.
Siye sacela kuSimakadze, watsi: "Ngubani nalowo lokhuluma nami?" Akazange aphendule; wayalela indvodzakati yakhe, wayikhipha ema-Egypti. Namuhla sihlala eKadeshi, emgwaqeni waseGibhithe.

Sivumele, sihambe ngemhlaba wakho; asiyawuhamba ngemifula yakho, noma ngetivini zakho, sitawudla namanzi emifuleni yakho. Siyawuhlala phandle kwendlela yasebukhosini, singayihleli ngakwesokudla noma ngakwesobunxele, kuze sidlule ezweni lakho.
Edomu waphendvula watsi: "Ungeke udlule lapha; ngobe uma udlula, sitawuphuma sikuhlasela ngesandla sethu."
Batsi kubo: "Siyawuhlala eduze kwendlela; uma sidla amanzi akho, mina noma tingulube zethu, sitawutikhokha; singahamba nje ngenyawo letfu."
Edomu yatsi kuye: "Ungeke uhambe ngaleyo ndlela." Ngako-ke Edomu waphuma waya kubo, naye abe nemkhosi omkhulu nemkhulu.
Edomu akazange avumele laSirayeli kutsi bahambe ngemhlaba wabo, kodvwa laSirayeli wabuyela emuva.
Basuka eKadeshi, bafika emfuleni iHori, bonkhe bantfu base-Israyeli.
Simakadze wabakhuluma kuMosi na-Aron, emfuleni iHori, emphemeni weEdomu, watsi:
Aron uyawufa, ahlangane nebantfu bakhe; ngeke afike ezweni lengingabanikela kulo bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli, ngobe niyenzile lokubi emkhondweni wami lapho kwadlalwa khona amanzi eMeriba.
Lala Aharon ne-Eleazar, umsa wakhe, ufike emfuleni iHor.
Tsuse iingubo ta-Aron, wabeka ku-Eleazaru, umsa wakhe, aze aphele khona, abe nebantfu bakhe."
Mosesi wakwenza njengobe Simakadze abemwisele kutsi akwenze; bafike benyuka förstångeni leHori, emlonyeni wema-Israyeli.
Mosesi wehlisa tigqoko ta-Aron, wazisa ku-Eleazaru, unyana wakhe; na-Aron wafa khona phezu komfula. Musa ne-Eleazaru baphuma emfuleni baphuma.
Batsi bakubona bonke bantfu kutsi uAron ubefile, batsi: "U-Aron ufile!" Baye bamsola u-Aron iminyaka lemashumi lamane.
Watsi lapho ubukhosi be-Arad, bokwaKananani, labahlala eNtshonalanga, beva kutsi bantfu baseSirayeli bafika ngendlela ye-Atarim, wahlasela lamakhosi aseSirayeli, wababulala.
Ngako-ke iSirayeli yanikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze, yatsi: "Uma usiyalela laba bantu esandla sethu, sitawuvala imijikelo yabo.
UNkulunkulu waphendula lamazwi laSirayeli, wabanikela ngabanye baseKanana; babulala bonke, nabo bonkhe bantfu bemijikelo yabo. Ngako-ke kwabizwa igama lelikhona ngokuthi Horma.
Basuka baphuma emfuleni i-Hori, behamba ngendlela yelwandle lwesibhakabhaka, kutsi babuyele ezweni laseEdomu; kodvwa lamakhosi akazange akhululeke ekuhambeni.
Bakhuluma ngaNkulunkulu naMosesi, batsi: "Ngubani na lowatfumisa eMisri, kutsi sife kulemhlabatsini? Akukho kudlasotsi, asikho amanzi, futhi sifuna kakhulu lekudla lokubi!"
Ngako-ke uSimakadze watsi kulabo bantu: "Nidle lilanga letfu, ngobe linyenti lamakhosikazi aseSirayeli lafile.
Ebenela la ebantwini, bafike kuMosesi, batsi: "Sifile, ngobe sakhuluma kuSimakadze kanye nawe; thandaza kuSimakadze, uhambe nalo mhlambi wetingulube." UMosi wathandaza kubo.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Yenza imphimbo yenyoka, uyibeke emgodini; ngobe lowo lodlwengulayo uma ebheka kuyo, uyaphila."
Mozesi watsi: "Yiba nenyoka yesiliva, uyibeke emgodini; uma umuntu egwazelwa ngunyoka, abhekane nenyoka yesiliva, waphila."
Lamadvodza lasuka e-Israyeli ahamba, wahlala e-Obhothi.
Basuka eObhothi, bamisa tindlu tabo e-Iye-Abarim, entaba-mlilo esigodlweni esibhekene neMoabi, lapho lilanga liphuma khona.
Besuka khona, bamisa tindlu tabo eGiliyadi-Zeredhi.
Besuka khona, bamisa esiteji ngaphesheya komfula i-Arnon, emhlabatsini, lapho ufika khona ezweni lalabo base-Amori; Arnon ngumhlabatsini phakathi neMoabi ne-Amori.
Ngako-ke kubhalwe encwadini yemibhikisho yaSimakadze kutsi: "Wahebi waseSupha, kanye netibopho teArnon,
kanye nemhlabatsine wemifula, lofinyelela e-Ar, kanye nemhlabatsine waMoabi esigodlweni saseMoabi.
Besuka khona befika eBeeri, lapho Simakadze abekhuluma khona kuMosi, watsi: "Susa labantfu, ngitawubanika amanzi."
Watsi uSirayeli wehlalela lokudlalwa loku, watsi: "Hlabela, intaba! Hlabela ngalo!
Batsi: "Kule ndlu, kuleyo ndzawo lengcwelengcwele, lapho labakhulu bebantfu bafaka khona isandla sabo kanye nesandla senkhosi yabo." Basuka eGibhithe bafika eMatana.
kusuka eMatana kuya eNahalieli, bese kusuka eNahalieli waya eBamoti.
Besuka eBamoti bahamba befika efulethini laseMoabi, lapho phezulu kwePisga libhekene neJordani.
Israele wathumela labaholi kuSihoni, ukumkani wema-Amori, watsi:
"Sivumele sihambe ngemhlaba wakho. Singeke sifike etindzaweni noma emavini, siphindze siphuze amanzi emifuleni. Siyawuhlala eKing's Highway kuze sidlule ngemhlaba wakho."

Sihoni akazange avumele laSirayeli kutsi bahambe ngemhlaba wakhe, kodvwa wahlanganisa lonke luhlanga lwakhe, waphuma waya emfuleni waseGibhithe, wabambisana naSirayeli, waya eJahazi, wahlasela Sirayeli.
Israyeli yayawubulala ngekulwa, yaba nemhlaba wakhe kusuka eMfula i-Arnon kuya eMfuleni i-Yabok, kuze kube yilapho lamadvodza ase-Ammon afika khona; ngobe umkhawulo wemadvodzana a-Ammon ubewuqinile.
Israyeli yakhipha tonkhe tinhloko-dolobha te-Amori, yahlala kuwo, nayo yonke iHeshboni nemindeni yayo.
ngobe iHeshboni yayiyidolobha laSihoni, ukumkani wema-Amori, loyawuhlasela umphathi wangaphambili weMoabi, waba nemhlaba wakhe wonke kuze kube ngu Arnon.
Ngako-ke lababhali bakhuluma bati, "Nifikeni eHeshboni; umsebenti waSihoni kumele ukhonjwe, kufanele ube mkhulu kakhulu.
Batsi: "Umlilo uphuma eHeshboni, umfula usuka emzini kaSihoni; watfusa i-Ar yaseMoabi, kanye nalabo abasemaphandleni ase-Arnon.
Ube ubuhlungu kuwe, Moabu! Uphelile wena, Nkulunkulu wa-Kemoshi! Washiya lamadodana akhe ahambe, namakhosikazi akhe abe ngumnikelo wekushiswa kuSihoni, ukumkani we-Amori.
kodvwa sitawubabulala; Heshboni iyawushiswa kuze kufike eDiboni, neNofa kuze kufike eMedebha, sitawubabulala nabo.
Ngako-ke iSirayeli yahlala ezweni lalabo base-Amori.
Mosesi wathumela kutsi bahlolisise iJazeri, batsi: "LabaSirayeli batfusa ema-Amori labahlala khona, bahlasela emabhishi ayo.
Babuyela baphuma behamba ngendlela yeBashan; waphuma naOg, ukumkani weBashan, yena nebantfu bakhe bonke, wabahlasela eEdrei.
