Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Ungamkholeli; ngobe ngitawumunikela kuwe, yena nebantfu bakhe bonke kanye nelizwe lakhe; uyawukwenza kuye njengobe wakwenza kuSihoni, ukumkani wema-Amori, lohlala eHeshboni."
Bembulala yena, nemadvodzana akhe, nemkhosi wakhe wonke, ngobe akazange amshiye lophilayo; bayawuhlala ezweni lakhe.
Basuka bahamba, batsi: "Sitamele emahlanjeni eMowabi, ngaseJordane, enkambeni yeJerikho."
Balaki, umsa wa-Siporu, watsi: "Ngibona tonkhe tive ta-Isirayeli tiyawubatsatsa laMamori.
LakwaMoabi kwatsi: "Kunebantfu labakhulu kakhulu labaseSirayeli, nalabasemaMoabhi bahlupheka kakhulu ngenxa yalabo baseSirayeli.

Batsi baMowabi batsi kubaholi beMidiyani: "Lebandla lizodla zonke izinto letisecaleni lethu, njengobe inkomo idla imifino yasemhlabatsini." Balaki, unyana kaSiporu, waba ngukumkani weMoabi ngalolusuku.

Wathumela, wabiza Balaamu, unyana kaBeori, waya ePethori, ensimini yakhe yasemndenini wakhe, lahlala ngaseMfuleni i-Euphrates; Balaki watsi: "Ngibona lihlanga lelikhulu liphuma eMijiphu, lingene phezu kwemhlaba wonke, libe lihlala eduze kwami.

Namuhla, ngiyakucela, hlangana nami, ubulale lomndeni lowo; ngobe unamandla kunami; kungase kube khona lapho ngitawuwubulala khona, ngiwukhuphule ezweni lenu; ngobe ngiyazi kutsi lowo wena uyawubulelisa, uyabuleliswa, nome lowo wena uyawubulela, uyalanywa.
Basuka khona labakhulu baMoabi nalabakhulu beMidiyani, babe nemali yembukiso emlenzeni wabo; bafika kuBalamu, batsi kuye amazwi aBalaka.
Watsi kubo Balaamu: "Thumelani lapha ekuseni, ngitakulethela impendulo yenu, noma yini leSimakadze angeke amphendule." Bahlala khona labaholi beMoabi.
Simakadze wafika kuBalaamu, watsi: "Baphi laba bantu abakho nawe?"
Balaamu watsi kuSimakadze: "Balaka, umsa waSiporu, ukumkani weMoabi, utfumele kuye, watsi:
"Lihlanga liphuma eMijiphu, nalo ligcwele buso bemhlaba; bese uyawufika ungawuphazamisa ngesandla sakho; kungase ngibe sengikwazi kukulwa nabo, ngibaise baphume."
Simakadze watsi kuBalaamu: "Ungeke uhambe nabo; ungabalama balimi labo, ngobe linyenti lelibalekelayo."
Balamu wavuka emini, watsi kubobaholi ba-Balaka: "Thumelani ezweni lenu, ngoba uSimakadze akafuni kutsi ngivumeleke ukuba ngihambe nani."
Babuyela kuBalaka, batsi: "Balamu akafuni kutsi afike nathi."
Balaki wathumela labanye bomkhuluwa, labaningi kunabo bakhulu kunalabo bangaphambili.
Bafika kuBalamu, batsi kuye: "Kuye kube njalo njengoba Balaki, unyana waSiporu, esho kutsi: 'Asikuvumeleki lutho lokukuvimbela ekufikeni kwami.
Ngitawukunikela ngemandla amakhulu kakhulu, ngitakwenza konkhe lokusho kwakho; fike, ngiyakucela, ubulale kubo bonkhe bantfu.'
Balaamu waphendula watsi: "Nakuba Balaki anganginikela ngendlu yakhe legcwele isiliva negolide, ngingeke ngiyiphula imvumo kaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wami, ngiyenze yini, inkulu nancane.
Namuhla, hlalani lapha ngalebusuku, ngobe nabo bahlala khona; ngi förstånge kutsi uSimakadze ukhuluma yini nami.
ANkulunkulu wafika kuBalaamu ngebusuku, watsi kuye: "Uma laba bantu befike bakutsela wena, hlala nabo; kepha yini lengingakukhuluma ngayo, uyenze."
Balaamu wavuka ekuseni, wehlisa ibhutsi lakhe, wahamba nabaholi beMoabi.
UNkulunkulu wagwema, ngobe wayehamba; khona-ke umkhonzi waSimakadze wehla endlelani, watsi: "Lakho kungenxa yendlela yakhe; yena uBhileham ubesebutsheni bakhe, nabangani bakhe bobabili babe naye."
Yabona ibhutsi lihlala endlelani, libe nesandla sayo sesiliva, yaphuma yesuka endlelani yafika ensimini; kodvwa Balaamu wayibulala, wayalela ukuba ibuyele endleleni.
Watsi ngalelo langa, angeluSimakadze wahlala enhliziyweni yendlela lebushelelezi phakathi kwetingcotfo tewayini letimbili; kwakungudonga kwelinye laleyo ndawo kanye nelongalelinye.
Ledoli libone indvodzakati yaSimakadze, latsi: "Ngubani na lowo umkhwenyana?" Latsi: "NginguBhenjamini," waphendvula, watsi: "NguNkulunkulu."
Watsi umkhonzi waSimakadze ehamba phambili, wahlala endaweni lencane, lapho kungeke kube khona indawo yekujika kwesokudla noma kwesobunxele.
Ledoli lakubona umkhonzi waSimakadze, lahlala phansi ngaphansi kweBalamu; kodvwa yena waba nendlala, wayibulala ledoli ngentambo.
Simakadze watsi: "Ledoli likhulume, ledoli latsi kuBalamu: 'Ngubani na longingakwenzile wena, kutsi ungibulala emaviki amathathu lawa?'"
Balaamu watsi kusemkhwenyaneni: "Ungibusise; uma ngibe nesiliva esandla sami, ngingakubulala namuhla."
Watsi umkhwenyana kuBalamu: "Ngingeke ngibe ngumkhwenyane wakho, lowuyawuhamba kuwo kuze kufike ngalolusuku? Ngakwenza yini lokhu kuwe ngaphambilini?" Akazange aphendule, watsi: "Akukho."
USimakadze wavula amehlo ka-Balamu, watsi: "Ubone umkhonzi waNkulunkulu ehlala enhliziyweni yendlela, nesandla sakhe sisemandleni akhe; uBalamu wehlisa ibuso bakhe phansi."
Watsi kuye angelu-Israyeli: "Ngubani na lowushayayo inkunzi yakho emaviki lamashumi lamane? Ngiye ngafika ngikuvale indlela, ngobe indlela leyakho ilungile emehlo ami.

Ledoli liyawungibona, liyawuhamba lilanga lesithathu lisuka lapha nami; uma lingabi lihambe lilanga lesithathu lisuka lapha nami, ngibe sengikubulala wena kuze kube manje, ngobe ngingeke ngiyishiye iphila.
Balaamu watsi kumuntfu waNkulunkulu: "Ngibe sengihluphekile; angizange ngikwazi ukuthi uhlala endlelani, ungeke ungivumele; kephasoti, uma kungakuhle kuwe, ngizobuyela ekhaya lami."
Watsi angeluSimakadze kuBalamu, watsi: "Hamba nelaba bantu; kepha lokho longeke ngikusho kuwe, wena utawukhuluma." UBalamu wahamba nabaholi beBalaka.
Balaki, lapho akubona ukuthi Balaamu ufika, waphuma waya kumyalela eMoabini, lapho kungena khona umfula i-Arnon, enkundleni yemhlaba wakhe.
Balaki watsi kuBalamu: "Ngibe sengikulethela incwadi ngikutsalele kutsi ufike, kodvwa kungani ungazange ufike kum? Ngingeke yini ngikukhokhele kahle?"
Balaamu waphendula watsi kuBalaka: "Namuhla ngifike kuwe; kepha, ngabe ngingeke ngikhulume yini? LoNkulunkulu lowubeka emlonyeni wami, ngiyakukhuluma."
Balaamu wahamba naBalaka waya eKiriyathi-Husothi.
Balaki wanikela ngenkomo nengulube, wabanika naBalamu kanye nebaholi labakhona naye.
Balaka waphuma ebusuku, waba neBalamu, waya eBamothi-ba-Abhaali, lapho kuphakeme khona ku-Abhaali; watsi: "Ngakho-ke uBalamu angabona ema-Israyeli.
Balaamu watsi kuBalaka: "Gcwalisa lapha ema-altari lasikhombisa, ulungiselele kutsi kube nengulube leyisishiyagalombili kanye nemkhwenyana lesishiyagalombili."
Balaki wakwenza njengobe Balaamu akusho, wanikela ngengulube kanye nemvu ngayinye ema-altari.

Balaamu watsi kuBalaka: "Thinda lapha eduze kwesondlo sakho sokudla lokushiswayo, ngobe ngizohamba; kungase kube nguSimakadze loyawuhlangana nami, nome yini lengingayibona ngaye, ngiyakutshela." Waphuma ke wafika esiphelweni senduli.
ANkulunkulu wahlangana naBalaamu; Balaamu watsi kuye: "Lama-altari lasikhombisa ngiwalungiselele, nganikela ngengulube kanye nemvu kulowo ma-altari.
USimakadze watsi: "Bhalakamu, buyela kuBalaka, bese ukhuluma njalo-ke."
Balaamu wabuyela, wabona Balaki ehlala eduze kwemnikelo wakhe wesono, naye nabo bonkhe bantfu baseMoabi.
Balaamu wakhuluma, watsi: "Balaka ungisitsatsela kusuka e-Aram; ukumkani waseMowabi usisitsatsele kusuka emadolobheni asenyakatho. Uthi: 'Thina, zulazula kuYakobi; thina, zulazula kuSirayeli.'
Ngubani na longeke ngiwulama lowo Nkulunkulu akazange amlame? Ngubani na longeke ngikhulume nalo Simakadze akazange akhulume ngalo?
Ngaphesheya kwetintaba-mlilo ngibabona, ngasemagcekeni ngibabheka; bangabantu labahlala emaphandleni, bangeke bacabange kutsi bangabanye labaholi bebantfu.
Uphi loyawubala lamakhosikazi aYakobi? Bangaba nenani lelikhulu kakhulu; uphi loyawubala isihlanu senkhosi yaseSirayeli? Nami ngafa njengelabo labalungile, nami ngiphele njengabo.
Balaki watsi kuBalamu: "Ngubani na lowakwenza kimi, lapho ngikutsatsela khona kutsi ubulale bobubi bami, kodvwa wena usabalalisa!"
Balaamu waphendula watsi: "Ngingeke yini ngigcine ngikhuluma loNkulunkulu atawumisa emlomo wami?"
Balaki watsi kuye: "Nceda, fike nami esinye isitembu lapho ungababona khona; kepha ungeke ubabone bonke, kepha utawubabona ingxenye yabo kuphela; bese uyawubalama lapha.
Balaka watsi kuye: "Thina-ke sifike emhlabatsini saseZophim, esiphelweni sePisga; wakha ema-altari lasikhombisa, wanikela ngengulube kanye nemvu kulowo ma-altari.
Balaamu watsi kuBalaka: "Thiba lapha eduze kwemnikelo wakho wesono, ngobe ngitahlangana naSimakadze khona."
Simakadze wahlangana naBalaamu, wabeka impendulo emlonyeni wakhe, watsi: "Buyela kuBalaka, ukhulume njalo-ke."
Balaamu wabuyela, wabona Balaki ehlala eduze kwemnikelo wakhe wesono kanye nabaholi beMoabi; Balaki watsi kuye: "UNkulunkulu utsi yini?"
Balaamu wakhuluma, watsi: "Thinda, Balaki, ulalele; lalela, wena sonke sengumntwana weSiporhi.
Nkulunkulu angeke abe ngumuntu, angeke abe ngumntu, angeke abe ngumuntu, angeke abe nenkinga. Ingabe u Chikhangeli ukhuluma, kodvwa akawuphumeli? Ingabe ukhuluma, kodvwa akawuphumeleli?
Ngitsi: "Ngibekelwe kutsi ngibulele; Nkulunkulu ubulelele, ngobe angingeke ngibuyele."
Akhe athole lutho lokubi kuYakobi, nakwebona lutho lokubi eSirayeli. Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wabo, ukhona nabo; bamemezela kuye kutsi nguMbuso wabo.
UNkulunkulu wabakhipha e-Egypt, Wabanika amandla afana nengulube yemhlabatsi.
Angeke kube khona lokushoko kuYakobi, naloko kuSirayeli; ngobe batawuti kuJakobho neSirayeli: "Bonani loku Nkulunkulu akwenze!"
Beka, labantfu baphuma njengalelinyoni, bavuka njengelinyoni; bangakhululeki kuze baphuze lokudla kwabo, baphuze gazi labo lababulalayo."
Balaki watsi kuBalamu: "Uma utawubalama, ungababusisi; kepha uma utawubabatisa, ungababusisi."
Balaamu waphendula watsi kuBalaka: "Ngakuphendvula ngitsi: 'Ngubani na lowo Simakadze lakhuluma naye, kumele ngiwugcine?'"
Balaki watsi kuBalamu: "Thiba, ngitakwebeka endaweni lenye; kungase kube kuhle kuNkulunkulu kutsi uyawubalama ngami kusuka lapho."
Balaki watsi kuBalamu: "Thina-ke sifike esiphelweni sePeori, lesibheke eJeshimoni.
Balaamu watsi kuBalaka: "Gcwalisa lapha ema-altari lasikhombisa, ulungiselele kutsi kube nengulube leyisishiyagalombili kanye nemkhwenyana lesishiyagalombili."
Balaki wakwenza kutsi Balaamu akhulume naye, wanikela ngenkunzi yenkomo kanye nemvu ngayinye enhliziyweni.
Balamu wabona kutsi kwakulungile kuSimakadze kutsi abembisana neSirayeli, akazange ahambe efuna umqondiso, njengobe akazange akwenze ngaphambilini; wabuyela emuva, wabheka emaphandle.
Balaamu waphakamisa amehlo akhe, watsi: "Ngibona bantfu beSirayeli behlala emakhaya abo ngemindeni yabo; khona-ke umoya waNkulunkulu waba phezu kwakhe.
Wakhuluma lobufakazi bakhe, watsi: "Lobufakazi bukaBalaamu, unyana kaBeori, lobufakazi bomuntu lobona ngemehlo akhe,
lokhuluma lowo lalalela amazwi kaNkulunkulu, lobona umbono weSimakadze longuSomandla, lohlala embhedeni, abuka ngamehlo akhe.
Kuhle kakhulu tindlu takho, mndeni waYakobi! Tindlu takho, mndeni waSirayeli!
Bafike bahlukaniswa njengemifula, njengamagadi elwandle, njengobe i-aloe uSimakadze abeyikhulele, njengobe i-cedar ibe ngasemanzini.
Lamanzi ayawuphuma emabhodleni abo, nembewu yabo itawudla amanzi; umphathi wabo uzoba mkhulu kuna-Agagi, nebukhosi babo buyawuphakama.
LoNkulunkulu, lowo wabakhipha eMisri, utawuba patfu kubo njengenkunzi yemhlabatsi; bayawudla lamazwe alabo abaphikisayo; baya kucasuka emacwecwe abo, nemilenze yabo iyabaphazamisa.
Bahlala baphumula njengelishona, njengalelinyoni; ngubani lotawubavusa? Nalowo lakubambisana nawe abe ngumnikelo wesono, nalowo lakubopha wena abe ngumnikelo wesono.
Balaka wehla emlonyeni wakhe, watsi kuBhiliyamu: "Ngikubiza kutsi ulale lamacala ema Chikhati ami, kodvwa wena usabalalisa lomnyaka wesithathu!
Namuhla, phuma lapha, uye ekhaya lakho; ngobe ngitsi ngakunikela ngemali yakho, kodvwa Simakadze ubeke phansi iminikelo yako.
Balaamu watsi kuBalaka: "Ngibe sengikhuluma yini kubo bonkhe bantfu labemithumela nabo, ngitsi:
Nakuba Balaki angisinika indlu yakhe egcwele isiliva negolide, ngingawuphula umyalo waSimakadze kutsi ngikwenze kahle noma kubi ngesandla sami; lobirondelwe nguNkulunkulu kumele ndikhulume.
Namuhla ngiya kubantfu bami; hlala, ngikutshele kutsi laba bantu bangakwenza yini kubo bonkhe bantfu bakho ezikhathini letine.
Wakhuluma lobufakazi bakhe, watsi: "Lobufakazi bukaBalaamu, unyana kaBeori, lobufakazi bomuntu lobona ngemehlo akhe,
lokhuluma lowo lalalela amazwi aNkulunkulu, lowo ofuna ukwazi lokukhulu, lowo obona umbono weSimakadze, lowo ohlala embhedzeni wakhe ngemehlo akhe avulekile:

Ngiyawumubona, kepha akusekho manje; ngiyakubona, kodwa angeke abe eduze. Kusuka eJakobho kuzoba khona inkwenkwezi, nesandla sebukhosi sizo kunyuka kusuka eSirayeli; utawubulala inhloko yaMowabi, kanye nemphini yebantfu bonke baseShethi.
Edomu neSeyiri, umkhonzi wakhe, bangabi namandla, ngobe iSirayeli iya kukhululwa.
Kuyawuphuma umholi kuYakobi, lotawubulala labo labashiyelwe kulo mji."
Wabona uBhileham lasema-Amaleki, wakhuluma watsi: "Amaleki angeke abe ngumnyaka wesikhashana phakathi kwebantfu, kepha ekupheleni kwakhe kumele aphelelwe ngaso sonke isikhathi.
Wabona laKenisi, wakhuluma watsi: "Indlu yakho iphephile, njengegcongolo elihlanganisiwe ematsheni.
Lakho-ke, niyawutfunywa, nibaKeni, lapho iAshuri ikwenta kutsi niboshwe."
Wakhuluma ngalolu phawu, watsi: "Awu, ngubani longeke aphile lapho Nkulunkulu esenza lokhu?
Kuyawufikalela ema-Ashuri ne-Eberi, kuze kube kufike inqanawa e lám chebe i-Cyprus, ngobe nabo baphelelwa livi.
Balamu waphuma, wabuyela endlwini yakhe; naBalaka waya ngendlela yakhe.
Inkhosi yaseSirayeli yahlala eShitimi, lamadodana ayo ahlangana nemadvodzana aMowabi.
Lamadodana abo ayewaletsa ema-Israyeli emabhishobhi abo; lamakhosikazi abo ayawudla emabhishobhi abo, wanikela kubo.
LaSirayeli bahlangana naBaali-Peori; Simakadze wagwema kakhulu laSirayeli.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Thipha labaholi bonke bebantfu, ubulala nabo, ubandlulule kubo phambi kwaSimakadze ekuseni, ukuze indlala yekuthula kweNkulunkulu ihambe kuSirayeli."
Mosesi watsi kubavikeli beSirayeli: "Lomunye nalowo ubulala lamadodana akhe, labo abesebandlululeni kuBaali-Peori."
Kwatsi lapho Mose nemindeni yabo be Pisani, belilela emgwaqeni wetente lekuhlangana, kwafika umSirayeli, wabeka indodana ye-Midyani etentweni lakhe, wayisa phambi kwabo, watsi:
Ngako Phinehasi, umsa ka-Eleazarhi, loyise wa-Aron umLevi, akubona lokhu, watsi: "Ngubani na lowo muntfu? NguSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu."
Waphuma walandela lomuntfu waseSirayeli waya etentini, wabeka sandla sakhe kubo bobabili, kulowo muntu naleyo ndoda; khona-ke ubhubhiso lwaluphelile phakathi kwabantfu baseSirayeli.
kodvwa labamashumi lasitfupha nesihlanu lamaphesenti ebantfu bafile ngesifo.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:

Phinehasi, umsa ka-Eleazarhi, lomnyaka mncane wa-Aron umLevi, ubeke icala lami ebantwini beSirayeli; watsi: "Uphinihashise ngesandla sakhe sakubo bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu yeGibhithe, ngobe akazange anikeze livi lami kubo.
Uyawutsi kuye kutsi: "Ngiyakwenza naye umhlangano wami wekuthula."

Uya kuba ngumnikelo wesono kuye, kanye nembewu yakhe ngemuva kwakhe, kutsi abe ngumnikelo wesono kuze kube sekupheleni; ngobe wanikela ngesandla sakhe kuNkulunkulu wakhe,-ke wabalungisa bantfu bakaSirayeli.
Lomuntu wase-Israyeli lobulawa kanye nendvodza yaseMidiyani waba nguZimri, unyana kaSalu, umphathi wemndeni wakwaSimeoni.
Lendvodzakati ya-Midiyani leyawufa yayinguKozbi, indodana ka-Tsuri, owayengumholi wemndeni wakwa-Midiyani.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
Uphindze wakhuluma kubo, watsi: "Beka ba-Midyani njengabahlaseli bakho, bese uhlasela.

Bathi: "Lemiphiko lenu, niyigcine kanjani inhlonipho yenu, lapho benukela khona ku-Baali wePeori, nakwe-Kozbi, intombi yomphathi waseMidiyani, umshado wabo, owabulawa ngosuku lwesifo ngenxa ye-Peori?"
Simakadze watsi kuMosi na-Eleazari, umsa wa-Aron, umLevi, ngemuva kwesifo lesibulalayo, watsi:
"Linganisa lonke ibandla lakwa-Israyeli ngemindeni yabo; linani labo labaneminyaka lemashumi lamabili nesikhombisa nangaphezulu, bonkhe bantfu base-Israyeli bangaphuma ekulwa.
Mosese na-Elezazare, umLevi, bakhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu emhlabatsini weMoabi, ngaseJordane, enkabeni yeJerikho, batsi:
Balala bonke labesifazane labaneminyaka lemashumi lamabili nesikhombisa nangaphezulu, njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose. Lokho kwalabaSirayeli labaphuma eMisri:
Rubeni, umzali waSirayeli; ku-Rubeni kwafika imindeni yabo: ku-Enoki kwafika imindeni ye-Enokiti; ku-Palu kwafika imindeni ye-Paluiti;
ku-Heshroni, kumndeni wa-Heshroni; ku-Karmi, kumndeni wa-Karmi.
Lalaba bamalunga emindeni yakwaRubeni; labo lababhalwa kubo bebengabamashumi lamane namakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa, namakhulu lasitfupha nesihlanu.
Unyana waPalu waba nguEliabu.
Labantwana bakaElibha: nguNemuweli, noDathani, noAbironi. LoDathani na-Abironi bebengababaholi bebandla, labaphikisako naMosesi na-Aron, basuka emndenini waKora, lapho bephikisaka khona kuSimakadze.
mhlaba wawuvuleka, wawabulala nabo kanye na-Korahi; nemindeni yabo yafa, lapho umlilo wehlisa khona amadoda lamakhulu mahlanu namashumi lamabili nesihlanu, abe nguphawu lwesikhashana.
Lamadvodza laKora akazange aphele.
KuSimeoni kwasuka kumndeni wakwaNemueli, kumndeni waNemueli; kumndeni waYamini, kumndeni waYamini; kumndeni waJahini, kumndeni waJahini;
kusuka ku-Zera, imndeni wakwa-Zerahi; kusuka ku-Shauli, imndeni wa-Shauli.
Lalaba bamalunga emindeni yaSimeoni; labo lababhalwa kubo bebengabamashumi lamabili nembili lamakhulu mahlanu.
KuGadi kwasuka kumndeni waSefoni, kumndeni waSefoni; kuHagi, kumndeni waHagi; kuShuni, kumndeni waSuni;
kusuka ku-Ozni, mndeni wa-Ozni; kusuka ku-Eri, mndeni wa-Eri;
kusuka ku-Arod, kwesuka emndenini we-Arod; kusuka ku-Areli, kwesuka emndenini we-Areliti.
Lalaba bamalunga emndeni waGadi; labo lababhalwa kubo bekungumashumi lamane lamakhulu mane.
Lamadvodza lasitfupha aJuda, Er naOnan, wafa ezweni leKanana.
Lakwa-Juda kwasuka kuShela, kwesuka kuShelani; ku-Perezi, kwesuka ku-Perezi; ku-Zera, kwesuka ku-Zeraha.
Ku-Perezi kwasuka kumndeni wakwa-Heshroni, umndeni wakwa-Heshroni; ku-Hamuli kwasuka kumndeni wa-Hamuli.
Lokho kwakungumndeni wakwa-Juda, kanye nalabo lababhalwa kubo, kwaba ngumashumi lamane nesihlanu emakhulu mahlanu.
Ku-Issakhari kwasuka kumndeni wakwaTolao, kwaba ngumndeni wakwaTolali; ku-Puwa, kwaba kumndeni wa-Puni;
kusuka ku-Yashubi, imndeni wakwa-Yashubiti; kusuka ku-Shimroni, imindeni ye-Shimroni.
Lalaba bamalunga emindeni ye-Issakhari; labo lababhalwa kubo förståtweni yabo bebengamashumi lamane nane lamakhulu matatu.
Ku-Zabuloni: ku-Sered, ku-kwemndeni wakwa-Seredi; ku-Elon, ku-kwemndeni wakwa-Eloni; ku-Yahleeli, ku-kwemndeni wakwa-Yahleeli.
Lalaba bamalunga emindeni yeZabuloni, njengobe lababhalwa kubo bebengabamashumi lamane lamakhulu mahlanu.
Kusuka kuJosefa kwaphuma lamakhosikazi, ngalabadvuna bakhe: Manase naEfremu.
LakwaManase kwakunguMahiri, loyise wa-Gileyadi; ku-Gileyadi kwaba ngumndeni wakwa-Gileyadi.
Lolu hlobo lwemindeni yemadvodzana aGileyadi: kusuka ku-Ezeri, ku-Ezeri; kusuka ku-Heleki, ku-Heleki;
kusuka ku-Asriyeli, imndeni wakwa-Asriyeli; kusuka ku-Shekem, imndeni wakwa-Shekemi;
kusuka ku-Shemida, imndeni wakwa-Shemidayi; kusuka ku-Heferi, imndeni wa-Heferi.
Selaphehadi, umsa wa-Heferi, akazange abe nemadvodzana, kepha waba nemadvodzakati; lamagama lamadodana akhe lakunguMahala, naNoha, naHogla, naMilka, naTirsa.
Lalaba bamalunga emindeni yaManase; labo lababhalwa kubo bebengamashumi lamane nambili lamakhulu lamabili nesihlanu.
Ephrayami: ku-Suthela, ku-Suthelahi; ku-Bekheri, ku-Bekheri; ku-Tahani, ku-Tahani.
Ku-Eran, umsa wa-Sutela, kwasuka kumndeni wa-Erani.
Lokho kwakungumndeni wakwa-Ephrayi; labo lababhalwa kubo bebengaba ngumakhulu mathathu, lasitfupha, lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu. Lokho kwakuye kwaba ngumndeni waJosefa.
Benjamini: ku-Bela, kwasuka ku-Belayiti; ku-Ashbeli, ku-Ashbeliti; ku-Ahirami, ku-Ahiramiti;
kusuka ku-Shefupham, kwesuka emndenini weSufami; kusuka ku-Hupham, kwesuka emndenini weHufami.
Lakwa-Ardi naNaamani, bantfu labazalwa nguBela: ku-Ardi kwasuka ku-Arditi; ku-Naamani kwasuka ku-Naamini.
Lalaba bamalunga emindeni yaBenjamini; labo lababhalwa kubo bebengabamashumi lamane nesihlanu lamawaka lamakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa.
Lomndeni waDani: ngu-Shuham, umndeni walaba-Suhamite; labo bahlala eDanini.
Lamadodana la-Suhami, labo lababhalwa kubo, bekungumashumi lamane nesihlanu emakhulu mane.
Ku-Asere kwaba nemindeni yabo: Ku-Imnah, kwakuyimndeni wa-Imnathi; ku-Ishvi, kwakuyimndeni wa-Ishviti; ku-Beriya, kwakuyimndeni wa-Berithi.
KuBeriya kwaba nemindeni yabo: Ku-Héberi kwakunemndeni wakwa-Héberi; ku-Malkhiyeli kwakunemndeni waMalkhiyeli.
Na-Asere waba nendvodzakati, igama layo bekunguSera.
Lalaba bamalunga emindeni ye-Aseri; labo lababhalwa kubo bebengamashumi lamane namakhulu lamabili nesihlanu, lamakhulu mahlanu.
Ku-Naphtali kwasuka kumndeni wakwaJahazieli, kwaba ngumndeni waYahazeli; ku-Guni waba ngumndeni waGuni;
ku-Jezeri, mndeni wa-Jezeri; ku-Shileme, mndeni wa-Shilemi.
Lalaba ngumndeni waNeftali, nalabo lababhalwa kubo babemashumi lamane nesihlanu emakhulu mane.
Nabo bonkhe bantfu lababalowe lamadodana eSirayeli, laba ngumakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane, lamakhulu lasikhombisa namakhulu lasitfupha.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
Bahlukanise lelizwe libe ngumnikelo wesono kuleso sihlanganiso, ngenombolo yamagama labo lababhalwa.
Utawunikela ngemhlaba kulowo lomkhulu, nawe utawunikela ngemhlaba kulowo loncane; sihlanga ngasinye sitawunikela ngemhlaba kuye kutsi kube nenani lalabo lababalolwe.
Batsi: "Lemhlaba kufanele uhlukaniswe ngekushaya sihlabani; lomndeni ngamunye wemadvodzana akhe kumele athole inhlanganiso yakhe, ngokwegama lamakhosi abo.
Isigaba ngasinye sitawuhlukaniswa ngetipho phakathi kwebantfu labakhulu nelabancane.
Lolu hlobo lwemindeni yaLevi, labo lababhalwa kubo: KuGershoni kwakuyimndeni wakwaGershoni; kuKahati kwaba yimindeni yeKahati; kuMerari kwaba imindeni yeMerari.
Lolu hlobo lwemindeni yeLevi: imindeni yalabaLibni, nemindeni yelabaHebroni, nemindeni yelabaMaheliti, nemindeni yelabaMushithi, namadvodzana aKehati bekuboAmrami.
Jokhebedi, indodana ka-Amram, wazalwa nguLevi eMijiphu; wazala ku-Amram lamadodana mabinisoti lababili, uAron noMosesi, nenkosikazi yabo, uMiryami.
Aharon wadzala Nadabu, naAbihu, naEleazari, naIthamari.
Na-Nadab na-Abhihu bafa, lapho benikela kuSimakadze ngemlilo longakavumelekile.

Nabo labaLevi, labo babalwa kubo kusukela emnyakeni owodwa nangaphezulu kwaba ngumakhulu lamashumi mahlanu nesikhombisa; ngobe bebengabhaliswa phakathi kwamadvodza aseSirayeli, ngoba akazange abonwe ngemhlaba nabo.
Loba babalwa nguMosese na-Eleazari, umLevi, lapho bebala khona bantfu baseSirayeli emhlabatsini sakwaMoabi,songweni waseJordane, ngaseJerikho.
Akukho namunye walaba babalwa nguMosese na-Aron, umLevi, emhlabatsini saseSinayini.
Ngako-ke uSimakadze wakhuluma kubo, watsi: "Baya kufa efulethini lelivukile." Akazange ashiye namunye wabo, ngaphandle kwaKalebe unyana kaJefune, noJoshua unyana kaNun.

Bafike khona nezingane ta-Celofehadi, umsa wa-Heferi, umsa wa-Gileyadi, umsa wa-Mahiri, umsa waManase, emndenini waManase, unyana ka-Yusufu; lamagama labantwana bakhe: Mahla, naNoha, naHogla, naMilka, naTirsa.
Bafike bahlala phambi kwaMosesi, kanye na-Elazarhi umLevi, nebaholi nabo bonkhe bantfu, emgwaqeni wetenti lekuhlangana, batsi:
Ababa bethu bafa efulani, naye akazange abe kulowo mhlangano waseKora, labaphikisayo naSimakadze; kodwa wafa ngenxa yesono sakhe, angeke abe nemadvodzana.
Ngabe kufanele kutsi igama lababa lethu liphelelwe emndenini wakhe, ngobe angeke abe nendvodzakati? Nceda usinike mhlaba phakathi kwemindeni yababa lethu."
Mosi wabeka icala labo phambi kwaSimakadze.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi:
Lamadvodza la-Celofehadi alungile; utawubanikela ngemhlaba phakathi kwemindeni yababa babo, njengendlu yabo; utawubanikela ngemnikelo wababa babo.
Utsi kubo bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli: Uma umuntu efa, angeke abe nemntwana, nitawunikela mhlaba wakhe kundvodzakati yakhe.
Uma angeke abe nendvodzakati, utawunikela ngemhlaba wakhe kubantfu bakhe.
Uma angeke abe nabangane, utawunikela ngemhlaba wakhe kubangane bakhe.

"Uma ubaba wakhe angeke abe nemadvodzana, khona-ke nitawunikela emhlabatsini sakhe kumyeni wakhe, lowo lomkhulu kunaye kumndeni wakhe; yena ayawuyisebentisa njengendlu yakhe. Lokho kufanele kube ngumthetho kanye nemyalo kuboSirayeli, njengobe Simakadze abewisela umthetho Musa."
USimakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Suka ufike kulomhlabatsini, ema-Abarim, bese ubona lelilizwe labengisalinikela kuboSirayeli.
Nawe, uma uyibonile, utawufa nawe, uye kubantfu bakho labafileyo, njengobe u-Aron, umngane wakho, wafa.
Nakho-ke, nitsi: 'Kulungile.' ngobe labaholi bebandla bakhuluma nami emfuleni iCini, lapho beboshwa khona nguSimakadze, utsi: 21'Lawa lawa amanzi eMeriba eKadeshe, endzingweni yeCini.'
Musa watsi kuSimakadze, utsi:
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, wena uNkulunkulu lonikela ngemoya kuwo wonke laphilayo; khipha, ngiyakucela, umuntu phezu kwalo mhlangano.
labetawubakhipha emkhosini, abeyawubabuyisela ekhaya labo, kutsi bangabi njengetingulube letingeke zibe nemfuyi."
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Thipha uJoshua, umsa wa-Nun, indodana yeMoya, uyibeke ngesandla sakho phezu kwakhe.
Afike abekwe phambi kwe-Eleazari, umLevi, kanye nemindeni yabo, abe nguMengameli wabo, lomunye webantfu.
Nceda umnike isikhundla sakho, kutsi libandla lonke leSirayeli likhulume naye.'

Ase afike ebusweni ba-Elazarhi, umLevi, loyawucela umnikelo wakhe wesono kuSimakadze nge-Urim; ngaleso siphakamiso sakhe Joshua kanye nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, ibandla lonke, bangaphuma bangafika.
Mosese wakwenza njengobe Simakadze abemwisile; wathatha Joshua, wambeka phambi kwa-Eleazari, umLevi, kanye nemindeni yabo.
Wabeka isandla sakhe phezu kwakhe, wamisa abe nguMengameli wakhe, njengobe Simakadze abekhuluma ngesandla saMosesi.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
Laletsa bantfu beSirayeli, utsi: "Nceda nibheke kutsi ninganginikela ngeminikelo yami yesono ezikhathini taso, nekudla kwami lokushiswayo, njengephunga lelihle.
Utawubaphendvula utsi: Le yimnikelo wekushiswa loyawunikela wona kuSimakadze: ema-andele lamashumi lamabili eminyaka, angabi nenkinga, ngosuku ngalunye, njengesondlo somlilo esihlala njalo.
Utawunikela lilanga lelinye ngekusasa, nelinye lapho liphuma khona ilanga.
Ngelowo nalowo, nifikeni nemnikelo wesono lofana nekilogremu lelishumi nesihlanu yekudla lokuhlanganisiwe kanye nelitji lelinye lemafutha e-olive.
Lo ngumnikelo wekushiswa lohlala njalo, lowo awungcolisa eMfuleni iSinayi; yiminikelo yekushiswa yephunga lelihle kuSimakadze.
Nemnikelo wekuyi Cope, nemnikelo wekudla, utawuwunikela ngaso sonke lesinyama lám chemo; uyawuyisa kuSimakadze endaweni lengcwele.
Lomunye umhlambi utawuwunikela ngasebusuku, nemnikelo wakhe wekudla kanye nesipho sakhe sewayini, njengobe kwenziwe ngekusasa; ngumnikelo wekushiswa, ngumphunga lomnandi kuSimakadze.

Ngelilanga leSabhati utawunikela ngenkunzi yengulube yemnyaka mncane lomibili, ingabi nenkinga, kanye nemnikelo wayo wesono wesiliva likhulu elinama-elfu lokuhlanganisiwe nephethiloli, kanye nemnikelo wayo wokudla.
Lo ngumnikelo wekushiswa lilanga leSabhati, ngaphandle kwemnikelo wesono loshiwo njalo kanye neminikelo yayo yekudla.
Ngomhla wokuqala wenyanga, nitawunikela ngesondlo somlilo kuSimakadze: inkunzi yengulube lencane lemibili, nemvu leyinye, nalamba lamashumi lamabili eminyaka, angeke abe nenkinga.
kanye Ebene shteti, nikela ngemnikelo wesondlo sesiliva lomile lokuhlanganisiwe nephethro kulowo mkhwenyana; nakwelowo mkhwenyana nikela ngemnikelo wesondlo segolide lomile lokuhlanganiswe nephethro.
Nase utawunikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa, lomnikelo wesono, lomnikelo wekudla, kanye nesondlo sekudla, kanye nesondlo sekudla lesinyenti, kutsi kube ngumnikelo wesono kuSimakadze.

Nalemimnikelo wabo wekushiswa kumele kube ngu-ethini yewayini ngayinye ingulube, ne-ethini lesikhombisa ngemuntfu lomncane, ne-ethini lesikhombisa ngalinye lingane. Lo ngumnikelo wesono kumnyaka mnye.
Utawunikela ngegodzi elinye kuSimakadze njengemnikelo wesono, ngaphandle kwemnikelo wekushiswa lohlala njalo kanye neminikelo yayo yekudla.
Kumnyaka wokuqala, ngelilanga lelishumi nelinesihlanu, kuyawube ngusuku lwePasha lokungcwele kaSimakadze.
Ngomnyaka wamashumi lalishumi nesihlanu walo mnyaka, kutawufika umthendeleko; niyawudla umnikelo wekushiswa wekudla lokunge-fermented iminyaka lesikhombisa.
Lemini yekucala nitawube nekuhlangana lokungcwele; ningasebenzi msebenzi lomusha.

Ninikeze umnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze, isondlo somlilo: inkunzi yengulube lencane lemibili, nemhlambi wemvu, nembingeleli wesifazane lomnyaka munye, lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa, angeke abe nenkinga.
kanye nemnikelo wabo wekudla, umnikelo wekushiswa wefulawa lomhlophe lokuhlanganisiwe nemsinyane lomncane, kanye nemnikelo wema-shekeli lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu kulowo mkhwenyana;
Utawunikela ngesiliva lelikhulu nemashumi lamane nalinye kulowo mkhwenyana, kutsi kube ngumnikelo wesono.
Negodzi lelinye njengemnikelo wesono, kutsi kube ngumnikelo wesono kuSimakadze.
Lamandla lawa niyawuwanikela ngaphandle kwemnikelo wekushiswa wekusasa.
Lokudla lokudlalwe ngemlilo, lokunephunga lelihle kuSimakadze, kufanele ukwenze njalo ngosuku lilanga lesitsatfu, ngaphandle kwemnikelo wekushiswa lohlala njalo kanye nemnikelo wayo wesono.
Ngelilanga lesisikhombisa nitawube nekuhlangana lokungcwele; ningasebenzi nhlobo umsebenzi wemsebenti.

Ngelilanga lekucala lokuvuna, lapho ninikela khona ngemnikelo wesono lomusha kuSimakadze emthendelekweni wemaviki lasikhombisa, kufanele kube nekuhlangana lokungcwele; ningasebenzisi lutho lwemsebenzi.
bese ninikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa, timbuti letincane letintsatfu, nemvu eyodwa, naletinye tingulube letinemnyaka munye letisikhombisa, njengephunga lelimnandi kuSimakadze.
kanye nemnikelo wabo wekudla, isiliva lelihlanganisiwe nemafuta, emashumi lamabili nesihlanu ema-shekeli ngayinye inkunzi yengulube, nemakhulu lasitfupha ema-shekeli ngaye lomhlambi,
kanye nema-shekeli lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ngalinye, kulowo mkhwenyana lositfupha.
Nifikeni ninikete nalowo mkhwenyana, kutsi ugcwaliseke kuNkulunkulu.
Lamandla lawo, kanye neminikelo yawo yekudla, uyawuwanikela ngaphandle kwemnikelo wekushiswa lohlala njalo kanye nemnikelo wayo wesonka; ngeke kube khona lutho lokubi kulo.
Lenyanga yesishiyagalolunye, mhla wokuqala wemnyaka wesitsatfu nibe nekuhlangana lokungcwele; ningasebenzisi lutho lokusebenza: ngusuku lwekuphucuka kwethumbu.
Nitawunikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa, njengephunga lelimnandi kuSimakadze: inkunzi yengulube eyodwa, umkhwenyana ngamunye, nembingeleli wesifazane weminyaka lelishumi nasikhombisa, bangabi nemonakalo.
kanye nemnikelo wabo wekudla, isiliva lelihlanganisiwe nemafuta, emashumi lamabili nesihlanu ema-shekeli ngemuntfu lomncane, nemashumi lamabili nesihlanu ema-shekeli ngemuntu omncane;
kanye nema-shekeli lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ngalinye, kulowo mkhwenyana lositfupha.
Negodzi lelinye njengemnikelo wesono, kutsi kube ngumnikelo wesono kuSimakadze.

Lokudla lokushiywa ngalenyanga, nesondlo saso sekudla, kanye nesondlo sokudla lokushiywa njalo, nesondlo saso sekudla, nesondlo saso sokudla, kanye nesondlo saso sewayini, kumele kube ngumnikelo wekushiswa wephunga lelihle kuSimakadze.
Lenyanga yesikhombisa, ngelilanga lelishumi kulomnyaka wesitsatfu, kumele kube khona kuhlangana lokungcwele; kufanele niphumule, ningasebenzi lutho.
Nitawunikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze, njengephunga lelimnandi: inkunzi yengulube eyodwa, umhlambi wemvu, nemhlambi walama-andele lamakhulu lamabili nesikhombisa, angeke abe nenkinga.
kanye nemnikelo wabo wekudla, isiliva lelihlanganisiwe nemafuta, emashumi lamabili nesihlanu ema-shekeli ngemuntfu lomncane, nemashumi lamabili nesihlanu ema-shekeli ngemuntu omncane;
kanye nema-shekeli lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu ngalinye, kulowo mkhwenyana lositfupha.
kanye nemvu lesinye njengemnikelo wesono, ngaphandle kwesondlo sesono sokwenza umnikelo wesono, kanye nesondlo lesisondzayo lesihlala sikhona, nesondlo saso somhluzi, nesondlo saso semhlweni.
Lenyanga yesixhenxe, ngemnyaka wamashumi lalishumi elinesihlanu kuyoba khona kuhlangana lokungcwele; ngeke nisebenzele umsebenzi lomusha nayinye imihla lesikhombisa.

Ninikeze imnikelo wekushiswa, umnikelo wesono lowuphunga lelimnandi kuSimakadze: inkunzi yemagilebhisi lengema-13, umkhwenyane wesifazane ongu-2, nengulube yemnyaka munye engumdvuna engu-14; kungabi nankinga kuwo.

kanye nemnikelo wabo wekudla, isiliva lelihlanganisiwe nemsinyane lemfishane elihlanjululwe ngamafutha, ema-shekeli lamashumi lamabili namakhulu mabiro kulowo mhlambi wemagilebhisi lamahlanu; nema-shekeli lasitfupha egolide kulowo muntfu lomncane walabo labambili;
kanye nemsindvo lesasingemagremu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu kulowo mhlambi wema-andele.
kanye nemhlambi wema-okhi, mnikelo wesono, ngaphandle kwemnikelo wekushiswa lohlala njalo, nesondlo sayo sekudla, nesondlo sayo sokudla.

Ngelilanga lesitsatfu nitawunikela ngenkunzi yengulube lencane lama-12, nemhlambi wemvu lababini, nembingeleli wesifazane wasemnyaka mnye lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu; kumele kube khona lutho lokubi kuwo.
Nabo batawunikela ngemnikelo wabo wekudla kanye neminikelo yabo yekushiswa, kanye nengulube, nemhlambi wayo, nalabo labafileyo, kanye nalabo labafileyo, ngamanani abo, njengobe kubhalwe.
Negodzi elinye njengemnikelo wekushiswa, kanye nesondlo sayo sekudla nesondlo sayo sokudla lokushiywa.
Ngelilanga lesithathu nitawunikela ngenkunzi yengulube lelishumi nelinye, nemhlambi wetinkomo letimbili, nenkunzi yemfuyo yemnyaka wesitsatfu lelishumi nanesihlanu, sigcwele.
Nabo batawunikela ngemnikelo wabo wekudla kanye neminikelo yabo yekushiswa, kanye nengulube, nemhlambi wayo, nalabo labafileyo, kanye nalabo labafileyo, ngamanani abo, njengobe kubhalwe.
Negodzi elinye njengemnikelo wekushiswa, kanye nesondlo sayo sekudla nesondlo sayo sokudla lokushiywa.
Ngelilanga lesihlanu nitawunikela ngenkunzi yengulube lelishumi, nemhlambi wemvu lababini, nembingeleli wesifazane wesikhashana lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa, bangabi nenkinga.
Nabo batawunikela ngemnikelo wabo wekudla kanye neminikelo yabo yekushiswa, kanye nengulube, nemhlambi wayo, nalabo labafileyo, kanye nalabo labafileyo, ngamanani abo, njengobe kubhalwe.
Negodzi elinye njengemnikelo wekushiswa, kanye nesondlo sayo sekudla nesondlo sayo sokudla lokushiywa.
Ngelilanga lesihlanu nitawunikela ngenkunzi yengulube yesishiyagalombili, nemhlambi wezinkomo ezimbili, nembingeleli wesifazane wasemnyaka mnye ulishumi nelisikhombisa; bangabi nankinga.
Nabo batawunikela ngemnikelo wabo wekudla kanye neminikelo yabo yekushiswa, kanye nengulube, nemhlambi wayo, nalabo labafileyo, kanye nalabo labafileyo, ngamanani abo, njengobe kubhalwe.
Negodzi elinye njengemnikelo wekushiswa, kanye nesondlo sayo sekudla nesondlo sayo sokudla lokushiywa.
Ngelilanga lesithandathu nitawunikela ngenkunzi yengulube yesishiyagalombili, nemhlambi wezinkomo ezimbili, nembingeleli wesifazane sommnyaka munye ulishumi nesihlanu; kumele bebengabi nankinga.
Nabo batawunikela ngemnikelo wabo wekudla kanye neminikelo yabo yekushiswa, kanye nengulube, nemhlambi wayo, nalabo labafileyo, kanye nalabo labafileyo, ngamanani abo, njengobe kubhalwe.
Negodzi elinye njengemnikelo wekushiswa, kanye nesondlo sayo sekudla nesondlo sayo sokudla lokushiywa.
Ngelilanga lesisikhombisa nitawunikela ngenkunzi yengulube leyisishiyagalombili, nemhlambi wemvu lababini, nembingeleli wesifazane wemnyaka mncane lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, bangabi nankinga.
Nabo batawunikela ngemnikelo wabo wekudla kanye neminikelo yabo yekushiswa, kanye nengulube, nemhlambi wayo, nalabo labafileyo, kanye nalabo labafileyo, ngamanani abo, njengobe kubhalwe.
Negodzi elinye njengemnikelo wekushiswa, kanye nesondlo sayo sekudla nesondlo sayo sokudla lokushiywa.
Ngelilanga lesikhombisa, nihlangane ngekuhlangana lokukhethekile, kodvwa ningasebenzi kahle.
Ninikeze iminikelo yekushiswa, imnikelo wekushiswa wephunga lelimnandi kuSimakadze: inkunzi yengulube eyodwa, umkhwenyana owodwa, nama-andele emnyaka mnye lasitfupha, angeke abe necala.
Nabo batawunikela ngemnikelo wabo wekudla kanye neminikelo yabo yekushiswa, kanye nengulube, nemhlambi wayo, nalowo mkhwenyana, nalowo mkhwenyane, kanye naleyo minja, njengobe kubhalwe.
Negodzi elinye njengemnikelo wekushiswa, kanye nesondlo sayo sekudla nesondlo sayo sokudla lokushiywa.

La mazwi niyawuwanikela kuSimakadze emažeme enu, emcimbini wenu, ngaphandle kweminikelo yenu yesive, neminikelo yenu yokudla, neminikelo yenu yokushiswa, nemnikelo wenu wesonka, nemnikelo wenu wokudla, neminikelo yenu yekuthula.
Mosesi wakhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu be-Israyeli, ngaso sonke kutsi Simakadze abemwise.
Mosesi wakhuluma kubaholi bemindeni yeSirayeli, watsi: "Lele linye linye lisho kutsi Simakadze utawutsi:
Uma umuntu enikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze, noma uma enikela ngesibopho sokubambisana, angeke abusise lutho lokushiwo kwakhe; kumele akwenze konke lokusho.
Uma indodakazi ihlala emndenini wayise, ibe nemnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze, noma ibeke sandla sayo enhliziyweni,
bese ubaba wakhe ekhuluma ngalo mnikelo wakhe wesono, noma ngesinqumo sakhe, kodvwa akazange akhulume naye, khona-ke zonke timinikelo yakhe yesono, kanye nesinqumo sakhe sesono, kumele zihlale.

Nakuba ubaba wakhe akazange avumele ngalolusuku lapho akubona khona, khona-ke nasiphi na sipho sakhe noma siphi nasinye isibopho sakhe ngeke sihlale sikhona; Simakadze utawumukhulula, ngobe ubaba wakhe akazange avumele.
Uma yena ekwatiwe, emtsetfweni wakhe, noma ngemnikelo wekushiswa, nome ngemnikelo wesono, wetfulwa,
nome umyeni wakhe akubona, kodvwa emhla lapho akubona khona angeke akhulume naye, khona-ke tincwadzi tekucala titsi "tikhuluma" nome "tisebentisa" kumele tigcine.
Kodwa uma umkakhe, lapho ekhuluma khona, akusho lutho ngalolu daba lwakhe, ungeke abe nesibopho ngaleso sibopho sakhe, noma ngeso sibopho sakhe lesingeke sivumeleke; Simakadze utawumukhulula.
Nakweyiphi na imvume noma umyalo lowenziwe nguwesifazane wesilisa noma wesifazane lokwatiwe kumele ugcinwe.
Uma indodana yemuntfu lokwatiwe inikela ngemtsetfo, noma ibandlulula nguNkulunkulu ngesifungo lapho ihlala khona ekhaya lomshado wayo,
nome umkakhe akubona, kodvwa angeke akhulume naye, noma angeke agweme kuye, khona-ke zonke tincumo zakhe kanye netincumo takhe kumele tihlale.

Ngako-ke, uma umkakhe ayisavumi kuleso sikhathi lapho ekhuluma khona, khona-ke ngeke kube khona nasiphi na isipho sakhe noma nasiphi na isibopho sakhe esiphuma emlonyeni wakhe; umkakhe ayisavumi, Simakadze utawumuxolisa.
Umyeni wakhe angavumela noma avuse noma siphi siphakamiso sakhe, kanye na förstång att gå utan saker.
Ngako-ke, uma umkakhe angeke akhulume naye kuze kube lilanga lesikhombisa, yena utawuvuma zonke tincumo zakhe kanye netibopho lakhe; ngobe akazange akhulume naye ngalolusuku lapho akubona khona.
Uma eshiya lokudla ngemuva kwekuva ngawo, utawuba necala lokubi lokube waphula sivumelwano sakhe."
Lamandla laSimakadze awawuseMosesi, phakathi kwendoda nendvodza yakhe, phakathi koyise nendvodzakati yakhe lehlala ekhaya lakhe.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
"Tsuse umnikelo wesono ema-Midiyani, njengoba bakwenta kuboSirayeli; bese ufa, uhlangane nebantfu bakho."
UMosese wathi kubo: "Nceda nilungiselele lamadodana enu emphini, afike abonge ema-Midiyani, aze abe yindlala yaSimakadze kubo.
Lalela lamashumi lamakhulu ema-Israyeli kutsi afike emphilweni.
Batsi: "Kuwo wonke umhlangane weSirayeli, bahlukaniswe labalishumi elinambili labengaba ngumakhulu lamabili namashumi lamabili nesihlanu emabutfo ekulwa.
Wabathumela emphini, lamashumi lamakhulu lasitfupha emindenini yabo, naye Phinehasi, umsa wa-Eleazari, umLevi; Phinehasi athathe ngesandla sakhe impahla lengcwele, netibopho letibuyisayo.
Bahlasela ema-Midyani, njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose, babulala bonke lamadoda.

Babulala naSimakadze, ngobe akazange abonise isandla sakhe kulabo labafileyo; babulala nabo bonkhe bantfu baseMidiyani: Evi, neRekem, neTsuri, neHuri, neReba, bantfu labahlanu, kanye naBalaamu, umsa waBeori.
Lamadvodza ase-Israyeli athathe lamadodana eMidiyani kanye nalabancane, wabulala yonke imfuyo yabo, nemihlambi yabo, nempahla yabo.
Babulala ngemlilo tonkhe tidolobha te-Midyani lapho behlala khona, kanye nemindeni yabo.
Baphindze bathatha yonke lento yabo, kanye naleyo beyitfunyekile, kube ngumuntu nome usinyane.

Bafike babeka ema-Amori, nalabo baseGibhithe, nalaba baseSiriya, nalaba baseYiputa, nalaba baseGibhithe, nalaba baseAsiriya, nalaba baseMidiya, nalaba basePerizi, nalaba aseGibhithe, kanye nemindeni yabo.
Mosi, ne-Eleazari umLevi, kanye nabo bonkhe labaholi bebandla baphuma bahlangana nabo ngaphandle kwegcawu.
Mosese waphosa ema-Amori, nalabaphathi bemikhosi, nebaholi bamashumi lamakhulu, nabemakhulu lamashumi lamakhulu, lababuya emphini.
Wabaphendvula watsi: "Ngibe niyawushiya besifazane bonke bephila?
Baye laba, behamba ngemtsetfo waBalamu, babulala lamadvodza aseSirayeli ekungeneni kwabo kuSimakadze, ngaleso simo sePeor; ngobe safika lesi sifo kubo bonkhe bantfu baSimakadze.
Namuhla, bulala wonke umfana, bulala yonke indodana lehlala nemuntu.
Lakho, gcinani kuye nalowo mkhwenyana longeke abulawe ngumfana.

Nalowo nalowo labulala umuntu, nalowo nalowo afike ekufaneni naye, kufanele ahlale ngaphandle kwekhampasi iminyaka lesikhombisa; mhla wesithathu nemnyaka wesihlanu kumele ahlanzwe, yena nalabo ababoshwe nabo.
Nawo wonke umgqomo, naleyo yinye into leyenziwe ngesikhumba, nemilenze yengulube, yangaphandle, kanye nemithi, niyihlanze.
U-Eleazari, umLevi, watsi kulabo labehleli emkhosini, labahambe emphilweni: "Leli limiso lemtsetfo loSimakadze waletsa uMosi:
Dlayini, golide, silebhu, bronze, iron, tin, lead

naye nanoma yini eyawumelana nemlilo, kumele idlulele emlilweni, ibe lihlanzekile; kepha kufanele ihlale lihlanzekile ngemanti lokuhlanza. Nayinye into lengayimelana nemlilo, kumele idlulele emanzini.
Niyawuhlamba iingubo zenu ngelilanga lesitsatfu, niyawuhlanzwa, bese ningena entabeni.'
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
"Lenani labatfunywa, wena kanye na-Eleazari, umLevi, kanye nebaholi bemindeni yebantfu labahlala kulo mhlangano, bonke abantu kanye nemfuyo.
Bahlukanise ibe ingxenye lemibili elinganayo: enye yalabahlaseli labafile emkhosini kanye nesinye salabo abasemphakathini.
Kuleyo ngemaphesenti lalabo labaphuma ekulwa, utawunikela ngemnikelo kuSimakadze: lomunye kumakhulu mahlanu, noma ngabe ngumuntu, noma ngabe yingulube, noma ngabe yidoli, noma ngabe yimvu.
Lawo ma-Amori nitawuwakhipha emaphesenti abo, niyawuwanikela ku-Eleazari, umLevi, kutsi abe ngumnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze.

Kuleyo ngemaphesenti lalabaSirayeli, utawuthatha lomunye kumashumi mahlanu, kube ngumuntu, kube yingulube, ibe yidoli, ibe yimvu, ibe kulomhlambi, kube yinyama; uyawubanikela kubo-ke labaLevi, labagcina inkonzo yetenti lengcwele kaSimakadze.
Mosesi na-Eleazari, umLevi, bakwenza njengobe Simakadze abewisela Musa.
Lokudla lokushiywe kuleyo ndlu, labahlaseli bakubopha, kwakungumakhulu lamabili nemashumi lamane nesihlanu lamaphesenti etimbuti,
tingulube letimashumi lamabili nesikhombisa lamakhulu mabili,
emabhubesi lamashumi lamane nalinye lamakhulu,
kanye nemadvodza lamakhulu lamashumi lasitfupha nesikhombisa, angeke ahlangane namuntfu.
Lephesenti leliboshwe libe ngumakhulu matatu, lamashumi lasitfupha nesikhombisa lamakhulu lamabili namakhulu mahlanu ema-odini,
kanye neminikelo yekushiswa yaSimakadze yaba ngumakhulu lasitfupha, lamashumi lamabili nasihlanu.
Kube khona tingulube tamakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, kanye nemfuyo yaSimakadze ilikhulu elinasitfupha nambili.
Kube nemadlelo lamashumi lamakhulu mathathu, lamakhulu lamabili nesihlanu; iminikelo yaSimakadze usike yaba ngumashumi lamane nalinye.
Labali-16, kanye nemnikelo waSimakadze waba ngu-32.
Musa wanikela ngemnikelo wesono ku-Eleazari, umLevi, lomnikelo wekushiswa, njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose.
Lengxenye yesibili yaba yileyo yalabaSirayeli, lelinye likhulu elinamaphesenti lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, labaMosese abeyihlukanisile kusuka kulabo labaphuma ekulwa.
Laphesheya kwebandla kwakungumakhulu lasitfupha, lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa, lamakhulu mahlanu, ema-ovini,
tingulube tamakhulu lamashumi lasitfupha nesihlanu,
nemashumi lasitfupha namakhulu lamabili,
kanye nebantfu labalishumi elinesihlanu lamawaka.

Ngaleyo ngxenye yalabaSirayeli, uMosese wathatha lomunye kumakhulu lamashumi mahlanu ebantfu kanye nesilwane ngasinye, njengobe Simakadze abemwisile uMosi, wabanika labaLevi, labagcina umsebenzi wetenti lengcwele kaSimakadze.
Bafike bahlangana naMosese labaphathi bemikhosi,o Paduka bamashumi lamakhulu nemakhulu lamakhulu.
Batsi kuye: "Labo baholi bakho babala lamaphoyisa angaphansi kwesandla sethu, angeke kube nemuntu longekho.

Lakho-ke sifike sanikela kuSimakadze ngemnikelo wegolide, lolowo nalowo lawutholayo: tintambo tesandla, nemilenze yesandla, nezinhlamvu zesandla, nezingcezu zemehlo, netingcumbu, kutsi senze lokulungile phambi kwaSimakadze.
Mozesi na-Eleazari, umsa waSimakadze, batfumisa legolide kubo, bakwenza kube yimihlobiso.
Wonke lomhlabatsi wegolide, lapho abaphathi bemashumi lamakhulu nalabakhulu banikela khona ngemnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze, waba ngushekeli lama-16 nelikhulu elinamakhulu lamabili nesihlanu.
Lomunye nelinye labaholi bemikhosi labese litfunyele lomunye.
Musa na-Eleazari, umLevi, bakhipha legolide kubaholi bemakhulu nemakhulu lamakhulu, bayawulisa etentini lekuhlangana, ibe ngumbukiso waSimakadze kubo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli.
Ba-Rubeni naGadi, lababenetingulube netibondza lamakhulu kakhulu, babona kutsi iJazeri neGileyadi yindawo lekahle yetintfo letiphilayo.
Lamadvodza laGadi neRubeni afike kuMosi, na-Eleazari umLevi, nabaholi bebandla, watsi kubo:
Ataroti, neDiboni, neYazeri, neNimra, neHeshboni, neEleale, neShebham, neNebo, neBeon,
lemhlaba, loSimakadze awungcolisa ebantwini beSirayeli, ngumhlaba lolungile ngekudla kwesilwane; natsi sisebenti sakho sinesilwane esikhulu.
Batsi: "Uma ubona kulungile emehlo akho, siniketwe lelizwe labakhonzi bakho njengelifa lethu; ungasivumele sihambe ngaleyo lwandle laseJordane."
Mosi watsi kubomadvodzana aGadi nemadvodzana aRubeni: "Bonkhe labangani bakho, bantfu ba-Israyeli, bangahamba yini bokulwa, nihlalani lapha?
Ngubani na lowo longeke avumele lamadodana eSirayeli kutsi ahambe afike ezweni leSimakadze abewanikela ngalo?
Lawo lakwentako bantfu bakho, lapho ngibathumela khona kusuka eKadeshe-Barnea kutsi babone lelizwe.
Bafike bafika emfuleni i-Eshkoli, bebona lelizwe, baletsa umlomo wabaSirayeli, kutsi bangangeni kulemhlaba loSimakadze abewanikela kubo.
USimakadze wagwema ngalolusuku, watsi:

"Labo baphuma eMijiphu, labaneminyaka lemashumi lamane ubudala nangaphezulu, angeke abone lelilizwe lapho ngibembise khona ngesandla sami ku-Abrahama, ku-Isake, naku-Yakobi, ngobe bangangilandelanga ngenhliziyo yabo yonke.
Kalebe, unyana kaJefune, umKenisi, kanye noJoshua, unyana kaNun, bangayibona; ngobe balandela uSimakadze ngentliziyo yabo yonke.
USimakadze wehluleke ngeSirayeli, wabashiya behamba esigabeni setfu iminyaka lemashumi mane, kuze kube kuphele loluhlobo lonke lwebantfu lababekezelele kuye.
Namanje, bonani, niye mnyaka lomusha webantfu lababi, nihlala endaweni yababa bakho, kutsi nikhudze kakhulu uSimakadze ngeSirayeli!
Uma nibuyela emuva, ningamlandzela, yena utawushiya nabo bonke labantu kulo mhlabatsini, niyawuba yingozi kubo.'
Bafike kuye batsi: "Sifuna ukwenza lamahhashi ethu, nemindeni yethu, namadolobha ezingane zethu."
Siyawuvala isandla sethu, sitawuhamba nemadvodzana a-Israyeli, kuze kufike bafike ezweni labo; nabantwana bethu bangahlala emigwaqweni enemiganga, bephephile kusuka kubo bonkhe bantfu balomhlaba.
Singeke sibuye emindenini yethu, kuze baSirayeli babe nemhlaba wabo, wonke.
sitawungena mhlaba nabo ngasenyakatho yeJordane, ngobe sesivune mhlaba wethu lapha ngasenyakatho yeJordane.' "
Mosi wabaphendvula watsi: "Uma niyawukwenza lomsebenzi, uma nitawuzivikela emkhosini phambi kwaSimakadze,
nabo bonkhe bantfu bakho labashayelekile, badlula eJordane phambi kweSimakadze, kuze aphumelise labasolwa bakhe phambi kwakhe;
bese lelizwe libekwa ngaphansi kwesandla saSimakadze, khona-ke niyawubuyela; ngobe ningeke nibe nemsebenti wenu kuSimakadze, nakwaSirayeli; futhi leli lizwe litawuba liwe lakho phambi kwaNkulunkulu.
Ngako-ke, uma ni tettela umnikelo wesono kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, nguNkulunkulu wenu lámmo, ningeke nihambe nalowo mnikelo wesono.
Bhala lamadolobha emindenini yenu, nemahhashi enja yenu; kodvwa nikwenze lokwentako.
Lamadvodza laGadi na-Rubeni akhuluma kuMosese, watsi: "Labakhonti bakho bayawukwenza njengobe umphathi wami akusho.
Labantwana bethu, nemadvodzakati ethu, nemfuyo yethu, naleyo mihlambi yesilwane sethu siyawuhlala lapha emizini yeGileyadi.
kodvwa sitawudlula, siyawuhamba nathi bonke labakhonzi bakho, wonke laphuma emphini, ukulwa phambi kwaSimakadze, njengobe umphathi wethu akusho.
Mosese watsi kubo ku-Eleazari, umLevi, nakuJoshua, umsa waNuni, kanye nabaholi bemindeni yebantfu labaseSirayeli.

Wabaphendvula watsi: "Uma lamadodana aGadi nalamaRubeni edlula nenu eningizimu yeJordane, wonke umuntu egqoke isandla sakhe sokulwa, phambi kwaSimakadze, bese lelilizwe libekwa ngaphansi kwenu, khona-ke nitawulibanika iGiliyadi njengelifa labo.
"Lakho-ke, uma bengenako kutsi bahambe nabo ngemikhosi, kumele bathathe nenu inhlanganiso yabo yemhlaba eKanani."
Lamadvodza laGadi na-Rubeni aphendule, watsi: "Lemikhonto yakho siyawukwenza njengobe uSimakadze washo.
Siyawudlula sijiyile phambi kwaSimakadze, sifike emhlabatsini waseKanana; kepha imhlabatsini lethu kumele libe ngaleso sinye seJordane.

Wabanikela kubo, labaGadi nalabaRubeni kanye nengxenye yemndeni kaManase, unyana waJosefa, inkhosi yaSihoni, ukumkani wema-Amori, nenkhosi yaOgi, ukumkani weBashani, nayo yonke lelizwe, nemindeni yayo, nemhlaba wayo wonke.
Lamadvodzana aGadi labuye bakwakha Diboni, neAtaroti, neAroeri,
Atroti-Shofani, neYazeri, neYogbeha,
Bethi-Nimra, neBethi-Harani, njengemadolobha anemi förståss, babuye bakwakha emabhodlela engulube yabo.
Lamadvodzana aRubeni labuye bakwakha Heshboni, neEleale, neKiritayim,
Nebo, neBaale-meoni, lapho lamagama abo ashintshwe khona, naSibma; nabo babeka amagama lahlukene emifuleni yabo leyababuyele nayo.
Lamadvodza laMakhire, umsa waManase, afike eGileyadi, wayawuyihlasela, wabakhipha ema-Amori abehlala khona.
Wayinikela eGileyadi kubo-Israyeli waMahiri, unyana waManase; nabo bahlala khona.
NaYahiri, lomunye wemadvodzana aManase, wahlasela nalabasemaphandleni akhe, watsi kubo: "Lamahhashi laYahiri."
Nobha wahlasela naKenati kanye nemindeni yayo, wayisabiza ngegama lakhe, watsi Nobha.
Lolu hambo lwabaSirayeli, lapho baphuma khona eMfuleni i-Egipta, ngemikhosi yabo, ngaphansi kwesandla saMosese naAron.
Mosese wabhala, ngesandla saSimakadze, emadolobhe abo, lapho besuka khona, ngaso sonke isikhathi sekuhamba kwabo; lamadolobha labo, kusuka emhlabatsini kuya kumhlabatsini.
Basuka eRamesesi kumnyaka wesitsatfu, ngemhla lesilishumi lelinesihlanu wenyanga yokuqala, lilanga lesikhombisa ngemuva kwePasha; baphuma bekhululeke kakhulu phambi kwemehlo labantfu base-Egypt.
njengobe ema-Egipta abulala bonke labadzala babo, labo Simakadze abewahlasela; ngobe Nkulunkulu wabo wabeka icala kubo.
Baphuma basuka eRamesesi, bamisa tindlu tabo eSukoti.
Basuka eSukoti, bamisa tindlu tabo eEthame, esiphelweni setfunywa.
Basuka eEthame, babuyela ePi-Hahirothi, enkabeni yeBaale-Sephoni, bamisa tindlu takhe ngaseMigdoli.
Basuka ePi-Hahirothi, bahamba eningizimu yelwandle, befika entaba-mlilo; bahamba lilanga lesihlanu entaba-mlilo yaseEthame, bamisa tindlu tabo eMara.
Basuka emara, bafika e-Elim; khona kwabekhona imifula yamanzi le lámiambili netingcotjo letimashumi lasikhombisa; bamisa khona tindlu.
Basuka eElim, bamisa tindlu tabo elwandle lwesiSundu.
Basuka eMfuleni waseSume, bamisa tindlu tabo emfula iSin.
Basuka eGibhithe, baphuma eGibhithe, besuka eGibhithe.
Basuka eDofka, baphuma behlala eAlusi.
Basuka e-Alusi, bamisa tindlu tabo eRefidim; khona kwabe kungasekho amanzi labantfu labadla.
Basuka eRefidim, bamisa tindlu tabo emfula iSina.
Basuka eGibhithe, basuka eSinayini, bamisa phandle eKibrothi-hataava.
Basuka eKibrothi-hataava, bamisa eHaserothi.
Basuka eHaserothi, bamisa tindlu tabo eRithma.
Basuka eRithama, batsi: "SiseRimoni-Perezi."
Basuka eRimoni-perezi, bamisa tindlu tabo eLibna.
Basuka eLibna, bamisa tindlu tabo eRisa.
Basuka eRisa, bamisa tindlu tabo eKehelatha.
Basuka eKehelatha, bamisa tindlu tabo emfuleni iShefer.
Basuka eMfula i-Shepher, batsi: "SiseHarada."
Basuka eHarada, bamisa eMakhelothi.
Basuka eMakhelothi, bamisa eTahathi.
Basuka eTahati, bamisa eTeraha.
Basuka eTera, bamisa tindlu tabo eMitka.
Basuka eMithaka, baphuma behlala eHashmona.
Basuka eHashmonah, bamisa tindlu tabo eMosereth.
Basuka eMoserothi, bamisa eBene-Jaakani.
Basuka eBene-Jaakan, bamisa tindlu tabo eHore-Hagidigadi.
Basuka eHore-Hagidgadi, batsi: "SiseJotbata."
Basuka eJotbhatha, bamisa eAbronah.
Basuka eAbrona, bamisa tindlu tabo eEzion-Geber.
Basuka eEzion-geberi, bamisa tindlu tabo eKadeshi, emhlabatsini waseCini.
Basuka eKadeshi, bamisa tindlu tabo emfuleni iHori, enhliziyweni yelizwe leEdomu.
Aron, umnikelo wesono, wehla emfuleni i-Hore, nge amarekhodi kaSimakadze, wafa khona ngosuku lokuqala lwenyanga lesihlanu, ngonyaka weziketene ngemuva kwekuphuma kwaboSirayeli ezweni laseMijiphu.
Wabe uAron uneminyaka lemakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, lapho afe khona emfuleni iHori.
Wava kutsi labaSirayeli befika, uMosi, umsa wa-Aradi, umKanani, lohlala eNtshonalanga yemhlaba waseKanani.
Basuka emfuleni iHori, bamisa tindlu tabo eSalmona.
Basuka eSalmona, bamisa tindlu tabo ePunon.
Basuka ePunoni, baphuma behlala eObothi.
Basuka eObhothi, bamisa tindlu tabo eIye-Abarim, emgwaqeni weMoabi.
Basuka e-Iyim, batsi: "SiseDiboni-Gadi.
Basuka eDiboni-Gadi, bamisa eAlmoni-Diblathayini.
Basuka eAlmon-diblathaim, bamisa tindlu tabo emfuleni weAbarim, eNebo.
Besuka emadolobheni eAbarim, bamisa tindlu tabo emahlathini eMoabi, ngaseJordane, enkabeni yeJerikho.
Bahlala khona emahlathini eMoabi, ngaseJordane, kusukela eBethe-Jeshimothi kuya eAbeli-Sitimini.
USimakadze watsi kuMosese, emhlabatsini weMoabi, ngaseJordane, enkabeni yeJerikho, utsi:
"Ukhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu ba-Israyeli, utsi kubo: Uma nidlula eJordane nifike ezweni leKanana,
Niyawukhipha ebusweni bakho bonke bantfu labahlala kulomhlaba; niyawubulala zonke imifanekiso yabo yesandla, nemifanekiso yabo yegolide, naleyo mihlobiso yabo yasemadolobheni.
Niyithole lelizwe, nihlale kulo; ngobe ngiyenzile lemhlaba kutsi niwugcine.

Nihlukanise lemhlaba phakathi kwemindeni yenu ngekutsila isandla. Nceda ninike linye lelincane nelinye elikhulu, nanoma yini lapho licala khona lomndeni utawuyihlala kuyo; naniyawuhlukanisa phakathi kwemihlambi yebantfu bami.
"Lakho-ke, uma ningeke niyawukhuphula lamakhosi ezweni leli, labo nitawubashiya nabo baya kuba yimiphiko emilonyeni yenu, netinsika emaceleni enu, bese babusisa ezweni lenu lapho nihlala khona.
Nalapho ngitakwenza nawe, njengobe sengicabanga kutsi ngiyakwenza nabo.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
"Uye ukhulume nalabaSirayeli, utsi: Uma nifika ezweni leKanana, leli yilizwe lesinconywa kutsi liniketwe wena njengelifa lakho, kanye nemkhawulo wayo.
Lemikhawulo yenu yasempumalanga itawuba ngumhlabatsini waseCini, kanye nemhlabatsini waseEdomu, kuze kufike ekugcineni kwelwandle lokufile, kuze kube umkhawulo wenu wasempumalanga.
bese ubuyela emaphandleni eSkorpion Pass, wadlula eZin, wadlula emaphandleni eKadeshe-Barnea, wadlula eHasar-Adari, wadlula eAsmoni.
Kusuka e-Azmoni ibuye ifike emfuleniremfuleni, ufike emaphandleni la-Egipta, bese ifika eMfula weMedithera.
Umkhawulo wenu wasenyakatho kumele ube ngulwandle lweMedithera; lomhlaba wakho wasenyakatho kufanele ube njalo.
Ngemkhawulo wakho wentshonalanga, cindezela incopho kusuka eMfuleni iMediterranean kuya eMount Hor,
Kusuka emfuleni iHori kuya ngendlela leya eHamati, umkhawulo ufike eSedadi;
Lemikhawulo yenu iyawudlula eSiphroni, ibe nguHazari-Enani; lemikhawulo yenu yasenyakatho itawuba njalo.
Lemikhawulo yenu yasempumalanga, niyibophele kusuka eHazari-Enani kuya eShepham.
Lemikhawulo iyawuhla kusuka eShepham kuya eRibla, ngasenyakatho yeAyin; kuze kufike emadolobheni lasentshonalanga yelwandle laseGaliliya.
Lemikhawulo iyawuphuma eJordane, ibe ngulwandle lokudlwengula; lemhlaba utawuba yilizwe lenu, kanye nemikhawulo yayo yonke.' "

Mosese waletsa lamadvodza ase-Israyeli, watsi: "Leli yilizwe lenu lokufanele lihlukaniswe kutsi libe ngumnikelo wesono; Nkulunkulu wemaSirayeli wayalela ukuba linikezelwe emashumini mahlanu nesihlanu emaLevi.
Batsi: "Sizwe seRubeni, nesive seGadi, kanye nesigamu semndeni wakwaManase, batfumele mhlaba wabo.
Lemindeni lemibili nengxenye yayo yathola mhlaba wayo ngaphesheya komfula iJordane, emaphandleni eJerikho, lapho kuphuma khona umoya.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
Lemi magama labesifazane labayawukulethela ilizwe njengelifa: u-Eleazari, umLevi, neJoshua, umsa waNun.
Bakhetha nesikhulu esisodwa kusuka kuwo wonke umhlanga kutsi asize ekuhlukaniseni lemhlaba.
Lemi magama abo: Kusukundza kwe-Juda, Kalebe, umsa waJefune.
KwakwaSimeoni, nguShemuyeli, umsa wa-Amihudi.
ku-Israyeli wa-Benjamini: Elihada, umsa kaKislon.
Kusuku lweDan, umholi wakhe ube nguBukki, umsa waJogli.
Lamadvodza laJosefa: emndenini waManase, nguHananiyeli, umsa waEfodi, umholi;
kanye nenkhosi yase-Efrayim, uKemueli, umsa waShifthani.
Kusuku lweSibiya, ngu-Elisafanu, umsa wa-Farnahu;
Kusuku lwe-Issakhar: umholi Paltiyeli, umsa wa-Azzani.
ngomnyaka wasikhombisa u-Ahihu, umsa waShelomi, waba nguMengameli wemadvodzana a-Aseri.
Kwakwa-Naphtali: umholi Pedaheli, umsa wa-Ammihud."
Loba ngubo laSimakadze abewaletsa kutsi bahlukanise ilizwe leKanana kubo bonkhe bantfu base-Israyeli.
USimakadze watsi kuMosese, emhlabatsini weMoabi, ngaseJordane, enkabeni yeJerikho, utsi:
"Uye ukhulume nalabaSirayeli, utsi: 'Banikele labaLevi emabhishi abo emhlabatsini lelungelo labo lokuhlala kulo, kanye nemadolobha abo asogwini lwawo.
Lamadolobha layawuba kuhlala kwabo, nemhlaba wabo utawuba ngemihlambi yabo, nemfuyo yabo, naleyo mihlambi yetilwane.

Lemifula lemincane yesitezi ngasinye semgwaqeni wema-Israyeli kumele ifike emasentimitha lamakhulu lamabili namashumi lamabili nesihlanu kusuka emgwaqeni wedolobha kuya kwelinye icala kanye nalolunye.

Ngaphesheya komgwaqo, ngemizuzwana lemine nemashumi lamane niyilinganisele icala lasenyakatho-mpumalanga, nangemizuzwana lemine namakhulu mahlanu icala lesempumalanga, nangemizuzwana lemine namakhulu matsatfu icala laseningizimu, nangemizuzwana lemine namakhulu lasitfupha icala lesintshonalanga; umgwaqo ungeke ube phakathi kwabo. Loku kumele kube yindawo yabo yekudla.
Lamadolobha lamane niyawuwanikela kuLevi, abe madolobha lokuphumula, kutsi afike khona lowo ubulalayo; kanye nemadolobha lamashumi mane namakhulu mahlanu nasitfupha.
Lamakhulu lalawo, nitawuwanikela kuLevi emadolobhana lamashumi mane namane nesikhombisa kanye nemadolobha abo.

Lamadolobha layawutiwa labaLevi asuke emhlaba wema-Israyeli; lomkhulu utawuba nemadolobha amaningi, loncane utawuba nemadolobha ambalwa. Lomkhulu utawuba nemadolobha amakhulu, loncane utawuba nemadolobha aphansi. Lomkhulu utawuba nemadolobha amakhulu, loncane utawuba nemadolobha ancane.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosi watsi:
"Ukhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu ba-Israyeli, utsi kubo: Uma nidlula eJordane nifike ezweni leKanana,
ukhethe lamadolobha ambalwa kutsi abe tidolobha takho letiphephile. Lomuntu lobulala umuntu ngengozi angahamba khona aze avikeleka.
Lamadolobha lawa angeke abe yindawo lephephile kusuka kulowo ofuna ukubuyisa lokubulala, kutsi lowo ophenywa ngokubulala angafa ngaphambi kokuba afike enkantolo phambi kwemphakathi.
Lamadolobha lamane nitawuwanikela kutsi abe tinhloko-dolobha tenu.
Lamadolobha lasitfupha nitawuwanikela ngaleso sinye seJordane, kanye nemadolobha lasitfupha emhlabatsini lwakwa-Kanana; lamadolobha lawa angeke abe ngukuthula.
Lamadolobha lamane angeke abe ndzawo yekuvikela labaSirayeli, nalabo baphumayo kanye nelabahlala khona phakathi kwabo, kutsi wonke lowo lobulala umuntu ngaphandle kwemcabango wakhe angafika kuwo.
Ngako-ke, uma umuntu ebulala umuntu ngento yensimbi, aze afile, lomuntfu ngumfati; lowo mfati kumele aphelelwe.
"Lombulalayo kumele atfute lowo umbulalayo; uma ehlangana naye, kufanele atfute lowo umbulalayo.
Uma umuntu ephazamisa omunye muntu, ngobe ayawumukhohlisa, noma ephuca into kuye ngenhloso kusuka lapho efihla khona, kutsi aphele,

"'Nase-ke, uma lomuntfu ebulala umhlambi wakhe ngesandla sakhe, ngobe angeke abe nekuthula naye; noma sewumushaya ngomcibisholo wakhe ngenxa yebuhlungu bakhe, aze amfe, lowo mkhwenyana uyawufa; ungumfishane. Lomunye welabo labasebentisa bokubulala kumele abafilele lombulawayo lapho emthola khona.
Kuze kube kukhona lowo longeke avumeleke kutsi atfuse omunye umuntu ngaphandle kwekumkhonta, noma atfuse into kuye ngaphandle kwekuyihlela.
noma, angamubonanga, atfule kuye mlilo lomkhulu kakhulu, abe ngumfo; ngobe angeke abe ngumfati wakhe, angeke abe nenhloso yekuwubulala.
Kusuka lapho, inhlanganiso kufanele igweme phakathi kwelowo lobulalayo nelowo ofuna ukubuyisa lokudlwengulayo, kulandela lemiyalo.

"Lebandla liyawuvikela lobulalayo emgwaqeni wakhe, liwubuyisele edolobhani lakhe lokuphephile lapho lafike khona, aze ahlale khona kuze kube sekufa umnikelo wesono longcwele, lowo waphekwa ngemafutha angcwele.
"Lakho-ke, uma lowo logwetywe ngekubulala ephuma ngaphandle kwemigwaqo yendzawo yakhe yekuphumula lapho afike khona,
bese umkhonzi wakhe efika emgwaqeni, wabulala lomuntfu, lowo mkhonzi angeke abe necala lokushona.
Angeke ahlale enhliziyweni yakhe yekuphumula kuze kube sekufa kwakhe; kodvwa ngemuva kwekufa kwakhe, angeke abuye ezweni lakhe.
Lemiyalo nemtsetfo kumele uwuba khona kuwe kanye nemindeni yakho, kuwo wonke lamadolobha akho.
Lomuntfu lobulala umuntu, kufanele abulawa njengemfishane ngesandla sebufakazi; ngobe kungakabi namuntu loyawufa ngesandla sebufakazi bomunye.
Ningeke nithathe mnikelo wekushiswa kutsi nigcine umbulalayo, lowo lofanele kubulawa; kumele atfunywe.
Ningeke nithathe mnikelo wekushiswa, kutsi lowo losuka emzini wakhe wekuthula abuye ahlale emhlabatsini sakhe, ngaphambi kwekufa kwenkhosi.

Ungeke ube yimhlaba lapho uhlala khona. Ukubulala kwenza umhlaba ube mnyama, futhi akukho lokuwulungisa ebusweni baNkulunkulu ngemuva kokufa kwalowo obulalayo, ngaphandle kokufa kwalo lowo wabulalayo.
"Ningeke niyiphazamise lemhlaba lapho nihlala khona, lomhlaba lapho ngihlala khona; ngobe mina, Simakadze, ngihlala phakathi kwabanaSirayeli.

Bafike bafika bomkhuluwa bemindeni yemadvodzana aGileyadi, emndenini wakwaMahiri, lomnyakamunye waManase, labahlala emabutfo aseJosefu; 21bakhuluma kuMosesi nabomakhulu awo, abemakhosikazi emindeni yamadodana kaSirayeli.

Bathi, "Namuhla, nkosi yami, uSimakadze waletsa kutsi uhlukanise lelizwe kuboSirayeli, ngekushaya sihlabani; futhi uSimakadze waletsa ukuthi usinike lamadolobha ka-Celofehadi, umngane wethu, emantombazane akhe.
"Lakho-ke, uma behlangana nalabo labaseSirayeli, lemhlaba wabo utawususwa emhlabani wemndeni wethu, wafakwa emhlabani wemndeni lapho bahlangane nabo; khona-ke lomhlaba uyawuncishiswa.
"Nalapho kuyawufika khona umnyaka weJubilee kubo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, lemhlaba wabo utawufakwa emndenini walendlu yabo, bese ususwa emhlabatsini lwemndeni wababa bethu."
UMosi waletsa lamadvodza ase-Israyeli, watsi: "Kulungile lokho lokushiwo ngumnikelo wesono wemndeni ka-Yusufu.
Lokho kulelo limiso leSimakadze elingene ngezingane ta-Celofehadi, watsi: Bangeke bahlangane nanoma ngubani lobathandekayo kubo; kepha kumele bahlangane nalowo wesifazane sesuku lababa babo.
Umhlaba ungeke uhambe kusuka emndenini ngamunye waya emndenini lomunye, kepha wonke lamakhosikazi aseSirayeli kumele agcine umhlaba wemndeni wakhe.
Naye nalowo mfana lophuma emndenini wemaSirayeli, lapho athola khona imfuyo yakhe, kufanele abe ngumunye wemindeni yemadvodzana akhe; ngobe bantfu baka-Israyeli kumele babe nemhlaba waboyise.
Imhlaba ungeke uhambe usuka emndenini wakhe waya emndenini wakhe, ngobe lomndeni waseSirayeli kumele agcine umhlaba wakhe.
Lamadvodza la-Celofehadi akazange akwenze njalo, njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose.
Lamadvodza laSelophehadi, emahla, neTirsa, neHogla, neMilka, neNoa, ayawushada nalabafana nabo ngesandla sababa babo.
Bafike bahlangana nemindeni yemadvodzana aManase, lomnyaka wasikhombisa kuYosefu; kodvwa lemhlaba wabo wawuhlala emndenini wababa babo, emndenini waseSihoni.
Lemiyalo lemi kanye nemithetho, leyo Simakadze abekhuluma ngayo kuboSirayeli ngesandla saMosese, emhlabatsini weMoabi, ngaseJordane, eJerikho.
Deut: Lamagama lawa akhuluma ngawo Mosi kubo bonkhe labaSirayeli, ngasenyakatho-ntshonalanga yeJordane, emhlabatsini, emfuleni iJordane, ngaphesheya kweSufi, phakathi neParan, naTophel, naLabani, naHaserothi, naDizahabi.
Kuthatha iminyaka lelishumi nesihlanu kutsi uhambe kusuka emfuleni iSinai kuya eKadeshi-Barnea ngendlela yemhlabatsi weSeiri.

Ngomnyaka wamashumi lamane, kumnyaka wesihlanu wenyanga yesikhombisa, ngelilanga lokuqala lemnyaka lolishumi elinanye, uMosese wabakhuluma bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, ngaso sonke leso Simakadze abemwisile kubo.
Kube wabulala uSihoni, ukumkani wema-Amori, lowabe eHeshboni, kanye noOgi, ukumkani weBashan, lowabe eAshtarothi, eEdrei.
Nalapho, ngaseJordane, ezweni laMoabi, waqala uMosesi kushumayela amazwi aNkulunkulu, watsi:
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, watsi nathi lapho sahlala khona emfuleni iSinayi, watsi: "Nihlale lapha emfuleni iminyaka leminingi.

Nihambe, nifike emhlabatsini lwaba-Amori nakwaso sonke isivini sawo: kuleyo ndawo iphansi yeJordane, nemhlabatsini, naseNtshonalanga, naseMfuleni weLibanoni; 24nasezweni lamaKananani, nakuLebhanoni kuze kuya emfula omkhulu waseFurathi.
bona, ngimise lelilizwe phambi kwenu; ningangeni, niyibambe itfu lelizwe loNkulunkulu abesho kubo-Abrahama, na-Isake, na-Yakobi, kutsi litawubanikela kubo, nabomadvodzana abo ngemuva kwabo.
Nami ngatsi kuwe ngalowo mnyaka, Ngitsi: Ngabe sengingeke ngibambise nine, kutsi ngibaphathe.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, wakwentela nikhule kakhulu, nalapho-ke namuhla ningaba nenani lelifana nelanga lesibhakabhaka.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli wababa bakho, akuletheleni kutsi nibe makhulu kakhulu kunaleso simo senu samanje, nakubambisene nani njengobe watsi.
Ngubani na longeke abambe inkinga yenu, nenkinga yenu, nenkinga yenu, ngami?
Nibakhetheni lamadoda anekhono, nekuqonda, nalabo abasaziwa emindenini yenu, nami ngitawubabeka njengenhloko yenu.
Uphendvula utsi: "Lento lokushoyo ngumbono lolungile."

Nami ngabathatha labaholi bemindeni yenu, lamadoda ahlakaniphile, nalabo abahlonishwayo, nami ngababeka njengenhloko yenu; babe ngumakhulu, namakhulu lamakhulu, namakhulu lamashumi mahlanu, namakhulu lalishumi, babe ngabaphathi bamasiko enu.

Ngeleso sikhathi ngibembise labaholi bakho, ngitsi: "Nikhulume nebantfu benu, nigweme ngekuthula, noma ngabe kukhona umSirayeli, noma ngabe kukhona umSirayeli, noma ngabe kukhona umhlali wasendlini yenu.

"Uma nitsi: 'Kulungile,' noma: 'Kubi.' lapho nicala khona, ningabonisi isikhumba semuntu; mlalela loncane kanye nomkhulu; ungakhathazeki ngaso sonke simo, ngoba umtsetfo nguwo waNkulunkulu. Nanoma yini leyinzima kakhulu kuweni, yifikeleni lapha kimi, ngiyawuyibona."
Ngeleso sikhathi ngatsi kuwe ngako konke lokufanele ukwenze.
Sisuka emfuleni iSinayi, sahamba ngaleso siphepho esikhulu kanye nesibulalayo, nisibone, ngendlela yemhlabatsi we-Amori, safika eKadeshe-barnea, njengobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, atibonile.
"Nami ngatsi kuwe: 'Nifike emhlabatsini lwaba-Amori, loSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu utawusinikela kuwo.
Bona, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, umise lelilizwe phambi kwakho; phuma uyithathe, njengobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, akusho kuwe; ungabi nendlala, ungabi nenkinga.
Nifike nitsi: 'Siyawuthumela lamadoda ngaphambili lelizwe, aze atibonele indlela esiya kuyo, kanye nemadolobha atawufika kuwo.'
Lombuzo wawuhle kakhulu emehlo ami, ngobe ngibe nemadoda lalishumi elinambili emiphakathini yenu, linye lihlanga ngalinye.
Bahamba bafike emhlabatsini, bafika efulethini lelingu-Eshkoli, bahlolisisa.
Batsi: "Lemhlaba loSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu usisinika wona, yilizwe lelihle kakhulu." 20Bafike baphuma eGibhithe besuka emadolobheni lasentshonalanga.
kodvwa ningeke nifike, ngobe nibe nenkinga nemyalo waSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu.
Naye nitsi: "Kube nguNkulunkulu lotfumisayo, lowo waphuma ezweni le-Egipta, ukuze atinike esandla se-Amori, kutsi atfumise.

Batsi: "Siyaphi? Labazalwane bethu batfusa umphefumulo wethu, besithi: 'Laba bantu bakhona banamandla kunatsi, nebude babo buphakeme kunatsi; imijinya yabo ikhulu, nemiganga yawo ifinyelela esibhakabhakeni; siye sabona khona nabana-Enaki, laba makhulu!"
Nami ngatsi kuwe: "Ungabi nebuhlungu, ungababi nabo.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, lohamba phambi kwenu, yena uyakulwa nani, njengobe wakwenza kwenu ngemehlo enu eMijiphu.
kanye nemhlabatsini, lapho ubone khona kutsi Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, wakubambisana nawe, njengobe umuntu ebamba umntwana wakhe, kuyo yonke indlela, kuze nifike kulendawo.
Ngako-ke, naleso sikhathi ningeke nikholwa kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu,
Loye wahamba phambi kwenu lapho nihamba khona, kutsi akuboneni nendawo yekucampa, ebusuku ngemlilo, kutsi akubonise indlela yenu yekuhamba, nelilanga ngefu.
ngobe Simakadze abewuva amazwi enu, waba nendlala, wakhuluma watsi:
"Kungeke kubekho muntu kulolu hlobo lokubi, loyawubona lelizwe lelihle labengisibophe kutsi litawubanikela kubobaba babo.
ngaphandle kwaKalebe, umsa waJefune; yena loyawuyibona; naye loyawuyinika lemhlaba lapho ahambe khona, kuye nakubo bonkhe bantfu bakhe, ngobe walandela Simakadze ngentliziyo yakhe yonke.
Nami, Simakadze wakhazamisa ngami ngenxa yenu, watsi: "Nawe ungeke ufike kulomhlaba.
Joshua, unyana wa-Nun, umkhonzi wakho, yena loyawufika kuyo; wakhe umoya wakhe, ngobe yena loyawuyisa lelizwe lakubo labaSirayeli.
Nabancane benu, labakhuluma kutsi batawubekwa ejele, labo abancane kakhulu, bangawazi lokuhle nalolobi, bona baya kuyo; kubo ngiyawuyinikela, nabo bazoyihlala njengelifa.
kodvwa niye, buyelani, nihambe esigabeni semhlabatsini, ngendlela yeMfula waseSumu.

Nitsi kuye: "Sibe nesono kuSimakadze; sizohamba siye kulwa, njengobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, akutsile kutsi sikwenze." Lakho-ke nifike nigqoka lo priso, ngobe nicabanga kutsi kungeke kube lula kuwe ukuba uhambe uye emfuleni.
Simakadze wandiphendvula watsi: "Cinga kubo, 'Ungayikhuphuka, ungaba nemphi; ngobe ngingeke ngibe phakathi kwenu, ukuze ningabi nenkinga nalabo batfutsi bakho.'"
Nami ngakhuluma nani, kodvwa nitsi: "Asikulalelani," ngobe ningakholwa kumtsetfo waSimakadze, nasenhliziyweni yenu niyehla niya emfuleni.
Baphuma nabo-Amori, labahlala kulomhlabatsini lowo, bahlangana nani, baphazamisa nisuka eSeyiri kuya eHorma, bebaphazamisa njengobe tingulube tiphazamisa.
Nibuye nilile phambi kwaSimakadze, kodvwa Simakadze akazange akuvumeli kutsi ulalele, angeke anibeke engqondweni.
Nihlala khona eKadeshi iminyaka leminingi, kuze kube sekuphele lilanga nihlala khona.
Siye sabuyela, sahamba sisuka eGibhithe safika eGibhithe, sahamba ngendlela yeMfula waseSumeni, njengobe Simakadze abekhuluma nami; sahamba sikude nemhlabatsine saseSeiri iminyaka leminingi.
USimakadze watsi kuye:
"Wena sewuhamba kahle kulolu mhlabatsini, bese ubuyela enyakatho."
"Uye uvumele labantu, utsi: Niyadlula ezweni letive zenu, labangani baka-Esau, labahlala eSeyiri; bayawukulibala, kodvwa nigweme kakhulu.
Mfushane nabo; ngobe ngeke ngikunike noma yini emhlabatsini lwabo, kuze kube nenyawo lelinye lamehlo akho lifike kuleyo ndawo. Ku-Esau sengikulethela intaba yaseSeyiri kutsi ibe yiye.
Bakhokhele ngemali lekudla lokudlako, kanye nemanti lokudlalako."

Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, wakubambisana nawe kuwo wonke umsebenzi wesandla sakho; wakuvikela ekuhambeni kwakho ngalolu lwandle olukhulu. Lamashumi lamane eminyaka uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, ube nawe; awuzange ufune lutho.
Siye sadlula ebantwini bethu, bantfu baka-Esau, labahlala eSeiri; sasuka sihamba ngendlela yeGibhithe lephuma eElathi ne-Ezion-Geberi, sabuyela sahamba ngendlela yaseGibhithe yeMoabi.
Watsi Simakadze kuye: "Ungabi nenkinga naMowabi, ungaba nekulwa nabo; ngobe ngeke ngikunike noma yini emhlaba wabo, ngoba labangani baka-Lote sengibanikela ngeAr njengendawo yabo.
Bahlala khona ema-Emi, labahlala khona ngaphambilini; bekungubantfu labanamandla, nelabakhulu kakhulu, nelabaphakeme, njengaba-Enaki.
Babizwa ngeRephayimi, njengaba-Enaki; kodvwa la-Moabi babitwa ngu-Emimi.
KuSeyiri kwahlala ngaphambilini neHori; kodvwa lamadvodza ase-Esau ayawukhipha, ayawubulala, wahlala esikhundleni sawo, njengobe labaSirayeli bakwenze ezweni loSimakadze abewanikela ngalo njengelifa.
Simakadze watsi kubo: "Nifikeni, nihambe ngegwadi leZeredi."Siye sahamba ngegwadi leZeredi.

Kusuka kuleso sikhathi lapho saphuma khona eKadeshe-barnea, kuze sifike emfuleni weZeredhi, kwadlula iminyaka lemashumi lamane namakhulu lasitfupha nesikhombisa; lomnyaka lowo wonke waba ngumnyaka lomfishane kubo bonkhe bantfu labaphilako bekulwa, ngobe Simakadze abewawutsi.
Isandla saSimakadze sabe sikhona kubo, kuze kuphelelwe nabo emaphandleni esitezi.
Nalapho lamashumi lasitfupha ebantfu labahlaselako bafile,
Simakadze watsi kuye:
Namuhla utawudlula eAr, emgwaqeni weMoabi.

Uma ufika ezweni lamadvodzana a-Ammon, ungababusisi, ungeke ube nekulwa nabo; ngobe ngeke ngikunike lutho emlandweni wabomadvodzakati e-Ammon, ngoba ngiyakubanikela kubo bonkhe bantfu ba-Lot kutsi babe yitfu.
Lomhlaba wabizwa ngemhlaba wema-Refayi, labahlala khona; kodvwa lamakhosi e-Ammon awabiza ngokuthi ngu-Zamzumim.
Laba bantu babenamandla, bakhulu kakhulu, nebude babo babufana nalaba-Enaki; kodvwa uSimakadze wababulala phambi kwamadvodza la-Ammoni, waphindze wawakhipha, wahlala endaweni yabo.
Ngako-ke uSimakadze wakwenza njalo kubomadvodzana aEsawu, labahlala eSeyiri, lapho wabulala khona laHoriya phambi kwabo; ngobe batawuwakhipha, behlala endaweni yabo kuze kube namuhla.
NalabaAvhi, labahlala emaphandleni kuze kufike eGaza, babulawa ngabaKaftorimi, labasuka eKrethe, babehlala endaweni yabo.
"Nifike nihambe, nidlule leNtaba iArnon; bona, sengikulethela phambi kwakho uSihoni, ukumkani waseHeshboni, umAmoreti, kanye nelizwe lakhe; qalisa lithathe, uye kumhlasela.

Ngakho-ke, ngitawuqalisa ngalolusuku kutsi livi lenu libe yitfutfuko kanye nekuthula kuwo wonke lamazwe angaphansi kwesibhakabhaka; lapho bakubona khona igama lakho, baya kukhathazwa, bazama ukulwa nawe.
Nami ngathumela labaholi kuSihoni, ukumkani weHeshboni, kusuka emasikweni eKedemothi, ngemibuzo yekuthula, besithi:
Sifike sihambe ngemhlaba wakho, sihlale ngendlela lehamba phambili, singasibeke ngasekudla noma ngasekhohlo.
Sithengise ukudla kutsi sidle, namanzi kutsi siphuze, sitawukukhokha ngemali; sivumele nje kutsi sihambe ngenyawo.
njengobe bakwenta bantfu baka-Esau labahlala eSeyiri, nebantfu beMoabi labahlala eAr; kuze sifike sidlula loMfula iJordani, sifike ezweni leSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu, usiya linika.

"Lamuhla-ke uSihoni, inkhosi yaseHeshboni, akazange ativumele kutsi sihambe ngaye; ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, wamisa umlomo wakhe, wamisa nenhliziyo yakhe, kutsi akunike wona esandla sakho, njengobe wakwenza namuhla.
Simakadze watsi ngami: "Bona, sengiqale ngikunikela phambi kwakho uSihoni nemhlaba wakhe; qalisa ukuthatha umhlaba wakhe ube yilungelo lakho.
Sihoni waphuma, yena nebantfu bakhe bonkhe, eJahazi, kutsi ahlangane nathi.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, wamnikela phambi kwethu, sawubulala yena nemadvodzana akhe kanye nemkhosi yakhe yonke.
Lawo mhla sawuthatha wonke lamadolobha akhe, sawubulala wonke lomhlaba, amadoda nabesifazane nezingane; asizange sishiye namunye.
Sihlala sigcina kuphela isilwane kanye nempahla yalemijiko lesihlanganisiwe, njengento yetfu.
Kusuka e-Aroeri, elibekwe emgwaqeni i-Arnon, kanye nedolobha lelisemgwaqrettweni,tseru kuya eGileyadi, akukho dolobha elingumgwaqo lomkhulu kunale; Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, wasinikela kuwo wonke.

Kuze kube ilizwe lemadvodzana a-Ammon, ningeke nifike kulo, noma yiliphi ilizwe leliselwandle lweJabhok, noma imifula yalemhlabatsini, noma kuphi nalapho Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, akazange anivumele ukuba sifike khona.
Siye sabuyela, sahamba ngendlela yeBashan; waphuma Og, ukumkani weBashan, naye nebantfu bakhe bonkhe, ahlasela eEdrei.
USimakadze watsi kuye: "Ungamkholeli, ngobe ngitawumunikela kuwe, yena nebantfu bakhe bonke kanye nelizwe lakhe; uyawukwenza kuye njengobe wakwenza kuSihoni, ukumkani wema-Amori, lohlala eHeshboni."
Ngako-ke Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, wamisa phambi kwethu naOgi, ukumkani waseBashan, naye kanye nebantfu bakhe bonke; sawubulala kuze asishiyenga namunye.

Ngaleso sikhathi siwuthathe wonke lamadolobha akhe; kwakungeke kube khona nalinye lamadolobha abo asingatawuwathatha, emanhloko-dolobha angamashumi ayisishiyagalombili, yonke indawo yaseArgobi, ibukhosi beOg eBashan.
Lamadolobha lalaba nawo abe netingcweti letiphakeme, netisango kanye nemabhodlela; kwabekhona naletinye tindzawo letiphansi letingenatingcweti.
Sazibulala ngazo, njengobe sakwenta kuSihoni, ukumkani waseHeshboni; siyawubulala yonke lemijikelo, amadoda, nabesifazane, nezingane.
Lemihlambi yonke, kanye nempahla lesuka emizini, sayithatha siyigcine sesinye.
Ngeleso sikhathi sakhipha ema-Amori lamadolobha abo lamakhulu lamabili eJordane, kusukela emfuleni iArnon kuya emfuleni iHermon.
Babe-Sidon bakhuluma ngentaba yeHermon kutsi yiSiriyon, kodvwa laba-Amori bayayibiza ngokuthi Senir.
Lamadolobha onke e-Arabha, neGiliyadi lonke, neBashan lonke, siyawuwana kuze kube seSalekha naEdreyi, lamadolobha ebukhosini be-Og eBashan.

Og, ukumkani waseBashani, lokuphelela la-Rephayimi labakhulu, abe nebhedu lakhe lelibomvu eRabhah, emndenini wa-Ammon, kuze kube namuhla; ubude bawo bube ngamasentimitha lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa, nebubanzi bakhe bube masentimitha lalishumi.
Ngaleso sikhathi, ezweni lesihloniphekile, ngalinikela kubo-Rubheni nalabaGadi, kusuka eAroeri, elisegwadini laseArnon, kanye nengxenye yemhlabatsine weGileyadi nemadolobha ayo.

Nalelinye lamadolobha eGileyadi, nemhlaba wonke waseBashani, uMbuso wa-Og, ngawunikela kwesinye sesigameko sema-Manase; lomhlaba wonke we-Argob waseBashanmanisi waseBashani wawubizwa ngokuthi yilizwe lama-Refayi.
UYahiri, wase-Manase, wakhipha yonke indawo yaseArgobi kuya emgwaqeni weGeshuri nawaseMaakathi; wababiza ngegama lakhe, lamadolobha eYahiri, eBashan, kuze kufike kulomnyaka.
KwaMahiri nganikela ngeGileyadi.
Lakwa-Rubeni nakwa-Gadi ngabanika lelizwe, kusuka eGileyadi kuya emfuleni i-Arnon, kanye nemfula iJabhok, umkhawulo wemadvodzana a-Ammon.
Lemhlaba wabo ube yiGoli leJordane, kanye nemfula iJordane abe ngumkhawulo wayo, kusukela elwandle laseGaliliya kuya eMfuleni Wokufa, ngaphansi kwemifula yePisga emgwaqeni wasenyakatho.

Nami ngatsi: Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, utawukulethela lelizwe kutsi niyigcine; ngobe bonke labo labahamba phambili ekulwa nabo kumele bahambe bejiyile phambi kwalabo labangani babo, bantfu base-Israyeli.
Lamadodana enu, nezingane zenu, nesilwane senu-ke-ke, ngiyazi kutsi ninesilwane sengukhulu, bangahlala emizini yenu leyo ngiyitfumeleni;

kuze uSimakadze avumele labangani bakho baseSirayeli ukuba baphumule njengenu, bese bona nabo bethola itfu lemhlaba loyawubanikela wona Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, ngaseJordanmini; emva kwalokho nizobuyela niya ezweni labengingabanikela lona.

Ngeleso sikhathi ngibembise uJoshua, ngitsi: "Lamehlo akho akubona konke lokuyenzile Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, kubo bonkhe bantfu lababini; kanjalo-ke uSimakadze uzokwenza kuwo wonke lamadolobha lapho uyaphuma khona.
"Mna-ke, ningabakhotsi; ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, yena loyawukulwa nawe.
Ngeleso sikhathi ngathandaza kuSimakadze,
UNkulunkulu, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, wena uqale ukutsi kumkhonzi wakho mandla akho amakhulu; ngobe yini lengcwele, entabeni noma emhlaba, engeke ikwenze imisebenzi yakho enkulu?
Ngiyawudlula, ngiyabona lelizwe lelihle elisevereni laseJordane, nalomhlabatsi lobuhle, kanye neLibanoni."
Ngako-ke uSimakadze wehlule ngami ngenxa yenu, watsi: "Kulungile; ungakhuluma nami lutho ngalo mcabango lonjalo. UNkulunkulu akafuni kutsi ngikhulume nawe."
