Hamba ufike esigabeni sePisga, ubheke emaphandle akho ngasenyakatho, nasentshonalanga, nasentshonalanga, nasentshonalanga, ubone lelizwe ngemehlo akho; ngobe awutadlula loJordani.
Uyawumisa uJoshua abe nguMengameli wakhe, uyengeze umphefumulo wakhe, wandise amandla akhe; ngobe yena longeke afike adlulisa laba bantu, naye longeke abanike itfu lelizwe labewulibona.
Batsi: "Sihlala efulethini lelinetigodzi, liseBet-Peori."
Ngako-ke, Israele, lalela imiyalo nemiyalo lemi, engingakufundisa yona, uyenze, ukuze niphile, nifike niyigcine ilizwe loSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, akunika lona.
Ningeke nifake kuleso sinqumo sengikusho kuwe, ningeke nisuse kuso, kutsi nigcine imiyalo kaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, lemi ngikhuluma ngayo.
Lamehlo enu akubona kutsi Simakadze abekwenzani ngeBaale-Peori; ngobe Nkulunkulu wenu, uSimakadze, wehlule kuwo wonke lalandelanga Baale-Peori, Nkulunkulu wenu.
Natsi nine, bonkhe labo labehleli kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, niphila kuze namuhla.
Beka, ngiyakufundiseni imiyalo nemithetho, njengobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wami, amemetele, ukuze niyigcine ezweni lenu lokuya kulo kutsi nilithathe.

Lakho-ke kufanele niyigcine, niyiphumele; ngobe lokhu kuzoba ngubufakazi bakho nebuhlakani bakho ebantwini, kutsi bakhulume ngaleyo miyalo yonke, batsi: 'Lenhlanga lelikhulu liyawube linyenti kakhulu labantu abanobuhlakani nebuhlakani.'
Liphi linye ilizwe elikhulu, elinaNkulunkulu wakhe lohle kakhulu kuye, njengobe uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu uhlala ecaleni lethu ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho sithandaza kuye?
Likhona yini linye ilizwe, likhulu kangakanani na, lelinemiyalo nemithetho efanele, njengemiyalo nemiyalo leyo ngiyibeka phambi kwenu namuhla?

Kuye, nigcineni kahle isandla samSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu; ningaze ukhohlwe lezinto amehlo enu lazibonayo. Akufanele ziphume emlonyeni wakho zonke iintsuku zekuphila kwakho; kumele uzifundise izingane zakho nezingane tabantwana bakho.

Losuku lapho wahlala khona phambi kwaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, emfuleni iSinayi, lapho Simakadze abesithi kimi: "Susa lamakhosi kum, aze alalele amazwi ami, ukuze bafunde ukuba bangabi nabuhlungu ngami nsuku zonke lapho bephila khona emhlabeni, futhi bafundise izingane zabo."
Nifike nihlala ngaphansi komfula, lapho mlilo uphuma khona kuze kufinyelele esibhakabhakeni; umfudlana wabeka phansi umfula, nemanti amnyama, nemvula emnyama.
Simakadze wabakhuluma nine kusuka embindini wemlilo; nakubona umsindo wemazwi, kodvwa ningabona lutho lokufana nalo, ngaphandle kwemsindo.
Wakhuluma kuwe ngesivumelwano sakhe, akusho kuwe kutsi ukwenze, lamazwi lalishumi; wabhala kuwo emacwecwe lamibili esiliva.
Ngeleso sikhathi uSimakadze watsi kuye: "Nifundise imiyalo nemithetho, kutsi niyiphumeze kulelizwe lenu lokuya kulo, nifike nilibambe.
"Ungeke ubone noma yini, ngelilanga lapho Simakadze abekhuluma nawe eMfuleni iSinayi, kusuka enhliziyweni yemlilo; ngobe kufanele ube nekuthula.
Mna-ke, ningabi nenkinga ngekwenza igolide noma yini efana naleyo, noma ngabe ingumfazi noma ngabe ingumuntfu;
noma yini lephilako emhlabatsini, noma yini lephilako emkhathini,
noma isilwane lesihamba ngemhlabatsini, noma inhlanzi lephila emanzini ngaphansi kwemhlaba.

Nase ufike ubheke emazulu, ubone ilanga, nenyanga, namadijithi, lamandla onke emhlaba; ungenambitheka, ubeke phansi, ubabuyele kubo; ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, wabanikela kuwo wonke lamazwe angaphansi kwezulu.
kodvwa nine, Simakadze utawuba nenu, waphuma eMijiphu, emgodini wensimbi, kutsi nibe bantu bakhe bokugcina, njengobe ningakho namuhla.
"Nakho uSimakadze wagwema ngami ngenxa yenu, watsi: 'Angeke ngihambe ngeJordane, ngifike ezweni lelihle loNkulunkulu wakho Simakadze akunika lona njengelifa.'
Ngitafa lapha ezweni lelinye, ngingeke ngidlule iJordane; kodvwa niyawudlula, niyigcine leyo mhlaba omuhle.

Nigcineni, ningawulibalanga umyalelo waSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, lowenza nani; ngobe ningeke nikwenze lutho lokudlwengulayo, nanoma yisiphi isibonakaliso, lapho Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, a undinike lona.
ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, ngumlilo lowudla, uNkulunkulu lomkhululayo; akakuhlukanisi nanoma ngubani umthandana nawe.

Uma ukhulela izingane kanye nezingane tabantwana bakho, bese uhlala isikhathi eside kulolu mhlaba, ungase ube nenkinga, uphindze wenze igolide noma yini efana naleyo, ukwenze lokubi emlonyeni waSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, ukuze umkhulise.

"Lakho-ke ngitsi: Lasezulu kanye nemhlaba sengikhuluma ngawo lapha namuhla, kutsi ningeke niphele ngokushesha ezweni lenu, lapho nihamba khona ngeJordane niya kuyo; ngeke nihlale khona iminyaka emikhulu, kodwa niyawufa.
Simakadze utawukusakaza phakathi kwebantfu, nawe uzoba nenani elincane lokuhlala phakathi kwalabo bantu, lapho Nkulunkulu atakususa khona.
Nalapho utawunikela khona emgudwini, msebenzi wesandla somuntu, lomtfubi nemlilo, angabonanga, angavanga, angadlanga, angaphuzanga.
Ngako-ke lapho uyawufuna khona Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, utawumuthola, uma umfuna ngentliziyo yakho yonke nemoya yakho yonke.
"Lamuhla-ke, lapho ukhona ebuhlunguni bakho, kanye nelapho lezi zinto zonke tikutfole khona, ngelilanga lekucala niyawubuyela kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, niyawulalela.
ngobe uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, uNkulunkulu lomkhululayo; akakushiyeli, akakuphelisi, angeke akhohlwe inhlanganiso yakhe labeyawuyinikela ngesandla kubabuphi bakho.

"Thintsi, ubuze ngeminyaka lengemuva, kusukela kuleso sikhathi lapho Nkulunkulu atfumele khona umuntu phezu kwemhlaba, kuze kube yiso siphesheya sezulu kuya esiphesheya sezulu: Ingabe kwenzeka yini into lenjalo? Ngabe kukhona lowaziyo into lenjalo?
Ngabe kukhona linye lihlanga lelihlelile ilizwi laNkulunkulu likhuluma ngasempumalanga yemlilo, njengobe uhlelele wena, waphila?

UNkulunkulu wazama yini ukuthatha ilizwe ekungeneni kwelinye ilizwe, ngesivivinyo, ngemiqondiso, nangemfihlakalo, nemfelandawonye, nesandla esinamandla, nemilenze eyimfishane, nangezinto ezinkulu kanye nezinto ezibulalayo? Lolu hlobo-ke loSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu wakwenza kwenu eMijiphu, phambi kwamehlo enu.
Wakukhombisa lokhu, kutsi ubone ukuthi Simakadze, yena loNkulunkulu; ngaphandle kwakhe angeke kubekho omunye.
Kusuka esibhakabhakeni wakwenza ubone lizwi lakhe, kutsi akufundise; emhlabani wakwenza ubone umfula wakhe omkhulu, nawe wakhuluma amazwi akhe kusuka embindini wemlilo.
Nakuba, ngobe abeyawuthanda bantfu bakho, wabakhethela kutsi babe ngumadvodzana abo ngemuva kwabo, watfumisa ngesandla sakhe kusuka e-Egypt, ngamandla akhe amakhulu,
kutsi akhuphule ema-Israyeli, lamakhulu kunawe, namandla kakhulu kunawe, aze akufikele ezweni labo, akunike lona njengelifa lakho, njengobe namuhla.
Wazi ke ngalolusuku, ugcine engqondweni yakho, kutsi Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, unguNkulunkulu entabeni nasemhlabatsini; akukho namunye.

Uyawugcina lamasiko akhe, nemiyalelo yakhe, engikushoyo kuwe ngalolusuku, ukuze kube lula kuwe, nabangani bakho ngemuva kwakho, nawe uhlale uhlala iminyaka emikhulu ezweni leSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, utawukulethela kuze kube sekupheleni.
Ngako-ke uMosi wahlukanisa tidolobha letintsatfu ngaleso sinye seJordane, ekufikeni kwelanga.
lapho lowo labulala khona umuntu ngengozi, ngaphandle kwekumkhonta ngaphambilini, angeke ahambe ephephile. Angeke ahambe esinye salesi sikhumulo sezindiza agcine impilo yakhe.
Lamadolobha lalaba nguBeser, eGibhithe, ema-Rubeni; Ramoth, eGileyadi, ema-Gadi; Golan, eBashani, ema-Manase.
Lowo ngumthetho loMosi abewutjela bantfu be-Isirayeli.
Lolu bufakazi, kanye nemtsetfo, naleso simiso, loMosi wakhuluma kubo, lapho bephuma e-Egypti,
enyakatho-ntshonalanga yeJordane, emfuleni, ecaleni leBeth-peori, ezweni laSihoni, ukumkani wema-Amori, loyawuhlala eHeshboni, loMosi nemadvodzana akhe abembulala, lapho bephuma eMijiphu.
Bayawuhlala eGibhithe, baphindze bahlasela iJordane, babulala bonkhe bantfu baseGibhithe, kanye nenkhosi yabo.
Lomhlaba wawusuka eAroeri, lapho kungena khona umfula i-Arnon, waya emfuleni waSiyoni, lowukunguMfula weHermon;
wabeka khona lonke lelive laseJordane, ngasenyakatho-ntshonalanga kweJordane, kuze kube kulwandle lokudlwengulayo, ngaphansi kwemfula iFisga.
Moses wahlanganisa bonke labase-Israyeli, wathi kubo: "Sika, i-Israyeli, lemiyalo nemibandela engikhuluma ngayo kuwe namhlanje; niyifundeni, niyigcineni niyiphumeze.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, wakwenza nathi sivumelwano emfuleni iSina.
Simakadze akazange abeke lomnikelo wekushiswa kuboyise bethu kuphela, kodvwa wawubeka nathi siphilako sonke lapha namuhla.
Simakadze wakhuluma nani buso kubuso emfuleni, kusuka embindini wemlilo.
Ngibe sengihlala phakathi kweSimakadze nenu ngalolu busuku, kutsi ngikutsheleni amazwi enkhosini; ngobe niye walokotela umlilo, ngobe angeke nifike emfuleni.
Ngiye Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, lowawutfusa ezweni la-Egipta, emhlaba wema-Amori.
Angeke ube nabanye bonkulunkulu ngaphandle kwami.

"Ungeke ukwenzele wena igolide, noma isiliva, noma igolide, noma isiliva, noma nanoma yini efana nento lekhona emazulu phezulu, noma lekhona emhlabatsini ngezansi, noma lekhona emanzini angaphansi kwemhlaba.

Ungeke ubeke isandla sakho esihlalweni, ungawukhoni lomhlabatsi; ngobe ngiye Simakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, Nkulunkulu wema-Egipta, Nkulunkulu wesive, lobulala inkohliso yababa kubo bonkhe labami, kuze kube ngumnyaka wesithathu nawasesihlanu kubo bonke labo labamethemba.
ngobe ngikhuluma nguNkulunkulu lophilayo, lowo uhlala emhlabatsini letfu, lowo ugcina imiyalo yami.
Ungeke usebenzise igama laSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho ngecala, ngobe Simakadze utawubulala lowo lokhipha igama lakhe ngecala.
Ugcine usuku lweShabbat lingcwele, njengobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, akuwisele.
Nine lilanga lesixhenxe kutsi nisebenzele tonkhe tisebenti tenu.

kodwa usuku lwesine ngusuku lokuphumula kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho; ungasebenzisi lutho ngalolusuku, wena, noma unyana wakho, noma intombi yakho, noma umkhonzi wakho, noma indvodzakati yakho, noma inkomo yakho, noma idlovu yakho, noma imfuyo yakho, noma umkhwenyana wakho lohlala emnyango wakho. Umkhonzi wakho nenkosikazi yakho kumele baphumule njengawe.

Khumbula kutsi ube ngumkhonzi ezweni leMijiphu, ngobe uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho watfumisa khona ngesandla sakhe esinamandla, nemilenze yakhe eyimfishane; ngakho-ke uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho wakwenta kube ngusuku lokuphumula.

Hlala ubaba wakho nomama wakho, njengobe Simakadze Nkulunkulu wakho akuwisele umthetho ngalo, ukuze uhlale uhlala isikhathi eside, nawe ube nempilo ekahle phezu kwelizwe loSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho akunika lona.
Ungabulalanga.
Ungeke ube necala lokubi.
Ungagcobi.
Ungatsi lutho lokubi ngemunye wakho enkantolo.
"Ungeke ufune indodana yemndeni wakho, ungafuni indlu yomndeni wakho, noma isihlahla sakhe, noma umkhonto wakhe, noma inkomo yakhe, noma isisu sakhe, noma yini nayinye eyinikwe ngumndeni wakho.

Lamazwi lawa akhuluma wona uSimakadze kubo bonkhe labaholi bebandla lenu, ngelizwi elikhulu, enhliziyweni yemlilo, nemfudlane, nebumnyama bomhlaba; akazange akhulume priso; wabhalela emacwecwe amabili egolide, wamnika.

Batsi: "Kungekucace kutsi, lapho nililalela khona lelizwi kusuka enhliziyweni yetinhlayiya, kanye nalapho intaba ikhula ngayo ngemlilo, nani bonkhe bantfu labakhulu bemindeni yenu nebaholi bakho bafike kuye.

nitsi: Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, ukutsile sijabuliso sakhe nebukhulu bakhe, sawulalela umsindo wakhe kusuka emiphakathini yemlilo; namuhla sesikubonile kutsi uNkulunkulu angakhuluma nomphefumulo, naye ahlale ephila.
Namuhla-ke, yini lesingafa ngayo? Lomlilo lomkhulu utawutfusa; uma sihlala silalela lizwi laSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu, siyafa.
Ngabe kukhona umuntu lokhe walalela ingoma yoNkulunkulu ophilayo ekhuluma ngasemliloni, njengathi siyibonile, wahlala?
Yifike wena, ulalele konke lokushoyo kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, bese ukhuluma nathi ngalo konkhe loko Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu, akusho kuwe; sitawukulalela, siyawukwenza.
Simakadze watsi kuye: "Ngikucele kutsi ukhulume nami, ngitsi: 'Laba bantu bakhuluma nawe; kulungile konke labakushoyo.'
Ngiyafisa kutsi babe nemphefumulo lonjalo, bangeke baphindze bagcine lemithetho yami yonke, kutsi bakhululeke nabo bonkhe bantfu babo kuze kube sekupheleni.
Yite, khuluma nabo, utsi: "Buyele etintfweni tenu."
Uhlale lapha nami, ngobe ngitakulethela yonke imiyalo, nemibambiso, nemithetho, kutsi uyifundise kubo; batawuyilandzela kulelizwe labengingabanikela ngalo ukuba libe yitfu.
Nigcineni kutsi nikwenze njengobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, akwentela; ningayiphazamisi ngesandla sakho sokudla noma ngesandla sekwesobunxele.
Nihambe ngendlela yonke leSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, watsi kuwe, ukuze niphile, niphile kahle, nihlale isikhathi eside ezweni lenu lokuya kulo.
Lemiyalo lemi, nemiyalo nemtsetfo, loSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu wakhuluma ngawo, kutsi ngiwufundise niyigcine ezweni lenu lokuya kulo kutsi nilithathe.
-ke ugcine yonke imiyalo yakhe nemtsetfo wakhe, ngiyakuletsa wena, kanye nemadvodzana akho, kanye nemadvodzakati akho, nsuku zonke lokuphila kwakho, ukuze uhlale iminyaka emikhulu.
Lingisa, Israele, uhlale ulalela, ukuze kube lula kuwe, nawe ube yinhlanga enkulu, njengobe Simakadze, uThixo wababa bakho, abekusho kuwe, ezweni lelivuthayo ummbila nemvubelo.
Lingisa, Israele: Simakadze uNkulunkulu wethu, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, nguSimakadze kuphela.
Uyawuthanda Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, ngentliziyo yakho yonke, nemphefumulo wakho wonke, nemandla akho wonke.
Lemiyalo lemi, lapho ngikuncenga ngayo namuhla, kufanele ibekwe emilonyeni yakho.
Lifundise bantfwana bakho, likhulume nabo lapho uhlala khona ekhaya kanye nelapho uhamba khona ngendlela, lapho ulala khona kanye nalapho uphuma khona.
Lalela emadolo akho, kube yiphawu lakho, bese uyibeka emlonyeni wakho, ibe ngubufakazi.
Utawuzibhalela emadolobheni endlu yakho, nakwemiganga yakho.
-ke Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, utawukungenisa ezweni lakhe, njengoba wakhuluma kubantfu bakho, kuAbrahama, neIsakha, naJakobho, kutsi akunikeze mhlaba wemihlaba yendlu yakho.

kanye nemindeni legcwele izinto letinene, lapho wena ungewugcwalisanga khona, kanye nebukhona bemhlabatsini, lapho wena ungungewuvulanga khona, kanye netingcotfo tewayini netingcotfo te-olive, lapho wena ungungewudzala khona.
khumbula kutsi ungeke ukhohlwe Simakadze, lowo watfumisa ezweni la-Egipta, ezweni lekutsi ube ngumkhonzi.
LoSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, ungeke ube nenkinga nawe; ngobe yena uNkulunkulu wakho.
Ningeke nilandele bonkulunkulu babanye, labangcwele bebantfu labasemhlabatsini wenu.
ngobe uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, lohlala phakathi kwakho, nguNkulunkulu ophilayo; uma nilandela imikhosi yabanye, khona-ke umsindo wakhe uya kutfunyaniswa nani, nawe uzokususa phezu kwemhlaba.
Mna-ke ningeke nicebe uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, njengobe nicebe kuye eMasa.
Hamba ugcine imiyalo kaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, nemiyalo yakhe kanye nemithetho yakhe, nalawo malungiselelo akhe, labekuwiselayo.
"Ningeke nikwenze lokho kulungile emehloni kaSimakadze, kutsi kube lula kuwe, nifike niyithathe itfu lelihle loNkulunkulu abekhuluma ngalo kubobaba bakho,
Simakadze utawukhipha bonkhe bantfu bakho ebusweni bakho, njengobe watsi.
Nalapho batawukubuza khona bantfu bakho ngekusasa, bethi, Liyini leli livi, naletimiso, netibopho, letiSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu, akwentela wona?
Nitsi kubo: "Sibe tikhonzi taFaro eMijiphu, kodvwa uSimakadze wathuthela eMijiphu ngesandla sakhe esinamandla.
Simakadze wakhipha imivimbo, nemibono emikhulu, ebuhlungu, ema-Egypti, kuFaro, nasensimini yakhe yonke, phambi kwemehlo ethu.
Watsi: "UNkulunkulu uyawutfumisa umhlaba, utawuwunikela kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu, watsi: 'Ngikunike lemhlaba lapho ngikhuluma khona.'
Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli watsi: "Lemiyalo lemikhulu yaSimakadze, Simakadze Nkulunkulu wethu, ifanele siyiphumele, siyigcine, siyigcine, siyigcine, siyigcine, siyigcine kuze kube nguleso sikhathi.
Sitawube silungile kuye, uma sihlala silandzela lemiyalelo yonke phambi kwaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu, njengobe atfumele kutsi siyenze.

USimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, utawukubeka ezweni lenu lokuya kulo kutsi ulibambe; utawukhipha emehlweni akho lamazwe amaningi, iHeti, neGirgasi, neAmori, neKananani, nePerizi, neHivi, neJebusi, amazwe asesikhombisa akhulu kakhulu namandla amakhulu kunakho.
Uma uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, enikela ngazo phambi kwakho, utawuzibulala, utawuzibhubhisa ngokuphelele; ngeke ube nesivumelwano nabo, noma uzoba nenhlonipho kubo.
Ungeke ukwati nasinye sabo; madvodzana akho angeke akwati lamadvodzakati abo, namadvodzakati akho angeke akwati lamadodana abo.
ngobe bangeke balungise labantwana bakho kutsi bangangilandzela, bahlale bekhonza bonkulunkulu bokunye; khona-ke umlilo wendlala kaSimakadze utawuphuma phezu kwenu, nawe uyakufishana ngokushesha.
Lokho lokufanele nikwenze kubo: Niphule ema-altari abo, niphula imihlobiso yabo, nicoce i-ashera yabo, nicubhulele emantongomane abo emlilweni.
ngobe wena umuntfu longcwele kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho; Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, wakukhethela wena kutsi ube ngumnikelorettwa wakhecharo, ngaphezu kwaso sonke sentsapho yemhlaba.
Simakadze akakuthandeni kutsi nikhulu kunawo wonke lamazwe, ngobe nilikhulu kakhulu; kodvwa nincane kunawo wonke lamadolobha.

Ngako-ke Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, watsi kuSimakadze: "Lakho nguNkulunkulu lokungekuhle longeke ukwenze; ngikutshele ukuthi, 'UNkulunkulu wakho, Nkulunkulu wemaSirayeli, utawuchaze ngesandla sakhe esinamandla.'"

Utawazi ke, kutsi uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, yena loNkulunkulu, uThixo lothembekile, logcina inhlanganiso yakhe nekuthula kubo labamthandayo nalabo abagcinela umthetho wakhe, kuze kube yiminyaka lezigidi.
Wababuyisela ebusweni babo labo labamchukumisayo, wababulala; angeke abe nesikhathi sokubabuyisela emehlo abo labo abamuchukumisayo.
Hlala ugcine lomthetho, nemiyalo, nemithetho, lemi ngiyibeka phambi kwakho namuhla.
Uma nikhuluma ngalemiyalo lemi, niyigcina niyenza, Simakadze Nkulunkulu wenu utawugcina kuwe inhlanganiso yakhe nekuthula, njengobe akazange akhulume nababa bakho.

Uyawukuthandela, utawukubambisana nawe, utakukhulumisa; utawukubambisana nawe ngezingane zakho, nekudla kwakho okuhle, nemfuyo yakho, newayini lakho elisha, namafutha akho; utawukubambisana nawe ngemihlambi yakho yengulube, nemihlambi yakho yemakati, emhlabatsini wakhe, lapho wakhuluma ngaso kuma-Israyeli, watsi: 'Ngikunikela kuwe.'
Uya kuba ngumnikelo wesono, utawuba ngumkhonto waSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho; wena nemadvodzana akho kanye nemadvodzakati akho ningeke ningabi namakhosikazi.
Simakadze utawukuvikela kunoma siphi sifo; ngeke akulethe kuwe nasinye sesifo esibi, lesiwazi ngaso eYiputa, kodwa uzolifaka kubo bonke labo abakwenqaba.
Uyawubulala lamazwe lawo wonke, aSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho utawuwanikela phambi kwakho; ungaba nenkinga nabo, futhi ungabatisi bonkulunkulu babo; ngoba lokhu kungeke kube yitfu kuwe.
Uma ukhuluma enhliziyweni yakho, utsi: Lamazwe lawa anamandla kunethu; siyawuwakhipha kanjani?
Uyawukhumbula kutsi yini leSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, akazange ayenze kuFaro nakubo bonkhe bantfu baseMijiphu.

Lamehlo akho akubona zonke izinkinga ezinkulu, nezimpawu, nezinto ezimangalisayo, nesandla esinamandla, nentamo eligcwalisiwe, lapho uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho abekukhipha khona; njalo-ke uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho uyakwenza kuwo wonke lamazwe lawo, lapho wena ungena khona.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, utawubeka buhlungu phakathi kwabo, kuze bakhululwe nalabo labafihlako kuwe.
Ungeke ukhathazeke kubo; ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, ukhona nawe; uNkulunkulu lomkhulu, lowubuhlungu.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, utawuzisusa lezi mindeni phambi kwakho, ngelilanga nelilanga; awungeke ube nakho ukuzibulala ngaso sonke isikhathi, ngobe titfunywa temhlaba zingakukhulu kakhulu.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, utawuzinikela phambi kwakho, utawubaphazamisa kakhulu, kuze baphelelwe.
Utawubanikela emabukhosi abo phambi kwakho, nawe uyawucima amagama abo ngaphansi kwesibhakabhaka; ngeke kubekho lowo longeke abeke phansi ebusweni bakho, wena utawuwabulala bonke.
Lemihlobiso yetibopho zabo niyicwebezele emlilweni; lilanga lesiliva naleligolide liserettweni lakhochare, ningakuthathela wena, ngobe lingaba yintambo yakho; Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, uyamthanda.
Ungeke ufike ufaka indlu yakho noma yini yelezinto letibi, ukuze ungabi nenkinga nayo; kumele uyikhondze kakhulu, uyeke kuyo, ngobe iyinto lebiwe.
Nigcineni yonke imiyalo yami, niyiphumeze, lemi kutsi nihlale niphila, nikhule nikhulule, nifike niyisetshenze ilizwe loSimakadze abetse kubabuphi bakhe.

Uyawukhumbula indlela Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, abekuhamba ngayo leminyaka lengema-40 emhlabatsini, kutsi akukhonze uhlupheke, ukuze akwazi ukuthi yini enhliziyweni yakho: ngabe uyagcina lamandla akhe noma cha.

Wakucindezela, wakwenza uhlupheke ngendlala, wakudlalisa nge-manna, engingakwazanga ngayo wena nababa bakho, kutsi akufundise ukuthi umuntu akaphila ngekudla kuphela, kepha aphila ngaso sonke sive lesiphuma emlonyeni waSimakadze.
Lemigqomo yakho ayisetsi, nenyawo lakho lisetshenziswe kahle leminyaka lengenamashumi lamane.
Ngeke ubone emphefumulweni wakho, kutsi Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, uyakuqeqesha kanye nawe, njengobe uyise eqeqesha umntwana wakhe.
Utawulandzela imiyalo kaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, uhambe ngendlela yakhe, uyeneliseke kuye.
ngobe uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, usakulethela ilizwe lelihle, ilizwe lelinemifula nemishado, namanzi aphuma emhlabatsini lasuka emahlathini nasentaba.
ilizwe lelibomvu, nelibovu, nelimotsi, netinsika, netinkoma; ilizwe lelisemilelweni yegolide kanye nejusi.
Uyakudla emhlabatsini lapho, ube nekudla lokukhulu, ungeke ube nenkinga ngaso sinye; ematshe ayo anesibhakabhaka, kanye netintaba zalo utawuvuna isiliva.
Utawudla, utfolwe, bese ubonga Simakadze Nkulunkulu wakho ngenxa yelizwe lelihle alikunike lona.
Gcwalisa wena, ungeke ukhohlwe kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, ungagcinanga imiyalo yakhe, namasiko akhe, namtsetfo wakhe, labengiwukhuluma kuwe namuhla.
lapho utawudla khona, ube nekudla lokugcwele, bese uhlala emindenini lekahle,
lapho inkomo yakho nengulube yakho ikhula khona, kanye nesiliva lakho negolide lakho likhula khona, kanye naleyo yonke into yakho ikhula khona;
ungabi nebugebengu, ungeke ukhohlwe kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, lowutfumelele ezweni leMijiphu, emhlaba lapho waba ngumkhonzi.

Wakuholela emhlabatsini olukhulu, nemhlabatsini lobuhlungu, lapho kukhona lilanga letfu, nalapho kukhona umkhwenyana, nalapho kukhona inkomo, nalapho kukhona imhlabatsi lomnyama longenawo amanzi; wakwenza amanzi aphuma emahlathini.
Wakudlalisa ema-manna emhlabatsini, lokudla labababuleki bakho abazange bakubona, kutsi akukhonze uhlupheke, kutsi akubonele, ukuze kube lula kuwe ekuhambeni kwakho.
Ungatsi utsi: 'Ngiwutfumele lomhlaba wonke ngemandla ami,' ngobe ngiwutfumele.
Kuye utawukhumbula Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho; ngobe yena lokunika amandla ekukhuleni kwakho, kutsi agcine inhlanganiso yakhe abekhuluma ngayo nababa bakho, njengobe kwenzeke ngalolusuku.
Uma nje usiyalela kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, bese ulandela imihlaba yebanye, uhlala kuwo, uyawubuka kubo; ngikuqinisekisile ngalolusuku kutsi nizophela.
Ngalendlela Simakadze abulala ngayo lamazwe angaphambilini kwenu, niyawufa nawe; ngobe awuzange ulalele amazwi kaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu.
Lingisa, Israele; namuhla uyadlula eJordane, ufike ube ngumnikazi wamasiko lamakhulu kunawe, namandla amakhulu kunewo, nemadolobha amahle anemigangatho ifinyelela entabeni.
Laba bantu banamandla, bephakeme kakhulu; bangase-Enaki; wena uyawuwakhumbula, nawe uyawuva kutsi kwatsi: 'Nguwuphi lowo longeke akhululeke emphinjeni yabanake?'

Uyawuzi kahle ngalolusuku, kutsi uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, lowo lohamba phambi kwakho, ngumlilo lowudla; yena lotawuwabulala, naye loyawubaphazamisa phambi kwakho; wena utawuwakhipha, utawuwabulala ngokushesha, njengobe Simakadze abekutshele.

Ungeke ukhulume enhliziyoni yakho, watsi: 'Kube sengilungile, ngobe Simakadze Nkulunkulu wakho abengisingenisile kulolu mhlaba kutsi ngiwuthathe.' Ngako-ke, ngenxa yebubi balelo lizwe, uSimakadze utawulibakhipha phambi kwakho.

Akufanele ufike ubambe ilizwe labo ngenxa yobulungisa bakho, noma ngenxa yenhlekelele yenhliziyo yakho; kepha ngenxa yekubi kwabo lamazwe lawa, uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho uyawuwukhipha phambi kwakho, ukuze agcine umbuso wakhe, namazwi akhe, abewakhuluma kubaba bakho, kuAbrahama, kuIsake, noYakobi.
Utawazi kutsi Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, akunika lelizwe lelihle lokulifuna; ngobe wena ulungile; kodvwa wena umuntfu lomnyama indlebe.

Khumbula, ungeke ulibale, indlela loyawukhazamisa ngayo Simakadze Nkulunkulu wakho esigabeni setfu; kusukela kurettweni lecharo lasuka ema-Egypti kuya ekufikeni kwenu kulobu mhlaba, niye niyiphula umthetho waSimakadze.
Nalapho emfuleni iSinayini, niyawukhazamisa Simakadze kutsi akukhulule, ngobe wacabanga kutsi utawukufisha.

Nase ngifike emfuleni, kutsi ngithathe ticwecwe tesiliva negolide, ticwecwe lesivumelwano loSimakadze abesinike sona; ngahlala emifuleni emaviki lamashumi mane namakhulu mahlanu ebusuku; angidlanga inhlanzi, angidle amanzi.

Watsi Simakadze wamnika ticwecwe letimbili tesiliva negolide, tabhalwe ngesandla saNkulunkulu; nalapho kwabe kubhalwe kuwo wonke lamazwi aSimakadze abekhuluma nani emfuleni, kusuka embindini wemlilo, ngosuku lwekuhlangabeza.
Ekupheleni kwelilanga lemashumi mane nebusuku bemashumi manhlanu, Simakadze wamnikela ngetibopho letimbili tesiliva nelibobhozo, tibopho tesivumelwano.
Watsi uSimakadze kuye: "Thiba, uyeke lapha ngokushesha; ngobe bantfu bakho, labewakhipha eMijiphu, baphelelwe livi; baphazamisa kulelo langa ngilibawise ngalo; bakha igolide lelitshiswayo."
Simakadze watsi ngami: "Ngibabone laba bantu, ngibona kutsi banesifuba sesandla esibuhlungu kakhulu.
Lahla mina, ngitawubabulala, ngiwususe igama labo ngezansi kwesibhakabhaka; kodvwa wena ngitakwenza ube yinhlanga lenamandla kunaleyo, nelikhulu kuneleyo.
Ngiye ngabuyela ngaphuma emfuleni, ngobe umfula ube nemlilo, nginetibopho letimbili tesivumelwano esandla sami.
Nami ngabheka, ngabona ukuthi nibe sewubusile kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu; nibe sewulungiselele igolide, nesiliva, negolide elibomvu, negolide lelibomvu, negolide lelibomvu, negolide lelibomvu.
Nami ngatsi: "Lawo macwecwe lamane, ngiwakhipha emilenzeni yami, ngiwaphula phambi kwenu."

Ngase ngibe sengihlala ngaphambilini kuSimakadze emaviki lamashumi mane nezinsuku lamakhulu mahlanu, ngaphandle kwekudla inyama noma ukuphuza amanzi, ngenxa yesono senu sonke esibe sekwenzela lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, kutsi nimukhaze.
Nami ngaze ngati, ngobe ngibe sengikhathazekile ngenxa yebuhlungu benhliziyo yaSimakadze, lapho akazange akususeni khona; kodvwa Simakadze wamlalela.
Simakadze waba nebuhlungu kakhulu ku-Aron, wafuna ukumbulala; kodvwa ngathandaza nge-Aron naleso sikhathi.

Nalo mkhwenyana longcolile, lona lomnqumo wenu, labewugcinele, ngawukhipha ngemlilo, ngawucindezela, ngawufafaza kuze ube nguthuli oluncane kakhulu, ngawufaka uthuli kulo mfula losuka emfuleni lophuma emfuleni.
NakwaTabera, nakwaMasa, nakwaKibrothi-hataava, naloko lakwenta kutsi uSimakadze agweme.

Nalapho uSimakadze ekusithumela khona kusuka eKadeshe-barnea, watsi: "Sukeni niyibambe lelizwe labengingakunikela ngalo kuwe." Kodwa niye naphula umthetho waNkulunkulu wenu, ningawukholwanga, ningawulalelanga.
Ube uhlala ungenelela kuSimakadze kusukela ngaleso sikhathi lapho ngikujwayele khona.
Ngatsi ke, ngabeka ubuso bam phambi kuSimakadze emaviki lamane nelilanga lemine nebusuku bemini lemine; ngobe Simakadze abesho kutsi uyakubulalani.

Nami ngathandaza kuSimakadze, ngitsi: "Simakadze longuSomandla, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ungabi nenkinga nalabo bantu bakho, labo bantu bakho, labawukhulule ngemandla akho amakhulu, labewakhipha eMisri ngesandla sakho esiqinile.
Khumbula labakhonzi bakho, uAbrahama, neIsakha, naYakobi; ungaboni lilanga lebantfu labo, noma ububi babo, noma umonakalo wabo.

Ngase-ke batawutsi abantu balomhlaba lowutfumele wona, bethi, Ngako-ke Simakadze angeke abe nekhono lokuwafaka ezweni lakhe, labewazibophelela lona, ngobe wabavutha, wabakhipha waya kuwabulala eGibhithe.
Bangaba bantu bakho, bantfu labakhona wena, labewaphuma ngamandla akho amakhulu, nesandla sakho esiqinile.
Ngeleso sikhathi Simakadze watsi kuye: "Cinga itibopho ezimbili tesiliva nelibomvu, njengobe zazingaphambilini, ufike ungene kulo mfula ngikhombisene nawe; wenze nebhokisi legolide.
Ngitabhalela emacwecwe langaphambilini, lakuboniswa emacwecwe langaphambilini, labewephula; wena uyawubeka emacwecwe ebhokisini.
Nami ngakwenza ibhokisi lesihlahla se-akademu, nashona tibhodi letimbili tesiliva nemlotsi njengetfu langaphambilini, ngaphuma ngafika emfuleni, nginetibopho letimbili esandla sami.

Wabhala emacwecwe langaphambili lokubhala kwakhe kuqala, amazwi lamashumi lalishumi, akhuluma ngawo kuni emfuleni, kusuka enhliziyweni yemlilo, ngosuku lokuhlangatshiswa; watsi uSimakadze wanikela ngawo.
Ngiye ngabuyela, ngaphuma emfuleni, ngabeka tibhodi ebhokisini labengisalile, lihlala khona, njengobe Simakadze abemiwiselise kutsi ngikwenze.
Baphuma basuka e-Ephithathi-jaakan, bafika eMosera; khona wafa uAron, wabanjwa khona, wahlala khona uEleazari, umsa wakhe, abe ngumnikelo wesono endaweni yakhe.
Basuka khona bahamba befika eGudgoda, bese besuka eGudgoda befika eJotbata, ilizwe lelinemifula yamanzi.

Ngeleso sikhathi uSimakadze wahlukanisa suku laLevi, ukuba lithathe ibhokisi lesivumelwano seNkulunkulu, libe phambi kuNkulunkulu, lisebenze kuye, libe nesibopho sokubambisana ngegama lakhe, kuze kube manje.
Ngako-ke laLevi akazange abe nengxenye naleyo mindeni; Simakadze uyawube yinxalenye yakhe, njengobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, wakhuluma kuye.
Nami ngahlala kulo mfula, njengaleso sikhathi sakuqala, iminyaka lemashumi lamane nezinsuku lemashumi lamane nelilanga; Simakadze wamlalela nalolu daba, akazange akususe.
Simakadze watsi kuye: "Thumela laba bantu, uhambe nabo, ukuze bafike babambe itfu lelizwe labengingati kutsi ngitawulibanikela kubo.' "

Manje-ke, Israele, yini leyawukucela yona uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, ngaphandle kwekuti ube nekuthula noNkulunkulu wakho, uhambe ngendlela yakhe, umthande, ube ngumkhonzi waNkulunkulu wakho ngentliziyo yakho yonke nemoya yakho yonke,
kutsi ugcine imiyalo yaSimakadze, kanye nemithetho yakhe, lengingakuncenga ngayo namuhla, ukuze kube lula kuwe.
Bona, izulu, nezulu lelikhulu, nguSimakadze longuSomandla wakho, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, kanye nemhlaba kanye nalowo wonke.
Ngako-ke Simakadze, lowo layawuthandala bantfu bakababa bakho, wabonga kubo, wabakhethela wena kutsi ube ngumnyakazo wabo phezu kwalabo bonke abantu, njengobe kubonisiwe ngalolusuku.
Lakho, shintsheni imimoya yenu, nehlabeni lokubi.

ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, uNkulunkulu mkhulu kunabo bonke bonkulunkulu, nguSimakadze longuSomandla, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, lowo mkhulu, lonamandla, lowukhathazayo, longeke abeke isandla sakhe kumuntu, noma athathe inhlawulo.
Uye ulungisa umfowabo kanye nenkosikazi yakhe; uyawuthanda nalowo lohlala nawe, wanikela ngekudla nakugqoko lakhe.
Natsi niyawuthanda nalowo losuka ngaphandle, ngobe nibekhona nisuka ngaphandle eMijiphu.
LoSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho utawukwesaba, uyewukhonta yena, ube nekuthula naye; ngegama lakhe uyakwenza nalowo mnikelo wesono.
Nkulunkulu wakho, lowo uyawukubonga; yena lowenza kuwe zonke lezi zinto ezinkulu nezingalibaleki, letimehlo akho akubonayo.
Babe-Israyeli babemashumi lamakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa, lapho baphuma khona eMisri; ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, wakwenza wena ube likhulu njengamaphuphu asemazulu.
Uyawuthanda Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, ugcine imiyalo yakhe, nemibandela yakhe, namasiko akhe, nemiyalelo yakhe, nsuku zonke.

Namuhla, khumbulani lokudla lokuwudle; ngobe ngikhuluma nabantwana benu, labo abazange bakwazi, labazange babone kutsi uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, wakwenta yini kuwe; bangaliboni ubukhulu bakhe, nesandla sakhe esinamandla, nemilenze yakhe eyimisiwe,
kanye nemizekelo yakhe, naleyo ayenze eMisri kuFaro, lomkhuluwa weMisri, nemhlaba wakhe wonke.

Nalo akazange akubona lokudla kwakhe emkhosini wema-Egipta, emahhashi abo nemilenze yabo, lapho abeke khona amanzi eMfula iSundu phezu kwabo, lapho bekubopha nabo; ngobe uSimakadze wababulala bonke, kuze kube limini lenhle.
Bangabona kutsi yini leyawukwenta kuwe emhlabatsini, kuze nifike lapha,

kanye nalapho abewenza khona kuDathani neAbironi, bantfu baseRhubeni, lamakhosikazi eEliab, lapho umhlaba uvule khona umlomo wakhe phambi kwalabo bonkhe labaSirayeli, wababulala nabo, nemindeni yabo, netente labo, naleyo silwane ngasinye sabo.
Lamehlo enu akubona zonke lezi zinto ezinkulu Simakadze abezenzayo.
"Nihlale nilandzela yonke imiyalo lengingakuletsa ngayo ngalolusuku, kutsi nibe nemandla lokuya ezweni lenu, niyithathe njengelifa lakho, nifike niyibambe.
bese nihlala isikhathi eside emhlabatsini, lapho Simakadze abetse kutsi utawubanikela khona bababa bakho kanye nemindeni yabo, mhlabatsini losuka emajikijolo nemvu.
Lemhlaba lowuya kuwo wena uyawuwuhlala, awufana nemhlaba we-Egypt, lapho niphuma khona, lapho ufaka khona isitshalo sakho, bese uyidlalisa ngesandla sakho, njengobe umvini.
Lemhlaba lowudlula kuwo kutsi uwuba neso, yilizwe lelinemifula nemifula, lidla umhwamuko wezulu.
Imhlaba loSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho uyawuwukhathalela, amehlo akhe ehamba kuwo njalo, kusukela ekuqalekeni kwemnyaka kuya kukuphela kwalo.
"Ukuba nihlala nilalela imiyalo yami, lemikhuluma ngayo ngalolusuku, niyawuthanda uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, niwusebenzele ngentliziyo yenu yonke nemoya yenu yonke,
utawunikela ngemvula emhlabatsini lwakho ngesikhathi saso, ngasebusika nasentwasahlobo; uyawuvuna umhluzi wakho, newayini lakho lelibomvu, nemafutha akho.
Uyawunikela ngekudla emhlabatsini lakho, kutsi lidle lenyama yakho; nawe utawudla ube setfu.
Kutsi-ke, khumbulani kutsi angeke nikhonjwe, ningase nihambe nisebenzele kanye nalabangcwele babanye.
ngobe kungeke kuphele umphiko waSimakadze phezu kwenu, aze avale izulu, kutsi kungabi nemvula, nemhlaba awunikeze umkhicito wakhe; niyawufa ngokushesha ezweni lelihle loNkulunkulu abeninika lona.
La mazwi ami niyawuwabeka enhliziyweni yenu, nasenhliziyweni yenu; niyawuwabopha njengephawu esandlani, niyawuwabeka emehlweni enu njengesikhumbuzo.
Watsi: "Lemiyalo lemingcwele, niyifundise izingane tenu; khuluma ngayo lapho uhlala khona ekhaya nalapho uhamba khona ngendlela, lapho ulala khona nalapho uphuma khona.
Utawuzibhalela emaphiko emnyango wendlu yakho, nakwemiganga yakho.
ukuze nihlale isikhathi eside, nine nemadvodzana akho, emhlaba lapho Simakadze abekhuluma ngawo kubobaba bakho kutsi utawubanikela khona, kuze kube lilanga lezulu lingaphansi kwemhlaba.
Uma nihlala nilandzela yonke lemiyalelo lemi ngiyikhuluma kuwe, kutsi niphile uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, nihambe ngendlela yakhe eyawuthanda ngayo, nikhonte kuye,
Simakadze Nkulunkulu wenu utawuzibulala zonke lezi bantfu phambi kwenu, niyawuhlala emhlabatsini lwebantfu labakhulu nalabanamandla kunaye.
Nakho nalapho tinyawo takho tihlala khona, lemhlaba wakho utawuba wakho; kusuka eGibhithe neLibanoni kuya emfuleni i-Euphrates, kuze kube selwandle elikhulu, lomhlaba wakho utawuba wakho.
Angeke kubekho umuntu loyawuhlala ebusweni bakho; Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, utawubeka umfutho wakho kuwo wonke lamakhosi emhlaba lapho uyafika khona, njengobe wakusho kuwe.
Bona, namuhla ngikubeka phambi kwakho phakathi kwebubi nebubi.
Uya kuba nekuthula, uma ulalela imiyalo kaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, lemi ngikuwisela wena namuhla.

Lalana, uma ningeke nilalele imiyalo kawari Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, kodwa nisuka enhliziyweni yenu kuleyo ndlela lapho ngikuwiselayo ngayo namuhla, nilandelela bonkulunkulu babanye, laba ningabawazi.
Nalapho Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, ekulethela khona lemhlaba lapho uphuma khona uyawuwuhlala khona, wena utawubeka lomnikelo wesono emfuleni iGarizimu, nelomnikelo wesilandza emfuleni iEbali.
Lomhlabatsi ukhona ngasenyakatho yeJordane, lapho lilanga liphuma khona, ezweni lama-Kananani ahlala emahlathini aseJordane, eduze kweGilgala, eduze netintaba taMore.
ngobe niyadlula eJordane, kutsi nifike niyibambe lemhlaba loSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu utawuwunikela kuwe; bese niwuthatha nihlala kuwo.
Hlala ugcine ulandzela tonkhe timiso takho netimiso temtsetfo, letitsi ngitibeka phambi kwakho namuhla.
Lokho kulomyalo kanye nemithetho, niyigcineni, niyiphumeze, ezweni leSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, utawukulethela ukuba lilungu lakho, nsuku zonke lapho niphila khona phezu kwemhlaba.
Niyisuse nhlobo zonke izindawo, lapho lamazwe niyawukhipha khona ema-Amoni, abehlala khona ema-Amoni abo, emadolobheni aphakeme, emabhishi, nangaphansi kwesihlahla sonke esimhlophe.
Niyibuyele ema-altari abo, niwubhutse umbhoshongo wabo, niwucweberettse ngecharu, nisuse imihlobiso yabo yetigodvo, nemagama abo aphelelwe kuwo lamadolobha labo.
Ungabambi Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, njengendlela labo bebambisana ngayo nalabo bonkulunkulu babo.
Kuleyo ndawo Simakadze Nkulunkulu wenu ayawukhetha kuyo tonkhe tive tenu, kutsi libekwe khona igama lakhe, niya kuyo; niyifune lendawo lapho ahlala khona, niye khona.

Lakhona nifikeni neminikelo yenu yokushiswa, nemnikelo wenu wesono, neminikelo yenu yeshumi, neminikelo yenu yesikhashana, neminikelo yenu yekunikela ngesandla, nalabo bazalwa kuqala emihlambini yenu, nemindeni yenu.
Nidle khona phambi kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, ninemindeni yenu, nani nemndeni wenu, nijabulise ngaso sonke sifiso sesandla sam, lapho Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, ekubumbise khona.
Awufanele ukwenze njengendlela lesihleli ngayo lapha namuhla, lapho wonke umuntu esenza khona lokho acabanga kutsi kulungile.
Nawe, ani, wena nakwesabiwa ngaleyo ndawo ibhalwe ngamazwi aNkulunkulu?
"Manje-ke uma nidlula eJordane, nahlala kwelinye ilizwe loNkulunkulu wenu uyawukunika lona kutsi libe yitfupha lenu; naye uzoninika lokuphumula kusuka kubo bonkhe lababubi benu labangaphandle kwenu.

Kulapho Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, ekhetha khona igama lakhe kutsi lihlale khona, utawunikela khona ngaso sonke sinye isive sakho, neminikelo yakho yokushiswa, neminikelo yenu yeshumi, nemnikelo wenu wesono, kanye nayinye yezinto zenu ezifanele kakhulu, nize nizifake kuSimakadze.

Niyawuphumula khona phambi kwaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, ninemadvodzana enu, nemadvodzakati enu, nalabakhonzi benu, nalabakhonzi benu, naLevi lohlala ezindaweni zenu, ngobe angeke abe nemfelokazi wakhe.
Khumbula kutsi utawunikela ngeminikelo yakho yekushiswa lapho uyayifuna khona.
Kulapho Simakadze atawukukhethela khona, esinye semindeni yakho, lapho utawuzinikela khona; khona utawukwenza konke lokushiwo nguSimakadze.

Ngako-ke ungadla inyama ngaso sonke isikhathi lesifunako inhliziyo yakho, nguNkulunkulu wakho lokunika wona, kuwo wonke lamagceke akho; lowo angabi nelowo ohlanzekile bangawudla, njengokudla kwengulube noma kwengubo.
kodvwa igazi lakhe ungeke ulidle; kufanele lifafaze emhlabatsini njengemanti.

Ungeke udle kulolu mhlabatsini lwakho, ishumi lekudla kwakho, newayini lakho, nemafutha akho, nalabo bazalwa kuqala emihlambini yakho, nalabo bazalwa kuqala emakhoboka akho, nalowo wonke lomnikelo wakho wesono, nalowo wonke lomnikelo wakho wokunikela ngesandla, nalowo wonke lomnikelo wakho wesono.

Kunelapho utawudla khona phambi kwaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, lapho akhetha khona, wena nonyana wakho, nendvodzakati yakho, nomkhonzi wakho, nemkhonzi yakho, naLevi lohlala ezindaweni zakho; nawe uyawuphumula phambi kwaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, ngaso sonke isimo sesandla sakho.
Gcwalisa kutsi ungeke walibala laLevi, nsuku zonke lapho uhlala khona ezweni lakho.
"'Uma Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, ekhulisa ilizwe lakho, njengobe wakusho kuwe, bese utsi: 'Ngifuna ukudla inyama', uma ufuna kudla inyama, khona-ke ungadla inhlanzi kutsi uyifune.

Uma indawo lapho uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, akhetha khona igama lakhe kutsi libekwe kuyo, ihlala eduze kwakho, khona-ke ungadla emindenini yakho, ngemihlambi yengulube naleyo mihlambi yengulube, Simakadze abekuleta kuwe, njengobe ngikuwisela umthetho ngayo; ungadla kuwo emafulethini akho, kuze kube sekudla kwenhliziyo yakho.
Uyawudla ngayo njengobe udla igazi, kanye nengulube; lowo longcolile nalowo ohlanzekile bangayidla.
Kusekho Arenatsi ugcine kutsi ungadli ubhiya, ngobe umphefumulo ngumoya; kodvwa ungadli umphefumulo nenyama.
Ungayidla igazi lakhe; kufanele ulifute emhlabatsini njengamanzi.
Ungayidla, ukuze kube lula kuwe kanye nabantwana bakho ngemuva kwakho, uma usenza lokuhle emehloni kaSimakadze.
Kunekwenta lokungcwele kuwe, kanye neminikelo yakho yesono, uye endlwini leSimakadze ayawukhetha kuyo.

Utawunikela ngeminikelo yakho yokushiswa, nemfuyo yayo kanye negazi layo, enhliziyweni yaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho; kepha igazi lelihlanganisiwe lelihlanganiswe nenyama yakho yemnikelo wesono kumele litfolwe eduze kwenhlanhla yaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, kepha inyama yalo ungayidla.

Hamba ulalele la mazwi onke, lawa ngikubonise wena, ukuze kube lula kuwe, nawe nemadvodzana akho ngemuva kwakho, kuze kube njalo, uma ungena ekwenzeni lokuhle nelokuhle emehlo kaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, utawucindza ema-Israyeli emehlweni akho, ezweni lapho uyaphuma khona uyawuhlala kulo; bese utawuwakhipha, uhlala kulomhlaba wabo.

khumbula, ungeke ube necala lokuya ngendlela yabo, ngemuva kokuba bakhululwe phambi kwakho; ungase usibuze mayelana nalabo bonkulunkulu babo, utsi: Ngendlela lamadolobha lawa akhuluma ngayo naboNkulunkulu wabo, nathi sitawukhuluma njalo.

Ungeke usebenzele Simakadze Nkulunkulu wakho ngendlela yabo; ngobe konke lokubi loNkulunkulu akushoyo, labo bakwenza kulabo bonkulunkulu babo; nabo-ke babulala izingane zabo ezincane nezingane zabo ezinkulu emlilweni, babe ngumnikelo wesono kuboNkulunkulu wabo.
Lawo onkhe emalungiselelo labengikwenta kuwe, khumbula kutsi uyawuwenza; ungakwengeza lutho kuwo, kodvwa ungawuciphisi.
Kungeke kufike phakathi kwenu umprofeti, noma lowo lochaza iphupho, akusho kuwe imfihlakalo noma inhlekelele.
Nakuba ibonakaliso, noma inhlekelele, akhuluma ngayo, yafika, watsi: "Siye silandele ema-gods labanye," lama-gods angeke uwazi, "siyawubanikela kubo,"

ungawuvumeli lowo mprofeti, noma lowo umphuphi wephupho; ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, uyawukusindzisa, kutsi abone ukuthi ningamuthanda yini Nkulunkulu wenu ngentliziyo yenu yonke nemoya yenu yonke.
Uyawulandzela Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, nawe utawumuhlonipha, utawugcina imiyalo yakhe, utawuwulalela, uyawukhonza naye, nawe utawuhamba kuye.

Umprofeti lowo, noma lowo umphuphi, kumele abulawe; ngobe wakhuluma nawe kutsi uphume kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, lowawutfusa ezweni leMijiphu, ukuze akuvulele indlu yebugebengu, wafuna ukukususa enhliziyweni yakho indlela lapho Simakadze, uNkulunkulu wakho, abekusho ngayo ukuthi uhambe ngayo. Ngako-ke kufanele ususe lokubi phakathi kwakho.

"Uma umngane wakho, noma unyana wakho, noma intombi yakho, noma indvodzakati yakho, noma umshado wakho, noma umhlobo wakho, ekhuluma kuwe, ethi: 'Siye sikhonze ema-gods labanye,' labo awazi wena nababa bakho,
nguNkulunkulu webantfu labangaphansi kwenu, labo bakhona kanye nalabo abade, kusukela ekugcineni kwemhlaba kuya kukuphela kwalo.
Lakho-ke, ungabi nekuthula nabo; ungeke ube nenhlonipho yabo.
Utawubabulala; isandla sakho kumele siqale kubitwa kwabo, nesandla sema-Israyeli wonke kufanele sihambe ngemuva.
Uyawubabulala ngemlilo, kuze bafe; ngobe befuna kukususa kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, lowo watfumisa ezweni leMijiphu, lapho waba ngumuntfu lomkhonzi.
Lawo ma-Israyeli ayawukubona, abe nebuhlungu, ngobe ngeke kubekho namunye wenu loyawuqhubeka ekwenzeni lokhu.
uma ukhuluma ngelinye lamadolobha akho, loSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho akunika wona kutsi uhlale kulo,
Laba bantu lababi baphuma emiphakathini yakho, bakhohlisa bantfu bedolobha labo, batsi: Siye sikhonze ema-gods amanye, lama-gods lasingawazi.
"Lakho-ke kufanele ubhekane nalo, uyihlolisise, usibuze ngesandla sakho; uma kuyiqiniso, bese kuqinisekiswa kutsi kube sekwenzekile lokudla lokubi phakathi kwenu,
Niyawubulala bonke labasekhona kulo mji ngesandla, niwuphelele lokubi, nalowo wonke lowo mji kanye nenyama yakhe.

Lawo emabhishi atawucutshungulwa, uyawuwahlanganisa emidlweni yendlela yakhe, uyawuwubulala lomhlaba wonke kanye naleyo ndawo, ube ngumnikelo wekushiswa kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho; kumele abe yimahhashi lalahlekile kuze kube sekupheleni; ngeke ibuye ibe yindlu kuze kube sekupheleni.

Ningeke nigcine lutho kulelo lidini elihlanganisiwe, ukuze uSimakadze abuye emphilweni yendlala yakhe, abe nekuthula nawe, abe nenhlonipho nawe, abe nenani elikhulu kuwe, njengobe wakhuluma kubo-baba bakho.

UNkulunkulu wakho utawukwenza lokhu, uma ulandzela amazwi kaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, kutsi ugcine yonke imiyalo yakhe, engikushoyo kuwe ngalolusuku, ukwenze lokho kulungile emehloni kaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wako.
Niyimadvodzana aSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu; uma umuntu efa, ningeke nicwebe, ningeke nicwebe inhloko yenu.
ngobe wena umuntfu longcwele kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho; Simakadze ukhethe wena ukuba ube ngumnikelo wakhe wesono, ngaphezu kwaso sonke sentsapho lekhona phezu kwemhlaba.
Ungeke udle noma yini leyimfihlakalo kuSimakadze.
Lolu hlobo lwesilwane ningeke nisidle: ingulube, nemvu, nembuzi,
tingulube, igazilela, tingulube temhlabatsini, tingulube temhlabatsini, i-ibex, i-antilope, netingulube temhlaba.
Ungadla noma yimuphi mhlambi wetilwane letinemilebe lehlukaniswe ibe ngemaviki lasitfupha, kanye neletinyama tekudla.
"Lamuhla-ke ningeke nidle ingulube, noma inkomo, nome umkhwenyana, noma lenyama yemhlabatsini; ngobe lezi zidla ngekudla kwazo, kepha zingabi nemphimbo yato ehlukanisiwe. Ziba nandzawo kuwe.
Nengulube nayo ingcolile kuwe, ngobe inemilenze lemibili, kepha ayidla lilanga; kufanele kutsi ungadli inyama yawo, noma ucoce imfuyo yabo.
Lolu hlobo lwezinto letiphilako emanti ningeke nilidle, nome ngabe linemilenze noma linesibhakabhaka.
Lawo lasingaba nemilenze noma nemacici, ningawadla; angeke abe ngububi kuwe.
Ungadla noma yimuphi mhlambi lohlanzekile.
Lolu hlobo lwetingulube ningeke nilidle: i-eagle, ne-vulture, ne-osprey,
ikati lelibomvu, i-falcon, noma yiluphi uhlobo lwekati
noma yimuphi hlobo lwetingulube
i-ostriche, i-owl, i-seagull, noma yimuphi hlobo lwe-hawk,
i-owl lencane, i-owl enkulu, i-horned owl,
i-pelican, i-vulture, i-cormorant,
i-stork, noma yimuphi hlobo lwe-heron, i-hoop, ne-bat.
Lonke lilanga lephilako lelibanjwa ngumoya, lingeke nilidle; lingabi nebubi kuwe.
kepha ningeke nidle noma yini lephilako lelinetinyawo letinyenti.

Ungeke udle noma yini leyifile, kepha ungayinikela kulowo wesikhashana lohlala emigwaqeni yakho, ukuze ayeke ukuyidla, noma uyithengise kulowo wesikhashana; ngobe wena ungumuntfu longcwele, lobekwe nguSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho. Awukucoci ingulube emlilweni wemama wayo.
Lomnyaka ngamunye qiniseka kutsi ubeka phansi ishumi lelinye laletinye timbewu letiphuma emhlabatsini lakho.

Uya kulidla phambi kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, endlwini yakhe, lapho akhetha khona igama lakhe kutsi lihlale khona, ishumi lembewu yakho, newayini lakho elisha, nephethiloli yakho, kanye nalabo bakhulu bemihlambi yakho, nemindeni yenu, ukuze ufunde ukubambisana noSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, nsuku zonke.

Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, utawukubambisana nawe kakhulu, kuze kube khona lapho akhetha khona igama lakhe lide kakhulu kuwe, nendlela ibe likhulu kakhulu kuwe, ukuze ungabi naleyo ngxenye yakho yeshumi.
bese uyithengisa ngemali, uthathe lemali ngesandla sakho, uye endaweni lapho Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, ayawukhetha khona.

bese uthenga ngemali yakho yonke into leyayifuna inhliziyo yakho, inyama yenkomo, nengulube, newayini, nekudla lokushisayo, nanoma yini leyayifuna inhliziyo yakho; bese udla khona phambi kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, wena nendlu yakho, uyenelise.
NaLevi, lohlala emigwaqeni yakho, ungawukhohlwa; ngobe angeke abe nengxenye yemhlaba wakhe.
Ekupheleni kwemnyaka wesithathu, utawukhipha yinye yemashumi lamane ekudla kwalowomnyaka, uyigcine emigwaqeni yakho.

khona-ke uLevi, longeke abe nengxenye yakhe, nalowo mkhwenyana, nalowo mkhuluwa, naleyo nkosikazi, lohlala emigwaqeni yakho, afike aze adle, atfole; ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, uzokubambisana nawe kuwo wonke umsebenzi wakho lowenza.
Ekupheleni kweminyaka lesikhombisa, kufanele ukhokhe tonkhe timali.

Lokho kumele kusetjentwe: Wonke lowo unikela ngemali emndenini wakhe, kufanele alungise. Angeke afune kubuyiswa kwesokudla kwakhe noma kwesobunxele kwakhe; ngobe isikhathi saSimakadze sokungalungiswanga sekumemetwe.
Ungeke ufune kubuyiswa kwemali kulowo laphuma ngaphandle, kepha kufanele ususe noma yini lomunye waseSirayeli atawukukhokha kuwe.
Angeke kube khona umtfubi phakathi kwakho; ngobe Simakadze utawukubambisana nawe kakhulu emhlabatsini loNkulunkulu wakho, lowo Nkulunkulu wakho, akunika wona kutsi ube ngumnikazi walo,
uma nje ulandzela ngesandla Arenani waSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, ubonkhe lolu mthetho ngiwukhuluma kuwe ngalo lilanga lesi.

ngobe uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, uyakubambisana nawe, njengobe wakusho kuwe; wena utawunikela ngemali emindenini emikhulu, kodvwa wena awungeke ube nenkinga yokuthatha inhlawulo; wena utawulawula emindenini emikhulu, kodwa yena ngeke akhulume nawe.
-ke uma kukhona umkhonto phakathi kwalabo bakho, ngaso sonke isikhundla sawo emhlabatsini wakho, lapho uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho ukunika khona, ungacicelisi sandla sakho kuye lowo mkhonto.
Kutsi-ke, nibe nesandla senu sivulekile, nibakhokhele kahle noma yini lebafunayo.

Gcwalisa wena, ungeke kube khona lutho lokubi enhliziyweni yakho lokushoyo: "Umnyaka wesishiyagalolunye, ngonyaka wekubuyiselwa umshwalense, uyafika," ngobe imehlo akho ahlale ebuhlungu kulowo mdlwane wakho waseSirayeli, ukuze ungamniki nakuphi! Ngaleyo ndlela angaba nesono ngawe emkhoneni kaSimakadze.
Uyawubanikela nabo, utawubanikela ngesandla sakho, ungabi nemehlo ebuhlungu; ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, uyakubambisana nawe kuwo wonke umsebenzi wakho, nakweso sonke simiso sakho.
Kunebantfu labafayo emhlabatsini lenu; ngakho-ke ngikuletsa kutsi uvule isandla sakho kubo bonkhe bantfu labafayo, nalabo abahluphekile, labangani bakho baseSirayeli.
"Uma utsatsa umfana noma indodana yeSirayeli, bese uyinikela kuwe iminyaka lesikhombisa; kumnyaka wesitsatfu utawuyawukhipha abe ngumuntfu lokhululekile.
Nalapho nitawubakhipha khona, ningabasusa bengenalutho.
Utawubanikela ngemihlambi yakho, nemfuyo yakho, nemhlabatsi wewayini lakho; utawubanikela ngaleyo ndlela Simakadze Nkulunkulu wakho abekubambisela ngayo.
Uyawukhumbula kutsi ube ngumkhonzi eMisri, ngobe uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho watfumisa; ngakho-ke ngikuphendvula ngitsi: UNkulunkulu wesive senu, Simakadze.
Nakuba umkhonzi wakho ekhuluma kuwe, watsi: 'Angeke ngikushiye', ngobe uyawuthanda wena nendlu yakho, ngobe afuna kuhlala nawe.
bese uthatha isandla lesicwebezelayo, uyewubopha emlonyeni wakhe kuya emnyango, aze abe ngumkhonzi wakho kuze kube sekuphele kuphila kwakhe; njalo-ke wenze nenkosikazi yakho.

Ungeke ucabange ukuthi kunzima kuwe kutsi umkhonzi wakho aphume ekhululekile, ngobe iminyaka lesikhombisa yenkonzo yakhe ifana neminyaka emihlanu yomuntfu lokhokhelwa; Simakadze Nkulunkulu wakho utawukubambisana nawe kuwo wonke umsebenzi wakho.
-ke uphindze unike kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, wonke umhlambi wemakati akho nalawo emakati emndenini wakho; ungawusebenzisi umhlambi wemakati wakho, uma ungeke ugcine umhlambi wemakati akho.
KuSimakadze Nkulunkulu Arena, Nkulunkulu wakho, wena nemndeni wako, niyidle iminyaka ngemnyaka, endaweni leyawuyikhetha.
Uma isilwane sinenkinga, uma sikhulu, noma sicobile, noma sinenkinga leyindilinga, ungayinikela kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho.
Uyawudla kuwo emathempelini akho; lowo longcolile kanye nalowo ohlanzekile bangawudla, njengobe bakudla i-gazela noma i-erhi.
kodvwa igazi lakhe ungeke ulidle; kufanele lifafaze emhlabatsini njengemanti.
"Ungeke ugcine umthendeleko waSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, ngemnyaka we-Abib; ngobe ngumnyaka we-Abib lapho Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, akwentela khona ekuphumeni kwakho eMfuleni iJordani.
Utawunikela ngepasha kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, ngenyama yakho lencane nenyama yakho enkulu, endaweni lapho Simakadze lakhetha khona igama lakhe kutsi lihlale khona.

Angeke uyidle nekudla lokuhlanganisiwe; lilanga lesitsatfu uyawudla ukudla okungahlanganisiwe, inyama yebuhlungu, ngobe waphuma eMijiphu ngekukhawulela, kutsi ukhumbulamini lokuphuma kwakho eMijiphu yonke imihla yakho.
Kungeke kuboneke umhluzi kuwo onkhe emadolobha akho, ngelilanga lesitsatfu; nenyama yakho loyawuyinikela ngasebusuku besuku lokuqala ngeke ihlale kuze kube ngumantsi.
Angeke ukhonze iPasha kunoma kuphi emindenini yakho, lapho Simakadze Nkulunkulu wakho akunika khona.

Kulapho Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, atawukhetha khona igama lakhe kutsi lihlale khona, lapho utawulibambisa khona ebusuku, lapho lifika khona lilanga, kuleso sikhathi sakusihlwa lapho waphuma khona eMijiphu.
Uya kulihlaza, uyidle lapho Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, akhetha khona; bese ubuyela etenteni lenu ekuseni.
Ngelilanga lesine utawudla inyama engenasici; ngelilanga lesisikhombisa kube nekuhlangana lokukhulu kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho; ungasebenzisi nhlobo umsebenzi.
Utawubala emaviki lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu, kusukela lapho utawuqala khona kutsila emhlabatsini.
Utagcina umnyaka wesihlanu kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, utawunikela ngemnikelo wekushiswa losuka enhliziyweni yakho; utawunikela ngaleīvuko taSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, labewukunika.

Uya kuphumula phambi kwaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, lapho atawukhetha khona igama lakhe, wena nemadvodzana akho, nemadvodzakati akho, nalowo mkhonzi wakho, naleyo mkhonzi yakho, naLevi losemnyango wakho, nalowo mkhwenyana, nalowo malume, nalowo umviwa, labakhona phakathi kwako.
Kutawutsi ukhumbula kutsi ube ngumkhonto eMisre, bese ugcina ulandzela lemithetho.
Utagcina usuku lwetindlu temhlabatsini iminyaka lesikhombisa, lapho usebentisa khona imbewu yakho kanye newayini lakho lokuphuza.

Nceda uphumule kulolu hlelo lwakho, wena nendodana yakho nenkosikazi yakho, nomkhonzi wakho nenkosikazi yakho, naLevi, nalowo ohlala ezweni lakho, nalowo ohlala emakhazeni akho, nalowo ohlala ekhaya lakho.

Uyakwenza usuku lokungcwele kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, lilanga lesisikhombisa, endaweni lapho Simakadze atawukhetha khona; ngobe uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, uyakubambisa yonke imfuyo yakho, nayinye imisebenzi yesandla sakho, nawe ujabulise.

Emahoreni lamashumi lamabili nesihlanu emnyaka, wonke lowesifazane wakho kufanele afike phambi kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, endaweni yakhe leyawuyikhethela; emthendelekweni wema-ovini angakhukhi, nemthendeleko yeviki, nasemcimbini wetibondza; ngeke kubekho lowo ufika phambi kuSimakadze ngesandla sakhe esingenalutho.
Nalowo nalowo utawunikela ngemandla akhe, ngaleyo mbhaka yeSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, lowutfumele kuwe.
Utawubeka emajaji nebaholi emindenini yakho, kuwo onkhe emadolobha akho, laSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho uyawukunika wona; nabo baphindze bagweme abantu ngekuthula.
Ungeke ubeke isandla sakho emthethweni, ungaba nembono yemuntu; ngeke uthathe inhlawulo; ngobe inkhokho iyabopha amehlo labahloniphileyo, ibe yimiphiko yalabo abangenacala.
Kulungile, kulungile kuphela, kufanele uhambe ngalo, ukuze uphile, nawe ube yinhloko yemhlaba loSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho utawukulethela.
Ungeke ubeke isihlahla se-Ashera semtfubi, eduze kwe altare yakho loyawuyenza kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho.
ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, uyawubaphazamisa.
Ungeke umnikelo wesono kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, umkhwenyana noma ingulube, lenayo nayinye inkinga, noma yini leyimfishane; ngobe Simakadze Nkulunkulu wakho uyihlukumeza.

Uma kukhona umuntu, indoda noma indodakazi, emgwaqeni wakho, emphinjeni yakho, lapho uSirayeli, Nkulunkulu wakho, akunika yona, atholakale ekwenzeni okubi phambi kwamehlo kaSirayeli, uNkulunkulu wakho, ngokuphula imihlangano yakhe,
Kube sekungenjalo, bayawuhamba bakhonza bonkulunkulu bebanye, bawunikela kubo, noma kulilanga, noma kumnyaka, noma emasinyaneni asezulu, lami ngiwaletsa.
khona-ke utawukhipha emnyango wakho lowo mfazi noma lowesifazane, lowenza lento lebi, uyewubeka emacwecwe aze aphele.
"Nase ukhuluma ngesandla sema Witnesi lababili, noma ngalama Witnesi lasitfupha, lowo muntu angeke atfutwe; kodvwa nase ukhuluma ngesandla sama Witnesi lanyenti, lowo muntu angeke atfutwe.
Labo baholi baphindze bafake emacwecwe kuwo, bese kubondza nabo bonke bantfu; nawe utawukhipha lokubi kusuka emiphakathini yenu.

Nakuba kukhona icala lelingafika enkantolo yakho, linzima kakhulu kuwe kutsi uligweme, njengelicala lokubulala, noma licala lomncintiswano, noma licala lokudlwengula, utawulifaka lapho Simakadze Nkulunkulu wakho ayawukhetha khona.
ufike kubaholi benkhosi, labaLevi, kanye nalowo longeke abe ngummeli ngalowo mnyaka, ukhulume nabo, bese bakunika incazelo yesinqumo sabo.
Lamandla abo ayawukwenta, wena utawuya kuwo lapho Simakadze atawukhetha khona; ngaso sonke sinqumo labakushoko kuwe, uphindze ukwenze.
Lakho-ke loSimakadze watsi kuMosi: "Thina-ke kufanele sihambe ngendlela yabo, sigcine kutsi bakhuluma nawe ngendlela lefanele; ungaphazamiseki ngaleyo mfundiso naleso sinqumo.
Wonke lowo muntfu longeke akhululeke kutsi alalele umnikelo wesono, lohlala khona ekhonza kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, noma ummeli, kumele abulawa; nawe utawususa lokubi emaSirayeli.
Lakho kuyawutsi kubo bonkhe bantfu, bakubona, baphindze bakhathazeke, bangabi nebugebengu.
Uma ufike ezweni loSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho akunika lona, uyewuthola, uhlala kulo, bese utsi: 'Sitawubeka ukumkani phezu kwethu, njengobe bahlala khona lamazwe onke angaphandle kwethu.'

"Uye ugcine engqondweni yakho kutsi ube nguSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, lowo atawukukhethela yena ukumkani; kumele abe ngumunye webantfu bakho. Ungeke wehlise phezu kwakho umkhwenyana ongasekho emaSirayeli.
Unkhosi ingeke ibe nemahhashi lamakhulu kakhulu, neyawubuyela eYiputa afake amahhashi; ngobe Simakadze utsi kuwe: "Ungabuyeli ngendlela leyo lilanga lesikhombisa."
Angeke athathe labesifazane abaningi, ngobe intliziyo yakhe ingase ihambe isuka kuSimakadze; naye angeke abe nesiliva kanye negolide leningi.
"Nase, lapho ehlala khona esihlalweni sakhe sebukhosi, abhale ngesandla sakhe kopi yemtsetfo lonjalo, kusuka kukopi legcinwe ngalabaLevi labangcwelephakheji, ibe yincwadi.
Uyawuyigcina kuye, uyayifunda yonke imihla yekuphila kwakhe, ukuze afunde ukubambelela kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakhe, kutsi agcine esenza zonke tincwadzi tekucala titsi "temtsetfo" naletimiso.

Angeke acabange ukuthi ungcono kunabanye baSirayeli, angeke ahambe ngesandla sakhe sokudla noma ngesandla sakhe sekwesobunxele; ngobe ubukhosi bakhe buyawuhlala kuSirayeli, yena nemadvodzana akhe, iminyaka leminingi.
BaLevi labaphakheji, kanye naloluhlanga lonke lwaLevi, ngeke babe nemnikelo wesono eSirayeli; bayawudla ngeminikelo yekushiswa yaSimakadze, leyo mnikelo wabo wesono.
Angeke babe nemhlaba phakathi kwemindeni yabo; Simakadze uyawube ngumnikelo wabo, njengobe watsi kubo.
Lolu hlobo luya kuba ngumnikelo wesono, lotawuthathwa ngabaphatsimandla kulabo labanikela ngesondlo, kube yingulube noma ingulube: intamo, nemilenze, nemphimbo.
Lakuqala ekudlaneni kwakho, kanye newayini lakho lelibomvu, namafutha akho, nibanike nabo, kanye nesikhumba sebantfu bakho.
ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, wabakhethela kubo kusuka kuwo wonke lamadolobha akho, kutsi bahlale bekhonza ngegama lakhe, yena nemadvodzana akhe ngemuva kwakhe, iminyaka yonke.
ULevi angasuka kuwo wonke lamadolobha aseSirayeli lapho ehlala khona, aze afike, ngesandla sakhe lesilungile, endaweni Simakadze abeyawuyikhetha.
Angeke asebenze khona ngegama laSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakhe, njengabo bonkhe bantfu bakhe, labaLevi, labasebenza khona phambi kwaSimakadze.
Ufanele abe nesibopho sokudla, ngisho nakuba unemali esuka ekuthengiseni kwempahla yemndeni wakhe.
Uma ufike ezweni loSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho alikunika lona, ungafundi kutsi uhambe ngendlela leyimfishane yalaba bantu.

Akufanele kube khona phakathi kwenu lowo ubulala lomfati wakhe noma indvodzakati yakhe ngemlilo, noma lowo okhuluma ngesimo sezulu, noma lowo okhuluma ngezinhlamvu, noma lowo okhuluma ngesimanga, noma lowo oshaya ngesandla;
noma ekhuluma ngemanti, noma ekhuluma ngemimoya, noma ekhuluma ngemandla, noma efuna ukukhuluma nalabo bafile.
Lowo lowenza lezi zinto, Nkulunkulu wakho uyawuwuphazamisa; kodvwa ngenxa yalezi zinto letibi, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, utawuzikhipha emehlweni akho.
Ufanele ube nguSimakadze longuSomandla wakho, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.
Lamazwe latawuwakhipha lapho uyawuhlala khona, angeke akhulume nalabo labakhuluma ngemanti, nelabo lababonako; ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, akakuvumele ukwenze lokhu.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, utawukuleta kuwe umprofeti kusuka ebantwini bakho, abe njengemi; yena niyawumulalela.

Kuye kwaba njalo, njengoba nifike nicela kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu emfuleni iSinayi, emini yekuhlangana kwenu, nitsi: "Singeke siphinde sikhulume nelizwi laNkulunkulu wethu, noma sibone lomlilo omkhulu, ukuze singafa."
Simakadze watsi kuye: "Lento labekhuluma yona ilungile.
Ngitawubakhipha umprofeti, losuka emiphakathini yabo, abe sengathi wena; ngitawubeka amazwi ami emlonyeni wakhe, aze akhulume nabo yonke imiyalo yami, engiyawuphendvula.
Nalowo longeke alalele amazwi ami, lakhuluma nguprofeta ngegama lami, ngaye ngitawuwuphenya.
Umprofeti lokhuluma ngegama lami into engingeke ngimutshele ukuthi akhulume ngayo, noma lokhuluma ngegama labanye bonkulunkulu, umprofeta lowo kumele aphele.
Ungeke ukhulume, uti: Ngabe sitawuzi kanjani kutsi umlayezo awusuka kuSimakadze?
Uma umprofeti ekhuluma ngegama laSimakadze, bese lokhu akushoyo kungakabi khona, noma kungeke kwenzeke, loku kushoyo akusekho kwaSimakadze; loprofeta lowo ukhulume ngesikhashana; ungamuhloti.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, utawubulala lamazwe asemhlabeni, lomhlaba lowo uyawukunika wona wena; bese utawuwakhipha, uhlala emizini yabo nemindeni yabo.
uphindze uhlukanise imidzi lemithathu kuwe, emhlabatsini lapho Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, akunika wona kutsi ube ngumnikazi walo.

Uya kulungiselela imikhumbi, uyawuhlukanisa ilizwe lakho, loSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, akunika lona kutsi libe ngumhlaba wakho, ibe yizigaba ezintathu, ukuze wonke lowo umbulalayo afike esinye sezidolobha letinjalo.
Lolu mthetho kulowo lobulala umuntu bese ehamba khona kutsi agcine impilo yakhe: kumele abewubulala umshado wakhe ngengozi, ngaphandle kwekuba ngumfoti wabo ngaphambili.

Kutsi, umfana angaya emfuleni nemndeni wakhe kutsi acwebeze isihlahla, lapho eshaya khona sandla sakhe kutsi acwebeze isihlahla, inhlavu yakhe ingaphuma emgodini, ibe yitfusa lomndeni wakhe, ibe ngumfo. Lomuntfu ungeke ahambe esinye sezidolobha letinjalo aze agcine impilo yakhe.

Uma kungenjalo, umshado welowo lafile, longeke abe nesibopho sokubulala lombulalayo, ungeke aphume emphilweni yakhe, kepha uma uhambo lube lude, ungeke afike agweme ukumbulala, nakuba lomuntu akazange afune kubulawa, ngobe akazange amkhonze umhlobo wakhe.
Ngako-ke ngikuletsa kutsi uhlukanise nami lamadolobha lasitfupha.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, alungise ilizwe lakho, njengobe wakhuluma kubo-baba bakho, aze akunike lonke ilizwe lakhe labewakhuluma ngalo.

"Uye utawukunikela, uma nje uhlala ulandzela yonke lemiyalelo engikwenta ngayo namuhla, uthandana noSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, uhambe ngendlela yakhe nsuku zonke; khona-ke uya kushiya imijikelo emithathu ngaphandle kwalemijikelo lemithathu.
Uyawukwenza njalo, ukuze kungabikho umuntu longakabi necala emhlabatsini lapho uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho akunika khona kutsi ube ngumnikazi wayo, nawe ungabi necala lokubulala.
Uma ngabe umuntu efuna umkhonto wakhe, efihla, ehlala ebhekene naye, ehlasela, ebulala, bese ehamba esinye sezidolobha letinjalo.
Labaholi bedolobha lakhe kumele bafike bamfune, babuyele kuye ngaphandle komgwaqo, bamnike kulowo longeke agweme umbulalayo, kutsi abe mnyama.
"Lakho-ke, uSimakadze watsi: "Ungeke ube nebuhlungu ngaye; ngobe wena utawukhipha kuSirayeli inkohliso yekufa kwalowo longenacala, ukuze kube lula kuwe.
Ungeke ushintshe umkhawulo wenkosi yakho, lowawusetshenzisiwe ngulabo ababekhona phambi kwakho, ezweni lenu lokuyolihlala kulo, ezweni leSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, akunika lona kutsi ulithathe.
Umshayeli ngamunye angeke avumelekile kukhombisa kutsi umuntu unecala, noma ngabe umsebenti wakhe wungcolisa yini, kepha kufanele kube nebufakazi bemehlo lababili noma bathathu.
Uma umshushisi lokhohlisayo ehlala ecala kutsi aphenye umuntu ngemsebenti wekubulala,
labo labaphikisiwe kumele bafike kuSimakadze, phambi kwalabaphatsimandla kanye nalabameli labakhona leso sikhatsi.
"Labo bahluleli kumele baphenye lecala, bese kubonisiwe kutsi lomuntfu ungeke abe ngumshushisi, kodvwa ube ngumfowabo waseSirayeli,
bese uyawukwenza kulowo wesikhashana, njengobe lowo sikhashana akazange akwenze kulowo wesikhashana; ngobe utawususa lokubi kusuka emiphakathini yenu.
Lelinye labantfu litawulilalela, lize lihloniphe, kungabikho namuntu loyawuqhubeka ekwenzeni lento lebi phakathi kwakho.
Lakho-ke, ungabi nenkinga nabo, ngobe kutsi kuyawufana naleso sigameko: kuphila ngekuphila, imehlo ngemehlo, inwele ngeinwele, isandla ngesandla, inyawo ngenyawo.

Uma uphuma umjikelo wekulwa nalabo abaphikisayo bakho, bese ubona amahhashi, nemilenze, nebantfu labakhulu kunawe, ungabakhohlwa; Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, lowo watfumisa ezweni la-Egipta, ukhona nawe.
Uma nifuna kubuyela emkhosini, umLevi kumele afike aze akhulume nebantfu, bese ukhuluma nabo.
utsi: Lingisa, Israele! Niphuma namuhla kutsi nihlangane nalabo baphikisayo; ningabi nendlala, ningabi nalobugebengu, ningaba nebuhlungu, ningaba nokungakhululeki kubo.
ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, uyawuhamba nani; yena utawukulwa nalabo batfutsi benu, aze akusindiseni.
Batsi: "Ngabe kukhona umuntu lowubambise indlu entsha, angeke ayeyilungiselele; kufanele abuye ekhaya lakhe, kutsi angabi nenkinga yekufa emkhosini, bese omunye enikela kuyo.
Ukhona yini umuntu laletsa ivini, angeke abe nekudla kwayo? Ahambe afike ekhaya lakhe, kutsi angabi nakufa emkhosini, ngobe lomunye abe nekudla kwalo.
Ngabe kukhona lowo muntfu lotawukwati indodana, kodvwa angeke abe ngumfazi wayo? Akufanele abuye ekhaya, ngobe kungase kube sewufa emkhosini, bese umfana welinye lihlanga uyala yena."
Batsi: "Wena-ke, uma ukhathazekile noma unenkinga yengqondo, kufanele afike ekhaya lakhe, kutsi nabo basebenti bakhe bangabi nenkinga yengqondo.
Uma abaphathi baphelelwe kukhuluma nemkhosi, kumele bakhethe labagcini-mandla labatawuwulawula.
Uma uphuma uhlasela dolobha, kufanele kuqala uphakamise kuthula kubo bonkhe bantfu bayo.
ngobe, uma bekuvuma, bese bekuvulela emasango abo kuwe, khona-ke bonkhe bantfu labakhona batawube baholi bakho, nabo bayawukukhonza.
Uma bengeke bakulethela siphepho, bese beyawukulwa nawe, khona-ke utawuwuhlaba umkhosi lomhlabatsini, utawuwuhlasela.
lapho Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, atawuyinikela kuwe, uyawubulala wonke lamadodana ayo ngesandla sakho.
Kusekho nabesifazane, nezingane, nesilwane, nesono lesikhona esiteshini sakho, ungasithatha wena; utawudla lokudla lokudlwengulwa kulabo abaphikisayo, labo Simakadze Nkulunkulu wakho abekulethela.
Ngako-ke utawukwenza njalo kuwo wonke lamadolobha angaphandle kwakho, lawo madolobha angaba ngalawo mazwe angaphansi kwako.
"Lamuhla-ke, ngitsi kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho: Lamadolobha abo bonkhe labaholi bebantfu bami, angeke agcine liphila nalinye isilwane lesiphila.
Utawubabulala bonke: iHeti, ne-Amori, ne-Kanana, ne-Perizi, ne-Hivi, ne-Jebhusi, njengobe uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho wakwenta.
ngobe bangakufundiseni kutsi nihambe ngazo zonke izinto letibi, labo abazenzako kulabo bonkulunkulu babo; nawe utawuphazanyiswa nguSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu.

"Uma uhlasela umfula, ube nesikhathi eside sokulwa nawo kutsi uyithathe, ungawubulala lomhlabatsi wakhe ngekweluka. Ungadla imbewu yawo; kodvwa awugwebi! Lomhlabatsi wesidvondza ngumuntu yini, ngobe uyawuhlaselwa nalo?"
Lemihlambi yetimfuyo, lowazi kutsi ayikho ekudlaleni kwayo, ungayibulala, uyenze ibe yimikhumbi-dvondza yekuhlasela umjikelo wakho, kuze kufike kugwaca.
Uma, ezweni leSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho utawukuleta kuwe kutsi ulinike njengetfu, kufunyelwa umuntu eshonelwe emhlabathini, ebhedlele, kungekho muntu lowaziyo lowo wambulalayo.
Labaholi bakho kanye nalabameli bakho kumele baphume, balinganisele umkhawulo kusuka kulowo mhlambi kuya emabhishi asogwini.
Ngako-ke labaholi bedolobha lelingaseceleni kwesilwane kumele bathathe ingulube lencane engeke ibe seyisebenzile kanye nengeke ibe seyigqokile ingubo yekulwa.
Bamele bafike kulomfula lonomfula lowari, lapho mhlaba awuzange ubulawe noma utfolwe khona. Lakho emfuleni kumele batsuse ingcezu yengulube lencane.

Bafike khona abaLevi labangcwele; ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, wabakhethile ukuba basebenze naye, nakubambisene ngegama lakhe; nabo baya kubeka isinqumo ngaso sonke isivi kanye nesinqumo ngaso sonke sifo.
Lapha bonke labaphathi bedolobha lelingaseceleni kwesilwane kumele bahlanze isandla sabo ngaso lesinyoni lesincane, lenhloko yayo yavunwa efulethini.
Batsi: "Isandla sethu asizange sibulala lomuntu, namehlo ethu akazange akubona.
UNkulunkulu, usindise ibandla lakho lase-Israyeli, elingabe likhululwe kuwe; ungeke ubeke ibandla lakho lase-Israyeli ngaphansi kwecala lokubulala umuntu ongenacala.
Ngendlela lenjalo, ningeke nigweme ukubulala umuntu longenacala; ngobe nitawukwenza lokho kulungile emehloni kaSimakadze.
Uma uphuma umkhosine nalabo batfutsi bakho, ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, atawubanikela phambi kwakho, bese uthatha labasolwa kubo;
ungabona phakathi kwabafileyo indodana ehlelekile, ufike ube nekuthula naye, wafuna ukumnika.
Uyawuyisa ekhaya lakho; kumele icwecwe inhlavu yayo, ibe nemilenze yakhe,
Uyawuvala iingubo zayo, aze ahlale endlwini yakho, abe ngumnyaka munye logcwele engoyise nenyoni yakhe; bese ufike kuye, ube ngumkakhe, yena abe ngumkakhe.
"Kutsi ngabe umuntu unebesifazane ababi, lomunye ayawuthanda, lomunye akawuthande; labo bangadla naye labantwana, nome umzali wakhe ube nguwelowo ayawuthandanga.

Uma enikela ngempahla yakhe kubonyana bakhe, angeke abe nelungelo lokunikezwa lomnyaka wokuqala kumntwana wenkosikazi lakhe layawuthanda, ngaphandle komntwana wenkosikazi yakhe ayayithandanga, lowo lomnyaka wokuqala.

Ase athathe umntwana wenkosikazi yakhe, lowo angeke amthande, abe ngumzali wakhe wokuqala, abe nengxenye lemibili yezinto tonkhe letikhona kwakhe; ngobe lomuntfu ngumnyakawo wakhe wesifazane, kanye nelungelo lakhe lokudzala.
"Kutsi ngabe umuntu unemuntfu lokhazimu, umkhonto, lowo angeke alalele ubaba wakhe noma umama wakhe; nakuba bamusa, angeke abonisele.
batawumthatha lobaba wakhe nemama yakhe, bafike bamtsatse kulabo basemgwaqweni wedolobha lakhe.
batsi kubaholi bedolobha lakhe: Lomunye wabantwana bethu ubuhlungu, umkhonzi, awufuni kutsi sikhulume naye; udla kakhulu, usela kakhulu.
Batsi: "Labo bonke labahlala edolobhaneni lakhe batawumshaya ngemlilo, aze afe; nawe uyawususa lokubi kusuka emehlweni akho; bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli bangalilalela, bangeke bakhathazeke.
Uma umuntu esenza isono lesifanele kutsi agwenywe, bese babulawa, bese msebenti wabo ukhontwa emgodini,

ungeke ushiye lokufa embhedeni wakhe ngebusuku bonke, kepha utawumufaka ngalolusuku lunye; ngobe lowo umkhonta embhedeni wakhe ngulowo lalamanywa nguNkulunkulu. Ungasasa itfu lemhlaba Simakadze Nkulunkulu wakho akunika wona kutsi ube ngumnikazi walo.
Uma ubona ingulube noma inkomo yemndeni wakho ihamba, ungayishiya uyibone; kumele uyibuyisele kumnikazi wayo.
Uma umnikazi awuhlali eduze kwakho, noma uma ungazi kutsi ngubani loyifunayo, vele uyithathe ekhaya nawe bese uyigcina kuze umnikazi afike afuna yona, bese uyibuyisela.
Uphindze wenze njalo uma uthola umkhwenyana wabo, noma ingubo yabo, noma yini lenye labeyilahlekile. Ungabe ucabanga kutsi awuwi.
Uma ubona ingulube noma ingulube yemuntfu waNkulunkulu ehlelekile, ungabi nenkinga, ngobe utawusiza umnikazi wayo kutsi abuye amise phansi.
Umkakhe angeke agqoke ingubo yamadoda, nalowo mkakhe angeke agqoke ingubo yamakhosikazi; ngobe uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho uyawuncumisa wonke lowo ekwenza lokhu.
Uma ufika ekungeneni kwekati eduze kwendlela, emthini noma emhlabatsini, kanye nemama ihlalarettweni lecharotes noma emaqanda, ungathatha umama kanye nalabo bancane
Ungeke uthathe labantwana, kepha qiniseka kutsi ushiya umtfubi wakhe, ukuze konke kuhambe kahle nawe bese uphila iminyaka leminingi.
Uma ukwakha indlu entsha, khipha umbhoshongo lophansi ecaleni lesitezi, ukuze ungabi necala lokufa kwabanye uma baphuma kuyo.
Ungeke ubeke esihlahlani sakho simbewu lehlukene, ukuze ungabi nekudla lokuphelele, kanye nekudla lesikhulayo, kanye nekudla lesivunayo.
Ungeke uvule mhlabatsi lapho ingulube kanye nedoli betimisiwe.
Musa kugqoka ingubo leyenziwe ngesundu kanye nelineni elibunjiwe.
Uphindze ubeke tingulube emacongeni lamane emanti akho, lowagqoka.
Kutsi ngabe umfana ukwati indodana yakhe, wahlala naye, watsi: "Ngitakushiya yini?
ukhuluma ngaye ngezinto letibi, watsatsa igama lakhe lingcolile, watsi: "Ngiwubulale lowesifazane, kepha lapho sengihlala naye, ngabona ukuthi angeke abe ngumkakhe."
Batsi: "Ubaba wakhe kanye nemtakwabo kumele bafike babe nebufakazi bokuthi lowesifazane ube yindodana yakhe, kubaholi bedolobha emnyango.
Ubaba wakhe utawukhuluma kubaholi, watsi: "Ngimnike lowesifazane intombi yami kutsi ibe ngumkakhe, kodvwa yena wabuyela emuva.

"Nakho-ke, uma yena ekhuluma ngaye ngezinto letibi, watsi: 'Ngabona kutsi intombi yakho angeke ibe ngumkakhe.' Lokho kukhombisa ukuthi intombi yami ayizange ibe ngumkakhe." 19Batsi bobabili labangani bakhe kumele bafake umlenze phambi kwabaholi bedolobha,
Labaholi balelo dolobha kumele babambe lomuntu, bagweme kuye.

Baye baphindze bagweme umsebenti wakhe, batsi: "Ake akhokhwe imali yesiliva lemakhulu lamashumi lamabili nesikhombisa, abe nguyise wesifazane, ngobe watsatsa igama lesibi lowesifazane waseSirayeli; yena kumele abe ngumkakhe, angeke amshiye iminyaka yakhe yonke.
kepha uma icala liyiqiniso, futhi akukho bufakazi bekuba ngumkakhe angeke abe ngumkakhe,

ke-ke kumele afike emgwaqeni wendlu yababa wakhe, lamadodana edolobha lakhe azomshaya ngesandla, aze aphele; ngobe wakwenza lokubi eSirayeli, waba nendodakazi yakhe ekhaya lababa bakhe. Ngako-ke kufanele ususe lokubi emiphakathini yenu.
Uma umuntu efunwa ehlala nenkosikazi yakhe, kumele bafile bobabili, lowo mfazi nalowo muntfu; nawe utawususa lokubi eSirayeli.
Kutsi ngabe umfana uhlangana nendvodzakati lencane, leyimfanakazi, emgwaqeni, ibe yindodana yemuntfu lomunye, wahlala naye.

Bafike bafike emgwaqeni wenhloko yedolobha, bese ubamba emacwecwe abo kuze bafe; nendodakazi ubambe emacwecwe ayo, ngobe yahlala emigwaqweni yedolobha, kodvwa akazange acile; naye-ke lowesifazane ubambe emacwecwe akhe, ngobe wabulala indodana yomfana wakhe. Uyawususa lokubi kusuka emehlweni akho.
"Uma umuntu ehlangana nendvodzakati yakhe emgwaqeni, bese emisa naye, lowo muntu lowenza lokhu kumele aphele.
Ungeke uyenze yini lendvodzakati, ngobe akazange abe nesono lesifanele kubulawa. Lenkinga ifana naleyo yemuntfu lobulala umngane wakhe,
ngobe lomuntfu wamthola emhlabatsini; lendvodzakati yekucala yaphuma icile, kodvwa angeke kube khona lowo loyawuyisa.
"Kutsi ngabe umuntu wahlangana nendvodzakati lencane, lengeke ibe ngumkakhe, ayawuyibamba, abe naye, bese bafunwa.
Atawunikela kuyise isiliva lama-50, afike abe ngumfazi wakhe; ngobe lowesifazane abewuphazamisa. Angeke amthumele ngaso sikhatsi sakhe sekuphila.
Umfana angeke abe nendvodzakati yababa wakhe, angeke abe nendodana yebaba lakhe, angeke abe nenkosikazi yakhe.
Angeke afike engqungqutheleni yaSimakadze, lowo muntfu lobe sewubiwe, noma lobe sewucishwe.
Angeke afike engqungqutheleni yaSimakadze, nalowo lozalwa ngendodana yenkhosi; kuze kube yiminyaka lemashumi lamane, ngeke afike kulo.
Lomuntfu wa-Ammon nalowo we-Moab angeke afike engqungqutheleni yaSimakadze; kuze kube yiminyaka lemashumi lamane, ngeke afike kuyo.
ngobe bangeke bakuhlangabeze ngekudla namanzi enhliziyweni yenu, lapho niphuma khona eMijiphu; nabo bakhokhele Balaamu, unyana waBeori, wasePetori eMesopotamiya, kutsi akulale.

Ngako-ke uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, akafuni kutsi akhulume naBalamu; kodvwa uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, wehlisele lolamato ube ngumnikelo wekushiswa kuwe, ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, akuthanda.
Uma uphila, ungayeki kuzama kutsi ubasize babe nekuthula noma baphumelele.
"Mna-ke ngitsi kuwe: Mna, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, ngiyakuphendvula, ngitsi: Angeke ufune umSirayeli; ngobe umSirayeli umndeni wakho.
Labantwana labazalwa kubo, kuze kube ngumnyaka wesithathu, bangangena engqungqutheleni yaSimakadze.
"Lamuhla, lapho nihlala khona emgwaqeni, kutsi nihlasele labangani bakho, kumele ningabi nalutho lokungekuhle.
Ngesebusuku kumele ahlanzwe ngamanzi, bese ekupheleni kwelilanga angafika entabeni yemphi.
Kube nendzawo yangaphandle kwekamva lapho ungaya khona ku toilet.
Uphindze usebentise i-shovel encane kanye nemiyalelo yakho. Uma ufika ku-toilet, khipha umgodi ngeso, bese uvikela imihlambi yakho.

ngobe uSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, uyahamba emigwaqeni yakho, kutsi akugcinele wena, nome atawunikela ngaso sandla sakhe emgodini wakho; khona-ke imigwaqeni yakho kufanele ibe ngcwele, ukuze angeke abone lutho lokubi emehlweni akho, aze abeke phansi.
Uma umkhonto ephuma kuSimakadze wakhe, bese efika kuwe, ungawubuyiseli kuye Nkulunkulu wakhe;
Ahlale nawe, emgwaqeni wakhe, lapho akhetha khona, lapho kulungile kuye; ungamubiseli.
Akukho muntfu lomnyama noma lomhlophe weSirayeli lokufanele abe ngumkhonzi ethempelini.
Ungeke ufake endlwini yaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, imali yendvodzakati noma yendodakazi, kutsi uyikhokhele yini nanoma iyiphi inhlanhla; ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, uyawubi nabo.
"Ungeke ukhokhe umtfubi emndenini wakho, noma ngabe yimali, noma ngabe yikudla, noma ngabe yisiphi nasinye isive lesikhokha umtfubi.

Ungeke ukhokhe umvuzo kulowo mhlali, kepha ungawukhokhi kulowo wesifazane waseSirayeli; ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, utawukubambisana nawe kuwo wonke umsebenzi wakho, ezweni lenu lokuya kulo kutsi ulinike.
Uma ungena nambi kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, ungeke ube nenkinga yokuyifeza; ngoba Simakadze uNkulunkulu wako uyakucela ukuthi uyifeze, futhi wena ungabi nemonakalo uma ungenawo.
Ngako-ke, uma ukhetha kutsi ungabi nesive, awunakuba necala.
Lakho-ke lokusho kwakho kutsi utawukwenza, kufanele uyigcine; uma ungena ngendlebe yakho kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho ngenhlanhla, kumele uwufeze.
Uma ufika esiteshini sokudla semndeni wakho, ungadla tithelo letiningi kakhulu njengoba ufuna, kepha ungabeka noma yini emgodini wakho.
Uma ufika emhlabatsini lekudla kwemndeni wakho, ungadlidliza emajikijolo ngesandla sakho, kepha ungadlidlizi emajikijolo abo ngesihluku.
Kutsi uma umuntu eshada nendvodza, angeke abe nenhlonipho kuye, ngobe athole kuyo yini nayinye into engalahlekiyo; kodvwa ubhalela iphepha lokushiyana naye, amnike yona, wamkhipha ekhaya lakhe.
Ngemuva kwekushiya indlu yakhe, angaba ngumkakhe wemunye indoda.
umfati wakhe wesibili angase ahambe naye,waribhalela incwadi yekwatisa, amnike yona, wamshiya endlwini yakhe; noma ngabe lowesifazane wakhe wekucala uyafa.

"Nakuba umkakhe wokuqala, lowo wamshiyayo, angeke aphinde abe ngumkakhe; ngobe uyawuphazanyiswa; lokhu kungeke kube yindlala kuSimakadze. Ungayibeka itfu lemhlaba lapho Nkulunkulu wakho, Simakadze, ekunika wona kutsi ube ngumkhuluwa wakho.
Uma umfana ekwatiwe, angeke adluliselwe emkhosini noma abe nesibopho lesinyenti. Kumnyaka owodwa uyakhululeka kutsi ahlale ekhaya aze ajabulise indodana yakhe entsha.
Ungeke uthathe isiliva lemibili, noma ngisho negolide lelikhulu kuphela, njenge garantiya yemali yentela. Lokusho kutsi utawuthatha indlela yemuntu yekuphila.

Uma kutfolwa umuntu ebulala umngane wakhe, uyise wemadvodzana a-Isirayeli, bese uhlala naye njengemkhonto, noma uyawuthengisa, lowo mkhonto kumele aphele; ngobe wena utawukhipha lokubi phakathi kwakho.
