"Uma kuphuma khona umkhuhlane ebusweni bakho, kufanele ucabangele kakhulu kutsi wenze njalo-ke, njengobe abaLevi labaphatsimandla bekutsile; kumele nicabangele kutsi nikwenze kanjalo-ke njengoba ngibatshele.
Khumbula kutsi Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, watsi yini kuMiriyamu endlela yenu, lapho niphuma khona ema-Egypt.
Uma udlulisa lomunye Arena, ungangena endlini yakhe kutsi uthathe impahla yakhe, bese uhlala khona kuze kube sekuphele iminyaka lemine.
Lala ngaphandle, uvumele lowo lowudlulisa kutsi akulethe kuwe ngaphandle.
Uma lomuntu angeke abe nemali, ungase uhambe uphumule ngekugcina ilungelo lakhe.
Ungeke uphindze ubeke phansi imilenze yabo lapho lilanga liphuma khona, kutsi baphumule kuyo; ngobe bayakubambisana nawe, Simakadze Nkulunkulu wakho utawukubona lokudla kwakho.
Ungeke usebentise ngesandla sakho umholi wendlu yakho, noma ngabe ungumLevi, noma ngabe ngumunye wabahlali bakho, lohlala emnyango wakho.
Utawubanikela ngemali yabo nsuku zonke, ngaphambi kokuba ubusuku buphele; ngoba bancane kakhulu, futhi bafuna ukuyithola; ukuze bangavimbi kuSimakadze ngenxa yakho, nawe ube nesono.
Abazali bangafa ngenxa yesono semadvodzana abo, nabantwana bangafa ngenxa sesono semadvodzakati abo; kodvwa wonke umuntu kumele afile ngesono sakhe.
Utsi: 'Awu, wena ungeke ube nelungelo kulabo bangaphandle, noma kubo abafayo, futhi awungeke ube nelungelo lokuthatha isikhumba sawo.
Khumbula kutsi ube ngumkhonzi ezweni la-Egipta, ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, watfumisa khona; ngakho-ke ngikuletsa ukuba ukwenze lokhu.

"Uma uvuna emajikijolo akho emhlabatsini lakho, bese usabalalisa khona inkomishi yemfuyo yakho, ungabuyeli uyithathe; wushiye kumkhwenyana, nomshado, nenkosikazi, ukuze Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, akuberekise kuwo wonke umsebenzi wesandla sakho.
"Uma uvuna imithi yakho ye-olive, ungayeki ngesandla sakho kuleyo mihlahlandlela; uyawushiya lokushiwo kumkhwenyana, nomjovo kanye nenkosikazi.
"Uma uvuna imbewu yesihlahla sakho semvini, ungayeki ukuyohamba ngaso; kumele uyishiye kumkhwenyana, nomjovo kanye nenkosikazi yakho.
Utakhumbula kutsi ube ngumkhonzi eMijiphu; ngobe ngikuphendvula, ngitsi: Ungeke ugcine lomthetho.
Uma abantu benenkinga, kumele bafike enkundleni yemtsetfo, bese baholi benkantolo bakhipha isinqumo ngecala, bamemetela longeke abe necala kutsi ulungile, kanye nalobe unecala kutsi ungekho.
Uma umuntu lophikisayo efanele kutsi agwenywe, ummeli kumele amnike ukuhlala phansi bese agwenywa phambi kwakhe, ngenombolo yetibopho letifanelwe kuhlukunyezwa kwakhe.
Ummeli angeke abe nenani lelikhulu, kodvwa uma edlula kulo, umfana wakho utawudlalwa phambi kwakho.
Ungawucoci lomlomo wengulube kutsi ungadla lilanga lapho iphuma khona ekudlaleni.

Kutsi ngabe bazalwane bahlala ndawonye, bese omunye wabo efa angeke abe nemntwana, indodana yakhe kumele ikwati umuntu longaphandle kwemndeni wakhe. Umyeni wakhe kufanele akwati indodana yakhe, agcine umsebenzi wakhe njengenkosikazi.
Lomnyaka mncane loyawuzala utawubeka igama lomfana wakhe lofileyo, kutsi igama lakhe lingacishiswe e-Isirayeli.

"Uma lomuntu angeke athande ukuthatha indodana yenkosikazi yakhe, khona-ke indodana yenkosikazi yakhe kumele ifike emnyango kubaholi bedolobha lakhe, itsi: 'Umkhuluwa wami akafuni ukwakha igama lenkosikazi yakhe eSirayeli; akafuni ukuba ngumkhuluwa wami.'
Lawo makhulu edolobha lakhe layawumubiza, akhulume naye; bese-ke, uma esho kutsi: 'Angeke ngiyithathe,'

indvodzakati yalowo mkhuluwa wakhe kumele ifike kuye phambi kwabaholi, ivule isiketi sakhe esinyawo lakhe, iphule emlonyeni wakhe, itsi: "Kungenjalo lokwentako kumuntfu longeke asungule indlu yalowo mkhuluwa wakhe."
Kusuka lapho, mndeni wakhe utawubizwa eSirayeli ngokuthi "umndeni wemuntu lomsebenti wakhe wasuswa."
Uma amadoda lamibili ehlaselana, bese indodana yemunye walowo ifika ivikela lowesifazane wakhe kulowo wesifazane labewudlalela, bese iyaphuma ibamba lowo wesifazane ngetinyawo zakhe,
ungeke ube nekuthula naye, ngobe nguNkulunkulu wakhe.
Ungase ugcine emabhande lahlukene ebhokisini lakho, elinye linzima nelinye lilula.
Ungaba nemlinganiselo lohlukene ekhaya lakho, umlinganiselo omkhulu nelomncane.
Ungeke usebentise umlinganiselo lolungile, kanye nemitha lefanele, ukuze uhlale uphila iminyaka emikhulu phezu kwemhlaba lapho Simakadze Nkulunkulu wakho ekunika wona.
ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, uyala wonke lowo wenza lokudla lokubi, nalowo angeke abe nekuthula.
Khumbula lokwentako Amaleki kuwe ngendlela yenu, lapho niphuma khona eMijiphu.
Bafike bahlangana nawe ngendlela, lapho uhlala khona ungenawo amandla, bese babulala bonke labo labakhubazekile nalabo abahamba phambili, bangabi nekuthula kuNkulunkulu.

"UNkulunkulu wakho, Nkulunkulu wenu, utawukususa kuwo wonke lamakhulu akho kanye nebantfu bakho bonke emhlabatsini lenu, kuze kube yilapho Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu, akunika khona itfu lokuphumula ekufeni kwenu.
Uma ufike emhlabatsini loNkulunkulu wakho, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, akunika wona kutsi ube yikhaya lakho, bese uyawuhlala kulo.

Utathatha lokudla lokukhulu kuleyo mhlaba lowo uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho akunika wona, utawutibeka ebhokisini, uyawuya endaweni lapho Simakadze Nkulunkulu wakho akhetha khona igama lakhe lihlale khona.

"Uya kumnikelo wesono loyawube ukhona ngalowo mnyaka, utsi kuye: 'Namuhla ngikhuluma kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, kutsi sengifike ezweni leliSimakadze abesho kubo-ke labababuphikisi bethu ukuthi atawulibanikela kulo.'
Lomnikelo wekushiswa utawukhipha ibhokisi emlonyeni wakho, wamisa phambi kwe altare yaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho.

Utakhuluma phambi kwaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, utsi: Ubaba wami waba nguArami, wahamba waya eMijiphu, wahlala khona ngebantfu abaningi, wafika lapho waba yinhlanga enkulu, inamandla, nemindeni emikhulu.
Bami-Ejipta batfumisa simo sethu, batfumisa simo sethu, basebentisa simo sethu sanzima.
Sifike sikhala kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, watsi: "UNkulunkulu wababa bami utsi: 'Ngubani nalowo lokhuluma nami?'" 20Kodvwa Simakadze akazange asiphendule.
Simakadze utfumele eMijiphu ngesandla sakhe esinamandla, nemilenze yakhe eyimisiwe, nangendlela lebuhlungu kakhulu, nangemiqondiso, nangemfihlakalo.
watsi: "UNkulunkulu uyawutfumisa umhlaba, utawuwunikela emhlabatsini, utawuwunikela kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli.
Ngako-ke, Simakadze, ngiyakulethela lokudla kwasekuqaleni kwembewu yemhlaba labewungisisile; bese ubeka ibhokisi phambi kwaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, ulale phansi ube ngumnikelo wesono.
Uyawuphumula, wena kanye neLevi nalowo mhlali lohlala phakathi kwakho, ngawo wonke lamandla alungile aSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, abewunika wena nendlu yakho.

Lomnyaka wesithathu, lomnyaka wesikhombisa, lapho uphelele khona ukunikela ngengxenye yeshumi yaleyo mbewu yakho yonke, utawuyisa kuLevi, nomkhwenyana, nalowo mnatsi, nalowo mdlovukazi; nabo bangadla ngaphakathi kweemnyango wakho, baphuze.

utawutsi kuSimakadze longuSomandla wakho, utsi: Namuhla sengisuse endlwini yami lento engcwele, ngiyinikela kuLevi, nomhlali wasendlini yangasese, nendodakazi, nenkosikazi, njengobe ubemiwisela; angishintshile emyalo wakho, ngawulibala.

Ngaye ngawudla uma sengifile, ngawususa lapho ngingabi nephunga, ngawukhipha lapho ngingabi nephunga, ngawunikela kulowo lofa; ngilalele isandla sashe soSimakadze Nkulunkulu wami; ngakwenza konke lokube ungangibekile.
Thinda ubone kusuka esibhakawari sakho esingcwele, ubuletise bantfu bakho baseSirayeli, nemhlaba lowutfumelele wona, njengobe watsi kubabuphi bakhe, ilizwe lelivuthayo ummbila nejusi.
Namuhla, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, utsi kuwe: "Sebenzisa lemiyalo kanye nalemigaqo; hlala uyenza ngentliziyo yakho yonke nemoya yakho yonke.
Namuhla ukhuluma kuSimakadze kutsi abe nguNkulunkulu wakho, nokuthi uhambe ngendlela yakhe, ugcine imiyalo yakhe, namasiko akhe, nemithetho yakhe, ukhulume ngaye.
USimakadze ukhuluma nawe namuhla kutsi ube ngumuntfu wakhe, abe ngumnikazi wakhe, njengobe wakusho, bese ugcina lamandla akhe wonke.
Uya kubeka phezulu phezu kwaso sonke isizwe asenzayo, abe ngumnikelo wesono, negama lelihle, nebuhle; uyawuba ngumuntfu longcwele kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, njengobe wakusho.
Musa nebaholi beSirayeli baletsa bantfu batsi: "Nceda nigcine yonke imiyalo yami, lemikhuluma ngayo namuhla.
Ngelilanga lenu lokudlula eJordane, nifike ezweni loSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu alikunike lona, kufanele nibeke emacwecwe amakhulu, niyifake phezulu igolide.

Uya kuzibhalela kuwo la mazwi onke lomthetho, lapho udlula khona, ukuze ufike ezweni leSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho alikunika lona, ilizwe elihlanganisiwe nemmbila nemvubelo, njengobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, abekusho kuwe.
Uma nidlula eJordane, nitawubeka ematshe lawa emfuleni i-Ebali, njengobe ngikuwisela umthetho ngawo namuhla, niyibeke ngegolide.
Uyawukwakha khona ithempeli kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, ithempeli lelinetitshe; ungeke usete ngensimbi kulo.
Uyawukwakha indlu yaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho ngetitshe temhlabatsini, letingeke ticwengwe; utawunikela phezu kwayo ngeminikelo yekushiswa kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho.
Lakhona utawunikela khona ngeminikelo yekuthula, uyidle, uyenelise phambi kwaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu.
Ubhalela emacwecwe lawo onkhe emazwi laleso mthetho, ubhalela kahle-kahle.
Watsi uMosese nalabaLevi labangcwele babekhuluma kubo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, besithi: "Khumbulani bese nilalela, Simakadze Nkulunkulu wenu.
Uyawulalela ilizwi laSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, ugcine imiyalo yakhe nemithetho yakhe, lemi ngikuwisela ngayo namuhla.
Simakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Lala lilanga lelinyenti, uMosi waletsa bantfu, watsi:
Lemihlambi lemihlanu yemadvodzana aSimeoni, naLevi, naJuda, naIssakhareti, naJosefa, naBenjamini, kumele ihlale phansi emfuleni iGarizimu, kutsi ibambisene nabobantfu, lapho nidlula khona eJordane.
Lamadvodza layawuhlala emfuleni i-Ebali, abe nguRubeni, neGadi, naAseri, naZabuloni, naDani, naNeftali.
BaLevi bayawutsi kubo bonkhe bantfu beSirayeli, batsi:

"Lalalelwe lowo lokwenza igolide, noma ukhuni lokucwebezelayo, nome umbhoshongo wesiliva, wamisa efihlakeleni; umsebenzi wezinyawo zomculi nguwo, Simakadze awungcolisa!""Nabo bonke abantu baphendule bati: "Amen."
"Lalamane lowo lotsi: 'Ube mkhulu utata wakhe, noma utata wakhe.'" Batsi bonke bantfu: "Amen!"
Lalamanywe lowo lokhipha umkhawulo wenkhosi yakhe. Batsi bonke bantfu, Ameni!
"Lalalelwe lowo loyawubeka umdlavuza engozini yendlela!" Lakho bonke bantfu kumele batsi: "Amen."
"Ulahlekeliwe lowo longeke avumele umkhwenyana, noma umfowabo, noma udzimate, abe nelungelo lakhe." Batsi bonke abantu: "Amen!"
Lalamanywe lowo lohlala nendvodzakati yababa wakhe, ngobe ubulala utata wakhe. Nabo bonke abantu batsi: Ameni!
Lalamanywe lowo lohlala nesilwane nasiphi na. Nabo bonke bantfu bangatsi: Ameni!
Lalamanywe lowo lohlala nenkosikazi yakhe, kube yindodana yobaba wakhe noma ibe yindodana yendvodzakati yakhe. Nabo bonke bantfu batsi: Ameni!
Lalamanywe lowo lohlala nenkosikazi yakhe. Nabo bonke bantfu batsi: Ameni!
Lalamanywe lowo lobulala umhlobo wakhe ngesandla sakhe, bese bonke bantfu batsi: Ameni.
"Lalalelwe lowo lamukelayo mnikelo wekushiswa, kutsi abulala umuntu longenacala!" Lakho bonke bantfu batsi: "Amen."
Lalamanywe lowo muntfu longeke agcine amazwi laleso simiso, aze akwenze. Nabo bonke bantfu batsi: Ameni!

Uma ukhuluma ngesandla saSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, ngaso sonke isikhathi, ungenelela kutsi ugcine wonke lamandla akhe, engikushoyo kuwe ngalolusuku, uyenzile, khona-ke Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, uzokwenza ube mkhulu kunazo zonke iintlanga emhlaba.
Nawo onkhe emabhakabhaka ayawufika kuwe, nekuvukela kuwe, uma ulandzela lizwi laSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho.
Ube ngcwele enhlokodolobha, ube ngcwele nasemhlabatsini.
Labantwana bakho, kanye nembewu yemhlaba wakho, nalabo labancane emihlambini yakho, nalabancane emakhowe akho, nalabancane kwemihlambi yakho, baya kubangcwele.
Ibhokisi lakho kanye nebhodlela lakho lekudla litawubhakwa.
Ube ungcwele lapho ufika khona, ube ngcwele lapho uphuma khona.
Simakadze utawukwenza kutsi labasolwa bakho, labaphikisayo nawe, bahlaselwe phambi kwakho; bangafika kuwe ngendlela eyodwa, kodvwa bayakushiya ngenendlela yesitsatfu.
Nkulunkulu wakho utawukubambisana nawe emhlabatsini lenu, nasekudlaleni kwakho; Simakadze Nkulunkulu wenu utawukubambisana nawe emhlabatsini lenu, lapho uyawukunika khona.
Simakadze utawukwenza ube ngumuntfu longcwele kuye, njengobe wakusho kuwe, uma ugcina imiyalo kaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, uhamba ngendlela yakhe.
Lakho kuyawubonakala kuwo wonke lamazwe emhlaba, kutsi wena uNkulunkulu; nabo batawukulibala.
Simakadze utawukwenza ube mkhulu ngekudla kwakho, nezingane zakho, nenyama yakho, nembewu yakho, ezweni lakhe lakazange akhulume nababa bakho kutsi awanike.

Simakadze utawuvula izulu, impahla yakhe ehlelekile, ukuze afake umhlwa ezweni lakho ngesikhathi saso, nakubambise yonke imisebenzi yesandla sakho; nawe uya kudlulisa kuwo lamazwe amaningi, wena ungeke udlulise kubo.

Simakadze utawukwenza ube yinhloko yakho, kungekhona umlenze wakho; uyawuhlala phezulu, awusayi kuhlala phansi, uma ulalela imiyalo kaSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, engikushoyo kuwe ngalolusuku, ukuze uyigcine uyenzile.
Ungeke uhambe ngesandla sakho sokudla noma ngesandla sekwesobunxele, ngayinye yaleyo miyalo engikhuluma ngayo kuwe namuhla, ulandzela bonkulunkulu babanye, ubabukhonze.

"Kuye kwenzeka, uma ungetsi ulalela izwi laSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, kutsi ugcine ukwenzela tonkhe timiso zakhe nemithetho yakhe, lemi ngikubonise wena ngalolusuku, khona-ke kuyawufika kuwe lonke lolu langa, luyakufinyelela.
Ungeke ube lilangabhekile enhlokodolobha, ungeke ube lilangabhekile emhlabatsini.
Ibhokisi lakho lekudla kanye nebhodlela lakho lekudla liyawufa.
Amakhosikazi akho, nembewu yemhlaba wakho, nalabo bandzawo bemihlambi yakho, nalabo bandzawo bemihlambi yakho, bangabi nalutho.
Ungeke ufike ungenele, ungeke uphume ungenelele.

Simakadze utawuthumela kuwe lilangabhe, nebuhlungu, nekuphazamiseka, kuwo wonke umsebenzi wesandla sakho, lowufuna ukuwenza, kuze kukhululwe wena, kuze kube sekuhleleni kwakho, ngenxa yebubi lwakho lokungemi.
Simakadze utawukubeka emagciwane labulalayo, kuze akukhulule emhlabatsini lowuhamba kuwo uyawuwuhlala khona.
Simakadze utawukubulala ngendlala, nemkhuhlane, nebuhlungu bemisipha, nenhlayiya, nendlala, nendlala yekudla, nendlala yesikhumba, nendlala yemehlo; lezi zinto zizokwephula wena kuze uphele.
Izulu lakho lelingene phezu kwehlavu lakho liyawuba ngubhedu, nemhlaba longaphansi kwenyawo zakho utawuba ngunsimbi.
Simakadze utawukhipha emhlabatsini lakho lilanga lemvula, kanye netfufu kusuka esibhakabhakeni, kuze uphele.

Simakadze utawukwenza uhlaselwe phambi kwalabo abaphikisayo; ngendlela eyodwa uyawufika kubo, ngaleyo ndlela leyisishiyagalombili uyawubaleka phambi kwabo; nawe uzoba mkhulu kunawo wonke lamandla emhlaba.
Lamahlombe akho azoba ngukudla kwaso sonke sitfunywa semhlaba kanye nenyama lephilayo yemhlaba, futsi ngeke kubekho lowo loyawutibulala.
Simakadze utawukubulala ngendlala yase-Egipta, nemilenze, nemkhuhlane, nenkinga yesikhumba, engeke ilungiswe.
Simakadze utawukubulala ngenkinga yengqondo, nebuhlungu bemehlo, nasenhliziyweni.
Lasebusuku uzoba sewuhamba njengemuntfu lomnyama enhliziyweni yakho, ungaphumeleli kunoma yini lekwentayo. Utawudlalwa lilanga nelilanga, uyetshiswa, kodvwa ngeke kubekho lowo uyakukhulula.
Uzoba nendodana, kodvwa umfana lomunye utawuyithatha, uyawuhlala naye; uzokwakha indlu, kepha awungeke uhlale kuyo; uzotshala ivini, kodwa awungeke udle impahla yayo.

Ingulube yakho iya kubulawa phambi kwakho, kodvwa wena awutawuyidla; umkhwenyana wakho uyawuthathwa kuwe, ungabuyeli kuwo; inkomo yakho itawunikezwa kumakhoboka akho, ngeke kube khona lowo loyawuyivikela.
Lamadodana akho nemadvodzakati akho atawunikezwa ebantwini babanye, bese mehlo akho ephuma ekubona kuwo yonke imihla, kepha ngeke kube khona amandla akho.
Lamandla emhlaba wakho, nemisebenzi yakho yesandla sakho, ayawudliwa ngubantfu abangeke ubazi; nawe uzobiwa lilanga lakho lonke.
Lezinto letiwubona titawukushaya umlomo.
Simakadze utawukushaya ngetinhlayiya letibi emadolo akho kanye nemilenze yakho, kuze kungabi khona lokuwuphilisa; kusuka emlenzeni wenyawo lakho kuya enhloko yakho.
Simakadze utawukususa wena nenkhosi yakho, loyawuyisa phezu kwakho, ufike ezweni lesingalizange ulibone, wena nababa bakho; khona-ke uzokhonza khona bokhokho bakho, ematshe netinhlaba.
Uyawuba yinhlekelele, nebucwebe, nebulili kubo bonkhe labaholi bebantfu lapho Simakadze atakuthumela khona.
Utafaka mbewu emhlabatsini lakho, kepha utawuyivuna incane, ngobe inkemba iyayidla.
Utawuletsa isihlahla semvini, nawe uyawukhula kuso, kepha awungeke uphuze umvinyo wayo, nalowo utawuwuvuna; ngobe inkungu iyayidla.
Utawuba nemithi ye Arena emhlabatsini lwakho lonke, kepha awungeke usebenzise ioli, ngobe i-Oliveni yakho iyaphuka.
Utawuzala lamakhosikazi nemadvodzakati, kepha angeke abe nawe; ngobe baphindze bathathelwe ebutsheni.
Lamahhashi akho nekudla kwemhlabatsini lakho kuyawudliwa lilanga lemlilo.
Lomunye lohlala emehlweni akho, utawuhamba ephakeme kakhulu kunakho; wena utawuhamba ephansi kakhulu.
Atawukudlulisa wena, kodvwa wena awutadlulisa kubo; yena uzobe yinhloko, wena ungeke ube nguti.

Nawo wonke lamalahlekelo azofika kuwe, aze akuphazamise, afike kulowo nalowo, kuze ukhululwe; ngobe ungewulalela amazwi kaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, kutsi ugcine imiyalo yakhe nemithetho yakhe, abekuwisela yona.
La mazwi kumele abe nguphawu kanye necala kuwe, nawe nalabo abaphuma kuwe, kuze kube sekupheleni.
Awuzange usebenzele Simakadze Nkulunkulu wakho ngekuphumula, nangekukhululeka, lapho ube nekudla lokuningi.
wena utawukhonza umfowabo, lowo Simakadze ayawuthumela kuwe; uzoba nendlala, ube nendlala, ube mnyama, ube nenkinga ngaso sonke simo. Uyawubeka intambo yensimbi emlenzeni wakho, kuze akukhulule.
Simakadze utawukulethela kuwe lizwe livela kude, kusuka ekugcineni kwemhlaba, liphuma lihamba njengelihlaza; lizwe lelingakuqondi ulwimi lwalo;
ilizwe lelinemehlo labuhlungu, lelingeke likhululeke kulowo wesifazane naloko lomncane.
Iyakudla imbewu yesilwane sakho, nembewu yemhlabatsi wakho, kuze ukhululwe; ngeke ishiye kuwe umhluzi, noma iwayini elisha, noma uphethiloli, noma inkunzi yakho, noma imfuyo yakho, kuze uphele.

Lawo atawukucekela, atawukuhlasela emafuleni akho onke ezweni lakho lonke, kuze kube lihla inhloko yakho lephakeme, nendlu yakho leqinile, lapho uhlala khona; lawo atawukuhlasela emafuleni akho onke emhlaba wakho wonke, loNkulunkulu wakho, Nkulunkulu wakho, akunika wona.
Utawudla labangani bakho, inyama yalabo madvodzana nemadvodzakati akho aSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, abekuleta kuwe, ngenxa yemphiko leyawukubeka kuyo lomholi wakho, lapho ungeke uphile khona.
Umntu wakho, nakuba ungeke ube ngumfana, noma ngabe ungumncane kakhulu kuwe, angeke abe nenhlonipho kulowo mngane wakhe, noma kuleyo ndvodzakati yakhe, noma kuleyo ndodana yakhe.

angeke abe nesibopho salowo nalowo lokudla inyama yabantwana bakhe, njengoba edla ngayo; ngobe kuyoba yinye kuphela into leyawuyishiya, ngenxa yemphiko lapho umshayeli wakho atawukucindezela khona kuwo wonke lamagceke.
Lowesifazane wakho, lowo mkhulu kunabo bonke, lowo mkhulu kakhulu kutsi angeke anikeze inyawo lakhe emhlabatsini, ngeke abe nekuthula nomkakhe, noma nalowo mfana wakhe, noma nalolowo mncane wakhe.
Uya kulala embhedeni wakhe, nabantwana bakhe abazalayo, ngesandla sakhe, ngobe angeke abe nekudla; ngenxa yemphiko lapho umshayeli wakho atawukubeka kuyo emathempelini akho.
Uma ningeke nigcineni kutsi niphumele yonke imiyalo yalo mthetho lobhalwe kulo ncwadi, kutsi nibulete leligama lelihle nalo libuhlungu, Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wenu;
Simakadze utawukulethela wena kanye nemadvodzana akho, tifo letibuhlungu, tifo letikhulu naletihlala njalo, nesifo lesibi nasetihlala njalo.
Uyawubeka phezu kwakho zonke tifo ta-Egipta, letiwukhathazayo, bese zijeziswa kuwe.
Nakweso sonke sifo, nakweso sonke sifo esibhalwe encwadini yalomthetho, Simakadze utawukulethela kuwe, kuze ube mkhulu.
Nakuba nibe makhulu kakhulu njengamacwecwe ezulu, niyawushiywa ningabambalwa; ngobe awuzange ulalele izwi laSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho.

Ngako-ke, njengobe uSimakadze wathanda kutsi akwenzeni kahle nikhule kakhulu, njalo-ke uSimakadze uyakuthanda kutsi anikhulise nikhulule; nawe utawucutshungulwa ezweni lenu lokuya kulo kutsi niyithathe.

UNkulunkulu utawukusakaza kuwo wonke lamazwe, kusuka esiphelweni esisodwa semhlaba kuya esiphelweni esisodwa semhlaba; khona-ke uzokhonza khona amanye amasiko, awuzange uyiqonde wena nababa bakho, imithi nemigodi.
Nasemiphakathi yalemindeni, ngeke uthole kukhululeka, noma indawo yekuphumula kwenyawo lakho; khona-ke Nkulunkulu wakho uzokunika intliziyo ebuhlungu, nemehlo ebuhlungu, nemoya obuhlungu.
Ukuphila kwakho kuyawuba khona engozini, ungeke ukhululeke busuku nebusuku, ungeke ube nesiqiniseko sokuphila.
ekuseni utawuti, "Ngabe kungesekuhlwa!" nakusihlwa utawuti, "Ngabe kungesekuhlwa!" ngenxa yebuhlungu benhliziyo yakho, kanye nemehlo akho akubonako.

Simakadze utawukubuyisela eYiputa ngetinqanawa, ngendlela lapho ngatsi kutsi awuzange uhambe kuyo; khona-ke niya kuthengwa kuwo lamacala enu njengabakhonzi nabangani, kodvwa angeke kubekho lowo uthenga.
Lezi zinto yimazwi esivumelwaneni, lapho Simakadze abewisela khona uMosesi ukuba akwenze nalabaSiraretthi echarweni laMoabi, ngaphandle kwesivumelwano sakhe nelaboSirabethi lapho eMfula iSinayi.
Mosesi wahlangana nabo bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli, watsi kubo: "Lamehlo enu akubona konke lokuyenzile uSimakadze eMijiphu kuFaro, nakubo bonke labakhonzi bakhe, nelizwe lakhe lonke.
Wabona inkinga enkulu, nezimpawu, nezinto ezimangalisayo ezinkulu.
Kodwa-ke, Simakadze akazange akunikeni intliziyo yekuqonda, namehlo ekubona, namehlo ekukhuluma, kuze kube ngalolusuku.
Kwaba minyaka lemashumi mane ngibe nihamba ngetfu emhlabatsini; kuleso simo, tigqoko takho azigcotshwanga, netinyawo takho atigcotshwenga.
Ningeke nidle inhlama, ningeke niphuze iwayini, noma yini leyimfishane, kutsi nibone ukuthi yena uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu.
Bafika lapha, baphuma kuSihoni, ukumkani waseHeshboni, neOgi, ukumkani waseBashani, kutsi bahlangane nathi; kodvwa sababulala.
Siye siyithathe itfu, sayisanikela kumadvodzana aRubeni, nemadvodzakati eGadi, kanye nesihlanu semndeni waManase.
Hamba ugcine amazwi lalowo mhlangano, uyawuwagcina, ukuze ube nempumelelo kulo lonke lokuya kukwenza.
Lowo usuku niwe bonke nibekwe phambi koYehova uNkulunkulu wenu, wena nomndeni wakho, nabangani bakho, nabasebenzi bakho, nalowo wonke indodana kaSirayeli,
nalabancane bakho, nemadvodzakati akho, nalowo mkhwenyana lohlala emgwaqeni wakho, lowo utsatsa umkhonto wakho, lowo ufaka amanzi akho.
Uhlala lapha, ufike ungene emshadweni naSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, emshadweni loyawukwenza nawe namuhla, kanye nemtsetfo wakhe.
namuhla utawukwenza ube ngumuntfu wakhe, naye abe nguNkulunkulu wakho, njengobe wakusho kuwe, kanye nalabo babatfu bakho, Abrahami, neIsakha, naYakobi.
Ngiyakwenza lesivumelwano, kanye nemtsetfo wayo, nawe kuphela
labo labakhona lapha nathi namuhla phambi kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu, kanye nalabo abasebangakho lapha nathi namuhla.
Niyazi kutsi sahlala kanjani eMijiphu, nendlela lesingangene ngayo emiphakathini yebantfu lapho safika khona.
Wabona titfo tabo, netibondza babo, emacwecwe, nematshe, nesilivere, negolide.

Angeke kube khona phakathi kwenu namuhla indoda, noma indodakazi, noma umndeni, noma luhlanga, lomphefumulo walo losuka kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wethu, ahambe abe ngumnikelo wekushiswa kuma-Israyeli; angeke kube khona phakathi kwenu imbewu lephumako umkhuhlane.

"Lawo muntfu, uma ekhuluma amazwi lalelo livi, angeke abe nekuthula enhliziyweni yakhe, bese esho kutsi: 'Ngiyawukhululeka, nakuba ngihlala ngihamba ngendlela yami.' Ngako kutawufika umonakalo emhlabatsini kanye nemhlabatsini.

Simakadze angeke afune ukumsindzisa, kepha umsindo wakhe kanye nebuhlungu bakhe kulowo muntu buyawudlidliza njengephunga; nalo lonke lokulamato lokubhalwe kulo ncwadi luya kuba phezu kwawo; Nkulunkulu utawucisha igama lakhe ngaphansi kwezulu.
Simakadze utawubahlukanisa nabo kusuka kuwo wonke lamasiko aseSirayeli, abe yingozi kubo, ngeso sonke silamalelo sesivumelwano esibhalwe kulo mbhalo wemtsetfo.
Labantwana bakho labayawuphuma ngemuva kwenu, kanye nalowo mkhwenyana loyawufika emhlabatsini lokude, batawubona indlala yelizwe, nesifo lesibulalayo leSimakadze abesilethela kuso.

Lemhlaba wonke uzoba ngumlilo we-sulfure ne-salt; ngeke kube khona into encibilikayo, noma ikhulayo, noma imiklamo ephumayo, njengekushiswa kweSodoma neGomora, neAdma neZeboyi, lapho Simakadze abewubhubhisa ngayo emlonyeni wakhe.
Nawo wonke lamazwe atawuti, 'Ngubani na lowo Nkulunkulu lowenza lokhu kulelizwe? Ngubani na lowo ubuhlungu bakhe?'
Batsi: Ngako-ke, ngobe bashiya isivumelwano saSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, nalabababa babo, abesenza nabo, lapho wabakhipha khona ezweni leMijiphu.
Baye bahamba, bakhonza ema-gods lamanye, bawunikela kubo, ma-gods abengawakholwanga, nema-gods angeke awanike wona uSimakadze.
Ngako-ke umsindo waSimakadze wehla phezu kwalolu mhlaba, watsi: "Lapha kuyawufika lonke lokubi lokubhalwe kulolu ncwadi."
Ngako-ke uSimakadze wabasusa ezweni labo, wababeka emhlabatsini lolunye, kuze kube namuhla, ngemphiko nebuhlungu betfu.
Lezinto letifihlakeleko tikhona kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wethu; kepha lezinto atfumelelana tona nabana bethu kuze kube sekupheleni, kutsi sigcine sonke sakhuluma ngaleso mthetho.
Nalapho zonke lezi zinto, inhlekelele nalelo langa, ngitibeke phambi kwakho, zifike kuwe, utawuzikhumbula phakathi kwebantfu lapho Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, atakusakaza khona.
bese ubuyela kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, wena nemadvodzana akho, bese ulandzela amazwi akhe ngentliziyo yakho yonke, nangemphefumulo wakho wonke, nikwenza konke lokudla lokushiwo namuhla;
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, utawukubuyisela ekuhambeni kwakho, utawukusinikela kuwe, utakuhlanganisa kusuka kuwo wonke lamazwe lapho ayawukususa khona.
Nakuba lomunye walabo ababoshwa bakho ekugcineni kwemhlaba ngaphansi kwesibhakabhaka, Simakadze Nkulunkulu wakho utawukuqoqa nalapho, nawe utakubuyisela.
Simakadze Nkulunkulu wakho utawukukhipha ezweni labababuleki bakho, nawe utawulihlala; uyawukwenza kube ngcono kuwe, nawe utawukuba mkhulu kunabababuleki bakho.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, uyawushintsha intliziyo yakho, nentliziyo yemadvodzana akho, ukuze umthande ngentliziyo yakho yonke, nangemphefumulo wakho wonke, nawe uphile.
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, utawubeka la macala onke enkundleni yalabo belandzabo, labo labakukhohlisayo, labekubonise wena.
"Niyawubuyela nilalela ilizwi leSimakadze, nigcine tonkhe timiso takhe letitsi: 'Ngikuvumeleni kutsi uhambe.'

Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, utawukwenza uphumelele kuwo wonke umsebenzi wesandla sakho; utawukubambisana nawe ngemindeni yakho, nemfuyo yakho, nekudla kwakho. UNkulunkulu uya kubuyela ekubumbeni kwakho okuhle, njengobe wababulela bobaba bakho,

uma ulalela lizwi laSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, ugcina imiyalo yakhe nemithetho yakhe lebhalwe kulo ncwadi yomthetho, uma ubuyela kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho ngentliziyo yakho yonke nemoya yakho yonke.
Lemtsetfo lowutsi ngiwukhuluma kuwe namuhla, awunzima kakhulu kuwe, ungeke uwufinyelele.
Asisezulu, ukuze utsi: Nguwuphi lowo loyawufika emhlabatsini, afike atithole, aze atikhulumele, kutsi siyigcine?
Nakho angeke kube ngaphesheya komfula, ukuze utsi: Nguwuphi lowo loyawudlula emfuleni, afike atithole, aze atikhulumele, kutsi sikwenze?
La mazwi angeke afike kuwe, kepha akhona emphinjeni yakho nasenhliziyweni yakho, ukuze utawuwulandzela.
"Lamuhla, ngitibeka phambi kwakho kutsi ukhethe phakathi kwekuphila nekuhle, kanye nemshado nebi.

ngobe ngikutshele namuhla, ukuthi uphile uSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, uhambe ngendlela yakhe, ugcine imiyalo yakhe, nemithetho yakhe, namasiko akhe, ukuze uhlale uphila, ukhule ukhule, nawe-ke unguNkulunkulu wakho, lowo utawukubambisana nawe ezweni lenu lokuya kulo, nilithathe.
Ngako-ke, uma intliziyo yakho ibuyela emuva, utsi awufuni kulalela, bese ukhohlwa, uyawubuka ema-gods labanye, ube nabo;
ngobe ngitsi kuwe lilanga lenu, kutsi niyawulahleka; ningahlala isikhathi eside emhlabatsini lowudlula kuwo iJordane utawuwuthola.

Namuhla ngikhuluma ngamehlo ezulu nemhlaba kutsi kube ngubufakazi labani, kutsi sengikulethela phambi kwakho kuphila nekufa, nekubambisana nekulahlekelwa; ngobe ukhethe kuphila, ukuze uphile wena nabantwana bakho.

Kuye ukhethe kukuthanda Simakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, ube ngumkhonzi wakhe, uyene naye; ngobe uNkulunkulu ngukuphila kwakho, nawe utawukunika iminyaka eminingi phezu kwelizwe lakhe, lakazange akhulume nababa bakho, uAbrahama, noIsake, noYakobi, kutsi liyawubanikela.
Mosese waya, wakhuluma lamazwi lawa kuwo onkhe emadvodzana a-Israyeli.
watsi kubo: "Ngineminyaka lemakhulu lamashumi mahlanu, namuhla; angeke ngihlale ngihamba niphuma niya endlwini yenu; Simakadze utsi: 'Utadlulanga loMfula iJordani.'
Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, yena loyawudlula phambi kwakho; yena loyawubulala lamazwe lawa phambi kwakho, nawe utawuwanaka. Joshua, lowo uyadlula phambi kwenu, njengobe Simakadze abekusho.
Simakadze utawubasebentisa njengobe wakwenta kuSihoni neOgi, bantfu baka-Amori, labo abehlukumeza nabo kanye nelizwe labo.
Simakadze utawubanikela phambi kwenu, nawe uyawukwenta kubo konkhe loku ngikutshele ngalo.
Bakhombiseni ukuthula nemandla, ningabacobeli, ngobe Simakadze, Nkulunkulu wakho, uyahamba nawe; akakushiya, angeke akushiye.

UMosi wabiza uJoshua, watsi kuye phambi kwalabo bonkhe baseSirayeli: "Beka sandla sakho esiqinile, ube nekuthula; ngobe wena utawufika nalaba bantu ezweni loSimakadze abesho lababuphikisi babo kutsi ubanike lona; nawe utawubanikela ngalo njengelifa labo.
Simakadze, yena lohamba phambi kwakho, lowo utawube nawe; akakushiya, angeke akushiye; ungabi nenkinga, ungenambitheki."
UMosese wabhala lomthetho, wawunikela kubaLevi labangcwele, lababeka ibhokisi lesivumelwane saSimakadze, kanye nalabaphathi bonke baseSirayeli.
Musa wabaphendvula watsi: "Ekupheleni kweminyaka lesikhombisa, kumnyaka wekubuyisana, ngemnyaka wekusihlwa setibondza,
lapho bayawufika khona bonkhe labaSirayeli, bevela phambi kwaSimakadze Nkulunkulu wakho, endaweni leyawuyikhethela; wena utawufunda lomthetho kulo tonkhe tive taSirayeli emlonyeni wabo.

Sihlanganise bantfu, lamadoda nabesifazane nalabancane, kanye nesitatimelwane sakho esihlala ezindaweni zakho, ukuze balalele, bafunde, babe nekuthula kuSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, bagcine baphumele kuwo wonke amazwi walomthetho.

Nabantwana babo, labangeke bakwazi lomthetho lonjalo, bangawulalela, bafunde kutsi babe nekuthula naSimakadze Nkulunkulurettwana,charo nihlale emhlabatsini lenu lokuya kulo, kuleyo lwandle laseJordane.
USimakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Lamuhla kufike isikhathi sakho sokufa; vula uJoshua, uye etentini lekuhlangana, ngitawumumisa khona." Waya ke uMosi naJoshua, wahlala etentini lekuhlangana.
USimakadze wehla etentini, emgodini wemvula; nemvula yahlala emehlweni emnyango wetenti.

USimakadze watsi kuMosesi: "Uyalala nababa bakho, bese lebantfu laba bahamba bephazamisa imiyalo yami; baya kulandela bokhokho babo balomhlaba lapho bephuma khona, bamishiya, baphula umnqophiso wami lowawubambisene nawo.

Ngaleso sikhathi umsindo wami utawuphuma kuwo, ngiyawuwashiya, newufihla ibuso bam kuye, aze aphelelwe yindlala; khona-ke kuyawufika ekuphazamisekeni kanye nasenhliziyweni yakhe. Utatsi ngalolusuku: Akukhona kutsi loNkulunkulu wethu awukho emehlweni ethu, ngobe sifike kuso lesi senzo?
Nami ngiyawufihla u Arena, ngalomhla lowo, ngenxa yebubi bakhe bonke, lapho bebuya khona ema-Israyeli kulabo boNkulunkulu.
Ngako-ke, bhaleni lengoma lesi, niyifundise bantfu beSirayeli, bayicwengele, ibe ngubufakazi bami kubo.

Ngitawubafaka ezweni lelingena lobisi nemvubelo, lapho ngiyenzile khona umyalelo kubabuphi bakhe; bayawudla, babuye babe mkhulu, bese bebuyela emangcweleni amanye, babambisene nabo, bangeke bamithande, bazama ukuphula inhlangano yami.

Nalapho kuyawufika khona lokubi kakhulu kubo, kanye nezinkinga eziningi, lengoma lenjalo itawuhlala ibe ngubufakazi kubo; ngobe lomndeni wabo awutawukhohlwa. Namanje ngiyawazi imicabango yabo, ngaphambi kokuba bafike ezweni labengingabakhipha kulo ngatsi:
UMosese wabhala lengoma ngalolo lilanga, wabafundisa bantfu be-Israyeli.
USimakadze watsi kuJoshua, umsa wa-Nun: "Beka sandla sakho esiqinile, ube nekuthula; ngobe wena utawubeka bantfu beSirayeli ezweni lengingabanikela ngalo ngesandla sami, nami ngizoba nawe."
Mosi waphela ebhalela emavesi lalowo mthetho encwadini, kusukela ekuqalekeni kuya kukuphela kwayo.
USolomoni watsi kulabo labaLevi, lababambe ibhokisi lesivumelwane saSimakadze:
Nithathe lelibhuku lemtsetfo, nilibeke ecaleni lebhokisi lesivumelwano saSimakadze Nkulunkulu wenu, lihlale khona, libe ngubufakazi kuwe.
ngobe ngiyazi isandla sakho esijulile, nemilenze yakho eqinile. Namanje-ke lapho sengiphila nihlala khona, ningakholwani kuSimakadze; ngaleso sikhathi sekufa kwami ningakholwanga na?
Sihlanganise nami bonkhe labaholi bemindeni yenu, nalabaphathi bakho bonke, kutsi ngikhulume nabo lamazwi lawa, ngitsi: "Lizulu nemhlaba liyawuba ngumshushisi labani.

ngobe ngiyazi kutsi ngemuva kwekufa kwami, niyawuphazamiseka kakhulu, niyawusuka kuleyo ndlela labengisabawise ngayo; khona-ke lenkinga itawufika kuwe emavikini aphesheya, uma nikwenza lokudla lokubi emehloni kaSimakadze, kutsi nimukhabe ngemisebenzi yezandla zenu.
Mose wakhuluma kuwo wonke lamazwi lengoma, aqala kutsi aphele, kuye kulo lonke libandla lakaJuda.
Lingisa, lizulu, ngitakhuluma; lalela, umhlaba, amazwi emilomo yami.
Lemfundiso yami ifike njengemvula, nemazwi ami afike njengamagwaca, njengemvula lencane emhlabatsini, kanye nekugwaca kwemvula emlonyeni.
Ngitakhuluma igama laSimakadze, nitsi: Livuke likhulu leNkulunkulu wethu!
UNkulunkulu ngumlilo, nemisebenzi yakhe ilungile; yonke imisebenzi yakhe ingumtsetfo. UNkulunkulu uthembekile, akabi nebubi; ungcwele, ulungile.
Baye bakwenza lokubi kuye; ngenxa yesono sabo, bangabengabantwana bakhe. Lihlobo lelingenakubekezelelani nalelikhohlakelayo.
Ngaye-ke niyawunikela njalo kuSimakadze, Nkulunkulu wema-Israyeli, lowo muntfu longeke acabange? Akufanele yini kutsi abe nguBaba wakho, lowo wakwenza wena, lowo wamdzala nawe, lowo watfumisa nawe?
Khumbula lilanga leminyaka lengemuva, cabanga ngemnyaka lodlule. Buza ubaba wakho, naye utawukutshela; buza bomkhuluwa bakho, nabo baya kukusho kuwe.
"Lengasephakeme, lapho enikela khona ema-Israyeli ngemhlaba wabo, lapho ehlukanise khona umhlaba webantfu, wabeka imikhawulo yalabo bantu ngenani lamadvodza aseSirayeli.
Ngako-ke iminikelo yekushiswa yaSimakadze yinye yebantfu bakhe, naYakobi yinye yemnikelo wakhe lokhethiwe.
Wamuthola emhlabatsini, emhlabatsini lolusizi, emhlabatsini lwesivunguvungu. Wamuvikela, wamgcina, wamgcobisa njengetingulube tamehlo akhe.
Njenge-eagle ekhulisa inkemba yakhe, ehamba phezulu emacandza akhe, wafaka imilenze yakhe kutsi awagcwabe, wabathwala ngemikhono yakhe.
Simakadze, yena kuphela loyawumphatha; angeke kubekho Nkulunkulu wesikhashana naye.
Wamuhambalisa emadolobheni aphakeme emhlaba, wakudla impahla yemhlabatsi; wabanikela ngejusi lephuma emfuleni, nephethroli lesuka entaba-mlilo.
Nasekudla kwengulube, nasemajikijolo emindenini lemincane, nemafutha emagilebhisi kanye nemakhowe, nama-otini amasha aseBashani, nemfuyo yemhlabatsi; wadla iwayini elihlanganisiwe.
UJeshurin wakhula, waba mkhulu; wena ukhule, waba mkhulu, waba mkhulu kakhulu. Wayishiya iNkosi yakhe loyawuyenza, wayalela intaba yakhe leyawuyisa.
Baye bavusa umsindo wakhe ngemingcwele yekwamanye amazwe, batfusa umlomo wakhe ngezinto tabo letibi.
Banikela ngesondlo kuma-demon, angeke abe nguNkulunkulu; banikela ngesondlo ema-gods labengawaboni, nema-gods lamasha lafika, lama-gods labebaba bakho bangawahloniphi.
Uyawulibala iNtaba, lowo waba ngumzali wakho; uyawulibala Nkulunkulu, lowo watfumisa wena.
UNkulunkulu wakubona, wababi kakhulu nabo, ngobe labantwana bakhe nemadvodzakati akhe abemkhonta.
Wathi, Ngiyawufihla ubuso bam kubo, ngibone kutsi kuzoba yini ekugcineni kwabo; ngobe basuku lokudlwengulayo, bantwana abangeke bathembeke.

Bamimisa emilonyeni yami ngento lengeke ibe nguNkulunkulu, bamimisa emlonyeni wami ngezinto zabo ezingenalutho; ngobe ngibamisimisa emilonyeni yabo ngento lengeke ibe yilizwe, ngibamisimisa emlonyeni wabo ngelizwe elingaqondi.
Ngako-ke mlilo uphuma emlonyeni wami, usuka eGibhithe, ufika eShebhoni; uyawudla umhlaba kanye nekudla kwalo, utawubulala isisekelo semadolobheni.
Ngitabeka emavi abo phezu kwabo, ngiya kusebentisa tonkhe tive tami kubo.
Bayawufa ngendlala, batawudla lilanga lemlilo kanye negciwane; ngobe ngitathumela kubo tilwane temhlabatsini letinemikhono yabo, natinyoka temhlabatsini letihamba ngenkungu.
Langaphandle, isandla sitawubulala labantwana babo; ngaphakathi kwendlu yabo, kuyawufika umfutho. Amakhosikazi nemadvodzakati abo, nalabo labancane kanye nalabo abakhulu, bayafa.
Ngitsi: "Ngitawubasusa ngaphesheya kwemhlaba, ngiwucishe lomlando wabo wonke emhlaba.
Nami ngakhathazeka, ngobe ngicabanga kutsi lababi babo bangatsi, bangatsi lababi babo bakhuluma ngesigebengu, bangati, Ngemandla ethu siyawubiswa; Simakadze akazange akwenze lokhu konke.
ISirayeli inhlanga lesingacabangi, Akukho kuqonda kubo.
Babe nengqondo, babone lokhu, bacabange kutsi yini leyawuba khona ekugcineni kwabo!
Ingabe lomunye uyawuphazamisa lamakhulu, noma lababini batfusa lamakhulu lamashumi lamabili? Uma iNtaba yabo ingabathengisile, uma Nkulunkulu angeke abewanikela.
Ngako-ke mlilo wabo awufana nemlilo wethu, ngobe nalabo batfutsi bethu bayavuma.
Iwayini labo livela evini leSodoma, nemhlabatsi weGomorra; iwayini labo ligcwele umkhuhlane, kanye nemajikijolo abo abuhlungu.
Lewayini labo lifana nemphimbo yetingulube, nemphimbo lebulalayo yetibopho.
Ngayigcina yini le nto, ngiyigcine ngesandla sami, ngayifihla emagumbini ami?
Ngami kutsi ngibuyele, ngami kutsi ngisabalalise; ngesikhathi saso inyawo labo lingeke likhululeke; ngobe usuku lwakhe lokudlwengula luhlelekile, nekufa kwabo kuyawufike kubo.

UYehova uya kulungisa icala labantu bakhe, nalowo lowo osebenza naye uyawuxolisa, lapho ebona khona ukuthi amandla abo aphelelwe yisikhathi, futhi akukho mntu ozoshiywa, nokuba ngumkhonto noma ngumholi.
Utawuti, "Kuphi naNkulunkulu wabo, lomtfubi lapho baphuma khona behlala khona,
labo labadla ubisi lwemithende yabo, labadla umhluzi wetibondza tabo; bangase bafike bakhombise wena, bangakuvikela wena!
Namuhla ubone kutsi ngimi; akukho Nkulunkulu ngaphandle kwami. Ngiye lobulalayo, kanye nelowo laphilayo; ngiyabambisana nalabo labaphazamisayo; angeke kube khona lowo angasindisa ngesandla sami.
Ngiphakamisa isandla sami esibhakabhakeni, ngikhuluma kutsi: Ngabe ngiphila kuze kube sekupheleni,
lapho ngitawutsimbisa khona isandla sami, ngiyibambe ngemtsetfo; ngobe ngitabalalisa kulabo baholi bami, nangebabikela labo labancumisa.
Ngitabeka emacwecwe ami egazi, nesandla sami sitawudla inyama, igazi lalabo labafayo nalababoshwe, kanye nenhloko yabaholi bebubi babo.
Lala, nimasiko, nabantu bakhe; ngobe utawubabuyisela labo babulala labakhonzi bakhe; utawubasusa labavukeli bakhe; uyawuhlanza umhlaba wakhe nebantfu bakhe.
Mosese wafika, wakhuluma tonkhe tincwadzi tekucala titsi "tingoma" emlonyeni wema-Israyeli, yena naJoshua unyana waNun.
Watsi lapho Mosese ephelela kutsi akhulume lamazwi lawa kuwo onkhe ema-Israyeli,
watsi kubo: "Niyibeke engqondweni yenu yonke lemiyalo engikhuluma ngayo kwenu namuhla, niyikhulume nabantwana benu, kutsi bagcine bayenze yonke lemigaqo yalomthetho.
Uma nikwenza njalo, nizohlala isikhathi eside ezweni lenu elidlulayo eJordani, ukuze ningabi nelungelo lokulithola.' " Wathi kubo: "Imigomo yalowo mhlaba ilungile kakhulu.
Simakadze wakhuluma kuMosesi ngalolusuku, watsi:
"Suka ufike emadolobheni eAbarim, emfuleni weNebo waseMoabi, lobekwe ngaseJerikho, ubone ilizwe laseKanana, lelizwe labengingabanikela ngalo bantfu baseSirayeli kutsi babe nelifa.
Ufike ufile kulomhlabatsini lapho uphuma khona, uhlangane nebantfu bakho labafile phambi kwakho, njengobe u-Aron, umngane wakho, washona emnceleni weHori, wahlangane nabo.
ngobe ningibekezelele emehlo lamakhosi aseSirayeli, ngamanzi eMeriba yaseKadeshe, entaba-mlilo yeCini; ningamingcwele phakathi kwamadvodza aseSirayeli.
Uyawuyibona lelizwe ngemehlo akho kuphela, ngobe ungeke ufike ezweni labengisalinikela kuboSirayeli.
Lowo ngumnikelo wesono loMosi, indodana yaNkulunkulu, wanikela kuboSirayeli ngaphambi kwekufa kwakhe.
Watsi: "UNkulunkulu wafika emfuleni iSinayi, waphuma kubo njengelanga eSeiri, wakhanya emfuleni iParan; wafika namakhulu lamakhulu langcwele, ngesandla sakhe sokudla abe nemlilo wemlilo wabo.
Uyawuthanda kakhulu abantu bakhe; bonke labangcwele bakhe bakhona esandla sakho; bangase bakhonze emadolo akho, nabo bonke bayakwamukela amazwi akho.
Mosesi watsi: "UMosese utfumele mthetho kutsi ube ngumnikelo wesono kumndeni waYakobi."
Simakadze waba ngubukhosi eJeshuruni, lapho behlangana khona bomkhuluwa babantfu, naletinye tihlanganiso teSirayeli.
URubhene uhlale ephila, ungafanga, nabantfu bakhe bangabi nenani elikhulu.
Lawo lamazwi akhuluma ngaYuda, watsi: "Linikele, Simakadze, inkulumo yaJuda, uyibuyisele ebantwini bakhe; ngesandla sakhe sakhe uyawubhekana naye; umkhonze kulabo abamfutsi bakhe."
Wathi kuLevi: "UNkulunkulu, iThummim yakho ne-Urim yakho yiye umkhonzi wakho lothembekile; uyawumuhlola eMasa, uyawuwubulalela emaveni eMeriba.
Wathi kubaba wakhe namama wakhe: "Angeke ngibacabangele." Akazange abeke icala labazalwane bakhe, noma licala lemadvodzana akhe; ngobe labaLevi balalela amazwi akho, bagcina umnhlanga wakho.
Bafundisa uYakobi imiyalo yakho, nemtsetfo wakho kuSirayeli; banikela ngefutfuma phambi kwakho, neminikelo yekushiswa engcwelelweni yakho.
UNkulunkulu, buyisa yonke imicabango yakhe, ube nekuthula emisebenzini yesandla sakhe; cindezela umlenze walelabo labaphuma naye; hlasele labo abamchukumisayo, ukuze bangavuki.
NgeBenjamini watsi: "Lomthandekayo kuSimakadze, ahlale ephephile ngaye; Simakadze uyawumuvikela nsuku zonke, naye lowo umthandayo kuSimakadze uhlala emehlweni akhe.
NgoYosefu watsi: "Simakadze uyawubarisisa lelizwe lakhe ngezinto ezinhle zezulu, ngamanzi aphansi, nangesibhakabhaka esiphakeme.
Kuye kube nekudla lokuhle lokutfunywa ngulilanga kanye nekudla lokuhle lokutfolwa inyanga ngayinye,
ngetipho letingcono kakhulu temifula yakudala, nemandla emahlombe lahlala njalo,

Nabo bonke labangcwele, kanye nezinto letinene zemhlaba naleyo yonke into ekhona kulo; nabo bonkhe labaholi bebantfu baphindze babe ngasenhloko yaJosefu. 21Batsi: "UNkulunkulu uyawunikela ngemandla akhe kuwo wonke amadolobha aseGibhithe"

Ubuhle bakhe bufana nengulube ezalwa kuqala, kanye namahlombe akhe afana namahlombe engulube yemhlaba; ngawo utawuphazamisa lamazwe, kuze kube kumaphenyane ehlabathini. Lokho kumakhulu lamakhulu eEfraim, nakumakhulu lamakhulu eManase.
Watsi kuZebuloni: "Lingisa, Zabuloni, lapho uphuma khona; nawe, Issakari, ematenteni akho.
Bayawucela abantu emadolobheni, batawunikela khona ngeminikelo yangempela; bazodla ngezinto ezinhle zelwandle, nempahla egcinwe emthethweni.
Wathi kuGadi: "Ungcwele lowo lowukhulule mhlaba waGadi; Gadi uhlala khona njengalelinyoni, libulala imilenze nenhloko.
Wayikhetha itfu lelihle kakhulu lemhlaba, wagcina ingxenye yakhe yebukhosi; lapho behlangana khona bomkhuluwa babantu, waba nemtsetfo waSimakadze, namasiko akhe eSirayeli.
NgeDani watsi: "Dani ngumnyaka mncane weLion, uphuma eBashan."
Wathi ngaNaphtali: "Naphtali, ugcwele inhlonipho kaSimakadze, ugcwele kutfunywa kwakhe; utawulima iNingizimu neNtshonalanga yelizwe."
Wathi ku-Asere: "U-Asere ungcwele kunabo bonkhe bantfu; kumele abe ngumthandela wabazalwane bakhe, nemhlaba wakhe kufanele ube mkhulu ngamafutha e-olive.
Leminyango yakho ibe yinye yensimbi neyesiliva, nemandla akho abe ngumnyaka wekutfutwa kwakho.
Angeke kube khona lowo ufana noNkulunkulu waseJeshuruni, lohamba ngetibhakabhaka kutsi akusize, ehamba ngetibhakabhaka ngemandla akhe.
LoNkulunkulu wasekufeni, lowo ngcwele wakho, kanye nemilenze yakhe lehlala njalo ingaphansi kwakho; yena loyawukhipha umfowabo phambi kwakho, watsi: "Khumbulana nabo."
IsiSirayeli siyawuhlala siphephile, nemndeni waYakobi utawuhlala ekahle, ezweni lelibomvu kanye newayini elisha, lapho imvula yezulu iphuma khona.

Uphile, Israele! Nguwuphi lofana nawe, abantu abakhululwe nguSimakadze, umkhonzi wakho, nomsindisi wakho, nesandla sakho sobukhosi? Abaholi bakho bangakuhlabela, wena utawuhamba phezu kwezindawo zabo eziphakeme.
UMosese wehla emahlathini eMoabi, waya emfuleni weNebo, phezulu kwePisga, enkabeni yeJerikho; Simakadze wambonisa khona lelizwe lonke, kusuka eGileyadi kuya eDani.
tonkhe tive taNef Arenati, nemhlaba wema-Eframu nawaseManasethi, nemhlaba wonke waYuda începutsa kulwandle lwaseMpumalanga,
kanye neNegebhi enyakatho, naleyo ndzawo lephansi yaseJerikho, lomhlabatsi wesihlahla sePalme, kuze kufike eSoari.

USimakadze watsi kuye: "Leli yilizwe labengingatsi ngesandla sami ku-Abrahama, ku-Isake, nakubo-Yakobi, ngitsi: 'Ngiyitawunikela etulungwini lwakho.' Ngikuvumele uyibone ngamehlo akho, kepha awungeke ufike kuyo."
Wafa khona Mosi, umkhonzi waSimakadze, eMoabi, njengobe Simakadze abesho.
Wayemfihla efulani laseMoabi, ngaphesheya kweBhete-peori; kodvwa akukho muntu lowaziyo ithempeli lakhe kuze kuleso sikhathi.
Musa ubeneminyaka lengema-120 ubudala lapho afe khona; mehlo akhe akazange anikele, wahlala enamandla.
Baphindze babulale uMosese emahlathini eMoab, iminyaka lemashumi lamane; kuze kube kuphele izinsuku zokulala nebulula kwaMosi.
UJoshua, unyana wa-Nun, wapheliswa ngumoya webwenge; ngobe Mosesi abemise isandla sakhe phezu kwakhe; bonkhe bantfu baseSirayeli bamlalela, bakwenza njengobe Simakadze abewisela Mose.
Ngaleso sikhathi akazange abuyele eSirayeli umprofeti lofana naMosesi, lowo Simakadze abewukhuluma naye ngemehlo akhe.
Akazange akhulume nalinye lamaphawu, nanoma iyiphi imicabango emibi, lapho Simakadze abemuthumela khona eYiputa kutsi ayenze ngayo kuFaro, nakubaholi bakhe bonke, nelizwe lakhe lonke.
Angeke kube khona muntfu lowenzako isandla sakhe esikhulu, noma ekwenzeni izinto letibuhlungu, njengobe uMosese abezenza phambi kwalabaSirayeli bonke.
